title: Angular Software Engineer
description:
Angular Software Engineer
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too.Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.500 professionals in Greece, and is listed in Greece's Top Employers, Great Place to Work and Best Workplaces for Women for 2024! Experience great flexibility, under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki, while benefiting from personalized learning and career development opportunities. We prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where everyone's unique perspectives are valued, that supports you in building an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. The opportunityWe are currently seeking highly motivated persons to work as Software Engineers for our IT Consulting, a leading provider of Technology services to large corporate clients of all industries. As a member of our team:
You will have a significant technical contribution to large-scale implementation projects
You will be given the opportunity to work and take responsibility in challenging engagements in Greece and abroad
Your ability to learn and apply advanced Technology solutions, will give you the opportunity to grow professionally and participate in the design and deployment of leading-edge technologies.

Skills and attributes for success To qualify for the role you must have

A Bachelor's degree in one of the fields of Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other related discipline
Ability to work as a team member
Self-motivated to contribute with your own ideas - showcase the feasibility and benefits with a proof of concept and document your cutting edge solution
Experience in Java or other object-oriented programming language
Completed military obligations (where applicable)

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience in SQL and PL/SQL
Working experience with at least one RDBMS e.g. Oracle (preferably), SQL Server, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL etc.
Familiarity with IDE tools e.g. JDeveloper (preferably), Visual Studio etc.
Knowledge and/or experience with web services (SOAP, JSON/REST)
Knowledge and/or experience with Oracle ADF
Knowledge and/or experience with Angular, Ionic or Node.js
Knowledge and/or experience with source control software (e.g. GIT, SVN, TFS)
Ability to design and develop solutions with business users (feel free to include relevant project and profile links, like GitHub, Kaggle or Stack Overflow)
Work experience either in Insurance sector, or in a solution provider environment engaged with Insurance projects implementation

What we look for What's most important is that you're dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You'll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You'll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the
confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you've got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you. What we offer What we offer
Competitive remuneration package: You'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Depending on your experience, our comprehensive rewards package includes benefits that suit your needs including cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health insurance scheme, life insurance, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. 
Flexible working arrangements: We operate under a hybrid working model, which is defined based on both your own preferences and team's needs, and we enjoy our summers with short Fridays.
Personalized learning experience and career development: We provide free and unlimited access to educational platforms and EY Badges, support certifications, and provide coaching and feedback, as a part of our Leadership & Development process, all of which can lead to a meaningful impact and success as defined by you.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
International Experience: Become part of international projects and work along multicultural teams, through our global network.
Above all, you will be working in one of the most recognized employers in Greece, as we have been awarded the Top Employers, Great Place to Work and Best Workplaces for Women awards for 2024.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. Apply now.EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. #betterworkingworld #LI-Hybrid

title: Frontend Engineer (Angular) Mid-Senior
description: Company DescriptionWe are Netcompany-Intrasoft, a member of Netcompany Group A/S, and a leading European IT Solutions and Services company with strong international presence and expertise, dedicated to responsible digitalisation. We offer innovative and added-value solutions of the highest quality to a wide range of public and private organizations, while being a key-player in the EU Institutions for the past 30 years. We hold an outstanding record of 500+ organizations in 70+ countries, that have chosen our solutions and services, to fulfil their business needs. Our team of 3500+ professionals is our driving force and our most valuable asset.Job DescriptionEver wondered what it feels like to be a Front End Developer (Angular) in Netcompany-Intrasoft? As a Front-end Developer, you will be a member of team responsible for designing, developing and testing in order to create software solutions aligned to the needs of the business and external customers. The role requires developed and strong foundation of web-development skills and good knowledge of relevant technologies.As a Frontend Developer you will:Able to take ownership, accountability and initiativeDetail-driven, able to take constructive criticismStrong analytical-thinker and problem-solverCommunicative and team playerQualificationsWhat would make you a fit for the role:University degree in Computer Science or Electrical EngineeringAt least 2 years of Javascript experienceAt least 1 year of Angular (version 2 or greater) development experience, or some other relevant framework (Backbone.js, AngularJS, viewJS, react)Knowledge of the interaction between JavaScript, HTML and CSS.Ability to create, modify, and style elements on a page with ease and can also do this dynamicallyAbility to analyse visual designs into design patternsStrong knowledge in MVC ArchitectureKnowledge of version control softwareExperience consuming RESTful API'sGood command of the English Language (written & verbal)It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:Cross browser experience, working with backwards compatibility with graceful degradationExperience in Bootstrap and responsive web application developmentFamiliarity with backend development, understanding application layersExperience writing RESTful API's and fully understanding the RESTful architecture and goalsA background in design or appreciation of good design and UXExperience with SQL and being comfortable with querying databaseAdditional InformationBeing a part of the Netcompany-Ιntrasoft team, you will be provided with: The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working modelA seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first stepsA competitive compensation & benefits packageHealth and life insurance programMeal and commuting allowanceWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)A personalized development plan for targeted career growthIf you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!By joining Netcompany-Intrasoft Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2000+ tech enthusiasts. When at the office you will have the chance to work at our brand-new, state-of-the-art, sustainable offices, located in 3 different spots in Athens!Our cultureOur people are the most important element of our success. Our work life is well defined by our set of fundamental Values: https://netcompany.com/careers/greece/our-values/ #BePartOfSomethingGreat!Please submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany-Intrasoft culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our our everyday working experience.

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
Role Summary
Pfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with academic and/or work experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. The SE analyzes specifications, designs logic, writes code, customizes products, unit tests, debugs, and documents software applications. The SE participates in agile team events and works within the agile team framework.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.
Role Responsibilities

Works within project teams as a contributor to design, prototype, implement and unit test software solutions in support of the project objectives.
Works as a senior developer on small-to-medium size software development projects, which may include accountability for the work of a small number of other junior and/or contract Software Engineers, as well as responsibility for dictating and managing coding standards, coding best practices, source code control approaches, versioning, etc.
Translates logical designs of user/system interfaces into physical designs, considering the target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
Helps produce detailed design specifications where applicable, and documents all work using required standards, methods, and tools, including prototyping tools, where appropriate.
Conducts reviews of supplied specifications as appropriate.
Defines the integration build and produces a build definition for generation of the software.
Work in a matrix, team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers.

Qualifications
Education:

Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering, Information Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other scientific or engineering discipline.

Prior Experience:

Minimum of 3 years of experience as a software developer/engineer.

Required Capabilities and Experience:

Facilitation, negotiating and presentation skills.
Experience working in ambiguous situations.
Demonstrated experience and skills in analysis and problem solving.
Demonstrated ability to developing multi-tiered solutions using multiple programming languages and web technologies including Java, TypeScript (Angular), HTML, CSS, SQL, etc.
Demonstrated experience using standard requirements business analysis techniques, including brainstorming, interviewing, requirements sessions, activity diagrams and use cases desired.
Demonstrated experience and/or competencies either informally or formally contributing on various-size teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to understand data and integration architectures to manage, transform, and exploit data across the enterprise.
Demonstrated capability to understand security requirements, and using the frameworks and tools the organization has put in place to meet those requirements.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Required Aptitude:

Quick to establish trust and respect
Action oriented and energetic
Resourceful and creative
Persistent and determined
Mature and cool under pressure
Easily makes connections
Reads situations quickly
Commitment and follow through

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Software Engineer with id 4919474.

description:
At Relational FS we know that companies with a strong positive culture perform so much better. That is why every day we strive to create a collaborative and inclusive working environment where our people can feel empowered to succeed.
Are you a skilled and experienced .NET developer looking for an opportunity to grow while working on exciting and challenging projects in a collaborative and dynamic environment?
Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Operating in an Agile environment, applications are built with latest modern technologies like C#, microservices and front-end web frameworks.
Responsibilities

Design, code, debug, document, and test software according development fundamentals, processes, and specifications
Estimate development project tasks and timelines
Contribute to product design reviews with creative and practical solutions
Mentor junior team members

Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written)
Familiarity with Agile methodologies
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or other relevant field
2+ years of relevant working experience
Strong understanding of Computer Science fundamentals such as OOP, Design Patterns, Data Structures, Algorithms
Good understanding of C# .NET & Asp.Net WebAPI,
Good understanding of RDBMS (SQL Server) and ORMs
Good understanding of microservice architecture
Experience with Front-end technologies, especially angular, will be considered a plus
Experience with REST microservices and Service oriented architecture will be considered a plus

Desired Qualifications: What we might consider an advantage

Unit testing (Test Driven Development)
Azure DevOps Pipelines (CI/CD)
Cloud native containerized application Docker

What Does our tech stack look like?
At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor
MSSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Spark.NET
Prometheus, Grafana, Loci, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry

Why work with us?
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Through matrix organizational structure we achieve cross-functional collaboration which helps to increase efficiency, innovation, and responsiveness to changing markets. Along with that we introduced a software coaching/mentoring scheme which provides guidance, feedback, and support to software engineers or learners who want to improve their skills, knowledge, and performance.
You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Our company is people - centric and offers personalized benefits to each employee:

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

title: Manager, Software Engineer
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.ROLE SUMMARYPfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications. Top candidates will also have experience working on regulated projects that have used an agile approach.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. In addition to standard software development and agile team responsibilities, SEs act as mentors as well as technical subject matter experts on in-house, outsourced, and co-sourced developed global applications. SEs may additionally lead technical teams and work independently or lead others on initiatives. SEs will collaborate closely with stakeholders of all levels across both the Digital Core Solutions organization as well as our partner business operations organizations, leading to opportunities to learn from and advise senior Pfizer leadership.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Works independently and within teams to advance organizational and project objectives.
Works with project teams across R&D Solutions, providing technical leadership across business domains, including support for short and long-term strategies in alignment with Pfizer Digital colleagues: Client Partners, Architects, Solution Delivery Leads, among others.
Participates in Agile practices in alignment with team processes and objectives.
Designs application areas to meet project objectives and alignment with Digital standards and best practices.
Works in team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Ensures the expectations and requirements of internal and external stakeholders are met.
Provides technical management of colleagues and contract resources for software development projects.
Provides technical expertise and oversight to ensure the quality and maintenance of existing production systems.
Suggests and assists in the development of Engineering Best Practices for the group.
Designs, prototypes, implements and unit tests software solutions in supported business areas.
Specifies user/system interfaces and translates logical designs into physical designs taking account of target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
Produces detailed designs and documents all work using required standards, methods and tools, including prototyping tools, where appropriate.
Conducts reviews of supplied specifications as appropriate.
Creates, improves, and maintains DevOps and other build and code management configurations to support efficient, high quality, and secure software development and delivery.





QUALIFICATIONS ​

Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering, Information Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other scientific or engineering discipline.
5+ years of relevant experience within the Software Engineering discipline.
Experience working within teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated capabilities and experience collaborating and working effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Experience in supporting the selection or implementation of technical direction on large projects and/or complex, program-level initiatives requiring technical and business-domain expertise.
Experience and demonstrated competencies either informally or formally managing and/or mentoring others with an emphasis on communicating software engineering and project development best practices.
Demonstrated focus on the high quality of outputs through various methods, such as through code quality initiatives, implementation of automated testing or a unit testing program, process improvement, or leading team engagement with quality initiatives.

Required Capabilities and Experience:

Strong capabilities in developing multi-tiered solutions using Java/J2EE, JBoss Application Server, SQL, REST and JMS, as well as web technologies and frameworks such as Angular, Typescript, HTML, CSS.

title: AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead
description:
Role Summary
Do you want to make an impact on patient health around the world? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that brings together scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Then join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) where you can leverage cutting-edge technology to inform critical business decisions and improve customer experiences for our colleagues, patients and physicians. Our collection of engineering, data science, and AI professionals are at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization that leverages data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team within Data Science Solutions and Initiatives is a critical driver and enabler of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading the process and engineering innovation to rapidly progress early AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As the AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead, you will be a leader within the Data Science Industrialization team charged with driving the development of web application frontends, particularly those focused on AI use cases. Your responsibilities will span both technical leadership and hands-on development. You will lead a global team and partner with cross-functional business stakeholders and Digital leaders to catalyze identification, design, iterative development, and continuous improvements of web applications that enable use case delivery. Your team will develop best practices and maintain standards for frontend application development. Your team will be accountable to key Pfizer business functions (including Pfizer Biopharma, R&D, PGS, Oncology, and Enabling Functions) for developing Web solutions that support business objectives across all of Pfizer's core business units.




Role Responsibilities

Architecting Solutions: You'll lead the design and architecture of frontend applications, ensuring they align with business goals and technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, product managers, and designers, to define technical roadmaps and prioritize features.
Mentoring and Guidance: Provide guidance to junior frontend developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both Angular and React is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Collaboration with Designers: Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to create consistent and delightful user experiences.
Responsive Design: Ensure applications are designed to work seamlessly across various devices and screen sizes.
Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.
Set a vision, prioritize workstreams, and provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and mentorship for a global team with technical & functional expertise.
Coach direct reports to adopt best practices, improve technical skills, develop an innovative mindset, and achieve professional growth through technical and organizational thought leadership.

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or engineering related area.
10+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
2-3 years of hands-on experience leading software engineering teams
Track record of managing stakeholder groups and effecting change
Recognized by peers as an expert in software, with deep expertise in frontend solution architecture, and hands-on development
Expert knowledge of frontend technologies; familiar with Angular, React,HTML/CSS/Bootstrap​.
Deep understanding of digital accessibility and disability inclusion. Experience developing digital products that comply with accessibility standards.
Familiarity with fundamental data science principles. Understanding concepts like data preprocessing, feature engineering, and statistical analysis is essential.
Adept at creating compelling visualizations. Familiarity with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and similar data visualization libraries.
Understands how to synthesize facts and information from varied data sources, both new and pre-existing, into clear insights and perspectives that can be understood by business stakeholders
Clearly articulates expectations, capabilities, and action plans; actively listens with others' frame of reference in mind; appropriately shares information with team; favorably influences people without direct authority
Clearly articulates scope and deliverables of projects; breaks complex initiatives into detailed component parts and sequences actions appropriately; develops action plans and monitors progress independently; designs success criteria and uses them to track outcomes; engages with stakeholders throughout to ensure buy-in
Ability to manage projects from end-to-end, from requirements gathering through implementation, and development of support processes
Demonstrated experience interfacing with internal and external teams to develop innovative frontend solutions
Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead id 4916364.

title: Manager, Front-End Application Development
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAt Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels, and the look and feel of our regional corporate sites around the world, consulting and supporting objectives from various stakeholders across the entire company, as well as directly setting objectives and delivering on them.The Front-End Application Development Manager leads the designing, developing, and implementing of moderately complex cutting-edge solutions for Pfizer's digital marketing initiatives (specifically, the user interface used by Pfizer.com and our regional corporate websites). The Front-End Application Developer plays a crucial role in Pfizer's pursuit of breakthroughs by pushing the boundaries of digital experiences and creating captivating solutions that drive patient engagement, knowledge sharing, and commercial success.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESSubject Matter Expertise - General

Design and develop digital solutions utilizing the latest development tools, frameworks, and platforms to build cutting-edge solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.
Implement source code management best practices to maintain high standards of code quality, integrity and consistency.
Applies knowledge of internal/external business challenges to provide input into recommendations for improvements to products, processes or services
Define and Implement best practices in usability, accessibility, and user interface design to ensure seamless and intuitive customer interactions within digital solutions.
Conduct and document thorough testing and debugging of digital solutions to identify and resolve any technical issues or performance bottlenecks.
Integrate digital solutions with other digital marketing technologies and platforms, such as content management systems, analytics, and personalization engines.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, security protocols, and industry best practices related to application development and deployment.
Act as primary front-end application developer for Pfizer.com (and functionality shared with our regional sites), performing all tasks necessary from bug fixing and tier 1 support up to advanced, emergency problem-solving and new, complex enhancement requests, in coordination with the Technical lead, Platform team and other relevant parties.
Provide direction to and integrate contributions from other front-end developers, both from within the team and from agency/vendor partners.

Strategic Leadership & Delivery

Participate in the ideation and prototyping of digital solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to explore new and optimized ways of solution development. Take appropriate risks to advance new concepts and methodologies that are moderately complex.
Make decisions that may require developing new options to resolve moderately complex problems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BSc degree with at least 5 years of experience or Masters with at least 3 year of experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience as an individual contributor/practitioner.
Expertise in graphics creation and editing tools, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc. (both for direct creation and for manipulating and extracting from source materials provided by partners).
Application development, with comprehensive knowledge and proven experience in implementing and integrating CMS tools with modern frontend technologies (e.g., HTML5, CSS3, ES6). Experience with a popular JavaScript framework like React, Next, Vue, Angular is a plus.
Proficient in modern frontend technologies (e.g., HTML5, CSS3, ES6) and a popular JavaScript framework like React, Next, Vue, Angular.
Experience in Front-End Web/REST API design, deployment and integration
Experience with performance tools like Lighthouse, PageSpeed, Calibre and performance optimization techniques.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and JIRA/Confluence.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug and optimize complex applications.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience maintaining and executing brand standards and design systems to the pixel, aiming for rigorous excellence and attention to detail to maintain a consistent visual experience.
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures.
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.

TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Candidate will be expected to travel globally to Pfizer locations as needed

title: Senior Manager, Digital Solutions Engineer & Technical Team Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Commercial Creation Center & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels, and the look and feel of our regional corporate sites around the world, consulting and supporting objectives from various stakeholders across the entire company, as well as directly setting objectives and delivering on them.The Solutions Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for developing ideas and leading the design and overseeing the implementation of complex cutting-edge technical solutions across business units. This role serves as the bridge between business requirements and technical capabilities, translating stakeholder needs into innovative and scalable solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
Subject Matter Expertise - General

Design and architect technical solutions that address stakeholder needs while adhering to best practices, industry standards, and Pfizer's technology strategies.
Develop detailed technical specifications, system architectures, and implementation plans for immersive solutions.
Oversee the implementation of digital solutions by development teams, ensuring adherence to the defined technical architecture and design principles.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, security protocols, and industry best practices related to solution development and deployment.
Act as technical lead for Pfizer.com (and functionality shared with our regional sites): accountable for the technical strategy, in close coordination with Platform team and other technical partners.
Strategic Leadership & Delivery
Take risk-based approach to advance innovative processes and methodologies based on comprehensive business knowledge for evaluation and recommendation of appropriate technologies, platforms, and frameworks, considering factors such as scalability, performance, security, and integration with existing systems.

Resource and Financial Management

Provide direct oversight to colleagues and contractors that comprise the technical/engineering team, as well as in-region manager for other local colleagues on the team (which may include roles that aren't primarily technical/engineering)
Manages and leads people, technological and financial resources within the Business Unit, often lead by influence rather than direct authority, in addition to direct reports.

Cross- Team Collaboration

Collaborate with the Delivery Lead, Service Owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather and analyze business requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including the Technical Services Leads and Platform teams, to ensure seamless integration and support for solutions with Pfizer's digital platforms and technologies.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
7+ years of extensive experience in solution architecture, technical design, and implementation of complex software systems, with a focus on leading a team of engineers and defining the process for a developer team, particularly in relation to a database-driven content management system (CMS).
Strong understanding of Drupal/PHP/MySQL stack development technologies, platforms, and frameworks, along with their strengths, limitations, and integration capabilities. Deep understanding of Drupal's caching system, modules, crons, taxonomies is a plus.
Strong proficiency in programming languages, development tools, and software engineering practices relevant to implementing and integrating CMS tools with modern frontend technologies (e.g., HTML5, CSS3, ES6). Experience with a popular JavaScript framework like React, Next, Vue, Angular is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges and trade-offs.
Passion for exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation in the field of GenAI/LLM/Semantic Search (several related efforts underway looking for leadership and individually contribution)
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, robust, and scalable technical solutions.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and JIRA/Confluence

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience in the Pharma industry
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.
High proficiency and proven successful delivery of experiences using Agile development, especially scaled agile and lean techniques and methodologies (Disciplined Agile, SAFe, etc.)

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Manager, Digital Solutions Engineer & Technical Team Lead id 4918233.

title: Associate, Software Engineer
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.
What You Will Achieve
You will help Pfizer build its information technology solutions. You will leverage your technical skills to design, develop and implement IT solutions which satisfy the short term or long terms needs of Pfizer. You will work on systems architecture, network systems and application infrastructure to deliver results.As an associate, your focus on the job will contribute in achieving project tasks and goals. Through your domain knowledge and commitment, you will create a collaborative teaming environment for your colleagues.It is your hard work and commitment that will help in making Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe.
How You Will Achieve It

Work with the technical lead to design and develop code in one or more technologies (Java, Python, JavaScript, .Net, Vue). Experience in writing code in at least two languages with minimal supervision.
Work with technical lead to develop, maintain, and improve new and existing software solutions with a strong sense of accountability and attention to quality. Should be creative, proactive in problem-solving, and flexible to adapt to changing business priorities.
Perform stringent testing of code written, including designing, and writing automated tests to allow for continuous delivery.
Help the team embrace agile core values, adopt, and apply those principles, and implementation practices.
Foster a learning and development mindset.
Be responsible for a specific application and/or a functionality within an application (e.g. front-end or back-end).

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
2 years of software development experience.
Experience in either Java, C#, Python or JavaScript programming languages.
Demonstrated ability to effectively document software designs and communicate implementation details.

Nice-to-Have

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related field.
Experience in front-end or back-end frameworks (Angular, vue, Spring, Quarkus).
Cloud-specific experience with Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure.
Linux, networking, security.




Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

title: Director, AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead
description:
Role SummaryDo you want to make an impact on patient health around the world? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that brings together scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Then join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) where you can leverage cutting-edge technology to inform critical business decisions and improve customer experiences for our colleagues, patients and physicians. Our collection of engineering, data science, and AI professionals are at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization that leverages data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team within Data Science Solutions and Initiatives is a critical driver and enabler of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading the process and engineering innovation to rapidly progress early AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As the AI and Data Science Frontend Engineering Lead, you will be a leader within the Data Science Industrialization team charged with driving the development of web application frontends, particularly those focused on AI use cases. Your responsibilities will span both technical leadership and hands-on development. You will lead a global team and partner with cross-functional business stakeholders and Digital leaders to catalyze identification, design, iterative development, and continuous improvements of web applications that enable use case delivery. Your team will develop best practices and maintain standards for frontend application development. Your team will be accountable to key Pfizer business functions (including Pfizer Biopharma, R&D, PGS, Oncology, and Enabling Functions) for developing Web solutions that support business objectives across all of Pfizer's core business units.



Role Responsibilities

Architecting Solutions: You'll lead the design and architecture of frontend applications, ensuring they align with business goals and technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, product managers, and designers, to define technical roadmaps and prioritize features.
Mentoring and Guidance: Provide guidance to junior frontend developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both Angular and React is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Collaboration with Designers: Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to create consistent and delightful user experiences.
Responsive Design: Ensure applications are designed to work seamlessly across various devices and screen sizes.
Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.
Set a vision, prioritize workstreams, and provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and mentorship for a global team with technical & functional expertise.
Coach direct reports to adopt best practices, improve technical skills, develop an innovative mindset, and achieve professional growth through technical and organizational thought leadership.




QualificationsMust-Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or engineering related area.
10+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
2-3 years of hands-on experience leading software engineering teams
Track record of managing stakeholder groups and effecting change
Recognized by peers as an expert in software, with deep expertise in frontend solution architecture, and hands-on development
Expert knowledge of frontend technologies; familiar with Angular, React,HTML/CSS/Bootstrap​.
Deep understanding of digital accessibility and disability inclusion. Experience developing digital products that comply with accessibility standards.
Familiarity with fundamental data science principles. Understanding concepts like data preprocessing, feature engineering, and statistical analysis is essential.
Adept at creating compelling visualizations. Familiarity with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and similar data visualization libraries.
Understands how to synthesize facts and information from varied data sources, both new and pre-existing, into clear insights and perspectives that can be understood by business stakeholders
Clearly articulates expectations, capabilities, and action plans; actively listens with others' frame of reference in mind; appropriately shares information with team; favorably influences people without direct authority
Clearly articulates scope and deliverables of projects; breaks complex initiatives into detailed component parts and sequences actions appropriately; develops action plans and monitors progress independently; designs success criteria and uses them to track outcomes; engages with stakeholders throughout to ensure buy-in
Ability to manage projects from end-to-end, from requirements gathering through implementation, and development of support processes
Demonstrated experience interfacing with internal and external teams to develop innovative frontend solutions
Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration

Your team will develop best practices and maintain standards for frontend application development. Architecting Solutions: You'll lead the design and architecture of frontend applications, ensuring they align with business goals and technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, product managers, and designers, to define technical roadmaps and prioritize features.
Mentoring and Guidance: Provide guidance to junior frontend developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both Angular and React is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Collaboration with Designers: Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to create consistent and delightful user experiences.
Responsive Design: Ensure applications are designed to work seamlessly across various devices and screen sizes.
Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.
Set a vision, prioritize workstreams, and provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and mentorship for a global team with technical & functional expertise.
Coach direct reports to adopt best practices, improve technical skills, develop an innovative mindset, and achieve professional growth through technical and organizational thought leadership.

10+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
2-3 years of hands-on experience leading software engineering teams
Track record of managing stakeholder groups and effecting change
Recognized by peers as an expert in software, with deep expertise in frontend solution architecture, and hands-on development
Expert knowledge of frontend technologies; familiar with Angular, React,HTML/CSS/Bootstrap​.

Clearly articulates expectations, capabilities, and action plans; actively listens with others' frame of reference in mind; appropriately shares information with team; favorably influences people without direct authority

Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration

Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.
 
Responsibilities

Work closely with a business analysts’ team and stakeholders to design and implement the best solutions.
Follow industry’s best practices and standards.
Test and deliver high-quality software.

 
Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.
Experience in building SPAs with Angular.
Experience in Typescript.
Experience in building rich responsive/adaptive web UIs with HTML5 and CSS3.
Extensive experience in consuming REST APIs and in REST principles.

 
Desired Qualifications

Experience with state management tools (e.g. NGRX, NGXS, Akita, Redux).
Familiarity with version control software tools (preferably Git).
Familiarity with CSS preprocessors (e.g. Sass, LESS).
Familiarity with CSS frameworks (e.g. primeng, tailwind).

At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor

 
Why work with us?
 
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
Role Summary
Pfizer's purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients' lives.In Pfizer Digital Core Solutions, we partner closely with our Pfizer business operations colleagues to efficiently deliver robust supporting technology solutions that enhance their work to achieve the Pfizer purpose. We value our team members' technical skills, but also their passion, teamwork, and growth. Our culture is focused on delivering value through courage, excellence, equity, and joy. Our collective skillset supports all aspects of technology planning, project execution and application development excellence.We are looking for Software Engineer (SE) candidates who are aligned with our culture and values, and with academic and/or work experience in software development projects that include both backend and frontend development using Java and Javascript-based technologies for multi-tiered, RDBMS-based web applications.The Software Engineer plays a key role in meeting our mission. The SE analyzes specifications, designs logic, writes code, customizes products, unit tests, debugs, and documents software applications. The SE participates in agile team events and works within the agile team framework.The SE will work closely with their manager to ensure growth over time, including the selection of project work among hundreds of applications that will expand their skillset to meet personal and organizational goals, to provide fulfilling work, and to advance their careers.
Role Responsibilities

Works within project teams as a contributor to design, prototype, implement and unit test software solutions in support of the project objectives.
Works as a senior developer on small-to-medium size software development projects, which may include accountability for the work of a small number of other junior and/or contract Software Engineers, as well as responsibility for dictating and managing coding standards, coding best practices, source code control approaches, versioning, etc.
Translates logical designs of user/system interfaces into physical designs, considering the target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
Helps produce detailed design specifications where applicable, and documents all work using required standards, methods, and tools, including prototyping tools, where appropriate.
Conducts reviews of supplied specifications as appropriate.
Defines the integration build and produces a build definition for generation of the software.
Work in a matrix, team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers.

Qualifications
Education:

Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering, Information Management, Computer Science, Mathematics, or other scientific or engineering discipline.

Prior Experience:

Minimum of 3 years of experience as a software developer/engineer.

Required Capabilities and Experience:

Facilitation, negotiating and presentation skills.
Experience working in ambiguous situations.
Demonstrated experience and skills in analysis and problem solving.
Demonstrated ability to developing multi-tiered solutions using multiple programming languages and web technologies including Java, TypeScript (Angular), HTML, CSS, SQL, etc.
Demonstrated experience using standard requirements business analysis techniques, including brainstorming, interviewing, requirements sessions, activity diagrams and use cases desired.
Demonstrated experience and/or competencies either informally or formally contributing on various-size teams of technologists, IT professionals or project managers using Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and other approaches for iterative development.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively in team settings, frequently in virtual teams with client partner and customer engagement responsibilities.
Demonstrated ability to understand data and integration architectures to manage, transform, and exploit data across the enterprise.
Demonstrated capability to understand security requirements, and using the frameworks and tools the organization has put in place to meet those requirements.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Required Aptitude:

Quick to establish trust and respect
Action oriented and energetic
Resourceful and creative
Persistent and determined
Mature and cool under pressure
Easily makes connections
Reads situations quickly
Commitment and follow through

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Software Engineer with id 4919474.

We offer innovative and added-value solutions of the highest quality to a wide range of public and private organizations, while being a key-player in the EU Institutions for the past 30 years. We hold an outstanding record of 500+ organizations in 70+ countries, that have chosen our solutions and services, to fulfil their business needs. Our team of 3500+ professionals is our driving force and our most valuable asset. Job DescriptionJoining us as an Intern in Software Development, you will have the opportunity to be a part of agile, highly skilled SW Development teams that design, develop, deploy, customize, and support web and digital applications for various industries (FinTech / Betting / Insurance / Telecommunications / Utilities / Retail / EU Institutions / Public Sector Digital Transformation). As an intern in Software Development you will:Work within an agile team that designs, develops, and maintains web applications by using technologies such as Java, Spring, Spring boot, Angular, React, etc. Perform a full range of programming tasks using a variety of web and application-based programming technologies and languages, keeping current with new programming techniquesDevelop and maintain code and application libraries, instructions, and technical documentationParticipate in peer code reviewsBe up to date, learn and gain experience in new technology stacks. Additional InformationBeing a part of the Netcompany-Ιntrasoft team, you will be provided with: The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working modelA seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first stepsWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)Join Netcompany-Intrasoft Patras' branch, and be part of our 150+ tech enthusiasts team! If you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be! Our cultureOur people are the most important element of our success. Our work life is well defined by our set of fundamental Values: https://netcompany. com/careers/greece/our-values/ #BePartOfSomethingGreat! Please submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential. We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Angular
description:
Description

Want to build great software with great people? Let's discuss and find a position that suits your interests.
INDICE is a software house based in Athens, Greece. Our team develops digital infrastructure for the enterprise and delivers large scale consumer facing applications. Our team is connected by their love of technology and held together by our common values: respect for the individual, pride in one's work and integrity towards our clients.
As a full stack software engineer at Indice you will be joining our experienced solutions development team. You get to work with the latest technologies in the Angular and .NET and open source ecosystem, delivering enterprise-grade software for leading Greek and foreign organizations that live on Azure. In your new role with INDICE, you will be tasked to work on large scale, api-based architectures that reside on premises or the cloud.
This position can be fullfilled through hybrid office/home work. We strongly suggest a 4 days in the office, 1 at home week arrangement in order to better understand the company's values, boost cooperation and morale.



Requirements


Familiarity with Angular or similar frameworks, prefferably Angular 12+ and RxJS
Good grasp of HTML5/CSS3 and CSS frameworks (Tailwind preferably),


API experience and OAuth (REST, swagger, OAuth flows) with .NET
Good grasp of Object Oriented software engineering, either in Typescript or C#
Understanding of agile scrum
experienced in Git and branching/merging strategies
experience with .NET Core is a strong plus

 
At least 2 years of prior experience in similar technologies is required for this position.



Benefits

perks include

Private health insurance plan
Sponsoring of certifications, conferences, books etc
Great workstations and paraphernalia
supportive atmosphere encouraging personal growth

title: Senior Laravel Backend Developer– Cyprus, Greece or Remote
description:
The Role: 
As our new Senior PHP Developer, you will embark a journey into the world of cutting-edge software engineering. You will be at the forefront of shaping the future of software development, making pivotal decisions that drive our processes forward, by leveraging tools like Kubernetes and Terraform in synergy with PHP, Go, Angular all nestled within the embrace of AWS. Our dedicated team will ensure that you are in sync with the latest technology stacks and workflows. From the inception of the daring projects to the triumphant realization, you will immerse yourself in the rewarding adventure of watching your visions come to life.
 
 The main responsibilities of the position include:

Develop and implement backend services using PHP 8+ and Laravel 9+, ensuring code quality, performance, and security.
Utilise Kafka (or similar technologies) to design and implement event-driven systems for real-time data processing and communication between micro-services.
Employ strong Git practices, such as trunk-based development, and implement CI/CD pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable code deployment workflows.
Optimise database performance and scalability using MySQL and Redis for caching and data storage.
Work in close collaboration with frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver end-to-end features and enhancements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable backend solutions for our platform.
Provide mentorship, code reviews, and technical guidance to junior team members to ensure high coding standards and nurture their professional growth.

 

Main requirements:
BSc/MSc in computer science or any other relevant degree.
At least 4-5 years of experience in a similar position.
Extensive experience in backend development using PHP 8+ and Laravel 9+, with a deep understanding of Laravel's advanced concepts such as service providers, Passport/Sanctum, Eloquent ORM, Queues, Scheduler, and more.
Proven experience in building and maintaining backend services, ensuring scalability, fault tolerance, and efficient communication between services.
Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns and concepts such as dependency injection, KISS, DRY, and YAGNI.
Experience with code quality tools like Psalm, PHPStan, and Laravel Pint.
Experience in writing tests using PHPUnit or Pest, and appreciation for TDD.
Strong familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies like Kafka, gRPC, or similar messaging systems.
Proficiency in VCS, particularly Git, and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, and caching mechanisms using Redis.

 
The following will be considered an advantage:

Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of cloud technologies, ideally AWS, and infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform.
Frontend skills in Angular or VueJS for effective collaboration with frontend teams.
Knowledge of building responsive and visually appealing user interfaces.
Experience in Go programming language for additional versatility in backend development.
Experience with ClickHouse or similar columnar databases for optimized storage and analytical processing.
Experience with tools such as NewRelic, Zabbix, and Sentry for monitoring infrastructure and tracking errors.

 
Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package plus performance related rewards
Food allowance
Intellectually stimulating work environment
Continuous personal development and international training opportunities
Attractive relocation package and support for a smooth relocation for you and your family

 
Type of employment: Full time
Location: Cyprus, Greece or remote
Please visit our website www.xm.com/careers to submit your online application for this position.
 
All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Senior .Net C# Software Engineer
description:
At Relational FS we know that companies with a strong positive culture perform so much better. That is why every day we strive to create a collaborative and inclusive working environment where our people can feel empowered to succeed.
Are you a skilled and experienced .NET developer looking for an opportunity to grow professionally while working on exciting and challenging projects in a collaborative and dynamic environment?
Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Operating in an Agile environment, applications are built with latest modern technologies like C#, microservices and front-end web frameworks.
Responsibilities

Lead features from architecture to implementation alone or as part of a cross-functional team
Work closely with a business analyst team and stakeholders to design the best solutions
Mentor and guide fellow colleagues on industry’s best practices and standards
Test and deliver high-quality software
Mitigate technical risks, issues and proactively address any challenges

 
Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written)
Familiarity with Agile methodologies
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or other relevant field
Firm understanding of Computer Science fundamentals such as OOP, Design Patterns, Data Structures, Algorithms
Firm understanding of C# .NET, Asp.Net WebAPI,
Firm understanding of RDBMS (SQL Server) and ORMs
Firm understanding of microservice architecture
Experience with Front-end technologies, especially angular, will be considered a plus
Experience with REST microservices and Service oriented architecture

 
Desired Qualifications

Unit testing (Test Driven Development)
Azure DevOps Pipelines (CI/CD)
Cloud native containerized application Docker

 
What Does our tech stack look like?
At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor
MSSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Spark.NET
Prometheus, Grafana, Loci, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry

 
Why work with us?
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Through matrix organizational structure we achieve cross-functional collaboration which helps to increase efficiency, innovation, and responsiveness to changing markets. Along with that we introduced a software coaching/mentoring scheme which provides guidance, feedback, and support to software engineers or learners who want to improve their skills, knowledge, and performance.
You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Our company is people - centric and offers personalized benefits to each employee:

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

Relational Financial Solutions adheres to the General Data Protection Regulation principles by applying its Privacy Policy as published in https://www.relationalfs.com/legal-information/pri.... By submitting an application to this position and by sharing your personal data with Relational Financial Solutions you acknowledge and accept its Policy and authorise Relational Financial Solutions to process your personal data for the purposes of the company's recruitment opportunities, in line to the Policy.

title: Software Engineer - Network Management Systems
description: INTRACOM TELECOM is a global telecommunication systems and solutions vendor operating for over 40 years in the market. The company innovates in the wireless access and transmission field, offers a competitive telco software solutions portfolio, and combines its offerings with a complete range of professional services.Our mission is to shape future through technology, and we recognize that human capital is the key factor to achieve this in today's business environment. Our company's highly specialized and experienced personnel are pivotal to achieving demanding objectives and advancing the capabilities of the company to better serve its customers. Within this framework, we are looking for an agile and highly motivated “Software Engineer” to join a team of future shapers.The successful candidate will be based in our Athens' headquarters or in our subsidiaries in Patras or Thessaloniki, and be involved in the design, development and support of our Network Management System software – managing our innovative packet microwave and millimeter-wave radio systems - used in front-haul and mobile backhaul transport of 4G/5G networks, as well as in Fixed Wireless Access broadband systems. Requirements University degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science Very good knowledge of JAVA, SQL Very good knowledge of English   Any or more of the following skills are desired: Knowledge of Database Administration (PostgreSQL, MySQL or Oracle) Good working knowledge of Linux Basic knowledge in Telecommunications / Networking Knowledge of Kubernetes Container Orchestration Platform Knowledge of Wildfly Application Server Knowledge of Version Control (GIT) Knowledge in software engineering tools (e.g. Eclipse, Apache Ant, Maven) Knowledge of Web Development (e.g. Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Angular JS, Bootstrap) Knowledge of Test-Driven Development, Selenium, Test Frameworks, Python   Personal characteristics:  Strong problem-solving skills, creativity and attention to detail Excellent communication and organizational skills Flexible, with a strong desire to learn and accept new challenges Comfortable asking for help, taking advice and accepting criticism Team-oriented Results-oriented Self-motivated BenefitsINTRACOM TELECOM provides an excellent working environment which encourages team spirit, cooperation and continuous learning, in which the career prospects depend on each employee’s performance. Remuneration is competitive and aligned with the company’s credo “our competitive advantage is our human capital”.Further, the facility of a company bus is convenient for every employee.Education and continuous personal improvement constitute major priorities for the company to keep abreast with the technology evolution and maintain the high growth rate and its strategic position.Our company applies policies for equal opportunities irrespective of caste, national origin, religion, disability, gender, sexual orientation, union membership, political affiliation, or age.

title: Principal Architect – Java & Cloud Migration
description:
We are seeking a Principal Architect with deep Java expertise and hands-on experience in migrating legacy monolithic Java applications to the cloud. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in refactoring and migrating legacy monolithic applications to the cloud, enhancing performance and scalability. Evaluate existing architectural systems and propose an architecture roadmap to improve performance, scalability, and migration to the cloud.
Design and implement scalable, secure cloud infrastructure solutions.
Work closely with engineering teams to integrate old systems into cloud applications with minimal downtime.
Develop and maintain a phased migration plan to transition legacy systems without impacting ongoing operations.
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability while ensuring compliance with security regulations.
Document all architecture processes and migration steps.
Provide training and support to other team members on cloud technologies and best practices.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and propose adaptations to keep our systems at the forefront of innovation.
Be hands-on if needed to work with developers and fix the code.
Analyze production incidents to find the most efficient way to address current architecture issues.

7+ years in development & software engineering with Java, Spring, Hibernate .
