Deep understanding of cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their application in enterprise environments.
Experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible and Terraform.
Experience with containerized environments, e.g., Docker.
Technical proficiency in the scaling, security, and performance of enterprise applications.
Experience with the creation of technical specifications or architecture visions covering quality attributes, diagrams, associated risks, technical, and system requirements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Remote working

Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.
 
Responsibilities

Work closely with a business analysts’ team and stakeholders to design and implement the best solutions.
Follow industry’s best practices and standards.
Test and deliver high-quality software.

 
Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.
Experience in building SPAs with Angular.
Experience in Typescript.
Experience in building rich responsive/adaptive web UIs with HTML5 and CSS3.
Extensive experience in consuming REST APIs and in REST principles.

 
Desired Qualifications

Experience with state management tools (e.g. NGRX, NGXS, Akita, Redux).
Familiarity with version control software tools (preferably Git).
Familiarity with CSS preprocessors (e.g. Sass, LESS).
Familiarity with CSS frameworks (e.g. primeng, tailwind).

 
 
What Does our tech stack look like?
At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor

 
Why work with us?
 
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Through matrix organizational structure we achieve cross-functional collaboration which helps to increase efficiency, innovation, and responsiveness to changing markets. Along with that we introduced a software coaching/mentoring scheme which provides guidance, feedback, and support to software engineers or learners who want to improve their skills, knowledge, and performance.
 
You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Our company is people - centric and offers personalized benefits to each employee:

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

Relational Financial Solutions adheres to the General Data Protection Regulation principles by applying its Privacy Policy as published in https://www.relationalfs.com/legal-information/pri.... title: Backend Developer
description:
You will be a part of our young and growing GWF Labs team in Thessaloniki, whose mission is to create real-time decision systems and intelligent solutions by harnessing IoT and telemetry data. The newly formed team offers a vibrant start-up environment with passionate bright colleagues and a clear goal to transform IoT data into modern applications. We commit to a pleasant, fun and achievement-oriented environment with plenty of room for growth.
 
Our role 
As a Backend Developer, you will develop robust server-side solutions to support our frontend and mobile applications and handle the influx of data from IoT devices. You will dive deep into GWF’s proprietary technology, ensuring data integrity, scalability, and high performance. Working closely with the local team, you'll get expert insights from our product tech leads. Your primary responsibilities include designing, developing, and maintaining the backend components of our applications, ensuring seamless communication between frontend and backend services. Engage in agile processes using Microsoft's ecosystem (MS Teams, Azure DevOps) which includes sprint planning, ticket grooming, and daily stand-ups. Stay updated with current technology trends and proactively contribute to the platform's enhancement and lifecycle, from brainstorming ideas to deploying them on cloud platforms.
 
Qualifications and experience 
3+ years of professional experience in building robust backend systems.
Proficiency in Python.
Experience in python web frameworks (preferably Django and/or FastAPI) and relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL).
Experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs.
Solid understanding of scalability, security, and other backend concerns.
Proficient with Git.
Fluent communication skills in English (both written and spoken).
 
Nice to have 
Experience with Cloud Services (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
Familiarity with containerization tools like Docker or Kubernetes.
Experience with data science techniques and tools, such as machine learning models, data analysis, and statistical methods.
Knowledge of advanced database design principles, including normalization, indexing strategies, and performance optimization.
German language skills.
BSc/MSc in Computer science or similar rounds up your profile.
 
We offer 
A pleasant, fun and achievement-oriented environment.
Learning and growth opportunities in an international company setup.
Full support for relevant training & lifelong learning initiatives.
Medical Coverage Package.
Modern, bright office with parking space, located close to the airport.
Company Sponsored events.
Relocation package for applicants abroad.
 
Interested?
We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.
Please note that we only consider applications received via our website.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
description:
Join INTRALOT as a Software Engineer (Java)!

Are you a Java Developer looking for an opportunity to work with modern technologies and microservices? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment that fosters innovation and technical excellence? If so, we invite you to join our team!
What you'll be doing:

 Contributing to the development and evolution of critical backend systems that support our applications and services.
 Developing and maintaining web applications in a microservices environment.
 Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
 Collaborating with the team to analyze requirements and design solutions.
 Supporting internal and external customers when needed.
 Keeping up with the latest technologies and best practices.

What we're looking for:
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.3+ years of experience in Java development.We work with Java 17 and are migrating to Java 21 - so you'll have the opportunity to work with the latest technologies!Experience with Spring Boot (currently using 2.6).Understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.Knowledge of multithreading programming and testing frameworks (JUnit).Experience with databases (MySQL) and ORM frameworks (Hibernate).Familiarity with Source Control (GIT, SVN) and Build Tools (Maven).Knowledge or experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Kafka.Team player with strong problem-solving skills!
About Us: INTRALOT, a publicly listed company established in 1992, is a leading gaming solutions supplier and operator active in 39 regulated jurisdictions worldwide. With a global workforce of approximately 1,700 employees, INTRALOT is committed to redefine innovation and quality of services in the lottery and gaming sector, while supporting operators in raising funds for good causes. In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.
INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.

Why Join Us:
 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family.
 Modern facilities, parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus.
 An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment.
 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status. Our premises in Paiania, Attica, are accessible to individuals with disabilities. Join us in shaping the future of gaming and lottery solutions!

description:
Role Summary
Do you want to make an impact on patient health around the world? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that brings together scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Then join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) where you can leverage cutting-edge technology to inform critical business decisions and improve customer experiences for our colleagues, patients and physicians. Our collection of engineering, data science, and AI professionals are at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization that leverages data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team within Data Science Solutions and Initiatives is a critical driver and enabler of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading the process and engineering innovation to rapidly progress early AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As a Manager, AI and Data Science Frontend Engineer, you will be part of the Data Science Industrialization team charged with designing and using UI/UX principles, developing and continuously improving web application frontends, particularly those focused on AI use cases. You will contribute to the best practices and maintain standards for frontend application development.
Role Responsibilities

Architecting Solutions: You will contribute in the design and architecture of frontend applications, ensuring they align with business goals and technical requirements.
Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both React and Vue or AngularJS is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Mentoring and Guidance: Provide guidance to junior frontend developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Technical Excellence: Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or engineering related area.
5+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
Experience developing dynamic and interactive web applications; familiar with React, AngularJS, Vue.
Experience in creating responsive user interfaces; familiar with technologies such as HTML, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material, Vuetify ​.
Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Understanding of digital accessibility and disability inclusion. Experience developing digital products that comply with accessibility standards.
Hands on experience working in Agile teams, processes, and practices.
Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration
Ability to creatively take on new challenges and work outside comfort zone
Strong English communication skills (written & verbal)

Nice-to-Have

Advanced degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline
Experience in UI/UX design
Experience working in a cloud-based ecosystems (AWS, Snowflake, etc)
Pharma & Life Science commercial functional knowledge
Pharma & Life Science commercial data literacy

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, AI and Data Science Frontend Engineer id 4918159.

description:
PHP Microservices Engineer (x/f/m), PHP 8+, Docker, SQL
Greece




About Us
Education is the future! And yet schools could be so much better for teachers and students alike. At eduki, we strongly believe in the power of good teaching and we made it our mission to empower teachers to deliver the best school education. eduki is an online platform that allows them to create, share and find self-made, class-tested educational resources. Teachers can help each other save time by offering printable as well as digital materials for all types of schools, subjects, and grade levels.
eduki is used by more than 2 million teachers internationally. Started in 2016 as a German-speaking platform, it is now available also in Spanish, French, Greek, and Italian.
If you share our mission and want to make a difference in the world of education, join our team!


Back-End Developer (x/f/m) | Backend Developer (x/f/m) | PHP Developer (x/f/m) | Intermediate | Greece (remote) | #PHP #Microservices #Web_Development
Your Impact
As a PHP Microservices Engineer (x/f/m) at eduki, you provide additional power to our development team and help us to reach our goal of empowering teachers to deliver the best school education. Here are the key tasks and responsibilities that you will be taking on in this particular role:

Microservices Development: You develop microservices using PHP to fulfill specific functionalities.
Integration and Configuration: You configure and seamlessly integrate microservices into our existing infrastructure. 
Architecture: You engage in discussions and decision-making processes for significant architectural matters.

Your Skills and Expertise
We are searching for an experienced PHP Microservices Engineer (x/f/m) who would like to create something big together in an internationally operating team. Furthermore, you should check the following boxes: 

You are experienced in developing microservices.
You are proficient in using PHP 8+, Docker, SQL and Kubernetes.
You demonstrate high reliability and can work independently.
You feel comfortable communicating in English and working in an international team.

Please note: Due to legal restrictions, we can only hire candidates living in and owning a valid work permit for Greece. eduki is a registered employer in Greece, and you will receive a direct work contract with us according to Greek work law. 
Our Commitment to You

Growth Opportunities: At eduki, you will find an exciting job opportunity within a profitable and fast-growing company. We prioritize action over perfection and view mistakes as opportunities for growth. Regular performance feedback sessions ensure that you receive constructive insights into your work and progress.Additionally, you will receive a 1,000 EUR development budget per year to invest in your professional development goals.
Remote Work: We fully embrace a home office culture and want you to enjoy the flexibility of remote work, allowing you to set your own work schedule and location.In addition to providing the necessary software and hardware, we offer a 500 EUR budget that you can freely use to equip your home office.Furthermore, you can work from abroad for up to 90 days per year with us!
Employee Health: At eduki, we are committed to supporting our team members in every aspect of their well-being. This is why we provide comprehensive physical and mental health support, including online yoga lessons, access to various mental health resources, and psychological help provided by our partner OpenUp.
Attractive Compensation Package: The total compensation for this role is up to 40.000 EUR per year and consists of a fixed salary and a VSOP (Virtual Stock Options Program) package. Depending on experience and performance, the gross annual salary will range between 24.000 EUR and 30.000 EUR.
Team Building Events: At eduki, we foster a strong sense of community. Whether virtual or on-site, you'll have opportunities to bond with your colleagues. Once a year, the entire team enjoys a company-wide team event, visiting new places and creating lasting memories together.

Your Contact
JulianeTalent Acquisition Manager
jobs@eduki.com


At eduki, we value diversity and the unique contributions each person brings to our team. We foster an inclusive culture where respect and appreciation are essential. Don't worry if you don't tick every box, we're not looking for a perfect match on paper. We're excited about the unique qualities you bring to the table. Talents are considered regardless of age, gender, sexual identity, ethnicity, nationality, religion, or disability.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Proficient in building and deploying microservices architectures.
Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching (Redis).
Familiarity with message brokers like RabbitMQ and IoT protocols like MQTT.
Experience in secure coding practices and building scalable architectures.
Experience with building CI/CD systems and processes

title: React Developer
description:
ICAP Executive Search & Selection is one of the premium consultancies and part of ICAP People & Employment Solutions, the largest HR Services Provider in Greece and Cyprus. With more than 50 years of experience, we specialize in assessing and recruiting Senior to Middle Level Executives across all sectors.
ICAP Executive Search on behalf of its client, a Greek technology group of companies offering a wide range of tailor-made software solutions and specialized ICT strategy consulting services, is seeking for an experienced React Developer.
 
React Developer (5780/RD/ESS/GR)
 
Responsibilities:

Design and implement high-performance, responsive user interface components using React.js and related technologies.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, and deployment.
Ensure best practices in code quality, optimization, and reusability, including conducting code reviews and supporting continuous improvement.
Work closely with product owners and designers to finalize user experiences and user interfaces, ensuring seamless and intuitive designs.
Take ownership of product features, writing technical documentation, and guiding less experienced developers as needed.
Contribute to task estimation and sprint planning, while ensuring timely and high-quality feature delivery in an agile team environment.

 
Requirements: 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
Proven working experience as a React Developer
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, including ES6+
Experience with modern React concepts and workflows (Hooks, Context API, Redux)
Experience with state management libraries/frameworks (Redux, MobX)
Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles
Understanding of RESTful APIs and integration with backend services
Experience with version control systems, such as Git
Ability to write clean, modular, and efficient code
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines
Fluency in English (both written and spoken)

title: Python Engineer | Strategy Risk & Transactions Advisory
description:
What Impact will you make?
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki that offers you a hybrid working model?
 
Are you ready to work on large scale projects for industry-leading clients around the world and elevate your career to an international level?
 
If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
 
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
 
#YourOpportunity
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Alexander Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
We are currently searching for Back End Python Developer, in order to expand and strengthen our Strategy Risk & Transaction Advisory team in Thessaloniki. Our Professionals at Deloitte Alexander Competence Center (DACC) work with Deloitte Projects across North and South Europe, collaborate with top performing international teams and advise organizations on how to effectively mitigate risks and make informed and intelligent risk decisions to maximize opportunities. This includes helping them manage and prevent risks around their business processes, technology and operations, and often extends to the design and implementation of revised control frameworks and technology solutions.
The people who will join us, can work in teams, have a detail-oriented mindset, analytical thinking skills, a drive for quality in technology and they will be able to understand and interpret business requirements - such that quality of the software is ensured via Testing.
#AboutYourTeam
Join an innovative team dedicated to developing AI-powered solutions, with a focus on leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to streamline and accelerate various business processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and develop analytical solutions in different industries, such as regulatory, procurement and auditing.
Develop and enhance the backend of the applications in our offering. Your responsibilities will include developing new functionalities, refining existing code, and implementing robust testing strategies to ensure reliability.
Take ownership of your work, transferring lessons learned to the team, and proactively looking for opportunities to improve and evolve our tools.
You will continuously evolve, developing and providing different types of software services to our clients.
Be open to learning new technologies and frameworks, discuss them with business stakeholders and implement them in our solutions. You will become expert in some areas and diversify in others.
#AboutYourRole
As a Senior Consultant in our Strategy Risk & Transaction Advisory department, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our clients in identifying, assessing, and managing risks that may impact their business objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on diverse projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams and leveraging your expertise to deliver value-added insights.
#YourRole
You will experience first-hand the backend of cutting-edge AI powered apps.
You will work on and expand existing codebase for an E2E application.
You will develop and implement strategies to ensure a modular and fit-for-purpose codebase that is easily maintainable, reusable, scalable, robust and resilient to edge cases and follows software standardization best practices.
You will collaborate with front and back-end teams to deliver on project requirements.
 
#OurRequirements
 
Key Qualifications
Education:

A Master’s degree in STEM or related field.

Technical:

Strong experience with software development in Python is a must.
Strong understanding of software design patterns and principles.
Strong experience with modularization of software applications to improve maintainability and reusability.
Expertise in designing scalable and high-performance applications.
Strong understanding of software standardization practices and implementation.
Experience with GIT (e.g., Gitlab/GitHub).
Experience in Relational and Non-Relational Databases.
Familiarity with DevOps, Unit-testing, Asynchronous Programming practices and tools.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure and/or AWS).
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI technologies is a plus.
Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices is a plus.
Comfortable manipulating and analyzing complex, high-volume, high-dimensional data from varying sources.

Communication:

You are fluent in English.
Ability to communicate technical matters and analytic approaches in a clear, precise, and actionable manner, and this to a range of stakeholders, from team members to business stakeholders.

Personal attributes:

Proactive and responsible, always anticipating the next steps.
You are a strong team player and show enthusiasm for supporting the development of others, but you can also easily work independently.
You have an analytical mindset and are able to analyze complex problems and design comprehensive solutions.
You are eager to learn and able to stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies

 
If you're ready to take your career to the next level in a challenging international environment, focusing on continuous learning and dynamic teamwork, both in Greece and abroad, you're ready for Deloitte!
 
#WhatWeOffer
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:
🏠 Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
⚖ Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
🌍 Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
📚 Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
🚀 Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust.
🤼 Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work.
🎉 Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
🏃 A buddy to support you with your onboarding
🌴 Extra days of annual leave.
⚕ Private medical health insurance plan
💳 Ticket restaurant card
🛒 Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
📱 Mobile phone
🍏 Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee every day at our offices
 
#About Deloitte
 
#OurServices
Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory, Tax and Legal. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Italy and globally. In pursuing this we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.
 
#OurPurpose
We are led by a purpose, to make an impact that matters with clients, people and society. This purpose defines who we are and what we stand for. It's not about being the biggest. It’s about being the first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.
 
#OurValues
At Deloitte we foster a collaborative culture where talented individuals can produce their best work. We value innovative thinking, diverse insights and a genuinely distinctive level of customer service through our expertise and professionalism. We value difference, with respect at the heart of our inclusive culture.
 
#OurTalentExperience
From day one at our firm, practitioners are part of a community. Our development and career progression framework will help them develop the skills and capabilities to succeed. The wellness of our people and the ability to offer agile working arrangements is at the center of our unique talent experience. We create a workplace that encourages collaboration, creativity, inclusiveness to ensure our staff are supported, encouraged and feel a sense of purpose and meaning in what they do each day.
 
Sounds like the sort of role for you? Apply now.
Location: Thessaloniki

Participate in the entire application lifecycle, focus on coding and debugging
Clearly understand and process requirements coming from the Product team
Work and communicate as part of a team of Developers, QAs and System analysts, as well as help and support the other team members

Build reusable code and libraries for future use
Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team, propose and implement solutions
Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic

Experience on developing backend applications using a popular framework

Good knowledge of relational databases

Team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent written and verbal skills in English

Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
Attention to detail and desire to probe further into data

Developer/Cloud Engineer Developer @ Deloitte Alexander Competence Center
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki, Greece that offers you a hybrid working model?

If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
#YourOpportunity
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Alexander Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
#AboutYourTeam
Our Platform Development practices support our customers, in various projects, in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions, identifying and implementing cloud architectures to support the development and deployment of cloud-native solutions.
Through our services, we help our customers to create safe and reliable innovations that guarantee a real competitive advantage in the market:

Cloud-native Platform Implementation: We specialize in deploying agile applications across software development, integration, and testing realms, fostering innovation and efficiency.
Accelerated Cloud Capabilities: Our services expedite the adoption of Cloud technologies, driving tangible business value through innovative Cloud Services.
Advanced Technological Architectures: Our expertise lies in designing architectures that seamlessly integrate modern Cloud applications with enterprise systems, ensuring compatibility and scalability

#OurRequirements
Key Qualifications

Degree or in the process of acquiring the degree related to Computer Engineering, Information Engineering, Computer Science and Information Technology
Hands-on experience in the .NET ecosystem, including expertise in C# and frameworks such as ASP.NET MVC, Web API Core, and Entity Framework
Solid experience with relational databases and SQL
Familiarity with Version Control Systems (e.g., Git)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and related tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar).
Basic understanding of Cloud Computing concepts
Good command of the English Language
Ability and willingness to work in a team, but also autonomously if necessary
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
High motivation for consulting field
Availability to travel (when needed based on business needs)

Bonus Qualifications

Exposure to DevOps practices and tools, such as Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Azure or other cloud-native technologies
Experience with another backend framework, such as Node.js, Django or Spring Boot

 
#WhoWeAreLookingFor
Individuals who have a strong will to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.
 
#WhatWeOffer
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:

Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work
Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
A buddy to support you with your onboarding
Extra days of annual leave
Private medical health insurance plan
Ticket restaurant card
Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
Mobile phone
Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee every day at our offices

title: Frontend developer / software engineer (JavaScript)
description:
Develop with us! 
The P-A-Systems Team is looking for a full-time team member as “Frontend developer (JavaScript / vue.js, nuxt.js) for IT (AI) projects”. We are a full-service-provider for digital transformation, artificial intelligence and software development and continuously growing since our official launch in May 2018. In our team we have united all specialist areas for software development (frontend, backend, design and project management) which will support you with any questions. 
 
Your advantages with us: 

active in a wide range of industries and therefore offer work on inspiring projects where no two are the same 


working in a young, motivated and international team 


flat hierarchies and quick decisions for a straightforward working environment 


home office as well as on-site work in our office in Ioannina 


flexible working time in coordination with your project team 


use of state-of-the-art tools and methods (MS365, YouTrack, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes) 

 
Your tasks: 

technical development exercises 
user interface development according to the requirements of the project 
integration of APIs from backend servers or third parties to retrieve and process data for display 


responsibility for the documentation of the projects 


estimating the effort required for various tasks with the support of experienced project managers 


technical back-office exercises to support the Senior Consultants 

 
Your profile: 

upper intermediate in English, intermediate/fluent in German (preferred) 


university degree, preferably in natural sciences, engineering, or informatics 


knowledge of cross-browser responsive layout using HTML5, CSS3, Tailwindcss 3 


knowledge of JS (ES6+) 


experience developing in Vue.js 2, Vue.js 3, Nuxt and Nuxt3 from 1 year 


experience with data processing, APIs, components, hooks 


experience with Vuex, Pinia, Vue Router and other Vue ecosystems incl. composition API 


experience in design with Figma is encouraged 


experience in working with software projects and understanding of reactive programming principles and component-oriented architecture, with Composition API in mind 
experience with Git

React Developer

Developing internal workshops and technical presentations for the team.

Ensuring code quality through unit tests, integration tests, and tools such as Jest and React Testing Library.

Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and working with backend teams.
Experience with testing tools such as Jest, Cypress, or React Testing Library.
Experience mentoring and coaching junior developers.

Knowledge of UI/UX design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
Ability to design and develop npm packages that support large scale projects, allowing for easy maintenance and code reuse.
Experience in microfrontend architectures
Angular Developer
Google Mobile Web Specialist Certification

Required skills for this position:

Attention to detail and highly organized
Aptitude in problem-solving
Flexibility and teamwork
Excellent ability to manage time and meet deadlines.

Competitive salary package
Opportunity to work in a dynamic and evolving environment
Career development opportunities & Continuous education

title: Frontend Software Engineer
description:
Kariera Group, on behalf of our client, a leading digital agency with a strong presence in large-scale web and mobile projects across multiple industries is seeking a skilled and passionate Frontend Web Developer to join their high-performing team.
The company manages high-impact digital projects across diverse sectors such as e-commerce, telecommunications, finance, travel, news, and the public sector. Their work spans large-scale websites, portals, intranets, and business-critical web and mobile applications.
 
Key Responsibilities:
As a Frontend Web Developer, you will play a critical role in creating high-quality web applications. Your main duties include:

Developing Responsive User Interfaces: Utilise HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create intuitive, visually appealing web pages that look great on all devices.
Collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with designers, backend developers, and product managers to transform designs into interactive, user-friendly features.
Optimising Frontend Performance: Ensure websites load quickly and efficiently, providing a seamless experience for users.
Implementing Best Practices: Follow industry standards for coding and maintain a high level of attention to detail.
Testing and Debugging: Conduct thorough testing to identify bugs and implement effective solutions.

 
Skills and Experience:

Proficiency in Frontend Technologies: Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Version Control Systems: Experience with Git or similar version control systems.
User-Centric Design Understanding: Ability to translate user needs into functional web applications.
Problem-Solving Ability: Skill in identifying issues and generating innovative solutions.
Communication Skills: Excellent ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively.
Teamwork: Experience working in a collaborative environment with cross-disciplinary teams.

 
Education and Experience Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Experience: At least 2 years of experience in frontend development or a related field.

 
Benefits and Perks:
We offer a supportive work environment with opportunities for personal and professional growth, along with an attractive benefits package, including:

Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience.
Flexible Work Arrangements: Options for a hybrid working model.
Healthcare: Comprehensive health and wellness programs.
Professional Development: Access to training resources and conferences.
Pension Contributions: Company-sponsored pension scheme.

 
Join us on this exciting journey to reshape the digital landscape!

title: Developer/Cloud Engineer
description:
What Impact will you make?
Developer/Cloud Engineer Developer @ Deloitte Competence Center
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki, Greece that offers you a hybrid working model?
Are you ready to work on international projects for industry-leading clients around the world and elevate your tech consulting career to an international level?
If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
 
#YourOpportunity
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
#YourServiceLine
Technology & Transformation​
Our Technology & Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.​
 
#AboutYourTeam
Our Platform Development practices support our customers, in various projects, in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions, identifying and implementing cloud architectures to support the development and deployment of cloud-native solutions.
Through our services, we help our customers to create safe and reliable innovations that guarantee a real competitive advantage in the market:

Cloud-native Platform Implementation: We specialize in deploying agile applications across software development, integration, and testing realms, fostering innovation and efficiency.
Accelerated Cloud Capabilities: Our services expedite the adoption of Cloud technologies, driving tangible business value through innovative Cloud Services.
Advanced Technological Architectures: Our expertise lies in designing architectures that seamlessly integrate modern Cloud applications with enterprise systems, ensuring compatibility and scalability

#OurRequirements
Key Qualifications

Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study
Hands-on experience in the .NET ecosystem, including expertise in C# and frameworks such as ASP.NET MVC, Web API Core, and Entity Framework
Solid experience with relational databases and SQL
Familiarity with Version Control Systems (e.g., Git)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and related tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar).
Basic understanding of Cloud Computing concepts
Good command of the English Language
Ability and willingness to work in a team, but also autonomously if necessary
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
High motivation for consulting field
Availability to travel (when needed based on business needs)

Bonus Qualifications

Exposure to DevOps practices and tools, such as Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Azure or other cloud-native technologies
Experience with another backend framework, such as Node.js, Django or Spring Boot

 
#WhoWeAreLookingFor
Individuals who have a strong will to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.
 
#WhatWeOffer
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:

Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work
Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
A buddy to support you with your onboarding
Private medical health insurance plan
Ticket restaurant card
Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
Mobile phone
Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee every day at our offices 

Please note that all the well-being benefits mentioned above are subject to annual review
 
#AboutDeloitte
#OurServices
Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit & Assurance, Tax and Legal, Strategy-Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Italy and globally. In pursuing this we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.
#OurPurpose
We are led by a purpose, to make an impact that matters with clients, people and society. This purpose defines who we are and what we stand for. It's not about being the biggest. It’s about being the first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.
#OurValues
At Deloitte we foster a collaborative culture where talented individuals can produce their best work. We value innovative thinking, diverse insights and a genuinely distinctive level of customer service through our expertise and professionalism. We value difference, with respect at the heart of our inclusive culture.
#OurTalentExperience

title: Payments Risk Operations Specialist
description: Etraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We hold consumer online travel agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate & Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights, TUI, etc. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 2400 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Canada, Greece, India, Poland with the Athens office being one of the largest, hosting around 580 employees working from the center of Athens for the rest of the world. Join us and start as Payments Risk Operations Specialist in the Risk Management team!Position SummaryIf you are captivated by mind games, you possess strong investigation skills and can see patterns behind numbers and scattered pieces of information, it’s highly likely that Payments Risk Operations Specialist would be your dream job!As a Payments Risk Operations Specialist your main responsibility will be to protect Etraveli Group from financial losses due to fraudulent activities while maintaining sales and customer experience in top performance. Besides screening high risk transactions, this role should also propose innovative improvements in existing processes. The ideal candidate must have excellent investigation, problem solving and decision making skills and is expected to be up-to-date with the latest online fraud trends as well as with potential fraud screening tools.Responsibilities Screen potentially high-risk transactions accurately and in a timely manner utilizing a wide range of fraud prevention systems, tools and reports. Identify fraud patterns or abnormalities and take appropriate actions to prevent similar activities and mitigate potential future fraud. Thoroughly process and analyze fraud alerts received from external sources. Ensure transaction authenticity by contacting customers via phone and/or email. Propose innovative improvements to our existing processes, aiming to further enhance our fraud prevention and detection strategies Deliver dynamic tasks & provide support for a wide range of business analyses. Stay up to date with the latest online fraud trends, practices, and tools through continuous learning & research. Be a problem-solver. Requirements Bachelor’s degree and/or studies preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics. Excellent command of the English language. Advanced experience with MS office (especially Excel) Data driven approach along with strong critical, analytical and investigation skills. Ability to act proactively, take initiatives and demonstrate a can-do attitude focusing on producing high quality results within a fast-paced environment. Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to effectively interact with clients.  Work independently, meet tight deadlines while navigating multiple systems and processes Discretion in dealing with confidential information. High level of responsibility & integrity combined with eagerness to work in a multicultural, international environment subject to continuous changes. Previous work experience as a Fraud Analyst will be considered a plus  Availability to work on shifts around the clock (24/7) – 8-hour shifts, 5 days per week including weekends and bank holidays.  BenefitsWe are looking for people who would make the world smaller for travelers but want a bigger world of opportunities for themselves. With us you can enjoy: #LI-Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility! Health Benefits - Through partners we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need. Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece. Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Ambelokipi Metro station. Growth – We believe in personal development and continuous education, thus we offer the opportunity of role-related training on tools and best practices. We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space! We have a relaxed & fun work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast coffee/tea, playing ping pong or video games.  At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Central Monitor Data Analyst, Senior Associate- Risk Based Monitoring
description:
Pfizer careers are like no other. In our culture of individual ownership, we believe in our ability to improve future healthcare, and potential to transform millions of lives. We’re looking for new talent to join our global community, to unearth new innovative therapies that make the world a healthier place.




The Senior Associate, Central Monitor is responsible for ensuring the completeness, quality, and integrity of the subject data in the clinical trial database under Risk Based Monitoring (RBM) mode. The areas of activity include but are not limited to: developing Risk-Based Monitoring system for applicable studies, ensuring key risk indicators (KRIs) properly defined and set up in the system to support the study, processing and reviewing study data in the system for the signal and action management, follow up for the issue resolution. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures risk-based monitoring activities comply with regulations, applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Processes at all times and is familiar with supported systems (RBM system, etc.) and able to troubleshoot and provide rapid response for all database issues. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor works with the global study team to meet the study objectives.




Must-Have:• Bachelor’s degree or above or equivalent experience in a scientific or business-related discipline required.• 2-4 years working experience in the clinical development fields.• Working knowledge of clinical development process, understanding concepts of Phase I-IV and principles of study design.• Previous experience within a data management role, understanding key processes and principles associated with role including CRF design, database set-up, edit check specification, DMPs and data cleaning activities.• Knowledge of clinical trial database and its applications.• Works independently, receives instruction primarily on unusual situations.• Ability to organize tasks, time and priorities; ability to multi-task.• Ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with internal & external stakeholders, locally and globally.• Knowledge of Windows Environment and its applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, etc.).• Technical expertise and business experience in supporting clinical trials database development, data management, site monitoring, etc.• Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.• Project management skills and technical capabilities as well as effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside the organization.• Good understanding of the state-of-the-art technologies to evaluate and leverage them into improved business processes for worldwide deployment and adoption.Nice-to-Have:• Master's degree.• Relevant pharmaceutical industry experience.• Experience in Oracle, PL/SQL, SAS, R/R-Shiny, Python, Java, relational database design and database programming skills.• Experience using data visualization tools.• Proficient experience using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products.• Awareness of regulatory requirements and relevant data standards.• Knowledge of basic statistical principles and statistical methodology.• Routine problem-solving skills, developing the ability to solve complex problems using skills based on experience and extrapolation to new situations.• Experience in developing successful partnerships within study teams.

title: Accountant – Industrial Cost Analyst
description:
The company P.G. NIKAS SA, one of the largest and fastest growing industrial food companies, wishes to hire immediately:
Accountant – Industrial Cost Analyst
The position reports to the Director of Financial Analysis and aims to calculate, control and analyze the monthly cost of products, based on the company's costing principles and the requirements of Greek Legislation and International Accounting Standards.
Main Duties-Responsibilities:   

Supervision of monthly inventories and inventory control
Allocating production costs to products
Product cost control
Reconciliation of cost reports with company books
Conduct cost forecasts and monitor and explain variances
Support monthly and yearly results
Production cost budget
Cooperation with the other departments of the company and the control bodies
Provision of reliable financial data and reports (reporting) to the Management of the company

Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar position/subject
Holder of a Bachelor's degree in Economics, a Master's degree in a relevant subject will be considered an additional qualification
Very good knowledge of accounting and costing principles
Excellent knowledge of PC (MS Office) and Accounting sheets
Very good knowledge of ERP systems, knowledge of SAP system will be an added advantage
Communication and collaboration skills, critical thinking and good time management

The company offers:

Competitive salary package depending on qualifications and experience
Providing health insurance plan
Daily transportation of staff to and from company facilities
Restaurant operation with free meals
Product disposition
Ongoing training and support in the workplace
Possibility of development

All nominations will be strictly confidential

title: Business Intelligence and Data Analyst (Atrium Platinum)-Rhodes
description:
Job Description:
Responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to provide actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making. This role will focus on various aspects of the hotel's operations, including revenue optimization, and operational efficiency.
Applicant’s main accountabilities:

Collect and compile data from various sources (property management systems, reservations Platforms, financial reports) to create meaningful reports.
Develop and maintain regular performance reports on key metrics (occupancy rates, average daily rate, and revenue per available room).
Monitor and analyze market trends, competitive landscape and pricing strategies of other hotels in Rhodes.
Assist in the creation of budgets and financial forecasts.
Provide insights into revenue and cost projections for the hotel’s financial planning.
Ensure data privacy and security protocols are followed in data handing and reporting.

Applicant’s main qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data science or relevant field.
Master’s degree or equivalent in Data science, Economics or relevant field would be considered as extra asset.
Proficiency in data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of hotel management systems and databases.
Minimum 2 years’ related experience in similar role.
Fluency in English; knowledge of other languages is a plus (preferably German).

Applicant’s main capabilities & values:

Integrity and confidentiality.
Excellent organizational skills.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

Company information and benefits:
The company offers a competitive remuneration package in a dynamic and highly professional working environment. Accommodation, meals and recreational facilities are also provided.
Furthermore, educational lectures and personalized training plans are conducted in order to meet employee needs.
Finally, a merit-based performance appraisal system is implemented, and a cash bonus is provided per month based on employee performance.

title: Financial Business Analyst
description:
Your role is crucial in guiding a company's financial strategy, improving performance, and ensuring long-term financial health.
Key Responsibilities:

analysing financial results: after cleaning up the data, you analyse the historical information using ratios and metrics to determine patterns. Your job is to identify trends and compare the performance with other companies in the industry. You can evaluate the company's value and find ways to improve investment income from the analysis.
forecasting and making projections: your analysis reveals company performance predictions. You can find various financial models to help you make projections and predict the company's future performance. If you are analysing the viability of investment opportunities, the financial models help you make investment decisions.
developing recommendations: as a financial analyst, your job goes beyond crunching numbers and creating financial models. You provide recommendations on ways to improve business operations based on the projections. For instance, you list viable investment opportunities and suggest ways to improve revenue and market share. Aside from writing reports, you make presentations to clients and investors.
risk analysis: as a financial analyst, you can specialise in risk analysis and assess potential risks in a company's financial strategy. You help the managers identify sources of loss and minimise the risks involved in financial investments to increase profits.

ALSO 
As a finance data analyst you will:

Provide analytics & design reports on financial and operational aspects of the business
Prepare business plans and feasibility studies for various projects of the business
Data quality management, processing and integration for understanding and distribution of results
Ad hoc data analysis tasks to formulate strategic planning
Product stock monitoring in collaboration with all involved departments
Writing finance & sales reports with Data Analysis (ERP & Power Business Intelligence) and
monitoring annual sales plan
Suggestions for improvement in existing procedures

Qualifications
Comfort to work with numbers
Extensive experience in Excel & other reporting tools
Experience in Microsoft PowerBI data visualization tool is desired
Excellent data analysis and data processing skills
Fluency in English
University Degree in Finance/ Statistics/ Economics or equivalent/ Information Technology

title: Financial Analyst
description:
ELGEKA S.A. is the largest Greek commercial company, operating since 1974 in the Greek market, in the food sector. Offering to its collaborators, customers and suppliers, an integrated system of commercial services comprising Sales, Marketing, Trade Marketing, and Logistics, ELGEKA constitutes an integral link in the sector’s supply chain.
Operating rather as a “subsidiary” of the principals with which the company cooperates, among its primary goals is the successful brand building of the products it represents and handles.
With a long experience and deep knowledge of the market and environment in which it operates, strong infrastructure in people, facilities, and equipment, ELGEKA offers its suppliers a variety of high-quality services at the lowest possible cost. For the principals (suppliers), ELGEKA is their Variable-Cost Subsidiary, since from their end there is no need of tying up capitals in investments for the formation and function of the high-quality services they enjoy.
 
Position: Financial Analyst
Position Type: Full time, permanent.
Location: Athens, Acharnes
 Responsibilities & Duties

Monthly Sales and Profitability (P&L) Analysis by product category, channel and customer versus plans and previous year, and presentation of deviations
Support in the preparation of the Company's financial results monthly, quarterly & annually
Assist in preparation of business documents and presentations for the management team and the entire team such as: profit & loss statements, balance sheet, accounts payable, accounts receivable, statement cash flows etc.
Analyze current and past financial data and performance to make recommendations on profit enhancement
Consistently analyze financial information based on both routine and ad-hoc reports
Interpret financial data to recognize changing trends, patterns, and their meaning related to key performance indicators
Communicate financial insights suggesting business issues to management
Demonstrable ability to translate data or/and facts into executable and effective reports

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or Business Administration
2 - 4 years of relevant experience as financial or/and business analyst
Experience with financial reporting, such as forecasts, budgets, and planning
Excel skills (advanced)
Experience with ERP systems (preferably SAP) and BI reporting tools is considered an asset
Excellent command of Greek and English language, both verbal and written

 
Skills

Demonstrate strong analytical & time management skills.
Superior attention to detail and ability to successfully manage multiple competing priorities.
Ability to clearly communicate ideas and numbers and recommend action.
Eager to dive in and learn in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of project ownership, ability to work independently, as well as in a team

title: Central Monitor Data Analyst, Senior Associate- Risk Based Monitoring
description:
Why Patients Need YouPfizer Global Product Development colleagues play a key role in connecting evidenced based, medical decision support with colleagues and stakeholders to enable better health and treatment outcomes. Whether you are creating framework necessary to ensure our evidence is scientifically sound, providing unbiased, medically necessary expertise or investigating how to close gaps in data, our mission is simple. Empower healthcare decisions regarding the safe and appropriate use of medicines for patients.What You Will AchieveThe Senior Associate, Central Monitor is responsible for ensuring the completeness, quality, and integrity of the subject data in the clinical trial database under Risk Based Monitoring (RBM) mode. The areas of activity include but are not limited to: developing Risk-Based Monitoring system for applicable studies, ensuring key risk indicators (KRIs) properly defined and set up in the system to support the study, processing and reviewing study data in the system for the signal and action management, follow up for the issue resolution. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures risk-based monitoring activities comply with regulations, applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Processes at all times and is familiar with supported systems (RBM system, etc.) and able to troubleshoot and provide rapid response for all database issues. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor works with the global study team to meet the study objectives.
How You Will Achieve ItGeneral:

Implement global strategies, initiatives, processes, and standards to ensure consistent, efficient, and quality processes to meet quality, timelines and deliverables.
Provide technical expertise to set up and test study level Risk-based Monitoring system.
Plan and execute communication plans & methods to ensure customer satisfaction and enable improvements to be implemented during the course of a study.
Able to resolve conflicts, influence and communicate with key stakeholders and customers.
Implement quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities.System setup Functions:
Review protocols to ensure the set-up, review and reporting requirements can be met and are standardized.
Provide technical oversight, guidance and coordination for all the central monitor activities.
Set up and test RBM system at study level to ensure system quality.
Define key risk indicators (KRIs) in study system and ensure consistency between the standard level and the study level.
Set up dictionary for data quality assessment DQA in study system.
Ensure RBM system align with the protocol and adhere to ICH GCP, SOPs, corporate standards and regulatory requirements.Data review Functions:
Work with Study Team to define the issue resolution for the reviewing findings as signal and action.
Develop, implement and maintain Quality Control related documentations for RBM related activities to ensure data completeness and accuracy.
Perform central monitoring activities including review system outputs, propose suggestion for signal and action management, and follow up with study team for the action resolution.
Work with Clinical Data Scientist (CDS) to ensure all signal and actions are properly mitigated and RBM systems properly released.
Organizational relationships and interfaces:
Interact and collaborate with Clinical Data Scientist, CDS at study level for deliverables.
Interact and collaborate with other study team members at study level for deliverables.

Qualifications:Must-Have:

Bachelor's degree or above or equivalent experience in a scientific or business-related discipline required.
2-4 years working experience in the clinical development fields.
Working knowledge of clinical development process, understanding concepts of Phase I-IV and principles of study design.
Previous experience within a data management role, understanding key processes and principles associated with role including CRF design, database set-up, edit check specification, DMPs and data cleaning activities.
Knowledge of clinical trial database and its applications.
Works independently, receives instruction primarily on unusual situations.
Ability to organize tasks, time and priorities; ability to multi-task.
Ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with internal & external stakeholders, locally and globally.
Knowledge of Windows Environment and its applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, etc.).
Technical expertise and business experience in supporting clinical trials database development, data management, site monitoring, etc.
Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
Project management skills and technical capabilities as well as effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside the organization.
Good understanding of the state-of-the-art technologies to evaluate and leverage them into improved business processes for worldwide deployment and adoption.Nice-to-Have:
Relevant pharmaceutical industry experience.
Experience in Oracle, PL/SQL, SAS, R/R-Shiny, Python, Java, relational database design and database programming skills.
Experience using data visualization tools.
Proficient experience using commercial clinical data management systems and/or EDC products.
Awareness of regulatory requirements and relevant data standards.
Knowledge of basic statistical principles and statistical methodology.
Routine problem-solving skills, developing the ability to solve complex problems using skills based on experience and extrapolation to new situations.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
 
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Central Monitor Data Analyst, Senior Associate- Risk Based Monitoring with id 4919205.

title: Clinical Site Data Integrity Analyst
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Data Integrity Analyst will be responsible for overseeing the management of data assets, ensuring high-quality data standards, and supporting the strategic use of data across the organization. They will collaborate closely with teams within Research and Development, with a particular emphasis on CD&O, Operational Analytics & Recruitment Strategies. The role involves maintaining data integrity, implementing data governance policies, and facilitating data sharing and access while adhering to privacy and security regulations. The Data Steward will play a pivotal role in enabling data-driven decision-making and operational excellence in alignment with the company's objectives.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintain Data Accuracy: Ensure the accuracy and completeness of clinical trial site data within the organization's databases.
Data Cleaning: Regularly review and clean data to remove duplicates, correct errors, and update site information.
Relationship Management: Identify and manage existing and new relationships between sites and large site organizations to facilitate efficient trial management.
Hierarchy Management: Manage and maintain the hierarchy of sites and clinics to reflect organizational structures and affiliations accurately.
Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Work with the SiteSentry application to implement CI/CD practices, ensuring seamless updates and maintenance of site data.
Data Governance: Implement and enforce data governance policies to ensure data integrity and compliance with regulatory standards.
Collaboration: Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to manage data needs effectively, ensuring that data supports business objectives across various units.
Data Quality Assurance: Develop and apply quality assurance protocols to validate the data of clinical trial sites, ensuring it meets the required standards for analysis and reporting.
Training and Support: Provide training and support to stakeholders on data stewardship practices and the use of data management systems.
Reporting and Documentation: Generate reports on data stewardship activities and maintain comprehensive documentation of data management processes and any changes made.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Life Sciences, Public Health, Data Science) or equivalent experience.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
Familiarity with clinical research processes or healthcare data management is a plus.
Good communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Clinical Site Data Integrity Analyst with id 4917993.
