title: Manager, Digital Product Analyst
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAs a Manager, Digital Product Analyst you will work under the direction of the Enterprise Product Management leadership with products impacting the HCP experience. You will collaborate the Product Managers and agile product teams to develop, update, and realize a product vision for technologies used by thousands of HCPs and staff globally. As part of the HCP product team, you will be responsible for guiding the Product Owners to improve the quality and reliability of our entire suite of analytics, resulting in enhanced data accuracy and actionable insights. As a Product Analyst you will work directly with the data and analytics team to support solution design, resulting in a robust and scalable analytics infrastructure. You will be responsible for gathering the reporting requirements for the PfizerPro Objectives and Key Results for the Product team, and the creation of OKR dashboards enabling data-driven evaluation and alignment of our product strategy with business goals. As a Product Analyst you will play a crucial role in developing and implementing reporting mechanisms used in quarterly business review sessions, providing valuable insights and facilitating informed decision-making at the executive level.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESIn collaboration with the HCP Product Managers, this role will:

Guide the Product Owners with minimal supervision from Product Managers, in all aspects of analytics work, including more complex and/or strategic reports
Work closely with PfizerPro Business Owner to understand commercial goals and reporting requirements to support strategic discussions
Analyze HCP omnichannel engagement metrics to support ongoing discussions with senior stakeholders
Communicate findings, recommendations, and concerns to senior stakeholders
Document analytical requirements and create compelling dashboards for general PfizerPro metrics, complex feature-level metrics, data-driven funnels, and OKR dashboards





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or a related field
5+ years of relevant experience as an information technology professional in roles such of data analyst or business analyst
Strong experience working with reporting suites such as Adobe Analytics and PowerBI
Experience working in an Agile development framework
A curious and highly motivated self-starter who can work effectively across cross-functional teams and can independently drive progress toward completion with proper planning and management
Experience using standard requirements business analysis techniques, including brainstorming, interviewing, requirements sessions, activity diagrams and use cases desired
Passion for creating user-centric digital and interactive experiences
Excellent in an ambiguous environment; can ask clarifying questions to help reduce ambiguity
Strong written and verbal communication skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education in Life Science-related field of study
Good understanding of Pfizer's Business Technology organization and Pfizer's Research & Development organization
Strong analytics skills and knowledge about the biopharmaceutical industry

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

description:

Sales Analyst Manager
 
About us…
Alumil brings the best of us forward. Our mission is to deliver the creativity of all the Alumilers and thus make the world a more sustainable place. Afterall, “meraki” in Greek, means spirited work, without forcing yourself to be someone you’re not. Be you, be unique, make the difference, that’s the most precious thing to us. Responsibility, innovation, inclusion, sustainability and teamwork are the keywords we focus on.
Build excellence with us every day.
 
The role
Our Sales Analyst Manager is an active member and integral part of our Sales Division. You are located in our head offices in Thessaloniki. As Sales Analyst Manager, you are responsible for ensuring the proper management of sales’ targets, forecasts and procedures to enhance sales performance. Your daily work life consists of overseeing and optimizing the sales processes within an organization. You are responsible for managing sales data, analyzing performance metrics, developing sales strategies, and implementing tools and technologies to improve sales efficiency. On daily basis, you will give the right direction to your team to collect all the necessary data and your analysis makes a great impact to the sales strategy and for a better pricing policy to our customers. You will communicate with internal stakeholders within the sales division on a wide selection of tasks including monitoring sales' metrics performance of Alumil Group. Your working life is compromised by several sets of data that should be interpreted and used in reports for the Sales Division. For that purpose, you need to analyze complicated data structures and turn them into valuable insights. Your frequent-use tools are QPR and Power BI. Also, you participate in several sales tasks, as setting the annual budget, analyzing commercial policies, sales & operations planning and costing the produced accessories. Finally, in your responsibilities are included tech duties. You support the automations of the sales division's information systems.
 
Your impact
Indeed, the person we need requires a strong sales and tech background, with knowledge of sales efficiency and sales policies and love for analyzing data, but that’s only the beginning. We want a people-oriented and a team player person, that will coordinate the sales operations team and will come in touch with our sales and marketing team, supporting their functions to create comprehensible reports. Your analytical skills, your attention to detail and your critical thinking skills play a crucial role to understand the numbers and validate the data to reach the right conclusions. 
 
You’re bringing with you

Degree in Mathematics, Applied Informatics, Business Administration or similar
MSc in Data Analysis will be appreciated
Previous experience in a similar position or in the construction industry is required.
Experience in B2B sales, preferred.
Excellent knowledge of Excel applications and the English language
Power BI knowledge
Acquainted with Power Automate
Very good knowledge of CRM and sales policies
Organizational skills, responsibility, time management skills
Analytical skills, critical thinking ability and attention to detail

 
What you’ll gain

Provision of private life & health insurance
Bonus according to performance
Continuous learning and support
Excellent working environment
Τraining plan based on the employee’s needs
Role specific benefits

When hiring and evaluating employees, it does not discriminate based on race, gender, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, nationality, political beliefs or social status.

The position will be based at the company's offices in the area of ​​Nea Erythraia (prefecture of Attica). Responsibilities: Monitors collections and payments in accordance with budget requirements. Prepares monthly financial analyzes (& variance analysis) and cash reports, comparing results to recent forecasts and budget. Prepares budget forms as requested by senior management and shareholders to collect data of all departments. Manages information (from budget managers) to prepare budget processing records in accordance with management directives and internal standards. Works with other departments to ensure proper flow of financial information. Prepares all Statements according to the results of the Budget. Analyzes monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports to ensure financial information is accurately recorded. Develops comprehensive income and expense reports and annual forecasts. Determines financial condition by analyzing actual results compared to forecasts Prepares monthly financial review summaries for management and required financial information. Prepares the final version of the report to management from the budget packages. Required Qualifications: University Degree in Economics and/or Finance Master's degree in Economics, Finance or Business Administration will be considered an additional qualification. 5-8 years of previous work experience in the following: Financial analysis and reporting Budgeting & financial forecasting Cash practices Previous experience in financial software will be considered an asset Knowledge of basic Greek accounting principles or international financial reporting standards Expertise in spreadsheets, databases, MS applications Office Knowledge of SAP and/or other ERP system Excellent use of English Ideal Candidate Profile: Excellent skills presentation, reporting and communication Methodology and attention to detail Time and Prioritization Management Consistency and confidentiality

title: R2R Payroll Global Accounting Analyst
description:
Why Patients Need You
Your in-depth knowledge and financial skills will keep our products in production and our innovators innovating. Whether you are part of establishing, coordinating, researching, or administering financial operations, your role is critical to getting our medicines in the hands of the people who need them most, faster and more efficiently than ever before.
What You Will Achieve
Your accounting skills will help prepare the financial reports, maintain and oversee the accounts and financial records of the company. You will be responsible for preparing the Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss statements, amongst other accounting schedules and reports. You will update the journals, ledgers, and other records of financial business transactions. You will verify this data for accuracy and prepare reports and reviews based on it. You will also design, modify, and maintain the computer-based accounting systems. You will be responsible for the adherence to and communication of the accounting and auditing policies and procedures.As an associate, your focus on the job will contribute in achieving project tasks and goals. Through your domain knowledge and commitment, you will create a collaborative teaming environment for your colleagues.It is your dedication that will help make Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe.




How You Will Achieve It

Contribute to the completion of project milestones and organize own work to meet project task deadlines.
Identify issues proactively and communicate to manager along with potential range of solutions.
Prepare financial and accounting analysis completely and accurately.
Maintain elements of domestic and/or international general ledgers including the preparation of journal entries and balance sheet account reconciliations.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date Work Instructions, Job Aids and Desktop Procedures documentation.
Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues of diverse backgrounds, including different departments, cultures, business units and countries.
Lead select activities involving the month end close, take initiative to understand complex problems and consistently meet deadlines with little to no assistance.
Lead the implementation of continuous improvement projects.
Engage directly with business partners on routine activities and deliverables.
Work independently to produce standard and regular reports as required for the operation.
Assist in providing key support for internal and external related audit activities, including the timely and accurate delivery of audit requests.
Prepare complete and accurate standard operating procedures and Sarbanes-Oxley related internal control documentation involving new activities and/or process changes as required.

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's Degree
Demonstrated experience in finance or accounting with the ability to deal with numbers accurately
Proven ability to maintain professionalism and possesses the ability to interface with all levels of colleagues
Demonstrated advanced technical US GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and financial reporting knowledge and experience
Proficiency in MS Office, especially MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint

 
Nice-to-Have

Public accounting experience
Enterprise Resource Planning {e.g. SAP} system experience
System Application & Products and Hyperion Financial Management skills
Demonstrates problem solving and analytical skills
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
Excellent oral and written communication skills

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job R2R Payroll Global Accounting Analyst, id 4916964.
Please apply by sending your CV and a motivational letter in English

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
Circana (formerly IRI and NPD) is the leading advisor on the complexity of consumer behavior. Through unparalleled technology, advanced analytics, cross-industry data, and deep expertise, we provide clarity that helps almost 7,000 of the world’s leading brands and retailers take action and unlock business growth. We understand more about the complete consumer, the complete store, and the complete wallet so our clients can go beyond the data to apply insights, ignite innovation, meet consumer demand, and outpace the competition.

The BI Reporting Analyst adds value to the clients by analyzing market data and sharing insights into their key business issues that lead to maximization of growth opportunities.
The successful candidate shall be highly motivated and results-driven with a passion for the reporting space.
The candidate must be able to work independently, as well as actively participate with a collaborative team and be involved in the implementation of both solutions and technological approaches, architectures and applications used to facilitate the provision and delivery of insights that ignite growth.
A deep understanding of how CPG organizations work, what the key areas for data driven business questions are and how information granularity required varies on different seniority levels and organizations.
The role is an international role in our Centre of Reporting Excellence (CoRE) located in Athens.
University Degree preferably in Mathematics, Statistics, Operational Research, Computer Science, Business Administration or Marketing
1-2 years of professional experience in relevant BI roles
Experience in working with BI tools (IRI Unify, Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, SAP BI) is considered an asset
Fluent command of English (German, Italian, French, Dutch, Spanish a plus)
Advanced Excel skills
Strong analysis and synthesis experience
Strong ability in understanding key business indicators and translating them into business strategy
Advanced communication & interpersonal skills and capability to interact effectively across levels and functions
Curiosity, Creativity, and passion for design to deliver stellar reporting experience (R-X)

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities (with us you can always bring your full self to work). Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together.

title: Insight Analyst based in Athens
description:
ABOUT IMPERIAL BRANDS HELLAS
Is a member of Imperial Brands, a global consumer-focused organization and the fourth largest international tobacco company with presence in more than 120 markets and 25.000 employees. Imperial Brands Hellas, with 40 years of successful presence in Greece, has achieved, amongst others, to build the most premium cigarette brand in Greece, Davidoff and has a strong presence in the New Generation Products, since its portfolio includes No. 1 brand in Εlectronic Cigarettes blu and No1 in Disposables blubar, Heating Device PULZE, Heated Tobacco Sticks iD and Heated Nicotine Sticks iSENZIA.
Imperial Brands Hellas is aiming to offer a variety of innovative products, developing new consumer experiences, meeting the evolving needs of the adult nicotine users, while focuses on building a strong challenger business powered by responsibility, focus and choice, forging a path to a healthier future. 
Please access the link for more information on the Company’s website www.imperialbrands.gr
THE ROLE
We are looking for a talented Insights Analyst who will join our Insights and Intelligence Team in Greece. 
 In this role, your responsibilities will include: 

Monthly performance reviews (progress vs plan, drivers of deviation vs plan).
Volume / Share correlation and alignment monitoring
Provide fact-based forecast on Market size and share, identifying new key trends and anticipating potential changes in demand.
Analysis to support pricing strategy definition where applicable.
Trade insights including monitoring competitor activities.
Support or co-lead implementation of group reporting tool(s) and local adaptations.
Work with multiple data sources, prioritise key areas of investigation, and apply a sound interpretation of findings.
Work with Market Insight Manager to translate business needs into robust insight requirements.
Use independent consumer insights to support the Cluster Insight Manager to drive data driven decision making and challenge perceptions when required.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE  

2 to 4 years relative experience in commercial and consumer analysis preferably in the FMCG.
Bachelor’s degree with focus on Business Administration, Statistics or Marketing Analytics. Master’s degree will be considered a plus
Proficiency in English (written and oral) is non-negotiable.
Strong MS Office Skills / Primarily Advanced Excel – [pivot tables, formulas] and Powerpoint
Sound analytical and reporting skills
Excellent communication skills
Willing to take ownership and deliver on responsibilities
Organized approach, self driven, able to drive in autonomy activities and to unlock other departments support wherever required

THE COMPANY OFFERS
Competitive package of salary, bonus scheme and additional benefits

description:

To support our team, we are looking for a business analyst to join our dynamic organization. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in driving strategic decisions and optimizing sales performance through data-driven insights and analysis.
 
Key Responsibilities
1. Database Setup and Maintenance:

Design and implement a robust database to manage and store the company's data effectively with the collaboration of our external partners.
Ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility within the database.
Regularly update and maintain the database to accommodate new data and requirements.

2. Backup Management:

Develop and implement a backup strategy to OneDrive.
Ensure regular and consistent backups are taken to prevent data loss.
Monitor and manage the backup process to resolve any issues promptly.
3. Data Model Development:
Develop a comprehensive data model to facilitate combinatorial analysis of IQVIA and CRM data.
Ensure the data model supports complex data queries and analysis for strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with Sales Department stakeholders to understand data requirements and incorporate them into the model.

4. Data Integration and Analysis:

Integrate IQVIA data with CRM and real sales data to create a unified view for analysis.
Perform regular data analysis to derive insights and support business decisions.
Ensure the data models are continuously updated with the latest data and analytics requirements.

5. Data Model Maintenance:

Regularly update and maintain IQVIA and Real Sales data models.
Ensure data models are accurate, up-to-date, and reflect the latest business metrics and KPIs

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.
Database management systems (e.g., SQL, NoSQL)
Data modeling tools and techniques
Excellent knowledge of MS Office: Excel formulas, Power Pivot, Power Query, macros, charts etc.
Cloud storage solutions (e.g., OneDrive)
CRM systems
Familiarity with IQVIA data and CRM systems is a plus.

Company Offers

Competitive salary
Excellent working enviroment with continuous training
Group private insurance

description:
Landis+Gyr is a leading global provider of integrated energy management solutions. We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. Our innovative and proven portfolio of software, services and intelligent sensor technology is a key driver to decarbonize the grid and helped to avoid around 9 million tons of CO2 in FY 2023. With sales of USD 2.0 billion in FY 2023, Landis+Gyr employs around 6,900 talented people across five continents. 
For more than a century, we've been pioneers in energy innovation, and we continue to lead the way toward a more sustainable and efficient energy landscape. 
Join us at Landis+Gyr,where we manage energy better! 
 
Overall objectiveTo provide an accurate and timely administration support service to the ESG Due Diligence team through: Supplier relationship management; document collection & storage; database management.
 
Key Performance IndicatorsQuality of work produced – i.e. accuracy, timely completion of work deadlines, number of completed Supplier folders with all components correctly documented and stored. Key Areas of Responsibility
Supplier Due Diligence

Maintain IMS Records Centre in relation to Supplier Due Diligence documents.
Review SCoC uploads in preparation for weekly SDD Meeting. Note: uploads can be made by anyone e.g. Local Procurement.
Coordinate and support the proceedings of the ESG Supply Chain Due Diligence Committee meetings (e.g. draw up agenda, prepare pre-reads) and decision-making process (e.g. take minutes of meetings, keep track of actions).
Review and upload any email Correspondence / Requests into Records Centre.
Undertake ChatGPT Review where Supplier has supplied their own Code of Conduct (i.e. not just signed ours).  Review ChatGPT Summary and include recommended actions in Summary Table (in readiness for Weekly SDD Mtg). Where ChatGPT review highlights weaknesses (especially in relation to Information Security), review Supplier web pages (where these exist) to locate any published documents (such as InfoSec Policy, etc).
Hold meeting to discuss all newly submitted Codes and ChatGPT reviews. Present new Codes / Reviews / recommendations.
Where Further Information Required, prepare email for Procurement Representative to return to supplier.
To support the Contractor administration process.

 
Projects and Tasks as Required

Developing and maintaining ESG Supplier Due Diligence related policies and procedures, including the Supplier Code of Conduct and the ESG Supplier Due Diligence Procedure.
Support the project team in defining the criteria for evaluating suppliers' ESG performance.
Reviewing and approving the criteria for evaluating suppliers' ESG performance.  Providing guidance on integrating ESG considerations into supplier selection and contract management processes.
Collaborating with relevant internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Supplier Development and Supplier Quality teams, to align ESG initiatives with overall business objectives.

 
Other Tasks

To support the ESG Due Diligence team for other ad hoc projects as needed.
Other administration tasks and responsibilities as directed.

 
Required skills

Proven experience for accuracy in data management 
Proficient use of all Microsoft Packages. Knowledge of SharePoint a plus
Interest in AI for data analytics
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Ability to use own initiative and use discretion
Flexible approach to tasks set
Effective time management skills
Excellent communication skills (written & verbal)
Interest in sustainability / ESG legislation
Appreciation of working in a confidential environment
Administration skills preferably gained within a data management / customer relationship management environment
Ability to adapt to different working environments and cultures
Comfortable with business English, written and spoken 

We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone.#EnergizeYourCareer and join us on our journey towards a greener tomorrow.

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
Logistics Analyst
            Responsibilities:

This position reports/ works very closely with the Services Parts Operations Manager (SPM) helping him manage day to day operational issues
Co-ordinates and works on escalation, daily metrics, operational financials issues, internal reviews and daily tracker on various activities including ongoing projects.
Supports Parts Demand in a timely and cost-effective manner. Works with remote teams to process customer orders which include order input, resolving order holds, and notifying customer of delays.
Provides parts availability, order status, customer pricing and part number information to internal customers.
Follows the company processes in maintaining Inventory Integrity as per Company expectations
Reports quality issues/concerns to appropriate personnel.
Collaborates with other division subject-matter experts to uncover root causes of problems and assists with resolution.
Generates reports, captures information, and records data using desktop tools. Work on understanding and evaluating vendors’ invoices and identify discrepancies if any.
Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of assigned processes and procedures
Consults and Collaborates with Team and SPM in improving existing processes or establishing new ones to address, new or changes to, business requirements.
Physical receipt of incoming shipments & preparation outgoing shipments

Education and Experience:
 

At least 2 years’ experience in a similar position in a Multinational Company
Tertiary education in Logistics / IT or Finance would be a plus

 
Skills and Attributes:
 

Team Player
Analytical
Problem Solver
Target oriented
Self-driven
Proven Fluency in MS Office Applications (Excel, Access, etc.)
Excellent Communication and interpersonal skills

title: Data Analyst
description:
Loulis Food Ingredients holds the 1st position in the Greek flour industry and in the production and distribution of bakery and confectionery raw materials.
With four state-of-the-art production facilities in Sorpi, Keratsini, Thiva and Toshevo, Bulgaria, LOULIS FOOD INGREDIENTS has been identified in the minds of its partners, suppliers and customers with the provision of excellent quality products, excellent service and value creation for society and nutrition.
Starting in 1782, the company today constantly invests in new technologies and upgrades its production with the aim of protecting the environment and its dynamic contribution to the national economy. 
For our factory in Sourpi (Volos), we are looking for a Data Analyst.
Main tasks:

Production department data collection and processing
Control and monitor KPIs
Optimization of production processes
Participation in projects of a technical nature

Required Qualifications:

University graduate (Mechanical or Electrical Engineer)
0-3 years in a similar position
Analytical skills with the ability to organize, analyze and transfer information
Attention to detail
Very good knowledge of Excel
Knowledge of English
Completed military service (if applicable)

The company offers:

Full and permanent employment.
Private Medical and Pharmaceutical benefits package
Respect for the partner and spirit of cooperation
Development prospects in a stable company, number 1 in its sector.

title: Vendor Data Master Analyst
description: Hellas Gold Single Member S.A. is a gold, silver, lead and zinc mining company headquartered in Athens, Greece. Since 2004, Hellas Gold operates the Kassandra Mines at N.E. Chalkidiki, under the strictest EU safety and environmental standards and regulations. The Kassandra Mines consist of the operating mine at Olympias the state-of-the-art Kokkinolakkas Tailings Managements Facility and the Skouries project. Evolving a mining history of 25 centuries, Hellas Gold invests in the development of sustainable mining in the region, contributing to the local economic growth and prosperity with investments of more than $1 billion, the employment of 1,600 people, the active support to the local suppliers, and important investments to local community initiatives and projects. Since 2012, Hellas Gold operates as a subsidiary of the Canadian-based Eldorado Gold Corporation, which has over 25 years of experience in exploration, construction and operation of mines around the world.We live our values in pursuit of our purpose: to find a better way to do things. We aim to break new ground in all that we do. We do this by creating a positive impact today, and for future generations, through our commitment to operating safely, sustainably, and profitably.The company offers the opportunity to those who wish to express interest in the position of “Vendor Master Data Analyst”, for its premises in Thessaloniki. The position will be reported to the Financial Accountant & AP Manager of the Finance department in Thessaloniki.Main Responsibilities:· Handle balance confirmation requests received from vendors promptly and accurately.· Coordinate with internal departments, such as Accounts Payable and Accounting, to verify and confirm vendor balances.· Address vendor queries and concerns regarding invoices, payments, and account statements.· Obtain and review vendor statements for accuracy and completeness.· Confirm that all transactions are captured and recorded in the accounting system and the respective clearing of the payment record and the vendor invoices has been completed successfully.· Generate balance reconciliation letters and forward it as required.· Receive incoming invoices through various channels (hard copies, mail, email, electronic submissions, etc.)· Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements for efficiency.· Initiate and oversee the creation of new business partner master data in the system.· Review and process requests for changes to existing business partner master data.· Conduct annual reviews of business partner master data to verify its accuracy and completeness.· Monitor and manage vendor payment terms in collaboration with the Procurement team.· Develop and execute processes for deactivating vendors when necessary and archive historical vendor data in accordance with data retention policies.· Support integration projects and initiatives.Requirements:· A university degree, preferably in Accounting or Finance.· At least 3-5 years of experience in a similar position, with a good understanding of business processes.· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.· Excellent organizational skills.· Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.· Confidentiality, honesty, dedication, responsibility, initiative, a proactive approach, and time management skills.· Excellent knowledge of laws and regulations, with practical experience in IFRS.· Certified Public Accountant license from the Economic Chamber.· Excellent command of the English language.· Strong knowledge of MS Office and SAP, with a preference for SAP S/4HANA experience.Our company offers a competitive remuneration package that includes an attractive combination of basic salary and benefits, as well as opportunities for development in a challenging work environment.Inclusion and DiversityHellas Gold is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfill their potential.If you are looking for a global and dynamic environment, please send us your CV in English.

title: ΒΙ Analyst
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to join our team. The BI Analyst will be responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that drive business decisions and strategies. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in data analysis, excellent problem-solving skills, and proficiency with BI tools and techniques.
Responsibilities:

Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Reporting: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate key performance metrics and business insights.
Data Integration: Integrate data from multiple sources to provide a comprehensive view of business performance.
Business Insights: Provide actionable insights and recommendations to support business strategies and decision-making.
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, finance, and operations, to understand data needs and deliver insights.
Data Quality: Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across all reporting and analysis activities.
Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with the latest BI tools, technologies, and best practices to continually enhance data analysis processes.
Problem-Solving: Identify and resolve data-related issues and discrepancies.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst or in a similar role.
Proficiency with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and database management.
Proficiency with SQL and data querying languages.
Experience with statistical analysis and data mining is a plus.

Interested parties are invited to submit their application to have the opportunity to work in a pleasant and supportive environment, in a steadily growing company in the hotel industry.

AEGEAN, based in Athens, Greece, is a member of Star Alliance Group since 2010 and a proud winner of 14 SKYTRAX World Airline awards as the ‘Best Regional Airline in Europe’. If you wish to explore the exciting world of aviation, join our team!

If you want an excellent opportunity to actively support the decision-making process, create impact and add value in a modern and agile environment, this role is for you.

Research and analyse market, industry and competitor trends and network economics

Present data and analysis results to all stakeholders
Support data collection, data maintenance and reporting
Evaluate schedule performance, propose operational improvements and monitor the impact of proposed changes

Bachelor’s Degree in a Quantitative/Numerical field or equivalent experience (a degree in Engineering is considered a strong asset)
Fluency in oral and written Greek and English
Proficient in MS office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SQL or similar software skills

Solving and analyzing problems, to probe facts and figures

Teamwork and Collaboration
Building and maintaining positive working relationships at all levels and across departments
Communicating and delivering ideas in an effective manner

 
If you pursue your career journey with AEGEAN, on top of a challenging job, we offer:

title: Analytical Development Analyst
description:
PharmaPath, a Greek pharmaceutical company with a rich history and significant legacy in the pharmaceutical field of generic medicines, is seeking a dedicated and skilled Analytical Development Analyst to join our dynamic team. 
 
Main duties & key responsibilities:

Performs daily analysis according to the relevant analytical methods and daily analysis program for lab-scale batches, pilot batches, stability studies, APIs and excipients
Performs sampling for APIs and excipients according to the relevant SOPs if necessary
Executes Method Development, Method Validation and Method Transfer protocols
Performs daily instrument calibrations according to the relevant procedures (balances, pH meters, Karl Fischer titer determination etc)
Records all data and results in specified forms (paper and electronic) with accuracy and responsibility
Performs integration of chromatograms according to the relevant procedures, calculates and evaluates the daily analytical results
Conducts data review to ensure completeness and accuracy of records and notifies the Senior Manager or Senior Analyst in case of OOS/OOT results and / or instrument, system suitability failure
Follows the laboratory safety rules
Cleans the laboratory equipment and laboratory areas according to schedule
Organizes and stores all chemicals substances, solvents, standards, samples and columns according to internal procedures instructions. Disposes all expired solvents, standards, analyzed samples according to the internal procedures
Places samples in the stability chambers. Removes and disposes stability samples according to the relevant schedule
Assists in maintenance and troubleshooting of instruments
Assists in ordering laboratory supplies


Requirements:

Bachelor Degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy or any other relevant field
Minimum 1 year of experience in R&D pharmaceutical laboratory
Working experience in pharmaceutical analytical techniques such as HPLC, GC, UV-Vis and Empower 3 software
Previous experience with Method Development, Method Validation and Method Transfer activities
Comprehensive understanding of Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Safety regulations and Quality Assurance Systems
Strong problem-solving attitude & results orientation
Attention to detail with focus on deliverables, quality and project timelines
Fluent in Greek & English


Benefits:

Competitive remuneration package, including benefits
Ability to become part of one of the most dynamic and prospective teams in the Pharmaceutical industry in Greece
Continuous opportunities in advancing personal and career goals

description:
Job Title: 
Telemedicine Systems Support Specialist and Health Data Analyst 
Company: 

 DRAKOPOULOS & Co OE (DEXTERA)

Location: 
Marousi, Athens 
Category: 
Full-Time 
Department: 
Sales and Business Development 
The Company: 
Dextera is an innovative consulting company specializing in IT and digital health solutions, with over 15 years of dynamic presence in the Greek market. Bringing the latest solutions and technologies to the largest Greek and international organizations, Dextera aims to improve operational efficiency and disrupt traditional business models through technology.  If you are a young professional who loves technology and are looking for an environment that encourages continuous development and innovation, Dextera is the ideal place for you! Here you will have the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of digital solutions that shape the future, showcase your skills, and grow professionally in a creative and ever-evolving environment. 
Job Description: 
The position involves supporting the telemedicine systems provided by the company, including the National Telemedicine Network, with a focus on operational support and analysis of operational and business data using modern tools. The candidate will actively participate in managing telemedicine systems, resolving daily issues, and implementing mid- to long-term strategies, while also analyzing data regarding the performance of services provided by the telemedicine system. 
Responsibilities: 
- Providing operational support for telemedicine systems. - Collaborating with technical teams and external technical providers to resolve technical and business issues and improve system operations. - Collecting and analyzing data on the performance and quality of telemedicine services. - Preparing reports to monitor the performance of systems and service quality. - Participating in the development of methods to improve services through data analysis. 
Required Qualifications: 
- Degree in IT, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. - Basic experience in system support. - Ability to collaborate and communicate to resolve technical issues. - Data analysis skills with basic tools like Excel. - Communication and negotiation skills. - Excellent command of the English language, both spoken and written. 
Desired Qualifications: 
- Good knowledge of health information systems or telemedicine technologies. - Experience with SAS platforms (e.g., SAS VIYA) for data analysis. - Experience in health data analysis or a similar position. - Knowledge of programming tools for data analysis (Python, R). - Experience in telemedicine environments or electronic health systems. - Ability to use data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI). 
What We Offer: 
- Competitive salary and benefits package. - Participation in innovative projects in the field of telemedicine and data analysis. - Continuous training and opportunities for professional development. - Dynamic and friendly work environment. 
How to Apply: 
If you are interested in joining our team, send your CV and a cover letter to hr@dexteraconsulting.com.

title: Manager, Digital Product Analyst, IRT Systems
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
As a Manager, Digital Product Analyst for IRT systems, you will be responsible for developing, updating, and realizing a holistic vision for the data and digital platforms, tools and technologies that enable IRT systems. You will be responsible for working with product managers, business stakeholders, and development teams to evaluate key business problems, impacts from feature releases and experimentation results to continuously advance and evolve user experiences.Working in close partnership with the user community and other stakeholders across the WRDM and Digital organizations, you will analyze and interpret business needs and translate them into powerful, functional, beautiful, and well-integrated software products that generate novel scientific insights, enhance productivity, and drive a superior user experience.Through your compelling vision and inspirational leadership, you will lead a cross-functional agile product team consisting of software, data and infrastructure engineers, designers, and user supporters and work closely with Technical Leads and Product Owners to align on technical decisions, build consensus, and resolve obstacles along the product lifecycle.You will demonstrate excellence in product centricity, combining your knowledge of clinical supply and technology to innovative digital solutions, manage the product backlog in alignment with product roadmap, and define meaningful ways to measure value and impact. You will partner with the Enterprise Product Management team responsible for the vision, strategy, design, and roadmap of digital products which will provide a consistent and delightful experience for internal and external users and the internal stakeholders whose business goals depend on the success of products created for them.You will deliver consistent, stable product operations, and meet all security, stability, usability, performance, and sustainability requirements. You will energetically evangelize and promote your products, give demos, and prove the impact of your solutions on Pfizer and our patients.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Analyze business processes and operational workflows to understand user needs and improvement opportunities, solicit, interpret and synthesize user requirements, and drive product design activities to translate these requirements into elegant, workable and well-integrated digital products that maximize value and impact to R&D
Define and prioritize product features, align stakeholders, manage product roadmaps and backlogs, coordinate and support user-acceptance testing, drive user adoption, evangelize products, train users, and assess business value and impact
Coordinate the creation and delivery of user stories and ensure they are aligned with the features prioritized by the product team
Partner with the Digital delivery teams and other Digital functions to effectively communicate product requirements and ensure that solutions are delivered on time, on budget and on value in an agile manner
Work closely with Product Owners and Technical Leads on priorities and day-to-day decision making
Define, monitor, and achieve product success and value metrics
Advocate for the needs of the customers in the agile team
Apply user-centered design principles and practices throughout the product development lifecycle, and coordinate with other product and digital teams to ensure a seamless, frictionless, end-to-end user experience
Partner with the Enterprise Product Management function to promote effective adoption of product management standards, best practices, and enterprise roadmaps across all of Pfizer
Lead business case development for continuous investments and contribute to strategic planning
Contribute to the overall success and lifecycle of the product during definition, design, user story / requirements creation, documentation, launch, management updates, and metrics reporting





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum of Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, life sciences or a business-related discipline such as logistics; advanced degree preferred
Strong business analysis, product design and product management skills
5+ years' experience in a product owner or a business analyst role
Experience working with scientific and/or clinical systems and data
Experience working in an Agile development framework
Ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional scientific and technical teams
Ability to navigate through organizational complexity to get the work done
Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
Deep empathy for the end user and a passion for the user experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree in computer science, data science, logistics or another business-related discipline
Business analysis, product design and / or product management experience
Experience in developing and implementing software and data systems for the life sciences
Experience in agile software development and knowledge of modern programming languages and development environments
Experience with computer systems validation and delivering solutions to GxP requirements

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Digital Product Analyst, IRT Systems id 4920344.

title: QA Analyst
description:
About us – we are a challenger bank in Southeast Europe and regional leader in alternative payment solutions, building an ecosystem by combining financing and shopping to address customers’ needs. Our successful business model and customer-focus approach allowed us to be one of the most profitable and efficient banks in the region. We currently serve customers in Romania, Germany, Bulgaria & Lithuania.We have now expanded our global footprint in Greece with thousands of merchants and consumers. Do you want to play a key role in our unique success story?
If yes, we are looking for a QA Analyst to join our Team in Greece!
What You Get To Do In This Role

Collaborate with stakeholders, developers, and product managers to create detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios based on functional requirements and user stories.
Conduct various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate the accuracy and functionality of banking software and applications.
Defect Identification and Reporting: Accurately identify, record, and prioritize defects using bug tracking tools, and work closely with the development team to facilitate timely resolution.
Data Analysis: Perform data validation and verification to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data within the applications.
Performance Testing: Conduct performance and load testing to evaluate system responsiveness, scalability, and stability under various conditions.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to address and resolve issues effectively.

 
What we are looking for:




Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience as a QA Analyst or similar role in the banking or financial services industry.
Familiarity with banking processes, financial systems, and FinTech trends.
Proficiency in manual and automated testing techniques, including test planning, execution, and defect management.
Experience with testing frameworks and tools, such as JIRA, or similar.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify, isolate, and document defects effectively.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a team and with stakeholders.
Analytical mindset with the ability to think critically and troubleshoot issues proactively.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment, adapting to changing priorities and tight deadlines.

 
In Return, We Will Give You

Opportunity to be a part of growing organization where you can see the difference you made!
Competitive Salary
A friendly environment & team of passionate multinational professionals. Don’t be surprised if you talk to 16+ nationalities @ tbi bank!

 
If this sounds like something you’d be interested in, we'd love to hear from you!To apply for this position, please send us your CV in English.Your candidacy shall be treated confidentially in accordance with the GDPR. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview.

description:
We are looking for a Product Qwner to collaborate with our team on key projects. In this role, you will coordinate tasks, manage vendors, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into actionable requirements and drive the product forward. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in product management, project management, or product ownership.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with Project Teams: Work with Product and Project Managers to optimize productivity.
Full Lifecycle Involvement: Contribute to all phases of the project lifecycle, from planning to delivery.
Requirement Gathering & Task Delegation: Help define requirements and assign tasks to team members.
Customer Engagement: Translate customer needs into product features and ensure alignment.
Technical Expertise: Understand technical aspects like data pipelines and algorithms to guide product development.
Stakeholder Management: Facilitate communication between internal teams (development, QA, operations) to ensure project goals are met.
Documentation & Testing: Oversee product documentation and user acceptance testing for quality assurance.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Technical Project Manager, Business Analyst especially in Agile or cross-functional settings.
Product Backlog Management: Previous experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, or acting as a liaison between technical teams and stakeholders is highly desirable.
Technical Understanding: Solid understanding of data pipelines, algorithms, and automated systems.
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Customer Focus: Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into technical requirements or product features.

Benefits

Competitive Salary: A remuneration package that rewards your skills.
Health Benefits: Private health care insurance.
Remote Work: Flexibility to work remotely, allowing for a better work-life balance.
Work-Life Balance: Generous vacation policy and flexible working hours to accommodate your personal needs.
Supportive Environment: A friendly and stable workplace within a leading company in the energy sector, focused on employee growth and satisfaction.

title: Decision Support CoE Finance Analyst - Market Facing Team
description:
Working together for a healthier worldFounded in 1849, Pfizer is the world's premier biopharmaceutical company taking new approaches to better health. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver quality, safe and effective prescription medicines to treat and help prevent disease for both people and animals. We also partner with healthcare providers, governments and local communities around the world to expand access to our medicines and to provide better quality health care and health system support. At Pfizer, colleagues in more than 90 countries work every day to help people stay happier and healthier longer and to reduce the human and economic burden of disease worldwide.Role DescriptionThe Decision Support Center of Excellence (DS CoE) Finance Analyst position is a Finance position responsible for undertaking data validation and financial management reporting and analysis in order to support our Finance customers. Key stakeholders will be Finance Business Partners / Senior Finance Business Partners. The DS CoE Finance Analyst is responsible for, but not limited to, conducting the following key activities:

Plan, Budget and Forecast modelling
Financial Reporting analytics
Presentation development and preparation
Data Validation & Continuous improvement
Report consolidation and submission

This role will require strong analytical ability, coupled with sufficient knowledge of business / finance analysis tools and methodologies. Analysts will be expected to respond to requests from Supervisors or Managers in an efficient and timely manner.
ResponsibilitiesPlan, Budget and Forecast modelling:

Collect Data - Gather data from internal Pfizer systems and data external non-Pfizer systems and sources necessary for OP Plan and LE
Prepare Data - Format data for entry into model or analysis, load data into appropriate tool
Run Models - Input assumptions and data, run model
Validate Revenue and Expense Data
Analyze Output - Highlight significant variances to budget, actuals and prior year, pinpoint specific type of variance categorize variances as system/technical or business related, follow-up with suspected system/technical related variances, create variances report, categorizing variances by type, amount and specific location


Root Cause Research - Research business related variances, identify variance as manual accounting error or legitimate business movement, follow-up with GFS or market colleagues to resolve variance
Write Commentary - Prepare memo (email) to finance leadership, describe trends for the reporting period for each report, including an explanation of remaining variances
Support Finance as needed - Gathering assumptions, updating business

Financial Reporting analytics:

Collect Data - Gather data from external Non-Pfizer systems and sources necessary for reporting or analysis
Develop Standard Reports - Determine if reporting need is already met by Standard Reporting Package, Document Reporting Parameters, Construct Shared View of New Report in Reporting Tool, Review Output with Report Requestor, Adjust as Necessary, Save View in Reporting Tool and Add to List of Standard Reports
Validate Data - Compare the following data types across systems/data warehouses: revenue, COGS, OPEX, Overall PNL; highlight discrepancies in data, determine source of data discrepancies, classify reconciling items as mapping error (if applicable type) and if necessary, follow up with account team for applicable system to resolve
Run Reports - Confirm that data is available and validated, access reporting systems/tools, select appropriate parameters, run/refresh report (Essbase) or export to Excel and modify as necessary
Analyze, Research and Prepare Commentary on Output
Prepare reports: Compile and submit financial analysis reports
Support presentation preparation - Replace content with content from current Op Plan and LE

Presentation Development and Preparation:

Prepare Recurring Presentations - update recurring presentations with new data and commentary, review and finalize presentations
Prepare Ad Hoc Presentations - prepare ad hoc presentations as needed per request from manager

Data Validation & Continuous improvement:

Maintain KPI's to reflect current data
Additional data validation tasks as outlined elsewhere
Drive and enable Continuous Improvements by constantly focusing on opportunities for improving efficiency and effectiveness of existing and new processes.

Report Consolidation and Submission:

Consolidate Results - Receive Offline reports and commentary or export data from reporting tool, consolidate data into central report
Submit Results - In email or by posting to shared drive, submit results of report with commentary
Review Output with Customers - Review report and commentary with business partners

QualificationsMust-Have

Bachelor's degree in mathematics/finance/accounting or related field required
Fluent in English - must be able to effectively communicate with colleagues in other countries who's first language is not English
Advanced Microsoft Office capabilities, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
Competency with spreadsheets & financial modelling (comfort with data manipulation and financial systems)
Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong communication skills, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and can multi-task, consistently meeting deadlines on multiple activities

Nice-to-Have

Master's degree / accounting qualification(or part qualified)
Relevant work experience
Prior experience with System Application & Products Business Intelligence (BI) and Hyperion Planning financial systems
Management Reporting and Analysis process experience preferred
Interest and experience in financial analysis and reporting
Good understanding of accounting principles and experience of working as an expert
Ability to identify business issues/opportunities and to frame business questions
Basic knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Decision Support CoE Finance Analyst - Market Facing Team, id 4921998.
Please apply by sending your CV and a motivational letter in English

title: Long Term Energy Analyst
description: On behalf of our client, ELPEDISON, we are looking to recruit a Long-Term Energy Analyst.This role offers a direct contractual association with Elpedison, ensuring that you become an integral part of our client's payroll and contribute your skills to their esteemed organization. Please be aware that our role is exclusively focused on overseeing the recruitment process.The companyElpedison is the first independent energy utility in Greece, and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. Elpedison, with its two privately-owned power plants in Thisvi (Voiotia) and Thessaloniki, with a total installed capacity of 820 MW, uses natural gas as fuel and ensures a clean and continuous electricity flow, based on a highly environmentally friendly power generation process.We operate with enthusiasm in what we do and we pride ourselves of offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. The Long-Term Energy Analyst focuses primarily on helping to implement the company’s energy long-term business and secondarily to support the desk’s commodities trading activities. As part of the responsibilities, a Long-Term Energy Analyst actively participate in the development of analytics and infrastructure and therefore we are looking for a highly analytical person with competency in data analysis, math and statistics.Responsibilities Performs quantitative analysis to provide rolling forecasts for electricity prices, mid-term plans and strategic planning of the company. Analyzes large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns. Develops analytic tools to facilitate operations. Estimates productions and economics for the Company’s asset portfolio. Assists in the development and creation of medium and long-term strategies that help the Company to achieve power business and development objectives. Participates in processes for retail/wholesale hedge portfolio. Analyzes sets of data to quantify profit and support decision-making related to the company’s portfolio. Regularly interacts with teams internally to discuss strategies, business implications, and market developments, which affect the power business. Monitors weather, load, price behavior, transmission constraints/outages, and generation outages to identify risks to the company position and take appropriate actions to mitigate portfolio risk. Identifies needs for Long Term Electricity Cross-border Trading, communicates with counterparties and reviews contractual process. Requirements BSc in Engineering or Mathematics MSc in related field will be highly desirable At least 2-5 years of proven experience in the energy sector Knowledge in R and/or Python or any statistical software will be an asset Understanding of machine-learning and operations research Excellent user of MS Office Suite, with specialization in MS Excel Excellent command of the English language, both written and oral Strong quantitative, analytic, modelling, pricing and risk management skills Self-drive and motivation Interest in applying technology and quantitative skills to solve complex trading problems Ability to communicate effectively across multiple teams and functions Benefits Competitive salary Performance-based variable pay Ticket restaurant card Transportation reimbursement Private Health Insurance coverage Pension Scheme Home electricity discount Continuous learning & upskilling opportunities and access to our online training platform Flexible work from home options available #LI-Hybrid

title: Business Intelligence and Data Analyst (Atrium Platinum)-Rhodes
description:
Job Description:
Responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to provide actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making. This role will focus on various aspects of the hotel's operations, including revenue optimization, and operational efficiency.
Applicant’s main accountabilities:

Collect and compile data from various sources (property management systems, reservations Platforms, financial reports) to create meaningful reports.
Develop and maintain regular performance reports on key metrics (occupancy rates, average daily rate, and revenue per available room).
Monitor and analyze market trends, competitive landscape and pricing strategies of other hotels in Rhodes.
Assist in the creation of budgets and financial forecasts.
Provide insights into revenue and cost projections for the hotel’s financial planning.
Ensure data privacy and security protocols are followed in data handing and reporting.

Applicant’s main qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data science or relevant field.
Master’s degree or equivalent in Data science, Economics or relevant field would be considered as extra asset.
Proficiency in data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of hotel management systems and databases.
Minimum 2 years’ related experience in similar role.
Fluency in English; knowledge of other languages is a plus (preferably German).

Applicant’s main capabilities & values:

Integrity and confidentiality.
Excellent organizational skills.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

Company information and benefits:
The company offers a competitive remuneration package in a dynamic and highly professional working environment. Accommodation, meals and recreational facilities are also provided.
Furthermore, educational lectures and personalized training plans are conducted in order to meet employee needs.
Finally, a merit-based performance appraisal system is implemented, and a cash bonus is provided per month based on employee performance.

title: Technology & Design Business Analyst @ Thessaloniki
description:
What Impact will you make?
 
Your Opportunity
Understand our business and ensure we are investing in the right technologies!
Our organization is always looking forward, whether it is to support our clients or our colleagues within the firm. In such an exciting environment, we need to ensure that the technology investments are the right ones, aligned to technology roadmaps and offering tangible business value. That’s where you come in! We want you to work with colleagues across the North and South Europe (NSE) cluster to understand their business and develop robust business cases that will drive our business forward.
 
Join Deloitte and help us make an impact that matters to all current and future Deloitters!
 
Your Role and Responsibilities
You will work closely with the NSE functional leader – Head of Technology support, to standardize technology across NSE and establish a NSE VDI service team to ensure a consistent user experience and frictionless support. Additionally, you will work closely with other members of the NSE Business Design team, and other stakeholders across Technology and Digital Services.
 
Specific responsibilities include;

Conducting data gathering exercises
Developing a business case for the leadership team and gaining their support for the standardization approach.
Inputting demands into ServiceNow, capturing all necessary information to facilitate effective decision-making.
Socialize the business case to stakeholders across NSE and the NSE leadership team.
Supporting the NSE Head of Technology Support Services by promoting and onboarding individuals to the standardization approach.
Providing support and coordinating activities for the COP lead and gathering requirements per Geo for the use of refurbished devices.
Conducting a persona investigation and creating different personas applicable to various situations.

 
Our Requirements
We are looking for candidates with:

Business Analysis and/or Business Architecture skills, with a focus on business case creation.
Stakeholder management skills, with gravitas to gain credibility and trust with stakeholders at all levels across the organization, with the ability to challenge where required.
Ability to understand, interpret, present and challenge complex information working with colleagues across all levels of the firm.
A strong “can do” attitude with an ability to motivate colleagues to do the same.
A role model as a team player with an ability to work collaboratively and positively with others in an open, friendly, flexible and facilitating manner.
Confident and comfortable to work under pressure and manage a number of tasks simultaneously.

 
What we offer
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:
🏠 Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
⚖ Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
🌍 Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
📚 Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
🚀 Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
🤼 Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work
🎉 Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
🏃 A buddy to support you with your onboarding
🌴 Extra days of annual leave
⚕ Private medical health insurance plan
💳 Ticket restaurant card
🛒 Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
📱 Mobile phone
🍏 Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee everyday at our offices
 
Our story
Your service line: Enabling Functions
At Deloitte, we’re all about making an impact that matters, together. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong Enabling Functions teams. With our combined specialist skills and business partnering expertise, we provide all the essential strategy, support, and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. So not only will you be providing world-class support to our internal clients, you’ll be making an impact for all the hugely influential organizations Deloitte works with too.
 
About Deloitte
Our services
Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory, Tax and Legal. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Greece and globally. In pursuing this, we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.
 
Our purpose
We are led by a purpose, to make an impact that matters with clients, people and society. This purpose defines who we are and what we stand for. It's not about being the biggest. title: Trade Support Analyst (PA)-Italian Speakers
description:
Nextcom, in collaboration with a prominent European Embassy, is seeking a qualified and motivated Trade Support Analyst to support Italian companies entering the Greek market and assist Greek businesses exploring opportunities in Italy.
This role plays a pivotal part in fostering commercial relationships and facilitating bilateral trade between Italy and Greece.
Key Responsibilities:

Market Research & Analysis: Provide comprehensive and up-to-date market data and sectoral reports on key areas of trade between Italy and Greece, supporting the activities of the Italian Trade Agency (ICE) in Athens.
Business Development Support: Assist in organizing one-on-one meetings between Greek businesses, investors, and other professionals with Italian counterparts to promote cross-border trade and investment opportunities.
Reporting & Communication: Prepare detailed reports for the Trade Agency headquarters and the Embassy in Greece, highlighting the activities and outcomes achieved by ICE Athens.
Travel & Representation: Occasionally represent the Italian Trade Agency domestically and internationally, particularly in Italy, to facilitate commercial exchanges and support trade delegations.

Qualifications:

MBA or Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business, Marketing, or a closely related field.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience for MBA holders, or 4 years for Bachelor's degree holders, in a similar role within the private and/or public sector.
Fluency in English and Italian is required.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Desired Competencies:

Strong analytical and research capabilities.
Excellent organizational and communication skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to work in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary package.
Opportunities for professional growth and international travel.
A collaborative and dynamic work environment with exposure to international trade and diplomacy.

If you are passionate about international trade and meet the qualifications outlined above, we encourage you to apply for this unique opportunity.

Creates reporting and analytics solutions with appropriate oversight that support the quality and timely delivery of data management reports and visualizations required per standard and study specific data review plans.

Knowledge of reporting and analytics tools that support the accuracy and integrity of study data

title: Senior Associate, Reporting Analyst, Data Management Reporting and Analytics, Clinical Data Sciences
description:
Pfizer careers are like no other. In our culture of individual ownership, we believe in our ability to improve future healthcare, and potential to transform millions of lives. We’re looking for new talent to join our global community, to unearth new innovative therapies that make the world a healthier place.
ROLE SUMMARYAs part of the Clinical Data Sciences (CDS) group, an integral delivery unit within the Global Biometrics and Data Management (GBDM) organization, the Senior Associate, Reporting Analyst has responsibilities for the collection, documentation and programming of study and asset level data cleaning and monitoring report requirements. The Senior Associate, Reporting Analyst will have responsibilities for the timely and high quality development and delivery of reporting solutions supporting the Pfizer portfolio.ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Creates reporting and analytics solutions with appropriate oversight that support the quality and timely delivery of data management reports and visualizations required per standard and study specific data review plans.
Creates any needed documentation for reports throughout the lifespan of the study and or asset for all Data Management Reporting and Analytics (DMRA) deliverables and ensures proper filing in the Trial Master File filings when appropriate.
Complies with applicable SOPs and work practices
Collaborates with other analysts, Clinical Data Scientists and other roles as needed to apply standards and to develop data cleaning reports to support of the data review plan
Knowledge of reporting and analytics tools that support the accuracy and integrity of study data

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or related field
3+ years of relevant experience, preferably in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or Regulatory agency.
Awareness of drug development process and data operations required for the reporting of clinical trial data (e.g. data review, study reports, regulatory submissions, safety updates, etc.)
Awareness of regulatory requirements and relevant data standards (CDISC knowledge and experience are preferable)
Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication skills including ability to communicate remotely
Technical skills and experience using relational databases (e.g. MS SQL Server, MS Access, or Oracle) and data visualization tools (e.g. Spotfire, jReview)
Experience in Oracle, PL/SQL, Python/R, SAS, relational database design and database programming skills
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite of tools (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.)
Business English required

title: Junior Digital Banking Business Analyst
description:
About the company
FinTech Insights is the world's leading competitive analysis tool for banks and fintechs. The world's largest Banks, including US Bank, Citibank, UBS, Barclays, Santander, and many more, rely on our platform to monitor competition and make accurate decisions.
 
You will have the chance to join our rapidly expanding team and be part of one of the most successful fintech companies worldwide. Learn more about FinTech Insights here: https://www.fintechinsights.io/
 
About the role
The Digital Banking Analysts are the team members responsible for analyzing the Digital Banking systems and feeding our platform with the needed data. This team is the cornerstone of our platform.
This position is for our offices in Athens, Greece.
 
What you'll be doing
You will be responsible for the analysis of the Digital Banking Platforms for Banks and Fintech worldwide. Apart from identifying features and services provided by each bank, the analyst needs to be able to have incredible attention to detail, organization skills, as well as the responsibility of a large portfolio of Banks and Fintechs. The
FinTech Insights team members are continuously coming in contact with various different banking systems, philosophies, characteristics, and analyzing all these parameters.
 
What you'll need

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Technology, or similar field (senior year students, expecting graduation are also applicable)
Excellent command of the English Language (both in oral and written form)
Ability to understand and create flowcharts and graphs, including UML diagrams
Attention to detail
Be methodical and a good time manager
Team spirit and commitment toward achieving deadlines

 
Nice to have

Familiarity with banking products
Prior experience in a similar position

 
Why work with us?
We value our team, it’s our family. We do everything to make you feel amazing. Among other things, we offer:

Attractive remuneration package
Private Comprehensive Health Insurance
Flexible working on-premises or remotely. What works best for you!
Excellent working environment (we call it “Heaven”).
In-house and paid training
Access to unlimited caffeine
Ability to flourish within a dynamically growing organization

title: Financial Planning & Sales Analyst (1)
description:
It’s been a whole century since the first KYKNOS can, appeared in Greek households. Since then much has changed. However, in all these years the consumers’ love and trust in KYKNOS have undoubtedly been enduring.  
 Our vision
“To grow by evolving into a more socially conscious food company offering natural, plant-based and tasty products in an ethical and sustainable way throughout the food chain from farmers to consumers. To achieve this, we commit to closely cooperate with farmers, the scientific community, and available technologies (i.e. smart farming, robotics, etc.) to improve and increase the production of agricultural products, while delivering a more sustainable planet to the next generation.”
Kyknos team having an extended presence in production of food, is looking forward to recruit a Financial Planning & Sales Analyst for the Head office team, in Athens.
The position is full time with indefinite duration, reporting to Financial Controller.  
Join us and be part of KYKNOS team, join a developing food company in a pleasant working environment, with main emphasis to respect, within a people oriented approach. 
 
Main responsibilities of the position of Financial Planning & Sales Analyst:
Contributes to the preparation of the monthly Management report, comparing and analyzing actual results with plans and forecasts
Understands customer business models to support go to market / channel strategy development
Participates in budgeting and planning processes
