You will participate in designing, developing, and testing workflows and business rules using Relational’s platform, MITOS, to deliver modern, large-scale enterprise software solutions for our customers. You will be a key member of a cross-functional team of diverse competencies and seniority levels, working in an Agile-inspired environment.
 
On a daily basis, you will collaborate with Product Owners, the Development Team, Support Team, Quality Assurance Team, and customer representatives to manage the full product lifecycle. You will also participate in retrospectives to discuss and continuously refine our working processes.
 
Key Responsibilities:

Gather, elicit, and document requirements into Functional Specification documents.
Design, develop, and test workflows and business rules using MITOS.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage the product lifecycle.
Participate in retrospectives to improve and refine working processes.
Contribute to design efforts for large software development initiatives.

 
Requirements:

University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field; MSc/MBA will be considered a plus.
Experience in Business Process Modeling.
Comfortable contributing to design efforts of large software development initiatives.
Positive attitude and a constant learner.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Fulfilled military obligations (for male candidates)
Fluent in English.

 
Nice To Have:

Familiarity with Banking environments & Loan Origination Systems.
Experience with REST API’s (XML, JSON) and SOAP.
Basic understanding of BPMN 2.0 notation.
Basic understanding of front-end technologies and platforms (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
Understanding of lean/agile practices and working experience with methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
Fluent in Jira, TFS or other collaboration tools.
Working experience in teams.
Availability to travel abroad if required.

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package

Our fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!

We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

SICAP is the Technical Company of SABO Group, founded in 1992, based in the center of Chalkida. The company has a 5th class contractor degree and constructs Port, Hydraulic and Road Construction projects in the private and public sector having at its disposal modern mechanical equipment, such as asphalt complex and machinery, earthmoving machines and portable concrete production complexes. SICAP also specializes in the construction of new industrial units with concrete or steel bearing structure and composite structures, as well as in the renovation of existing buildings and facilities. Finally, it deals with residential constructions, detached houses, apartment buildings and residential complexes.
The company is staffed by Civil Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Surveying Engineers, Economists and specialized technicians. This team, which is full of motivation, passion for development and innovation, is looking for a Business Analyst & Controller.

As a Business Analyst & Controller, you will

Support budgeting and forecasting processes with accurate data and analysis
Develop and maintain financial models to support strategic planning and forecasting
Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for senior management
Monitor and analyze financial performance against budgets and forecasts
Develop and implement internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure accurate financial reporting
Lead or participate in cross-functional projects to improve business processes and financial systems

Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related field. MBA or relevant certification will be a plus
At least 3 years of experience in general ledger
Proven experience as a Business Analyst & Controller or in similar role with a strong understanding of financial management and business analysis
Proficiency in ERP systems (preferably Soft1) and Excel
In-depth understanding of financial and accounting principles, regulations, and reporting standards
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting and analysis
Strong team spirit

A motivating and engaging work environment
Continuous learning and career development opportunities
Competitive compensation package
Private life & health insurance

title: Lead Due Diligence Analyst
description:
The Lead Due Diligence Analyst will be responsible for conducting thorough investigations into various aspects of business transactions, partnerships, investments, and other corporate dealings. The role involves verifying information, and ensuring compliance with legal, ethical, and regulatory standards, as well as identifying reputational risks through rigorous investigative practices.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Team Leadership and Oversight:

Lead a team of analysts and coordinate daily with investigators on the ground and local agents. Discuss ongoing investigations, address challenges, and share insights.
Foster a collaborative environment and provide guidance and support in complex investigations to enhance effectiveness and ensure alignment with the client’s goals and requirements.

Conduct Due Diligence Checks and Background Investigations:

Perform comprehensive background checks on companies and individuals to:
uncover financial, legal, and reputational risks
ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and laws, including anti-money laundering (AML) and anti-bribery laws.
Monitor social media, local news outlets, public records, and other open sources for intelligence related to financial, legal, and reputational risks.
Analyze and assess the credibility and reliability of sources and information.
Utilize various databases and tools for data gathering and analysis to support investigative processes.
Open source intelligence (OSINT) techniques to gather and analyze information from publicly available sources.
Compile detailed reports summarizing findings and providing clear executive summaries.
Synthesize data from multiple sources to develop comprehensive insights, presenting complex information clearly and concisely.
Ensure all reports are well-researched, accurate, and adhere to organizational standards.

 
Required Skills, Qualifications, and Attributes:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or a related field.
At least 3 years of proven experience in due diligence.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Fluency in Arabic language written and verbal is MANDATORY.
Proficient in using research databases and investigative tools.
Strong ethical foundation and integrity.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
The Company welcomes applications from candidates located across the European Union or Middle East
Due to the technical specifications of the role, only candidates with the required attributes will be contacted

 
The Company Offers:

A highly competitive compensation package including a performance related bonus.
Flexibility to work from a remote location/work from home.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
What if we didn't focus on who you are now, but who you could become? 
Here at EY, you'll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We'll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you'll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future - all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond. 
The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.200 professionals in Greece, and is listed in Greece's Top Employers for 2023! Experience great flexibility, under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki, while benefiting from personalized learning and career development opportunities. We prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where everyone's unique perspectives are valued, that supports you in building an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.The opportunity: your next adventure awaits 
Modern technology produces more data than ever before, but also provides the tools to store, organize, analyze and share this data, resulting in new opportunities and substantiated business insights in support of new and deeper insights and more informed decision making. EY delivers leading services and solutions in the area of big data, business intelligence and data engineering built on a blend of tools and custom-developed methods.
As part of our AI & Data team of the Technology Consulting practice, you will work with multi-disciplinary teams to support clients in a wide range of data initiatives aiming to generate and present new, useful and actionable insights. You will have the opportunity to work and take responsibilities in challenging engagements, gaining exposure to clients in various sectors both in Greece and abroad.Your Key Responsibilities

	Participation in large-scale client engagements.
	Contribution in the delivery of innovative and engaging data engineering solutions.
	Understanding of business and technical requirements, provision of subject matter expertise and implementation of data engineering techniques.
	Conducting of data discovery activities, performing root cause analysis, and making recommendations for the remediation of data quality issues.
	Putting into practice good organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and complete multiple complex projects under tight deadlines.

To qualify for the role you must have:

	A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other equivalent subject
	Knowledge in SQL querying and development (Joins, Store procedures/functions, Aggregations/Window Functions, CTEs, Indexes, optimization)
	Basic experience in Visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau etc. )
	Knowledge of Data Management, Data Warehousing concepts & methodologies (familiarity with at least one of the following databases & design principles: DWH, DataLake, Lakehouse, Delta etc.) will be considered an asset 
	Excellent command of English both oral and written

What we look for 

	You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We're looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
	You are curious and purpose driven. We're looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world. 
	You are inclusive. We're looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust. 
	Qualifications: What's most important is that you're dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You'll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You'll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you've got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you.

What's in it for you 

	Competitive remuneration package: You'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Depending on your experience, our comprehensive rewards package includes benefits that suit your needs including cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health insurance scheme, life insurance, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. 
	Flexible working arrangements: We operate under a hybrid working model, which is defined based on both your own preferences and team's needs, and we enjoy our summers with short Fridays. 
	Personalized learning experience and career development: Accelerate your technical capabilities and transformative leadership skills with future-focused courses and development programs. We provide free and unlimited access to educational platforms and EY Badges, support certifications, and provide coaching and feedback, as a part of our Leadership & Development process, all of which can lead to a meaningful impact and success as defined by you. 
	Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
	International Experience: Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds - both professionally and culturally.
	Above all, you will be working in one of the Top Employers in Greece for 2023, awarded by the Top Employers Institute.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today. #betterworkingworld

title: Senior Director, Smart Mfg. Foundations & Sustainment
description:
Pfizer careers are like no other. In our culture of individual ownership, we believe in our ability to improve future healthcare, and potential to transform millions of lives. We’re looking for new talent to join our global community, to unearth new innovative therapies that make the world a healthier place.

Work with Principal Engineer of Global Supply to identify the latest technologies in AI Engineering.
Design, pilot, incubate, and work with product and solution teams to implement scalable AI solutions to improve manufacturing operations, processes, and product quality.
Ensure collaboration with IT and solution teams to effectively integrate AI technologies.
Work closely with AIDA (internal Digital team) to design and implement a robust data strategy that supports and enhances cross-functional efforts across Digital Manufacturing. Ensure all data management practices adhere to legal standards and organizational policies, maintaining data integrity and confidentiality.
Work closely with AIDA to oversee the management and integration of Master Data Management (MDM) systems to ensure data accuracy and usability and define the structures and strategies for data processing, quality control, and storage.
Work closely with AIDA to establish and maintain a framework that supports data accessibility and accountability across the organization and aligns with standards across the broader Digital organization.
Adopt the PGS scaled agile framework (SAFe) for manufacturing to streamline the application of agile practices throughout PGS, enhancing our ability to deliver PGS business value more efficiently and effectively.
Adhere to GMP guidelines and processes to reduce production risks and ensure our outputs align with PGS business requirements.
Work with stakeholders in broader Digital to develop and maintain an analytics framework to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency.
Work with stakeholders in broader Digital to establish and maintain governance frameworks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security, supporting the organization's strategic objectives and compliance requirements.
Work with solution teams to ensure seamless integration of analytics with existing manufacturing systems for real-time data processing
Manage the operational aspects of AI solutions in manufacturing to ensure reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.
Work with product and business teams to ensure implementation of best practices for AI operations to optimize performance and minimize downtime.


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 15 years of experience in manufacturing operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Demonstrated expertise in AI/ML, analytics, cloud, and AR/VR technologies in a manufacturing context.
Proven leadership in sustainability and operational efficiency.
Proven experience with ML Ops, cloud computing, technical operations, and data integration.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic digital initiatives that integrate with and enhance core manufacturing processes.
Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP), Cloud Technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or related fields.
Expertise in implementing scalable machine learning solutions.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex technical problems.
Excellent communication and people skills.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $191,300.00 to $318,800.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments.  Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.
This role may require occasional travel to sites for team collaboration, stakeholder meetings, and on-site assessments.

Construction (EPC) market, continues to create value to its stakeholders by executing complex EPC projects worldwide, in recognition of its superior standards of performance.We have an outstanding record in completing major Energy, Marine, Infrastructure and Defense & Security projects around the globe and we pride ourselves on delivering over the years the kind of reliability and trust that the client has the right to expect from a major EPC contractor.Job DescriptionWe are currently looking for a Procurement Engineer who will be based Athens corporate office and will be working under the direction of a Procurement Manager.For assigned packages, source and propose the Bidders from registered Client and Company approved vendor list and based on approved Procurement strategyEnsure that all Supplier Pre-Assessment is done in compliance with the procedure to improve the performance of company/project in Supplier selection.Coordinate with all relevant in-house departments to ensure all requirements are included in the bidding documents and prepare/issue the Invitation to Bid (ITB) to the suppliers of the Bidders lists.Coordinate closely with Project or Tendering department to provide regular updates for the progress of the packages assigned (ITB, Quotation receipt, etc)Maintain the Project or Tender Procurement Plan up to date.Have a close interface with the technical responsible and lead all technical / commercial / contractual clarifications with the suppliers.Perform commercial and contractual analysis, schedule evaluation of bids and incorporate technical evaluation from Engineering/Tendering.Finalize the Comparison Statement (CS) of the quotations and make recommendations only for technically acceptable solutions.QualificationsBSc Engineering University degree in one of the relevant fields (Electrical / Instrumentation) Motivation to learn and grow in Archirodon in the Procurement DeptGood communication, co-operation and analytical skills3-4 years working experience and one experience as Procurement Engineer/Site Engineer/Tender Engineer.Adequate knowledge of commercial aspects and instruments.Able to handle multiple tasks with minimum supervision and very short deadlineFluency in the English language (oral and written).Enjoys challenge, working with different cultures and travelling.Additional InformationCompetitive salary and benefits are part of the offering, yet the real joy comes from being a member of smart and passionate teams, within an international leading EPC Group on a mission that matters. We create mega construction projects - literally around the globe - with meaningful impact on the local communities for the years to come. At Archirodon, you will find a proud, productive and human-centric culture, caring for and building on our people and their development!Please note that you will be contacted only in case you are shortlisted for an interview. In the meantime, do not hesitate to stay in touch and keep monitoring our open vacancies and our LinkedIn page! Rest assured that your application will be treated with strict confidentiality and under all applicable data privacy regulations.

title: Procurement Engineer - Category
description: Company DescriptionArchirodon, having earned its reputation as a reliable and respected international contractor for more than a half century in the Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) market, continues to create value to its stakeholders by executing complex EPC projects worldwide, in recognition of its superior standards of performance.We have an outstanding record in completing major Energy, Marine, Infrastructure and Defense & Security projects around the globe and we pride ourselves on delivering over the years the kind of reliability and trust that the client has the right to expect from a major EPC contractor.Job DescriptionThe Procurement Engineer (Category) will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies for Categories assigned in cooperation with the Category Manager.The Procurement Engineer is assigned at corporate level and is working under the direction of the Procurement Category Manager.Responsible for collecting and analysing data to determine trends and report results within a specific Category or Categories.Coordinate closely with the Category Manager and Technical Expert and other internal stakeholders.Periodically re-assess the action plan set to achieve the objectives planned for the specific Categories.Support PRC Department at site or corporate level when required after PRC management approvalAdhere to procurement guidelines and work in full compliance with approved procedures, using available APICS Procurement tools and in accordance with Archirodon IMS System.Perform rigorous analysis of internal company data and external market researched data, while working with the Procurement Category Manager and the Technical Experts to jointly develop strategies containing objectives, savings hypotheses and other specific targets.Harmoniously cooperate with other internal stakeholders for collection of data and exchange of information.For an assigned Category/Categories, source and propose appropriate bidders from the company's vendor list and source and propose appropriate bidders from external research as per the planned strategy. Perform bidder assessments in compliance with the company procedures.Execute the full procurement cycle for market engagement of the shortlisted category bidders: produce forecasts of potential future spends, prepare Invitations to Bid and float them to the selected bidders, perform bid reviews and carry out clarifications to minimize risks, perform comparison statements, apply appropriate criteria for scoring of bid packages.Prepare the proposed Category Strategy Recommendations for Management approval including the internal Change Management Plans and Work Instructions for implementation of the Category within the existing company environment and other relevant documentation. Carry out negotiations with awarded suppliers and work on the Frame Agreements in cooperation with the relevant internal departments.Roll out the frame agreement within the company environment, perform troubleshooting and apply the planned monitoring schemes.Produce Key Performance Indicators to allow continuous monitoring and assessment of the procurement strategy defined. Apply adjustments.Coordinate with the Regional / Divisions Procurement teams and Projects/Sites Teams to ensure proper communication and implementation of plans.Perform regular meetings with the supplier(s), maintain an objective stance between the supplier and the company while facilitating the implementation of the frame agreement to the advantage of the company.Report on a bi-weekly basis or as agreed with the Category Manager.Keep written records as agreed with the Category Manager.QualificationsBSC Engineering University Degree in a relevant field (Civil / Mechanical)Excellent knowledge of MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel including pivot tables)Good analytical skills: data analysis, identification and presentation of trends and results, and preparation of strategiesFluency in the English language (oral and written)Very good communication and cooperation skillsGood knowledge of ERP softwareMinimum 4 years' experience as Procurement Engineer / Project Controls Engineer / Tender Engineer / Site EngineerPrevious experience in the Construction Industry. Previous experience in the Oil & Gas sector is an asset.Proven experience in a relevant field (Civil/Mechanical)Additional InformationWhat's in it for you:Competitive salary and benefits are part of the offering, yet the real joy comes from being a member of smart and passionate teams, within an international leading EPC Group on a mission that matters. We create mega construction projects - literally around the globe - with meaningful impact on the local communities for the years to come. title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Company DescriptionWe are Netcompany-Intrasoft, a member of Netcompany Group A/S, and a leading European IT Solutions and Services company with strong international presence and expertise, dedicated to responsible digitalisation. We offer innovative and added-value solutions of the highest quality to a wide range of public and private organizations, while being a key-player in the EU Institutions for the past 30 years. We hold an outstanding record of 500+ organizations in 70+ countries, that have chosen our solutions and services, to fulfil their business needs. Our team of 3500+ professionals is our driving force and our most valuable asset.Job DescriptionEver wondered what it feels like to be a Cloud Security Engineer in Netcompany-Intrasoft?Joining us as a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be a part of the vibrant team of our highly skilled Cybersecurity Technology Department of the Information Security organization. Your everyday life will mainly consist of designing and implementing Cloud Security Solutions:As a Cloud Security Engineer you will:Design, implement, and maintain cloud security solutions to protect against unauthorized access, data breaches, and other security threats.Collaborate with development and operations teams to integrate security measures into the development and deployment processes.Conduct threat modeling exercises to identify potential security risks and vulnerabilities in cloud architectures, applications, and services, and work with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies.Develop and maintain documentation, policies, and procedures related to cloud security controls, configurations, and incident response protocols.Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies relevant to cloud computing, and make recommendations for enhancements to security posture.Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to Cloud Security.The option to be engaged in mid-term missions abroad at EU institutes, mainly in the Benelux region.QualificationsWhat would make you a fit for the role:University degree in Computer Engineering or another relevant fieldAt least 2 years of relevant experience in delivering Cloud services with focus on securing Azure environments.Solid understanding of diverse cloud computing technologies, encompassing Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS)Experience with cloud security in Microsoft Azure, showcasing proficiency in safeguarding cloud-based environments.Strong methodical mindset and problem-solving acumen, facilitating the identification and resolution of cloud security challenges.Comprehensive knowledge of fortifying cloud-hosted data and applications against a spectrum of threats.Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Excellent command of the English language (verbal and written) It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:Master's degree in information securityRelevant Microsoft Azure credentials and Microsoft Security credentials will be considered a plus.Additional InformationBeing a part of the Netcompany-Ιntrasoft team, you will be provided with: The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working modelA seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first stepsA competitive compensation & benefits packageHealth and life insurance programMeal and commuting allowanceWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)A personalized development plan for targeted career growthIf you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!#LI-TM1Our cultureOur people are the most important element of our success. Our work life is well defined by our set of fundamental Values: https://bit.ly/3SSbBzU  #BePartOfSomethingGreat!*Please submit your CV in EnglishAll applications will be treated as strictly confidential.

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
The only factory with vertically integrated production in Greece, 3i S.A. (ISOPIPE S.A.), specializing in synthetic rubber, insulation, in state-of-the-art facilities, with a total area of ​​60,000 m² and building facilities of 30,000 m², in Ritsona, with a workforce of 150 people.
In the context of dynamic development and to support its needs, the Company wishes to staff
Maintenance Engineer
Responsibilities: 

It immediately repairs technical faults if they occur during the production process
Maintains and schedules repairs of machines/production lines, with the goal of optimal operation of the equipment during the production process
Undertakes the preventive and corrective maintenance of the machines, in order to ensure the quality of the produced product and proposes solutions
Participates in installation and connection of new production machines
Implements the maintenance program, following safety procedures
Compiles and reviews maintenance/machinery process reports

We are looking for candidates who have:

Previous experience in an industrial unit is required
Professional experience of at least 2 years or more
A.E.I. degree or T.E.I. Engineer
Good knowledge of the English language
Administrative and organizational skills
Team spirit
Commitment to achieving goals and efficiency
Consistency, accountability, confidentiality and integrity
Ability to work under pressure
Ability to identify and solve problems
Ability to work in shifts

We offer:

Meal, feeding program by an expert, certified catering company
Transportation to and from the factory
Private security
Attractive salary package
Training and development prospects in a modern, pleasant and dynamic work environment
Ongoing support and development

Interested parties are requested to send a CV by selecting "Apply now" or send it to the email hr@tzanos.gr with Maintenance Engineer in the Subject or contact us at 2262089800. 
Your application will be treated in strict confidence and confidentiality, in accordance with all applicable regulations regarding personal data.

Very good knowledge of MS Office and SAP

Achievement drive and results orientation, with problem solving skills

Teamwork and collaboration
Good communication and interpersonal skills

Competitive remuneration package
Opportunities for career development in a multinational environment
Pleasant and modern working environment in a challenging organization
Continuous learning opportunities

title: Electrical Engineer (Archipetrol S.A.)
description:
We are seeking for an Electrical Engineer, who besides to have strong motivation for technical development and evolvement, will be able to:

Perform design calculations in the Electrical Department (such as cable sizing etc.)
Prepare material take-offs (MTOs).
Review and evaluate vendor documentation.
Perform 2D and 3D design work.
Prepare electrical equipment Material Requisitions.
Prepare updates and checks calculations for detailed engineering.
Contributes to optimization of material quantities by proposing valued engineering solutions.
Ensures contractual technical specifications are met by the suppliers.
Adheres to the maintenance of the project schedule, company quality standards, all contractual requirements and execution plan.
Executes electrical engineering activities and meets quality objectives of the project.
Ensures that the discipline engineering deliverables are compliant with project QHSE plan and discipline engineering processes & standards.
Works towards development and training.
Provides assistance to Electrical Department Head in various departmental activities.

Qualifications

Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Relevant experience in a similar role related to Oil & Gas Projects and detailed engineering in the field of expertise (Electrical engineering - preferably within a major engineering company) will be considered an advantage.
Knowledge of international codes & standards, international design guidelines & recommendations (like IEC, NEC, etc).
Knowledge of performing basic calculations and preparation of data sheets for electrical equipment.
Knowledge of developing and follow-up of Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), Load Lists, Electrical Cable Layouts as well as cable lists.

You are someone with:

Ability to liaise with the other engineering disciplines, assisting them during detail engineering.
Experience using relevant electrical commercial software applicable to electrical engineering (like ETAP etc) will be considered an advantage.
Be able to work in a team environment and handle multiple Project responsibilities.
Willing to work on a national and international environment.
Previous exposure to international environment will be considered an advantage.
Mobility is desirable to participate in working teams at project home offices throughout the countries where EPC projects are executed.
Excellent command in English (written and spoken)

The Electrical Engineer will report to the Electrical Department Discipline Head.

Perform process simulations and develop Process Flow Diagrams and H&MBs

Perform design calculations in the Mechanical Department
Prepare Material Requisitions for mechanical equipment (Pressure Equipment, Machinery, Packages).
Prepare material take-offs (MTOs).
Prepare technical bid evaluations of Vendor offers
Review and evaluate vendor drawings and documents.
Prepares technical specifications for pressure vessels, tanks, machinery and packages.

Coordinates work with other engineering disciplines.

Performs vendor’s documents and drawings review.

Adheres to the maintenance of the project schedule, company quality standards, all contractual requirements and execution plan.
Works towards development and training.
Provides assistance to Mechanical Discipline Head in various discipline activities.
Interfaces with other discipline specialist engineers and possibly provides project support function.

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (five years studies).
Relevant experience in a similar role related to Oil & Gas Projects and detailed engineering in the field of Instrumentation engineering of at five (5) (preferably within a major engineering company) will be considered an advantage.

title: Department Manager - Strategic Planning  - Saudi Arabia
description:
Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in construction consulting? Hill International is seeking talented and motivated professionals to join our team! With projects spanning various sectors and locations, Hill International offers a dynamic and stimulating work environment where innovation, collaboration, and excellence are our core values.
Hill International provides comprehensive program, project, and construction management services for clients across diverse sectors undertaking major construction projects worldwide. Our expertise includes cost engineering and estimating, quality assurance, inspection, scheduling, risk management, and claims avoidance. To learn more about Hill International, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com.
We are committed to delivering exceptional project management services and solutions globally. Whether you are an experienced project manager, engineer, or a recent graduate eager to launch your career in the construction industry, we have opportunities that will both challenge and inspire you
We are currently looking for a Department Manager - Strategic Planning to join our mega NWC project in Saudi Arabia. Submit your application in English today at apply@hillintl.com.
Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of the construction industry!
General Description of Role and Responsibilities:

Adopting and implementing Client’s PMM and EXPROs Five-Year Projects.
Portfolio Planning (5 YPPP) processes and methodologies.
Project registration and managing initial stages of the Stage-Gate process.
Review and update the National Guideline for the Master Planning.
Manage the development of the National Master Plan.
Review Clusters Master Plan.
Review and approve the Capital Investment Plan (CIP) that the Local Master Plan identifies.
Ensure that all projects identified within the CIP contribute toward achieving the KPIs.
Review and approve the project's business cases.
Ensure all projects are aligned with the requirements of the Master Plan.
Supporting the cluster to prepare/update the 5YPPP periodically.
Prioritize projects within the 5 YPPP based on the approved criteria.
Update and finalize the 5YPPP based on the comment from the EXPRO team.
Work with other client departments to develop the capital expenditure for their specialized program.
Supporting the Client in coordinating with external governmental departments such as municipalities to ensure the alignment of their projects with their expansion plans.
Working with the supply and demand committee to update their plan regularly.
Monitor the implementation of the regional Master Plans and their identified CIPs.
Assessing the capability of the Client’s existing department staff and recommending appropriate roles and responsibilities.
Integrate client’s assets GIS data in one database platform.
Preparing the Strategic Planning department knowledge transfer program, which includes comprehensive on-the-job learning.
Working with the Client to coordinate the water and wastewater service with the main developers.
Draft agreements and MOUs to provide services for the developers.
Coordinate with the regional clusters to ensure the timely execution of agreements and relevant projects.
Attend coordination meetings with the main developers.
Review mega project requirements for water and wastewater service and ensure these requirements are included within the master plans.


Informs themselves of the relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals and Procedures within Hill International and ensures continued compliance with these requirements while employed by Hill.
Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor.

Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills:

Bachelor / Master of Engineering or Urban Planning from an accredited Western university.
Minimum 20 years experience in the related field on national/international major initiatives and developments. A record of close engagement with utility providers and wider commercial and public cluster stakeholders.
Expert in major development master and urban planning – preferably at national levels. Thorough knowledge of urban and infrastructure planning disciplines.
Expert in the development of water and wastewater master plans.
Extensive experience of working internationally (preference for Middle East / KSA). Preferred cultural understanding of the project.

title: Sr. Associate, Network Automation Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYEnterprise Platforms & Security (EP&S), integrates and oversee Pfizer's global infrastructure, information technology operations, risk management, data privacy, and cybersecurity capabilities Our business application platforms support Pfizer's enterprise application and critical business processes. A robust infrastructure allows business traffic to travel where it needs to go, internally and externally, along with the appropriate access controls. EP&S secures Pfizer's most important information assets through world class controls and protections and enables Pfizer's business results by making security an enabler and not a roadblock to achieving business results.The Digital Command Operations (DCO) team delivers excellence in the pursuit of those breakthroughs through industry-leading infrastructure operations reliability. This is achieved through transparency in business and service health, predictive detection of service interruptions, the elimination of repetitive operational tasks (toil) through automation, and improved diagnostics to drive better decisions and interventions.The ​Sr. Associate, Network Automation Engineer​ will work collaboratively with other members of the Network Infrastructure, peer organizations and the broader Pfizer Digital Organization, to provide technical expertise in building Pfizer's network automation capabilities and identifying & successfully implementing advanced IT automation solutions for Pfizer Digital and our clients.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Identify potential opportunities to automate Network Operational processes, including elimination of toil and risk.
Programmatically analyze network incidents and develop automated solutions for close loop remediation.
Utilize software engineering practices, and programming or scripting languages like Java, Python, or JavaScript, to develop code, automate tasks, and integrate monitoring and alerting in the process.
Stay updated on emerging trends and technologies in network engineering, software engineering, and cloud computing.
Utilize logging and monitoring solutions like Grafana, Splunk or similar, to track, troubleshoot, and remediate issues.
Use and customize industry-leading Network Performance Monitoring, Planning, and Configuration Management capabilities.
Maintain design and support documentation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for improving data collection, analysis processes, and data-driven decision-making.
Document analysis methodologies, findings, and insights to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintain data quality standards.





QUALIFICATIONSMinimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or STEM related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of professional experience in network engineering or a related field.
Experience in any of the following Cisco/Meraki/SDWAN, Catalyst, Nexus, AireOS.
Experience with Network Performance Monitoring, Planning, and Configuration Management tools.
Experience in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Python).
Experience in programmatically analyzing network incidents and developing automated remediation solutions.
Demonstrated experience with network automation tools and technologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
Demonstrated ability to work in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

Preferred Qualifications:

Associate level Industry certifications (CCNA, DEVASC, CCSA, or equivalent expertise).
Familiarity with F5 Load Balancers.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Grafana, Tableau.
Familiarity with software engineering best practices, version control, testing, deployment in maintenance will be considered plus.
Experience working in Agile environments, preferably with Scrum methodology with a focus on continuous improvement and delivery.
Professional certifications in network engineering, automation, or cloud services (e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect).

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr. Associate, Network Automation Engineer id 4913533.

title: Web Developers
description:
Duties
As a Senior software engineer, you will join an autonomous team of software engineers, and your primary duties will be the following:

Incentives
● Flexible working hours● Possibility of working remotely● Competitive remuneration package

title: GCS Sr. Associate Analytics Solution Engineer
description:
ROLE DETAILSAll over the world, Pfizer colleagues are working together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Each position at Pfizer touches and contributes to the success of our business and our world. That's why, as one of the global leaders in the biopharmaceutical industry, Pfizer is committed to seeking out inspired new talent who share our core values and mission of making the world a healthier place.R&D within AIDA (AI, Data and Analytics), a Pfizer Digital organization, is responsible for the development and management of all data and analytics tools and platforms across the enterprise - from global research and development, to manufacturing, to commercial, to patient care across over 100+ countries. One of the team's top priorities is the advancement of AI/ML enabled analytics and the creation of data solutions that can be leveraged across the enterprise.R&D in AIDA holds responsibility for the development and operations of the aggregate data solutions (data lakes and associated application portfolios) supporting Pfizer's scientific and clinical functions.The Sr. Associate Solution Engineer will develop scientific data solutions with a team of peer developers, digital client partners, architects, platform leads and contract support personnel under the direction of a senior software developer.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop, maintain, and improve new and existing data solutions with a strong sense of accountability and attention to quality.
Collaborate closely with other engineers and team leaders to become a valued member of an autonomous, cross-functional team.
Translate high-level business problems into solutions using data-driven modeling and analysis.
Perform stringent testing of code written, including designing and writing automated tests to allow for continuous delivery.
Define and maintain related artifacts that support data integration.
Clearly and regularly communicate with line management and colleagues.
Mentor your more junior developer colleagues and perform tasks such as peer code reviews, provide feedback and corrections as necessary.
Help the team embrace agile core values, adopt, and apply those principles, and implementation practices.

QUALIFICATIONSProfessional Experience and Educational Requirements

BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years' experience in data solutions and analytics development.
Fundamental knowledge in programming using Python and Pyspark.
Demonstrated knowledge of Structured query language (SQL).
Back-end experience with databases such as Oracle, RedShift, and Snowflake.
Knowledge of Big Data technologies.
Ability to work independently, in a team environment and multi-task effectively.
Flexible and willing to accept a change in priorities as necessary.
Strong attention to detail with high standards of quality and customer value.
Self-motivated and proactive with the ability to take ownership of issues.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with developing identity management solutions desirable.
Experience in developing solutions aimed at medical professionals desirable.
Experience in the Pharma industry desirable.
Experience in modern software development practices including distributed versioning systems, continuous integration/deployment, automated testing (DevOps).
Working knowledge of Jira, GitHub, and Docker.
Experience with AWS and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures (We heavily leverage AWS and experience of its services and how to use them is a definite bonus).

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job GCS Sr. Associate Analytics Solution Engineer with id 4918714.

She/he will be responsible for delivering solutions that are crucial for the day-to-day and strategic decision-making of other internal teams.As a Senior BI Engineer at Upstream, you’ll have the chance to work on a broad range of BI areas and technologies, from analyzing business requirements to data management and ETL, to report building and data visualization. Monitor the health and performance of the BI infrastructure and take the required corrective actions. Continuously try to improve our tools and processes, following high quality and efficiency standards. title: FTTH Design Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated FTTH Design Engineer to join our growing team and contribute to the expansion and enhancement of our fiber optic networks!
Job Description
As an FTTH Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the planning, design, and implementation of fiber optic networks to deliver high-speed internet and telecommunications services directly to homes. You will work closely with project managers, field engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment of FTTH infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
- Network Design: Develop detailed FTTH network designs, including fiber routes, splice plans, and equipment placement.- GIS Mapping: Utilize GIS software to create accurate network maps and documentation.- Capacity Planning: Perform network capacity analysis and ensure designs meet current and future demand.- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all designs comply with local, state, and federal regulations, as well as industry standards.- Project Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align design plans with construction schedules and project goals.- Site Surveys: Conduct site surveys to gather data and assess the feasibility of network deployments.- Documentation: Maintain comprehensive design documentation, including technical drawings, schematics, and project reports.- Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks and validate network designs to ensure reliability and performance.
Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or a related field.- Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in fiber optic network design, specifically FTTH projects.- Tecnical Skills: Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCad) and GIS tools. Familiarity with fiber optic design software.- Regulatory Compliance: Stay informed about relevant codes, standards, and regulations, and ensure all designs and projects adhere to them.- Knowledge: Strong understanding of FTTH network architecture, fiber optic technology, industry standards as well as Strong understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to construction and environmental permitting. 
- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Clearly articulate technical information to diverse audiences.- Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
What We Offer
- Competitive Salary: Reflective of your skills and experience.- Benefits Package: Comprehensive health insurance plan- Professional Development: Opportunities for continued learning, training, and career advancement.- Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge projects with a team of dedicated professionals.- Work-Life Balance: Flexible work arrangements to support your personal and professional life.
Join us at Circet Hellas and be a part of shaping the future of telecommunications!
If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for innovation, we encourage you to apply!

description:
Revotech is a technology powerhouse devoted to innovatively combining groundbreaking technologies to catalyze the development of next-generation solutions. Our ultimate goal is to shape a better future through transformative innovations that have the potential to significantly enhance human life. We first envision the future – then create it
“Engineering is a mindset we need in all aspects of our business”
We are seeking a skilled and determined Sr. Project Manager (Civil or Mechanical Engineer) to join our team! 
Your responsibilities will include:

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets 
Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, and other stakeholders to develop comprehensive project plans and designs
Develop studies in your domain of expertise
Manage project finances, including monitoring expenses and negotiating contracts
Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring compliance with safety regulations
Serve as the primary point of contact, addressing concerns and managing expectations
Prepare technical and financial proposals
Assess the feasibility of proposed projects based on financial data and market conditions
Conduct quality control inspections and resolving any issues or discrepancies that may arise during the construction phase
Resolve or coordinate the solution of issues that arise during the project lifecycle
Track project progress diligently, compiling comprehensive reports to inform stakeholders
Supervise and manage construction projects from start to finish, ensuring adherence to project plans and specifications.
Support the timely completion of the various projects
Other tasks as assigned

Proven experience of at least 5 years
BS/MA in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or similar field
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage teams and stakeholders
Familiarity with rules, regulations, best practices, and performance standards
Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
Proficiency in project management software and Microsoft Office suite
Κnowledge of business and management principles (i.e., budgeting)
Excellent Software skills on AutoCad 2D/3D 

Revotech perks:

Competitive compensation package
An exciting high-growth career path
Private health insurance plan
Part of a youthful talented team striving for innovation

Reports to: CEO

title: Support Engineer & Systems Coordinator
description:
FAMAR, a multinational company active in Europe, with a leading position in the field of pharmaceutical and cosmetic production, is looking to recruit for the Anthousa Factory
                             Support Engineer & Systems Coordinator (SESC_ANT_08.2024)
The post holder reports to the plant's Facilities, Utilities & Projects Manager and contributes to defining the scope and objectives of projects, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility. Plans, studies and participates in the supervision of projects at all stages and ensures they are completed within budget and on schedule.
Basic competencies

Support the Anthousa plant in the development and full implementation of the CMMS and train the colleagues of the other sites in the respective implementation
Prepares documents (technical specifications, studies, drawings, presentations, schedules and cost estimates) as part of project planning
Participates in the evaluation of technical bids and specifications from suppliers and/or subcontractors, to support the procurement process
Participates in the supervision and coordination of the installation of Electromechanical equipment and during project testing by contractors/suppliers
Manages problems during project execution
Conducts regular meetings with all project stakeholders to ensure specific requirements are clarified and met in a timely manner
Documents and reports project progress to stakeholders and suppliers
Ensures contractors perform all work in accordance with agreed work methods
Ensures all projects are delivered on time, within scope and within budget
Creates and maintains project database including technical information (layouts, plans, bids, studies, etc.)
Follows and complies with good practices (GxP), Quality Management System, regulatory requirements, internal procedures, corporate directions, corporate governance code, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) procedures and good practices and any rules and policies of the company and actively participates in proposals for their improvement
It ensures and protects data integrity in every action
Undertakes any other task or responsibility assigned by the company, within the scope of the wider duties of the position

Necessary Qualifications

Graduated in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
3-5 years of experience in managing / executing technical projects
Excellent knowledge of the English language
Excellent computer use of MS Office, MS Project, Autocad 2D
Familiarity with quality, health and safety standards
Communication skills, collaboration, flexibility, organizational and problem solving skills, effective time management

title: BMC Consultant
description:
Join Our Team as a BMC Consultant!
Are you passionate about configuring and maintaining cutting-edge software tools? As a BMC Consultant at Relational Financial Solutions, you will be an essential member of our dynamic ITSM team. Your role will involve collaborating with our talented team to configure, maintain, and customize BMC software products and similar tools, ensuring our solutions align with user needs and business requirements.
 
Your Role:
As a BMC Consultant, your responsibilities will include:

Software Configuration & Support: Configure, maintain, enhance, and support BMC software products and similar tools.
Customization & Development: Customize and add new features to software solutions based on business requirements using low-code and no-code platforms.
Customer Support: Provide technical support to resolve application-related issues promptly and support customer operations related to software packages and developed solutions.
Quality Assurance: Conduct tests for applications, troubleshoot problems, and assist with product launches.
Software Management: Perform software upgrades and manage software licensing.

 
What We’re Looking For:
We’re seeking candidates with the following skills and experience:

Experience: 1 to 3 years as a Software Engineer or Software Developer.
BMC Expertise: Administrator or Developer experience on BMC ITSM or similar tools preferred.
Development Skills: Proficiency in test-driven development methodologies and experience with relational database management systems (RDBMS).
Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with reporting tools such as Grafana and YellowFin is advantageous. Knowledge of Operations Management and Service Management tools is beneficial.
Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to address technical challenges effectively.
Team Collaboration: Excellent teamwork skills to collaborate with internal teams and customers.
Eagerness to Learn: Eagerness to take on new responsibilities and challenges. ITIL v4 certification is a plus.
Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Informatics, or a related field.

 
Why Join Us?
At Relational Financial Solutions, we value our employees and strive to create an inclusive and rewarding environment. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive Salary: We offer an attractive salary package to compensate you for your skills and contributions.
Health Benefits: Your health matters to us. All colleagues receive private health insurance from day one.
Exciting Projects: We thrive on challenges and invite you to take part in exciting projects.
Continuous Learning: We never stop learning and evolving! You will have your own mentor and training program, along with access to our training sessions and online courses.
Team Spirit: We love the relational vibes and regularly gather for smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

 
Ready to Apply?
Join us in shaping the future of IT Service Management at Relational Financial Solutions. Apply now to be a part of a team where your skills and passion for technology will thrive.
 
By submitting an application to this position and sharing your personal data with Relational Financial Solutions, you acknowledge and accept our Privacy Policy and authorize us to process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with this policy.

title: Senior Associate, Solution Engineer
description:
All over the world, Pfizer colleagues are working together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Each position at Pfizer touches and contributes to the success of our business and our world. That's why, as one of the global leaders in the biopharmaceutical industry, Pfizer is committed to seeking out inspired new talent who share our core values and mission of making the world a healthier place.R&D within AIDA (AI, Data and Analytics), is a Pfizer Digital organization responsible for the development and management of all data, analytics tools and platforms across the enterprise - from global research and development, to manufacturing, to commercial, to patient care across over 100+ countries. One of the team's top priorities is the advancement of AI/ML enabled analytics and the creation of data solutions that can be leveraged across the enterprise.R&D in AIDA holds responsibility for the development and operations of the aggregate data solutions (data lakes and associated application portfolios) supporting Pfizer's scientific and clinical functions.The Sr. Associate Solution Engineer will develop scientific information software with a team of peer developers, digital client partners, architects, platform leads and contract support personnel under the direction of a senior software developer.




How You Will Achieve It

Work within project teams as a contributor to design, prototype, implement and unit test software solutions in support of the project objectives.
Translate logical designs of user/system interfaces into physical designs, considering the target environment, performance requirements and existing systems.
​Work in a matrix, team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners.
Dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers.
Focus on growing as an engineer, learning existing tools, resources and DevOps processes.
Develop productivity skills by learning source control, editors (IDE), build systems (CI/CD), Cloud platforms (Atlassian, GitHub, AWS), and other tools as well as unit testing best practices.
Accept feedback graciously and learn from everything they do .
Exhibit Pfizer's core values of Courage, Excellence, Equity, Joy and focuses on understanding and living these values.
Work under general supervision using own judgement where needed.
Proactively reporting issues and enhancements.
Documenting processes.
Debugging and fixing simple to moderately complex technical issues.





Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelors degree in relevant field.
At least 3 years of experience as a software developer/engineer .
Demonstrated skills in analysis and problem solving .
Fundamental knowledge of Kubernetes.
Programming using Python and Java.
Knowledge using GitHub for source control and Git Actions for CICD workflows.
Understand modern software engineering, including coding standard, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and releasing.
Knowledge of database interaction languages such as SQL (PySpark is an advantage). 
Comfortable using collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence and MS Teams.
Ability to challenge, improve and develop existing practices & processes.
Self-motivated with the ability to drive work forward and work well in a geographically dispersed, virtual team environment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

Knowledge in operating and managing AWS infrastructure.
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (ie Scrum) .
Knowledge of ELK or OpenSearch is an advantage.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Solution Engineer with id 4916417.

title: Process Engineer
description:
Melissa Kikizas was founded in 1947 by the vision of Alexandros Kikizas to create a food industry that highlights the raw materials of our country, producing high quality products. Today, 7 decades later, it is the No. 1 producer of pasta and extra virgin olive oil in Greece. The main brands of the company are: Melissa, Terra Creta, Primo Gusto, Stella, Avez, Deveta and Vlacha. In addition, the company has the exclusive representation of the multinationals KRAFT HEINZ and Del Monte in Greece.
Melissa Kikizas employs 300 staff and has been awarded 6 years as a Great Place to Work. From the first moment of its establishment until today, it invests in the growth and development of its people, with respect, care and dedication. Guided by her values ​​and people, Melissa Kikizas remains true to her vision "to share the wisdom of Greek food and culture with the whole world". 
In the context of the continuous development of the Larissa factory, we are looking to hire a Process Engineer who will report to the Operations Manager. 
Main Duties & Responsibilities:

Captures and analyzes production and packaging department performance data, prioritizes and quantifies areas for improvement, and provides input to the maintenance department to determine maintenance priorities
Trains production and packaging department operators to correctly enter information into the performance recording system
Coordinates and trains production & maintenance team members in problem solving processes, using the respective tools with the participation of all parties involved
Creates and updates standards and work instructions as a result of daily operations and problem analysis
Coordinates the creation of an action plan to improve the performance of the production and packaging departments in the logic of continuous improvement and manufacturing excellence
Identifies cases and opportunities to re-implement good practices throughout the plant
Prepares package and carton engineering drawings for new codes or any changes to old ones and designs them based on optimal palletizations
He undertakes the opening of the new codes in the system (bom) and is responsible to answer requests and questions of the sales departments regarding specifications of boxes, materials, pallets or anything else that may concern the packaging department.

Abilities- Skills:

Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or Chemical Engineering or Production and Management Engineering 
1-2 years of experience
Communication skills
Solving problems
Managing pressing schedules
Analytical thinking
Ambition and constant search for improvement, progress and development
Passion for work  
SAP user experience 
Excellent knowledge of English, knowledge of Italian is desirable 
Good knowledge of MS Office (excellent knowledge of Excel)

title: Senior SW QA Engineer
description:
In Thessaloniki, GWF has established a modern Development Center whose mission is to create fresh smart-metering and IoT solutions that reshape traditional utilities toward smart city paradigms. We want to contribute to the local tech ecosystem and at the same time drive the company’s international growth. The team offers a vibrant environment, passionate bright colleagues, and a clear goal to transform IoT data into modern applications.Responsibilities

You will lead testing and quality assurance projects for the digital products of GWF. This includes writing and execution of the test plans, and test automation for software products and features.
You will be mentoring and coaching colleagues in your domains of expertise. This will contribute to growing a healthy SW QA culture in the organization.
You will contribute towards program goals, ensuring schedules are met and deliverables are signed-off in time, scope, and budget.
To excel in this role, you will further need to think beyond your area of expertise and recognize dependencies across the technology stack, i.e., across hardware, and all layers of the software. For this you will research new and existing technologies to determine how they could be applied in new ways to solve problems.

 Qualifications and experience

Experience as a Software QA Engineer, with at least 4 years in a lead role.
Understanding of frontend stack fundamentals (e.g. JavaScript, CSS preprocessors and bundling tools, React Remix run, Next.js).
Experience in web frameworks (e.g. Python/Django) and relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL).

 

Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing principles is required. Experience with Cloud Services, especially Azure
Experience with static and dynamic code analysis tools is required.
Experience with automated testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Appium).
Relevant testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB, CSTE) are a plus.

 

Ability to fluently interface with internal and external stakeholders on a technical level.
Excellent English communication skills is a must, German is a strong plus.
Good communication and presentation skills are a must.
MSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar rounds up your profile.

We offer

Competitive compensation
Medical Care program
Partial remote work flexibility
Learning and growth opportunities in an international company setup
A pleasant, fun, and achievement-oriented environment
Modern, bright offices, located close to the airport.

 Interested?We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.

title: Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Network Protection Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Global Information Security (GIS) organization delivers proactive cyber defense for the global Pfizer enterprise. Our mission is to secure all of Pfizer's information assets ranging from the manufacturing floor to the core data centers and out to the patient facing solutions. We achieve this mission through a team of world-class talent, utilizing top-tier technologies, advanced analytics and the promotion of a cybersecurity ownership culture across the company.In this role, we are looking for emerging cybersecurity talent driven to proactively design and implement cybersecurity network protection solutions with agility, quality and speed, make data driven decisions, automate routine tasks, continuously improve and maximize the value and effectiveness of security solution defenses.For Pfizer, we look for candidates that are motivated, self-learning, and team-oriented individuals. From a technical perspective, an ideal candidate would have the skills shown below, but candidates that possess a strong subset and an attitude towards self-development & growth will be considered.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESThis role will have the following primary responsibilities, but will often act under the support and direction of the Senior Manager, Cybersecurity Network Protection Lead:

Analyze business requirements and provide recommendations for building scalable solutions to meet security functional and non-functional requirements


Build and operationalize solutions to deploy and protect the network. Define and configure security policies throughout the various network boundaries


Create and maintain documentation related to network solutions; this may include conceptual, logical, and physical diagrams; new environment design documents; write ups on technical capabilities and solution configurations; etc.
Perform continuous security policy analysis to ensure effectiveness of security defenses.
Develop analytics/Analyze data to improve situational awareness and make informed decisions.
Assist with the development and operation of both infrastructure-as-code as well as manual change tracking processes
Manage small to medium security enhancement and remediation projects.


Demonstrate commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrate effective oral, written, and interpersonal communications skills as well as organizational and planning abilities.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BS in Computer Sciences, Information Security, Information Systems, Engineering, Sciences, or related field.
Technical experience with network solutions; either infrastructure or security related.
Understanding of network traffic with security controls in mind.
Understanding of network technology.
Ability to onboard, learn and adapt to new technologies
Foundational knowledge of malware operation and indicators or threat, current threat landscape (threat actors, APT, cyber-crime, etc)
Demonstrated ability to work in ambiguous situations and initiate technical aptitude to understand/design solutions.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to prioritize and execute with minimal direction or oversight.
Concise, accurate communication skills (both verbal and written).
Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Demonstrated commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

3+ years of experience with network security, cyber network defense, or cyber incident response
Experience performing raw data analysis using a log repository or SIEM.
Experience managing policy and configuration via Infrastructure-As-Code
Experience and resolving network connectivity issues where multiple layers of host and network-based firewall and/or IPS solutions may be involved
Experience engineering preventative solutions to address specific vulnerabilities or adversary techniques
Experience designing policy within a modern next-generation firewall

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
 
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Network Protection Engineer id 4909621.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join INTRALOT as a DevOps Engineer!

Empower Innovation. Drive Impact. Shape the Future.
Are you a passionate DevOps professional ready to take the next step in your career? At INTRALOT, we're not just building infrastructure - we're transforming the gaming industry with scalable, reliable, and cutting-edge systems.
Here's your chance to make a difference and grow with a dynamic team that thrives on innovation and collaboration.

What You'll Do
As a DevOps Engineer, you'll play a vital role in enhancing operations and contributing to the delivery of high-quality software. Your contributions will make a difference as you:
 Support Scalable Systems - Contribute to the design and maintenance of secure, robust, and high-performance infrastructure for our global gaming platforms.
⚙️ Drive Automation - Help implement and refine CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or CircleCI.
 Manage the Cloud - Assist in maintaining cloud environments (AWS or Azure) to ensure efficiency and scalability.
 Leverage Containers - Optimize and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
 Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - Collaborate on infrastructure provisioning and configuration with tools like Terraform and Ansible.
 Monitor Effectively - Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems with Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK.
 Work with Data Streams - Help optimize real-time data flows and messaging systems with Kafka.
 Collaborate Across Teams - Work closely with software teams to promote a DevOps-first culture.


What You'll Bring
We're looking for an enthusiastic and driven individual with:
 Experience: 2+ years in a DevOps or related role.
☁️ Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure.
 Scripting Skills: Proficiency in scripting/programming languages like Python, Bash, or Go.
 Containerization: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
⚡ IaC Basics: Experience with tools like Terraform and Ansible.
 CI/CD Enthusiasm: Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bamboo.
️ Monitoring Skills: Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus and Grafana.
 Communication: Strong collaboration and communication skills in both Greek and English.
