In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.
INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.

Why Join Us:
 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family.
 Modern facilities, parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus.
 An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment.
 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
 We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status. Our premises in Paiania, Attica, are accessible to individuals with disabilities. Join us in shaping the future of gaming and lottery solutions!

title: Network Engineer
description:
Volton Hellenic Energy SA is a Greek company that is dynamically active and is increasing its capacity rapidly in the field of Electricity Supply and Trading, in the Gas Energy Sector and soon enough in the field of Telecommunications.
By offering reliable services that meet the ever-growing energy needs of businesses and households, Volton aims to build solid and trustful relationships with its customers. The company's ambition is to become one of the most important companies in the industry and remain at the forefront of developments as the first Multiservice provider combining Electricity, Natural gas and Telecommunications. As part of its development, Volton strengthens its human resources in Athens and seeks:
 
Network Engineer
 
This is an engineering role in a network operator and Telecommunications Service Provider (mobile and fixed), covering many segments of IP networks, such as core, transport, access and Data Center, and many aspects of the surrounding technology: IPv4/IPv6, interconnections, network security and VPN, L2 aggregation, Data Center networking, FTTH, NFV, etc.
This role is an opportunity for a passionate Network Engineer who wants to be part of an exciting project, an ISP/MSP in the making.
 
Responsibilities:

Design, operation and support of networking infrastructure (switching, routing and firewalling) that support the needs of telecommunications systems, platforms and applications
Development, operation and support of the IP network needed for the interconnection of the company with other service and Internet upstream providers
Evaluation and selection of solutions and architectures for the network and the required infrastructure that will support the telecommunications services
Management of virtual/physical assets (ASNs, IP addresses, equipment inventory etc.)
IP traffic management and monitoring
Testing of new equipment for introduction into the network
Documentation and implementation of standard operating procedures for all network technologies deployed

 
Necessary Skills:

Excellent knowledge of Ethernet & IP technologies and more specifically

IPv4/IPv6
Interconnection, IP traffic routing & switching and aggregation technologies

Routing: OSPF, BGP, MPLS
Security: L3VPN, IPSec/SSL VPN
L2: VLAN, STP, vPC, LAG
Service provisioning: PPPoE, IPoE, BRAS/BNG, FTTH, OLT, ONT/ONU


Very good knowledge in the installation, configuration, operation and maintenance of IP network equipment



 
Preferred Skills:

DNS, DHCP , AAA (RADIUS, LDAP)
IPv6 transition technologies (IPv4aaS)
Familiarity with security and hardening principles and technologies for telecommunications networks

 
Necessary Qualifications:

University Degree or equivalent, in Engineering, Computer Science or similar
At least 3 years of experience in Ethernet & IP technologies, ideally in a Telecommunication Service Provider environment or related technology Vendor/Integrator
Experience with network monitoring (e.g. TICK stack) and automation (e.g. Ansible, Python) will be strongly considered
Fluency in English
Related certifications will be considered an asset, especially from Cisco
Soft skills: problem-solving abilities, effective communication and teamwork are all considered as a must

 
The Company Offers:

Competitive remuneration package
Hybrid working model
Mobile phone
Private insurance, corporate benefits and perks
Continuous training and professional development
Excellent professional environment
Modern and productive working facilities

 
Don’t miss the chance to join a Great Place to Work-Certified Company that promotes a positive work environment.
 
 
All applications will be treated with confidentiality.
If your CV meets the requirements of the job, we will contact you by phone to schedule an appointment.
Information about the Group on our site volton.gr

title: Software Engineer (React)
description:
Join INTRALOT as a Software Engineer (React)!
Your Role:

As a Software Engineer (React) at INTRALOT, you'll play a pivotal role in our Digital iLottery Projects!

More specifically, some of your main tasks will be: 

 Participating in all phases of the development life cycle, focusing on coding and unit testing.
 Developing and maintaining functional and stable applications to meet company's needs.
 Designing and implementing highly scalable solutions for unpredictable traffic patterns.
 Following standard code practices and building reusable code and libraries for future use.
 Implementing security and data protection mechanisms.
 Optimizing the application for speed and scalability.
 Contributing to application strategy and planning.
Staying up to date with emerging technologies and formulating concepts and ideas for additional products, tools and services to be provided.
To get this role, you should match the following criteria:

 You hold a University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or relevant technology-related field.
 At least three (3) years of experience in Software Development.


 Strong working experience in Javascript (ES6), HTML5, CSS3, SASS and React.JS/MobX
 Experience in using version control software such as Git.
 Excellent understanding of the entire web development process (Design, Development and Deployment).You have an excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken
  We work better as a TEAM. So, you also have to be an excellent team player.

Nice to have, but not necessary:
Experience in developing and maintaining high-quality React Native applications using clean code.

About Us: INTRALOT, a publicly listed company established in 1992, is a leading gaming solutions supplier and operator active in 39 regulated jurisdictions worldwide. With a global workforce of approximately 1,700 employees, INTRALOT is committed to redefine innovation and quality of services in the lottery and gaming sector, while supporting operators in raising funds for good causes. In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.
INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.

Why Join Us:
 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family. 
 Modern facilities, parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus.
 An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment.
 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally. 
Equal Opportunity Employer: We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status. Our premises in Paiania, Attica, are accessible to individuals with disabilities. Join us in shaping the future of gaming and lottery solutions!

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Metlen Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, leading the green energy transition with innovative solutions while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy. Our global presence covers two business Sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. With a consolidated yearly turnover of €6.3 billion and a workforce of over 5,500 dedicated individuals, we fuel success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.
We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, leaving a lasting impact. We foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.
 
We are currently looking for Data Engineer to join our M Energy Generation & Management Division in our Offices in Marousi
By joining this role, you will step into a crucial position where you will optimize data-driven processes for the energy management team and ensure seamless data flow across systems. You will develop and maintain ETL processes to facilitate and automate the team’s data extraction needs and implement processes to create business-level analyses.
 
Your role will encompass:


Creating and maintaining procedures to extract data from diverse origins and consolidating it within our centralized databases.


Ensuring that data meets rigorous validation criteria and is stored in an organized manner.


Carrying out exploratory data analysis (EDA) and executing the process of feature engineering.


Adopting state-of-the-art methods for choosing Machine Learning models and fine-tuning models’ parameters.


Deploying models into production environments.


Creating, developing, and maintaining Power BI reports.


Participating in the development of analytic tools to assist the daily operations of the department.


Monitoring the status, the performance, and the health of data pipelines and ensuring they do not fail.


Creating detailed documentation to facilitate team members’ comprehension of the completed tasks and pipelines.


 
What You Bring to the Role:


Bachelor’s in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.


2+ years of experience in Data Engineering


Hands-on with Azure, including Azure Data Factory and Databricks.


Proficient in SQL for ETL.


Experience with Python, PySpark, and/or R.


Knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning.


Strong Power BI skills.


Proficient in written and spoken English.


Strong data analysis and modeling skills.


Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Eager to learn new skills and technologies.


Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.


Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently.


 
Your Benefits:


Competitive remuneration package


Ticket Restaurant Card


Group Health Insurance program


Protergia discount on electricity and natural gas bill


Pension Plan


Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news
 
We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential.  
At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.

title: Power BI Specialist
description:
We are seeking an SQL Server Data Engineer to join our dynamic IT team at a leading retail company. This role entails responsibility for ETL, analyzing, and visualizing data to provide valuable insights and drive informed business decisions.
Role's Responsibilities

Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI.
Write T-SQL queries to provide ad-hoc reports based on business user requirements.
Design, develop, and optimize data models and queries, employing SQL and SSIS to extract, transform, and load data from diverse sources.
Optimizing queries for performance and efficiency.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders to comprehend their data requirements and translate them into effective visual representations.
Implement data cleansing and data quality strategies to ensure the accuracy and reliability of reports and analyses.
Utilize the Soft1 ERP system to extract relevant data and integrate it into Power BI dashboards for comprehensive insights.
Create and maintain documentation for data models, processes, and report specifications.
Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in data visualization and business intelligence.

Requirements

Proven experience as a Power BI Specialist or similar role, demonstrating a strong understanding of data analysis and visualization concepts.
Experience writing complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions to extract, transform, and load data.
Proficiency in using Power BI to create interactive reports and dashboards.
Hands-on experience with SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services) for ETL development, including package design, configuration, and deployment.
Familiarity with SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services)
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, showcasing the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Familiarity with Python for data manipulation and analysis is considered a plus.
Outstanding communication and teamwork skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and present findings.
Experience in the retail industry is desirable, but not required.

title: SQL Software Engineer

Manage and enhance reporting solutions
Perform application parameterization to meet evolving requirements
Resolve UAT and production support tickets efficiently

Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Engineering, Mathematics or Statistics field.
Fluency in English Language (both oral and written)

title: Sr Manager, Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients. Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation, and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.Our team, the Operations & Insights Team, is passionate about using software and data to improve manufacturing processes. We partner with other Pfizer teams focused on:

Manufacturing throughput efficiency and increased manufacturing yield
Reduction of end-to-end cycle time and increase of percent release attainment
Increased quality control lab throughput and more timely closure of quality assurance investigations
Increased manufacturing yield of vaccines
More cost-effective network planning decisions and lowered inventory costs

As the Senior Manager, Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you will work with a team of engineers, driving the overall reliability and performance of our systems and solutions. You will be a key leader in the architecture, strategy and execution of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practice. You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, Data Engineers and stakeholders across the organization to ensure our infrastructure and software deliverables are robust, scalable, and efficient.You will lead initiatives to automate processes, optimize costs and continuously improve the infrastructure that powers our solutions. Your leadership in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation will help us achieve new heights in operational excellence.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
As the Senior Manager, Lead Site Reliability Engineer, your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Act as a Technical lead and mentor in a team of SREs to deliver high-quality software and infrastructure in a fast-paced, agile environment
Define and drive the overall SRE strategy, ensuring performance, scalability and reliability of systems
Architect cost-effective, performant and secure systems in alignment with business needs
Automate manual and repetitive processes to enhance operational efficiency
Champion cloud capabilities for the SDLC and oversee cloud infrastructure performance and cost management
Lead the design, implementation and optimization of our CI/CD pipelines
Architect and implement monitoring, alerting and automation solutions to ensure service health and reliability
Lead the release and deployment process, building a robust knowledge database and continuously optimizing procedures to reduce deployment time and improve reliability
Partner with cross-functional teams to design, develop and enhance new and existing applications
Drive continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on increasing operational efficiency and reliability





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline
Minimum 7 years of experience in Technology Operations, Software Development, or similar field
Proven experience with the following platforms and tools:

Kubernetes / EKS
AWS EC2, EKS, EBS, S3, RDS, MSK or equivalents on other Cloud Providers
GitHub Actions or similar Cloud based CI tooling
Terraform
FluxCD/ArgoCD or Similar GitOps based Kubernetes CD tool
Docker
Prometheus / Grafana
ELK/ECK stack


Proficiency in Bash, plus at least one other modern programming language suchas Java, JavaScript, C#, Python
Operational experience with at least one SQL and one NoSQL Database platform such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, DocumentDB, Neo4j
Deep understanding of microservices architecture and cloud computing
Demonstrated success in managing complex software products including the deployment of multiple versions / releases of a large product
Experience working in teams to address software defect analysis, troubleshooting and resolution
Excellent communication skills (verbal & written)
Proactive approach and goal-oriented mindset, research, problem solving and analytical skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Pharmaceutical Experience
Certified Kubernetes Administrator certification
AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification
Practical knowledge of Agile (Scrum), SAFe (Scalable Agile Framework)

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS
Ability to manage many parallel objectives and changing priorities.
NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Job will require working with global teams and applications. Flexible working schedule may be needed occasionally.
Must be able to support planned weekend or night cutover activities occasionally, depending on release schedule.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr Manager, Lead Site Reliability Engineer id 4919712.

title: Process Maintenance Planning Engineer
description: Hellas Gold Single Member S.A. is a gold, silver, lead and zinc mining company headquartered in Athens, Greece.  Since 2004, Hellas Gold operates the Kassandra Mines at N.E. Chalkidiki, under the strictest EU safety and environmental standards and regulations. The Kassandra Mines consist of the operating mine at Olympias the state-of-the-art Kokkinolakkas Tailings Managements Facility and the Skouries project. Evolving a mining history of 25 centuries, Hellas Gold invests in the development of sustainable mining in the region, contributing to the local economic growth and prosperity with investments of more than $1 billion, the employment of 1,600 people, the active support to the local suppliers, and important investments to local community initiatives and projects. Since 2012, Hellas Gold operates as a subsidiary of the Canadian-based Eldorado Gold Corporation, which has over 25 years of experience in exploration, construction and operation of mines around the world.We live our values in pursuit of our purpose: to find a better way to do things. We aim to break new ground in all that we do. We do this by creating a positive impact today, and for future generations, through our commitment to operating safely, sustainably, and profitably.The company offers the opportunity to those who wish to express interest in the position of ‘Process Maintenance Planning Engineer’, for its premises in Chalkidiki. Ensure optimal resourcing and prioritization of work orders in Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). ·      Custodian of Equipment Downtime Register, liaise with Maintenance Engineer on relevant Analytics and data presentation.·      Maintain and assist in developing Job Standards. ·      Develop and maintain standard job Application Parts Lists (APL’s) for area equipment.·      Coordinate and integrate the PM/selected Asset Management programs.·      Maintain detailed equipment history in CMMS, rotable spares.·      Generate maintenance equipment performance reports.·      Facilitate Post-Mortem meetings following scheduled and major maintenance projects. – continuous improvement.·      Assist Maintenance Superintendent in preparation of the annual maintenance budget.·      Assist Maintenance Engineer with the monthly management of maintenance budget / forecast.·      Administrator of the Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for the Process Plant.·      Verify and coordinate with real time update of all planned maintenance jobs by way of field observations.·      Assist with the updating of maintenance procedures and perform planning and scheduling of maintenance training.·      Conduct and assist with time motion studies of maintenance functions for the process plant.·      Review Notifications to the Maintenance department and open work orders in the CMMS.·      Act as a Supervisor during major shutdown operations of the Process Plant, focused on managing the shutdown schedule and coordination of additional jobs.Requirements:·      Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or Equivalent Maintenance Qualification.·      Working Knowledge of Computer Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), and Reliability Asset Management Systems.·      Working knowledge in the use and integration of predictive and preventive maintenance principles.·      10+ years’ experience as an Engineer in Oil and Gas, Mining or Heavy Industry, ideally with process plant or production engineering experience.·      Plant Maintenance background considered essential.·      Plant Commissioning and Ramp-up experience, considered an asset·      Demonstrated strategic, conceptual and analytical skills.·      Well Developed Business and Financial acumen.·      Demonstrated organizational and We are committed to promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace where we value and respect every colleague for who they are and provide equality of opportunity so that everyone can fulfill their potential.If you are looking for a global and dynamic environment, please send us your CV.

title: Software Developer
description:
The Opportunity
Worldwide and 24/7, air traffic controllers use our innovative software to keep operations running. ​Support our team as an expert in software development for Air Traffic Control (ATC) solutions at international airports. ​ Be part of this challenge and join our team to work on the following tasks: 
 
You will make an impact by

Developing professional software based on a Qt/C++ stack in the field of fault-tolerant, high-performance computing in the aviation industry. ​
Designing, implementing, testing, documenting and integrating features within the agile team.

 
The talent we want to inspire has....

Education in Software Development (either via higher technical college or degree in computer science, engineering, physics or mathematics)​
Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant work experience within Software Development.
Proficiency in C++
Strong problem-solving skills and a structured and methodical approach to complex topics​
Experience with the Git version control system​.
Familiarity with development under Linux ​
Team player, with willingness to work as part of a pragmatic agile team​.
Fluency in English (working language)

 
This would be a plus but not a must!

Experience in the aviation sector is considered a plus.
Experience with Qt and Python is beneficial.

​​​​​​​Why join ADB SAFEGATE? 
We value you and your contribution in the business. Recognizing and rewarding the impact you make is important to us. 
 

In return, we offer a truly global environment with competitive salaries and benefits. 
The opportunity to develop your career. We love to upskill and promote our staff; there's nothing better than to see someone gain a strong sense of pride and accomplishment. 
A great flexible working culture with company values and behaviours that help shape your development and lead to success for you and the Company. 

If you want to join a global business and enjoy being a team player who's driven and passionate, then this is your opportunity to come on board by applying!

title: PHP Developer
description:
BIOAXIS Healthcare, an IQVIA business, is the leader in Patient Support Program services in Greece and cooperates with global and local pharmaceutical companies. We are looking for an experienced PHP Developer, who is dedicated to the craft, writes code that they are proud of and can hit the ground running. A PHP Developer writes beautiful, fast PHP to a high standard, in a timely and scalable way that improves the code-base of our products in meaningful ways. You will be a part of a full-stack creative team that is responsible for all aspects of the ongoing software development from the initial specification, through to developing, testing and launching.
 
Responsibilities:

Write “clean”, well-designed code
Produce detailed specifications
Troubleshoot, test and maintain the core product software and databases to ensure strong optimization and functionality
Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle
Follow industry best practices
Develop and deploy new features to facilitate related procedures and tools if necessary

Requirements:

Previous working experience as a PHP Developer for minimum 5 years.
PHP developer with front-end skills (Javascript, HTML5, CSS3).
Proficient in PHP, HTML5, JavaScript, JQuery.
Basic Linux administration skills.
Must have a full-stack attitude and understand concepts of software engineering.
Knowledge of the software development life cycle.
Ability to work in fast-paced environment.
Ability to acquire missing knowledge and research problems with minimal guidance.
Experience working on a variety of software development projects / technologies is a plus.
UI-UX artistic talent is a plus, though not decisive.
Familiarity with limitations of PHP as a platform and its workarounds.
Excellent relational database skills with MySQL.

title: Full Stack .NET Developer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack .NET Developer
Company: ComPro SA
Location: 10557 Athens, Attica Greece
Position: Full Stack .NET Developer (Junior/Mid/Senior)
Type: Full-Time, On-Site
 
About Us: ComPro SA is a pioneering force in delivering end-to-end automated software solutions tailored for the financial industry and listed companies. With a rich history dating back to 2000, we are dedicated to crafting, offering, and sustaining innovative solutions that align with the ever-evolving technological and regulatory demands of our valued clients. Our commitment extends to nurturing our specialized staff, enabling them to adeptly address real-time client needs, and forging enduring relationships grounded in trust.
Role and Responsibilities:

Υou will play a key role within our cross-functional team
Responsible of both Back-End and Front-End Web Development applications using techniques and languages like C#, .NET Framework, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL Server, UI/UX among other solutions for our digital platforms.
Developing, implementing, and maintaining robust Desktop Applications in the fintech area.
Analysis of project requirements and culminating in the design and implementation of website architecture and of Desktop Applications and SQL Server Objects.
Your crucial duties comprise not only the development and implementation of technical solutions but also close collaboration with diverse teams to ensure the successful completion of projects within established timelines and budgetary constraints
Your assistance will be vital in the development, enhancement, maintenance, and design of a wide array of websites and online applications, catering to a variety of clients.

Main Tasks:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements, scope, and deliverables.
Develop and maintain resilient code and SQL Server objects and scripts using technologies and languages like C#, .NET Framework, SQL Server, WinForms, among other, mainly for our desktop applications.
Design, write, validate and modify scripts and code.
Develop and execute effective testing plans.
Ensure data security and implement measures to protect sensitive information.
Ensure data integrity and quality through meticulous review of data and reports.
Create and maintain documentation for the allocated web applications, programs and other systems.
Utilize Version Control systems to manage codebase and track changes.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical team members to provide updates and gather insights.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance our solutions.

 
Key Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Good Knowledge and proven experience in Front-End Development (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript etc.)
Expertise in Back-End Web Development with proven experience in technologies like C#, .NET Frameworks (ASP.NET, .NET Core etc.), Web API, SQL Server etc.
Expertise in Software Development, with proven experience in technologies like C#, .NET Frameworks (WinForms, .NET Framework, .NET Standard etc), SQL Server and others, for crafting high-performance applications.
Strong experience in building and managing databases to support seamless data flow and storage.
In-depth knowledge of security protocols and data protection measures ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of sensitive information.
Familiarity with Version Control systems, enabling efficient management of the codebase.
Excellent team player with effective communication skills, capable of interacting with both technical and non-technical team members.
Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills to address complex challenges and find optimal solutions.

 
Preferred Qualifications:

2+ years of experience in C#, .Net Frameworks, SQL Server
Experience in developing using ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC applications
Experience using latest .NET frameworks
Experience with DevExpress Controls
Detail- oriented and excellent concentration ability
Experience in the financial technology (fintech) sector is a plus.
Experience in Mobile Development

title: Software Engineer (Oracle)
description:
ICAP Executive Search & Selection is one of the premium consultancies and part of ICAP People & Employment Solutions, the largest HR Services Provider in Greece and Cyprus. With more than 50 years of experience, we specialize in assessing and recruiting Senior to Middle Level Executives across all sectors.ICAP Executive Search, on behalf of its client, a multinational industrial group of companies with offices in the city of Thessaloniki, is seeking an experienced professional for the position of: 
Software Engineer (Oracle) – Ref. 5692/SEO/ESS/GR
Position Overview:We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to design and develop software applications that meet our clients needs. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality software, ensuring the functionality of key systems, and supporting users with technical issues. Your work will have a direct impact on the smooth operation of their manufacturing and supply chain processes.Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop software applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and relational databases such as Oracle and SQL Server to support company operations across all subsidiaries.
Conduct testing and debugging to ensure the proper functioning of applications, particularly those built with PL/SQL.
Write technical documentation for software deliverables.
Provide technical support and maintenance for existing systems, including ERP, CRM, and WMS platforms.
Train users on new applications or system upgrades.
Research and present new software development technologies that could benefit the company’s systems.
Gather and evaluate user requirements to recommend software optimizations.
Collaborate with teams to translate user needs into technical specifications.
Provide ongoing user support for daily technical issues.
Train staff on software tools and systems.
Present and implement emerging technologies that can enhance our information systems.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
At least 3 years of experience in a relevant role (Back-end Developer, SQL Developer, etc.).
Experience in software development using mobile and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
Strong knowledge of relational databases.
Experience with Oracle and SQL Server database development.
Proficiency in PL/SQL is required.
Familiarity with SAP ERP, WMS, MRP, and CRM systems is a plus.
Fluency in English.
Strong communication skills.
Team-oriented mindset and ability to collaborate effectively.
Initiative and problem-solving capabilities.
Analytical thinking.

title: Software Engineer
description:
FlexLearn Business Solutions is a rapidly growing company that specializes in providing innovative and pioneering HR solutions to both businesses and educational organizations.
Our goal is to upgrade people skills, empower organizations to digitize HR processes, and streamline talent acquisition through innovative technology, guided by the principles of flexibility, independence, and collaboration.
We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Software Engineer to design and develop cloud software programs and applications. You will be able to develop, write and implement fully performing software in compliance with the latest coding standards.

Analyze complex concepts and develop clear, practical solutions
Write well designed, testable, efficient code
Strong verbal and written communications
Quick learner of new concepts and technologies

Design & Develop applications using Visual Studio C#, ASP.NET Core, Signal R
MS-SQL (ADO.NET, stored procedures, triggers, etc.)
Front-end engineering using CSS/HTML/JavaScript/JQuery/XML
Object Oriented Analysis/Design/UML Modeling
Ability to recognize and apply software design patterns with security considerations
Experience in deploying load balanced web solutions
Microsoft developer certifications (i.e. MCPD, MCSD)

 Competitive Compensation

Highly effective learning environment
Annual and project-based incentive bonus plan tied to performance
Hybrid working model

Additional Benefits

We at FlexLearn have the opportunity to combine the intense rhythms of life with personal exercise and improvement of our health - in accordance with the international trends of Employee Support - by regularly offering Swimming pool, gym subscription, free yoga classes, mental health programs etc.
Variety of events are organized for employees.

title: Market Developer - Πωλητής (Νομός Πιερίας)
description:
Το SupFolio είναι μια καινοτόμος εταιρεία πληροφορικής και τεχνολογίας, η οποία δίνει τη δυνατότητα σε όλες τις Επιχειρήσεις Εστίασης να Πραγματοποιούν τις Αγορές τους προς τους Προμηθευτές τους μέσα από το Κινητό τους Τηλέφωνο.
 

Προώθηση και πώληση της πλατφόρμας SupFolio σε πιθανούς πελάτες στον τομέα της εστίασης.
Ανάπτυξη νέων αγορών και πελατών για την επέκταση της παρουσίας της εταιρείας.
Καταγραφή και παρακολούθηση προόδου πωλήσεων με χρήση CRM συστημάτων.
Συνεργασία με το τμήμα μάρκετινγκ για την ανάπτυξη στρατηγικών προώθησης και πωλήσεων.
Παροχή υποστήριξης και εκπαίδευσης στους πελάτες σχετικά με τη χρήση της πλατφόρμας.

​Καθήκοντα

Προσδιορισμός & Στόχευση Πιθανών πελατών για τη Πλατφόρμα στο Κλάδο της Ho.Re.Ca. (Χαρτογράφηση)
Επίσκεψη στο Χώρο του Πελάτη με σκοπό την Επικοινωνία, Παρουσίαση & Επίδειξη της Πλατφόρμας
Καταχώρηση Στοιχείων Πελατών - Αντατροφοδότησης (Feedback)

 

Ευθύνες




Προσέγγιση, Ενημέρωση και Onboarding νέων πελατών της Πλατφόρμας (Προμηθευτές - Εταιρείες Χονδρικής στον τομέα της εστίασης) | Κανάλι Άμεσων Πωλήσεων.
Προσέγγιση, Ενημέρωση και Onboarding νέων συνεργατών (Partners Program) | Κανάλι Έμμεσων Πωλήσεων..
Καταγραφή και Παρακολούθηση της προόδου των πωλήσεων.
Παροχή Ενημέρωσης - Υποστήριξης (Πρώτου Επιπέδου)*Ο Τομέας της Υποστήριξης χωρίζεται σε 3 Επίπεδα Υποστήριξης.
Ανάλυση των αναγκών των πελατών μας και προσφορά λύσεων που προσαρμόζονται στις επιχειρησιακές τους ανάγκες.
Συμμετοχή σε εκθέσεις και εκδηλώσεις για την προώθηση της εταιρείας και την αύξηση του κύκλου πελατών.
Διατήρηση θετικών σχέσεων με τους πελάτες και αντιμετώπιση πιθανών προβλημάτων ή αντιφάσεων.
Οικονομική Διευθέτηση απαιτήσεων της Εταιρείες με τους Πελάτες (Όταν αυτό δεν είναι αυτοματοποιημένο).
Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και ανάπτυξη προσωπικών δεξιοτήτων για τη βελτίωση της απόδοσης και την αντιμετώπιση νέων προκλήσεων.


Οφέλη


Η θέση προκηρύσσεται με σκοπό τη διατήρηση της σε Μόνιμη Βάση μετά το πέρας της Δοκιμαστικής Περιόδου εφόσον πιαστούν οι στόχοι της Εταιρείας για το συγκεκριμένο Νομό.

Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών που περιλαμβάνει βασικό μισθό από το Πρόγραμμα, έξτρα αποδοχές από την Εταιρεία έως τη συμπλήρωση του ποσού 800Ευρώ Καθαρά το Μήνα και μπόνους βασισμένους στην απόδοση.
Πενθήμερο ωράριο εργασίας (Δευτέρα έως Παρασκευή).
Προοπτικές ανάπτυξης καριέρας σε ένα δυναμικό και αναπτυσσόμενο περιβάλλον.
Εκπαίδευση και κατάρτιση για την απόκτηση νέων δεξιοτήτων και γνώσεων.
Υγιειές περιβάλλον εργασίας με έμφαση στη συνεργασία και την αμοιβαία υποστήριξη.



 

Παροχές & Ωράριο
 

Η εταιρεία παρέχει τα παρακάτω:

Αυτοκίνητο: Η εταιρεία παρέχει υπηρεσιακό αυτοκίνητο για τις ανάγκες των εργαζομένων που αναλαμβάνουν τις πωλητικές δραστηριότητες.
Κινητό: Οι εργαζόμενοι λαμβάνουν υπηρεσιακό κινητό τηλέφωνο για επικοινωνία και παρακολούθηση επαγγελματικών υποθέσεων.
Tablet: Οι εργαζόμενοι λαμβάνουν υπηρεσιακό Tablet για την ορθότερη επικοινωνία, Παρουσίαση και παρακολούθηση επαγγελματικών υποθέσεων.
Ωράριο: Πενθήμερο (Δευτ. - Παρασκευή) Επιλογή i)  9:00 - 17:00 Επιλογή ii) 9:00 - 15:00 & 18:00 - 20:00

 

Απαιτήσεις
 



Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε πωλήσεις ή σε σχετικό τομέα θα θεωρηθεί επιπρόσθετο πλεονέκτημα.
Εξαιρετικές επικοινωνιακές δεξιότητες και ικανότητα πειθούς.
Ικανότητα να εργαστεί αποτελεσματικά σε ομάδα και ανεξάρτητα.
Ευελιξία και διάθεση για την ανάληψη πρωτοβουλιών.
Ικανότητα να διαχειρίζεται πολλαπλές εργασίες και προθεσμίες.
Άριστη γνώση της ελληνικής και της αγγλικής γλώσσας, προφορικά και γραπτά.
Εξοικείωση με τη χρήση υπολογιστών και εφαρμογών γραφείου.
Αποδοτικός και οργανωμένος με εξαιρετική ικανότητα προτεραιότητας.
Προθυμία για ταξίδια και συμμετοχή σε εκδηλώσεις και επαγγελματικά ραντεβού κατόπιν ανάγκης.

title: Collection Manager
description:
Role
As part of the Supply team and under the supervision of the Head of Business Development and supply, your main responsibilities will be to develop the portfolio of homes, sourcing new luxury homes matching our customers' search criteria, and overseeing the entire process of adding them to the catalogue. You will also manage and develop a portfolio of luxury properties, ensuring they meet The Collectionist's criteria. Your role covers a specific destination and involves a certain approach to property management.
 
Objectives
 
Market research and analysis

Conduct thorough market research to identify emerging trends, potential clients, and
investment opportunities
Analyse the competitive landscape and create strategies to position our rental offerings effectively.
Use data-driven insights to make informed business decisions.

 
Business objectives - sourcing

Participate in building consistent goals in line with the LC Group budget and guidelines
Implement and coordinate the company's business plan
Recruit new owners/properties to achieve revenue targets and support local operations teams to attain their goals
Maintain strong owner relationships throughout the year to optimise financial terms and secure availability
Identify and develop new destinations in the area to accelerate local office growth
Create compelling sales presentations and materials if needed
Demonstrate a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets
Effectively negotiate and close deals
Effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams
Demonstrate excellent interpersonal and networking skills

Collection addition process

Search for new luxury properties that meet Le Collectionist's standards in strategic destinations.
Evaluate the relevance of properties based on selection criteria and market needs.
Negotiate with property owners to establish favourable partnerships
Full process management for adding to the collection catalogue
Supervise and coordinate the entire process, from initial selection to the online listing of properties
Collaborate closely with internal teams, Rental Manager and marketing teams

 
Strategy & Governance

Identify and capitalise on new business opportunities (potential acquisition targets for
example)
Support the target assessment with operational insights during the Due Diligence phase.
Ensure compliance with local laws and regulations (mandates, licenses, etc.)

Local Branding

Networking within industry events, conferences, and relevant business circles to expand the company's reach
Establishing and nurturing relationships with potential clients, partners, and stakeholders

Portfolio management of properties

Manage a portfolio of luxury properties, ensuring they meet Le Collectionist's standards
Develop the property portfolio by identifying new opportunities and respecting selection criteria in collaboration with the Business Developer
Maximize revenue realization conditions for your portfolio
Select the owners with whom to negotiate and convince to sign an exclusivity mandate, seasonal purchases or free up availability for our agency
Promote and sell additional products to property owners
Contribute to the creation and management of a network of owners in our main destinations
Participate in establishing annual objectives and budgets for the Supply department

 
Optimize your portfolio properties' income.

Act as a facilitator and negotiator during transactions with owners (support to sales teams)
Monitoring KPI for each property in the portfolio (owner income, number of requests, conversion rate, occupancy rate, etc.)
Maximize the conditions for achieving turnover on your portfolio
Performance analysis and recommendations to owners
Development and deployment of action plans to improve indicators
Monthly, quarterly or annual meetings with owners to maintain a good relationship as well as provide advice to optimize the performance of their property, as well as good operational management

 
Property management

Assume the primary relationship with each portfolio owner, from the visit to updating information intended for internal teams and clients.
Coordinate the collection of data and organize photography sessions for onboarding properties.
Monitoring the update of legal documents (Protexa, licenses, mandates, etc.)
Support for Stay teams in negotiating with owners’ security deposit deduction or compensation by tenants

 
Stay and Sales Team Training Support

Participate in the training of Stay teams (support on pre-season visits, first arrivals, VIP arrivals, creation of video training content, etc.).
Training of Sales teams and support in closing portfolio deals

 
Profile 

Degree from a business or management school
Bilingual in English and Greek, French would be an additional asset
Embody the company's values and strategy as defined by management
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the team
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
Ability to analyze data and make decisions based on factual information
Results-oriented with a commitment to service excellence
Passion for the luxury property rental sector and the travel industry

 
Perks

Monthly food coupon
2 remote days per week
One day off for your birthday (excluding weekends and public holidays)
A laptop & a phone
Events all year round (Christmas Party, Summer Party...)

Note: The above job description is a general overview and may be subject to change based on the organization's specific requirements and priorities.

title: Manager, Back-End Application Development
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAt Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels, and the look and feel of our regional corporate sites around the world, consulting and supporting objectives from various stakeholders across the entire company, as well as directly setting objectives and delivering on them.The Back-End Application Development Manager leads the designing, developing, and implementing of moderately complex cutting-edge solutions for Pfizer's digital marketing initiatives (specifically, maintaining and expanding upon the code that powers our global corporate websites). The Back-End Application Developer plays a crucial role in Pfizer's pursuit of breakthroughs by pushing the boundaries of digital experiences and creating captivating solutions that drive patient engagement, knowledge sharing, and commercial success.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESSubject Matter Expertise - General

Design and develop digital solutions utilizing the latest development tools, frameworks, and platforms to build cutting-edge solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.
Implement source code management best practices to maintain high standards of code quality, integrity and consistency.
Applies knowledge of internal/external business challenges to provide input into recommendations for improvements to products, processes or services
Define and Implement best practices in usability, accessibility, and user interface design to ensure seamless and intuitive customer interactions within digital solutions.
Conduct and document thorough testing and debugging of digital solutions to identify and resolve any technical issues or performance bottlenecks.
Integrate digital solutions with other digital marketing technologies and platforms, such as content management systems, analytics, and personalization engines.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, security protocols, and industry best practices related to application development and deployment.
Act as primary back-end application developer for Pfizer.com (and functionality shared with our regional sites), performing all tasks necessary from bug fixing and tier 1 support up to advanced, emergency problem-solving and new, complex enhancement requests, in coordination with the Technical lead, Platform team and other relevant parties.
Provide direction to and integration contributions from other back-end developers, both from within the team and from agency/vendor partners.

Strategic Leadership & Delivery

Participate in the ideation and prototyping of digital solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to explore new and optimized ways of solution development. Take appropriate risks to advance new concepts and methodologies that are moderately complex.
Make decisions that may require developing new options to resolve moderately complex problems.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bsc degree with at least 5 years of experience OR Masters with at least 3 year of experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience as an individual contributor/practitioner.
Application development, with comprehensive knowledge and proven experience in Drupal/PHP/MySQL stack development technologies, platforms, and frameworks.
Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API integrations and containerization technologies like Docker.
Knowledge of AWS services like Fargate, S3, Aurora, EFS, CloudFront and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and JIRA/Confluence.
Experience in Python/Scripting.
Solid understanding and awareness of security topics like DDOS Attacks, SQL Injections, Content Security Policies, Cross Site Scripting, Cross Origin Requests.
Solid understanding and awareness of Drupal's security concepts like Users, Roles, Permissions, Anonymous user access levels.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug and optimize complex applications.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Passion for exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, engaging, and user-friendly experiences.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management practices.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures.
Experience in performance monitoring tools like Kibana/New Relic/Wormly/Lighthouse/Xhprof/Blazemeter is a plus.
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Back-End Application Development id 4918500.

title: Senior Associate, Back-End Application Development
description:
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels, and the look and feel of our regional corporate sites around the world, consulting and supporting objectives from various stakeholders across the entire company, as well as directly setting objectives and delivering on them.The Back-End Application Development Sr. Associate contributes to developing and implementing moderately complex cutting-edge solutions for Pfizer's digital marketing initiatives (specifically, maintaining and expanding upon the code that powers our global corporate websites). The Back-End Application Developer plays a crucial role in Pfizer's pursuit of breakthroughs by pushing the boundaries of digital experiences and creating captivating solutions that drive patient engagement, knowledge sharing, and commercial success.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESSubject Matter Expertise - General

Develop digital solutions utilizing the latest development tools, frameworks, and platforms to build cutting-edge solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences.
Implement source code management best practices to maintain high standards of code quality, integrity and consistency.
Implement best practices in usability, accessibility, and user interface design to ensure seamless and intuitive customer interactions within digital solutions.
Conduct and document thorough testing, and debugging of digital solutions to identify and resolve any technical issues or performance bottlenecks.
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, security protocols, and industry best practices related to application development and deployment.
Serve as a back-end application developer for Pfizer.com (and functionality shared with our regional sites), performing all tasks necessary from bug fixing and tier 1 support up to advanced, emergency problem-solving and new, complex enhancement requests, in coordination with the Back-end lead, Technical lead, Platform team and other relevant parties.

Strategic Leadership & Delivery

Participate in the ideation and prototyping of digital solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to explore new and optimized ways of solution development. Explore and apply new ideas and knowledge in solutioning.
Make decisions to resolve moderately complex problems.

Cross- Team Collaboration

Collaborate with the Delivery Lead, Service Owners, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into digital solutions.
Participate in design reviews and solution evaluations to ensure alignment with Pfizer's design strategies and standards.

Coaching and Mentorship

Stay up-to-date with technologies, trends, and best practices in the field of application development, and contribute to the continuous improvement of Pfizer application development practices.
Participate in the development of standards, processes, and procedures.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years or relevant working experience.
Experience as an individual contributor/practitioner.
Application development, with strong knowledge and proven experience in Drupal/PHP/MySQL stack development technologies, platforms, and frameworks.
Experience in Python/Scripting.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and JIRA/Confluence.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug and optimize simple/medium complexity applications.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Passion for exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation..
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, engaging, and user-friendly experiences.
Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management practices.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures.
Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API integrations and containerization technologies like Docker.
Knowledge of AWS services like Fargate, S3, Aurora, EFS, Cloud.
Understanding and awareness of security topics like DDOS Attacks, SQL Injections.
Understanding and awareness of Drupal's security concepts like Users, Roles, Permissions, Anonymous user access levels.
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.

TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Candidate will be expected to travel globally to Pfizer locations as needed.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Back-End Application Development with id 4918499.

As a Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant at GWF, you play a crucial role in transforming our business technology solutions in Dynamics 365. Join a team that leads Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) initiatives, shaping the future of digital practices in the flow control space and beyond.

Demonstrate expertise in D365 functional areas, including Finance, HR, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Sales & Power Platform Apps
Experience in setting and parametrizing D365 modules, showing a deeper understanding of their interdependencies from a functional process and also technical implementation perspective
Ensure the quality of project deliverables, showcasing proficiency in system and functional testing
Lead end-to-end implementation projects, contributing to design, configuration, testing, training, cutover, and reporting phases
Collaborate with operational teams to gather requirements, ensuring expectations align with deliverables
Act as the interface between functional requirements and development initiatives, by owning functional specifications and being able to translate them into developer’s language

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology with a preference for a Master’s degree
Microsoft Dynamics D365 certifications
5 to 8 years or more of relevant experience in a similar role, especially in a professional services/consulting firm
Knowledge of ERP implementation methodologies and strong analytical acumen
Ability to work under minimal supervision and adapt to changing environments
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with fluency in English and at least German or Greek

Soft Skills

Confidence, independence, and a professional demeanor
Effective time management in handling multiple tasks
Clear thinking and calmness under pressure
Creative problem-solving and a focus on business process excellence
Eagerness to assess and incorporate new technologies into your skillset

We offer

Competitive compensation
Flexible work models
A pleasant, fun, and achievement-oriented environment
Learning and growth opportunities in an international company setup

title: Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Global Information Security (GIS) organization delivers proactive cyber defense for the global Pfizer enterprise. Our mission is to secure all of Pfizer's information assets ranging from the manufacturing floor to the core data centers and out to the patient facing solutions. We achieve this mission through a team of world-class talent, utilizing top-tier technologies, advanced analytics and the promotion of a cybersecurity ownership culture across the company. This role requires the individual to embrace an agile work environment and demonstrate a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive approach to problem solving.In this role, we are looking for emerging talent to develop analytics and automations that enable seamless execution and monitoring of operations, while being compliant to standard processes for Global Cybersecurity Engineering services. The Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer is a hands-on role which will develop analytics, and automations and work towards Infrastructure as Code and Policy as a Code to ensure end to end reliability, continuity and consistency of our services to protect Pfizer.For Pfizer, we look for candidates that are motivated, self-learning, and team-oriented individuals. From a technical perspective, an ideal candidate would have the skills shown below, but candidates that possess a strong subset and an attitude towards self-development & growth will be considered.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESThis role will have the following primary responsibilities, but will often act under the support and direction of the Sr. Manager, Cybersecurity Engineering Automations Lead:

Design and implement Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning and management of infrastructure.
Automate Policies as Code and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
Develop automations to eliminate manual repetitive tasks and allow time for more meaningful work.
Develop and optimize automation scripts for configuring and managing cloud infrastructure, while ensuring efficient and error free deployment process.
Create analytics from transactional logs from Global Cybersecurity Engineering solutions to provide visibility to support operational monitoring and policy analysis.
Develop analytics/analyze data to improve situational awareness and make informed decisions.
Manage small to medium security enhancement and remediation projects.
Demonstrate commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrate effective oral, written, and interpersonal communications skills as well as organizational and planning abilities.
Create and document processes, templates, and workflows for service execution across the Global Cybersecurity Engineering services.
Create and maintain compliance and audit related records relevant to the automation processes.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BS in Computer Sciences, Information Security, Information Systems, Engineering, Sciences, or related field.
3+ years of experience.
Experience with Python and SQL.
Experience developing automated workflows using a graphical user interface solution.
Experience developing python scripts for data collection and automation use cases.
Experience performing raw data analysis using a log repository or SIEM.
Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to prioritize and execute with minimal direction or oversight.
Concise, accurate communication skills (both verbal and written).
Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Demonstrated commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Policy as Code, Security.
Experience with Terraform, PowerShell, and cloud infrastructure monitoring tools.
Experience developing alerts and reports based on data logs.
Experience with agile ways of work, Scrum framework and Scrum Master role.
Experience with compliance frameworks, code quality assurance and audit processes.
Experience creating workflows and templates in Confluence/JIRA.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer with id 4915504.

title: Customer Experience Partner Rare Disease Greece
description:
About the job
Job Purpose:
Achieve personal sales objectives and support regional sales targets for registered products in alignment with company goals and values. Communicate effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs), evaluate interactions, and implement strategies to maintain, expand, and acquire customer relationships through both digital and physical channels.
What you’ll be doing:

Sales and Activities Goal Setting:

Co-create and participate in setting sales and activity goals.
Execute visits to targeted HCPs for responsible products, integrating both physical and digital touchpoints.




Customer Engagement:

Conduct regular visits and digital engagements with HCPs to meet cyclical and annual sales plans.
Identify and engage non-HCP target groups according to established classification criteria.
Share detailed information on Sanofi products as per approved marketing strategies during interactions, ensuring ethical and accurate communication.




Promotional Compliance:

Utilize only approved and ethical promotional materials, ensuring alignment with company strategy and standards.
Organize meetings with HCPs, including face-to-face and online formats, and accurately record activities in electronic systems (ETMS).




Analytical Tools Utilization:

Employ OneCI and other analytical platforms to enhance sales outcomes through data-driven decision-making and personalized customer experiences.




Product Knowledge:

Maintain up-to-date medical knowledge of responsible products and apply this information in compliance with legislation and internal regulations.




Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to pharmacovigilance regulations and Sanofi’s quality standards for reporting defects.
Prepare and submit timely and accurate activity reports, leveraging ETMS as needed.




Regional Management:

Monitor and report regional activities to the Manager
Execute tasks assigned by the employer in accordance with the employment contract and job description.




Agile Work Approach:

Work within an Agile sub-organization group (HUB), assuming the role of a developer in the “Development Team.”
Deliver incremental value in each sprint, aligning with overall business goals.




Omnichannel Strategy:

In line with the CSE GenMed strategy, use the most suitable channels, formats, and timing for communication, integrating an omnichannel approach.




Event Participation:

Organize and participate in seminars and congresses related to assigned products, both in physical and virtual settings.




Representation and Confidentiality:

Represent Sanofi in accordance with its values, code of ethics, and strategy, maintaining confidentiality of non-public information and internal strategies.



About you
 
Experience: 

Experience in promoting pharmaceutical products

Soft and technical skills: 

Driving license
Proficiency in computer applications (Microsoft Office, internet, internal systems)
Result and customer orientation, dynamism, accuracy, diplomacy
Ability to work in matrix organization, team player
Adaptability to a rapidly changing environment
Ability to build relationships across departments and functions and to support a collaborative working environment
Play to Win behaviors

Languages: 

Fluent in Greek and advanced level of English (both verbal and written) would be a plus

Education: 

University degree in Life Science (Medicine, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Medical, Bioengineering, etc.) would be a plus

Utilize HTML/CSS and email marketing best practices to create and code interactive email experiences.

Troubleshoot HTML, CSS, and other performance issues.

Contribute to team efforts by achieving targeted results.

Degree in multimedia and web development, computer science or any other related field.
Understanding of HTML5 and CSS3.
Familiar with versioning tools such as GIT.
Good understanding of the fundamental principles of design, creative thinker & problem solver.
Ability to work with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English.

Continuous personal development and international training opportunities

If you are committed to excellence in client service and passionate about how technology could be an enabler in our digital world, then you are the one!
We are one of the leading providers of Advisory related services in Greece. Processing of monthly payroll and statutory bonuses, preparation and submission of tax/social security obligations that have arisen from payroll


Creation and submission of notifications to labor authorities


Calculation of gross to net/ net to gross scenarios


Computerized preparation of payslips


Preparation of the annual budget


Design of reports based on our client’s needs

Excellent academic records from a Greek or foreign university (Bachelor’s or Master’s degree) relevant to any of the following areas: Finance, Economics, Business Administration or other related field


0-1 year of previous working experience in a relevant role


Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and fluently both in Greek and English


Familiar with ERP systems and Excel will be considered as an asset 


Ability and willingness to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines


Exceptional collaboration, communication and interpersonal skills and a team-player mentality


Continuous learning and development mindset


Military services fulfilled

🕑 Hybrid working model

title: Senior Graphic Designer - Creative Director
description:
Do you want to lead a project that will make history? Then maybe you are the Graphic Designer - Creative Director we are looking for! 
If you dream of a work environment without the pressure of customers and negative reviews, and you have the skills to turn ideas into designs that stand out, then you might be the one we're looking for! 
In our team, you will have the opportunity to lead the largest online educational project in finance with a focus on the American market. Our goal is to revolutionize the education of entrepreneurs in business finances, using the art of design and the power of storytelling.
What will you do with us:

Design of digital projects: You will undertake the design and implementation of innovative digital projects, such as our digital city and our software, as well as social media campaigns and other digital tools. Your goal? Showcase our ideas with your creativity and design in the hottest market in the world!
Creative Team Leadership: You will lead the creative team and work closely with marketing and other teams to design and bring to life the most innovative concept in finance through our branding and storytelling.
Research and continuous improvement: You will research new trends in digital design and constantly improve our digital projects, ensuring that we are always highly creative and impressive!

 
What we are looking for in you:

Degree in Graphic Design or a related subject and at least 3 years of experience in a senior position, preferably in digital projects 
Excellent knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) and experience in digital design.
We will not write about ability to pressure and negative criticism because in our project we want creativity, and we know that stress and creativity do not go hand in hand. What we want is the ability to organize your priorities and manage your time effectively.
Ability to take initiatives and offer original "out of the box" solutions.
And of course creative thinking, imagination and enthusiasm. 

 
It will be appreciated: Knowledge in additional programs, such as UX or 3D Low Poly Design, and anything else that can upgrade our project.
 
What we offer:

Competitive salary: Starting from 1,500 euros (net), with the possibility of a higher salary depending on the additional qualifications and experience you bring to the project.
Efficiency bonus: We always reward effort and believe in reward!
Travel: With offices in London too, we support travel for inspiration and creativity. Our last trip with the group was 2 months ago to Disneyland for inspo!
Excellent working environment: Our offices are located in Kalamaria, in one of the most beautiful areas, with your own office and many privileges, including - of course - security.

If you are excited by the idea of ​​participating in one of the projects that will become the talk of the world, then this is your chance!
Be part of the team that is transforming the way the world perceives finances, through impressive and creative visuals!
Send resumes and work sample: hr@cmv.gr

Above all, Mandarin Oriental is renowned for creating unique hotels through distinctive design and a strong sense of place, luxury hotels right for their time and place.
Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino
Located on the southwest coast of the Peloponnese, one of the most unspoiled and breath-taking landscapes in the Mediterranean, and 45 minutes’ drive from Kalamata International Airport.
The beachfront resort is part of the sustainable resort destination of Costa Navarino, a well-established tourism destination which includes 3 other resorts. It comprises of 99 suites and villas, all with outdoor terraces and sea views, along with seven restaurants and bars.
Scope of Position:
The In Room Dining Manager oversees the operational and financial aspects of the In Room Dining operation. He/she ensures the implementation and consistency of the company standards and supports the F&B Director in driving forward the F&B ambitions of the property.
Duties & Responsibilities:

Takes responsibility for the business and qualitative performance of the outlet
Actively supports the hotel’s team culture, and helps to achieve the hotel’s vision, goals and values
Handles day to day management activities
Establishes shift pattern organization
Plans and coordinates menus with the chef
Ensures that the team has good knowledge of food and beverage and that they act in accordance with MO standards
Ensures all equipment is in good condition and correct training for its use is arranged
Ensures that all daily meetings are arranged and conducted and that time and attendance sheets and holiday planners are accurately maintained and distributed to F&B Director
Carries out other duties when requested by management
Ensures that the outlet operates efficiently and profitably, while maintaining standards in terms of food, service, health & safety and reputation
Analyses and plans outlet sales levels and profitability
Prepares reports at the end of the shift/week, including colleague control, cost of sales control and sales
Creates and executes plans for department sales, profit and staff development
Sets budgets and/or agreeing them with senior management
Supervises F&B service by directing and guiding colleagues, providing them with feedback
Ensures that guests preferences are remembered by colleagues and that guests’ satisfaction is met by every member of staff
Ensures greeting and taking orders by staff are all done to MO standards
Develops outlet up-selling strategy and communicates it to all relevant staff
Ensures food and beverages are presented to guests according to the standards of the outlet
Develops a strategy for handling special requests and VIPs
Deals with guest complaints in a timely manner and updates the F&B Director where appropriate

Qualifications / Experience:

EU passport is mandatory in order to work in Greece
Degree or Higher National Diploma in Hospitality/Hotel/Business Management is preferred.
Minimum of 3 years experience in a similar position, preferable in luxury hotel/restaurant environment
Opening experience preferred.
Local and international food and beverage awareness.
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, in English and Greek.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite; Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Behavioral skills / attributes:

Service oriented with an eye for details.
Flexibility - Adaptability
Strategic agility and ability to make quality decisions
Solid organizational skills to motivate and grow talents
Effective managerial and communications skills.
Emotionally intelligent – especially across different cultural groups, high-net worth and / influential guests, nationalities and stakeholder interests.
Highly self-motivated, professional, and capable of managing their workload and prioritizing tasks.
Well presented and professionally groomed at all times.

We offer exciting benefits including and not limited to :

Accommodation provided
Medical Plan Insurance
Free meals at Colleagues' Dining
Free laundry of those wearing uniform
Colleague recognition program
Learning & Development Program
Task force Opportunities across the Group of Mandarin Oriental
Colleague Social events and Wellness programs

description:
Pfizer careers are like no other. In our culture of individual ownership, we believe in our ability to improve future healthcare, and potential to transform millions of lives. We’re looking for new talent to join our global community, to unearth new innovative therapies that make the world a healthier place.
Role Overview:We are seeking a Senior Director, E2E Network Solutions to join the Digital Manufacturing Team. They will be responsible for spearheading ownership of solutions, products, and dashboards with broader applications than manufacturing. For example, this includes owning the Digital Operations Center (DOC) product suite as it stands today while also looking for opportunities to expand and consolidate existing DOC capabilities to merge manufacturing, quality, and supply chain processes into a seamless, data-driven insight engine. DOC is a custom-Pfizer product suite designed to be a collaboration and management tool that enables a harmonized, digital view of manufacturing operations at all levels in the PGS organization and can be accessed on multiple devices.In addition to DOC, solutions and products under this leader include Digital Manufacturing Intelligence & AI (MDA), Connected Worker & Shop Floor (SF) Products, Predictive Operations Suite, E2E Visibility & Analytics.
