This team includes data scientists who can partner with PGS teams to apply statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other mathematical tools to business data.In addition to developing new products, solutions, and dashboards, they will be expected to advance opportunities to consolidate data similar products within the existing portfolio. Furthermore, when a new dashboard or data product is requested, the lead should first evaluate whether a current tool could be used or adapted to meet the business need before adding net new solutions and products to the portfolio.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Operations Management, Data Science, or a related field.
15+ years experience with a minimum of 7+ years in operational analytics or a related field, with significant leadership experience in a complex, multi-functional organization.
Expertise in data analytics tools, statistical software, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.

Additional Skills/Preferences:

Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Operations Management, Data Science, or a related field.
Exceptional ability to think strategically and analytically to solve complex operational challenges.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effectively leading teams and presenting insights to executive management.
Proven leadership skills with the ability to drive team performance and foster a positive work environment.
Excellent project management skills, with a track record of successfully leading large-scale analytics projects.

Additional Information:

This role may require occasional travel to sites for team collaboration and stakeholder meetings.

Private health and life insurance


Mobile phone and Laptop


Career development opportunities

title: Payroll Outsourcing Professionals - Στελέχη Μισθοδοσίας (PP0824)
description:
Payroll Outsourcing Professionals - Στελέχη Μισθοδοσίας (PP0824) 


Andersen Greece is the Greek member firm of Andersen Global®, an international firm with 475 locations and more than 17.000 professionals worldwide. Andersen Greece focuses on delivering quality and value to its clients through innovative and practical legal solutions on business issues that matter.
In Andersen people matter. Their creativity is the fuel that drives us. Who does the work makes all the difference. We’re good to each other but tough on ourselves. Always striving and never settling for second best.
Always willing to go the extra mile for our clients. We are imaginative and creative. We go further together even when it may be quicker or easier to go alone. If the plan doesn’t work, we change the plan – but never the goal. We know that together everyone achieves more. This is how we do business.
Our firm is providing significant long-term career opportunities for our professionals. Due to the expansion of our services, we are looking for dynamic and experienced Payroll Professionals to deliver accurate and compliant payroll services for a group of assigned clients.
 
Primary Responsibilities:

Oversees the daily workflow of the department.
Delivering accurate and compliant payroll processing for a group of assigned clients, coordinating the client’s requirements and managing the process of payroll delivery.
Managing and delivering client payrolls against the agreed schedule – communicating directly with clients to meet or exceed the client’s deadlines. Escalating and investigating issues within clients and networks to meet and exceed agreed Service Level Agreements.
Managing and maintaining clear and informative communications to clients, our partners and implementation teams.
Taking responsibility for developing and maintaining detailed knowledge of Greek labor, social security and tax law and holding detailed knowledge of the statutory processes in Greece.
Working closely with the implementation team to take on new payrolls and clients.
Showing pride in payroll, a customer-focused and professional attitude and a sense of urgency to deliver best-in-class and high-quality payroll results.

 
Position Requirements:

A strong academic record including a University degree in the fields of Economics, Accounting or HR. A master’s degree in the same fields of study is desirable but not essential.
3-7 years’ experience in fully processing payrolls, knowing of legislation and all year-end processes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel including advanced functions i.e. pivot tables, logical formulas, and macros.
Excellent command of Greek and English language.
Experienced in working with clients from different sectors (retail, pharmaceutical, shipping, FMCG, etc.).
Knowledge and experience in the information system of the Hellenic Ministry of labor, social security and Welfare (ERGANI).
Extensive knowledge of payroll software like Epsilon-net.
Advanced payroll software customization knowledge.
Knowledge of payroll transactions associated with general accounting principles, union contracts, and audit requirements.

 
Skills:

Strong supervisory and leadership skills.
Excellent organizational and time management skills to meet payroll and period closing deadlines.
Capable of discretely handling confidential information.
Highly motivated and driven professional, with excellent communication skills and a track record of delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
Ability to work independently and as a team player.
Able to effectively analyze and process data.

 
What we offer:

The chance to work, gain experience and grow within a rising star in the payroll outsourcing industry in Greece, expecting huge growth in the short term of time.
Educational activities.
Competitive salary based on market rates.
Excellent working environment.

 
We give our people the opportunity to participate in the most challenging cases, develop their skills, acquire experience and become the professional they want to be.
 
Sounds like you?
Send your CV to the e-mail address hr@gr.andersen.com and mention the code PP0824.

title: Senior Manager, Frontend Development, Web Publishing
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.
What You Will Achieve
Your technical skills will help us develop and support robust software for our business. Due to your expertise, you will develop program logic for new applications and modify existing ones. You will support a range of activities, such as coding, testing, debugging, documentation, implementation and maintenance of software applications for Pfizer.As a Senior Manager, your advanced knowledge of the principles and concepts in the discipline and comprehensive knowledge of other disciplines will enable you to lead complex projects across the division. Your ability to develop and manage plans will facilitate in achieving objectives, interpreting internal and external business challenges and recommending best practices for improvements. While managing complex project environments, you will be able to anticipate and troubleshoot roadblocks and influence teams to achieve targets for the division.It is your hard work and focus that will help in making Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe.
How You Will Achieve It

Develop ideas and lead frontend web initiatives and processes across platform teams.
Use knowledge of industry, customer requirements and general business environment to enable delivery of projects and programs, leveraging both standard commercial roadmap patterns as well as innovative technologies across a range of systems disciplines.
Help coordinate the creation of technical designs and implementation plans.
Well versed in agile principles and able to lead software engineers in this area.
Help guide technical objectives for one or more teams with ongoing work activities across all commercial business units within a product grouping and portfolio of projects.
Assist with release management of related platforms.
Work with the infrastructure and shared service organizations to procure and manage stable application platforms.
Establish relationships with customers and members of the project delivery team and liaises between our customers and technical members of the project team.
Work in a matrixed team environment with Pfizer colleagues as well as vendor partners by participating in vendor management activities.
Embed Continuous Improvement and automation into daily work and develop a DevOps culture in the team.





Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's Degree
7+ years' experience
Demonstrated experience as an information technology professional in roles such as a frontend developer.
Proven experience working with business teams developing and delivering strategy and operating plans with demonstrated competency in strategic thinking, and relationship management
Experience working with distributed teams of contract or colleague resources
Ability to take a systematic approach to estimation of technical project
Exhibits a high level of business knowledge and understanding of the external marketplace and anticipates business line or sub-function customer requirements
Ability to lead in a complex, matrix environment with geographically distributed resources
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to establish relationships, influence outcomes, and deliver effective presentations to a variety of audiences
Expertise in setting up and maintaining robust testing environments using tools like Jest, Mocha, and Cypress.
Thorough knowledge of WCAG 2.1 guidelines, with hands-on experience in implementing and auditing accessibility features.
Strong experience in integrating frontend codebases into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
Advanced skills in optimizing web performance by implementing lazy loading, code splitting, tree shaking, and asset minification.
Expertise in monitoring and optimizing Core Web Vitals such as Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), First Input Delay (FID), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).

 
Nice-to-Have

Master's degree
Relevant pharmaceutical industry experience
Proven progressive experience as an Information Technology professional, preferably in a pharmaceutical industry
Knowledge of system integrations
Experience in legal technology space

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

title: WEB DEVELOPER

FactSet Digital Solutions is a provider and operator of customized financial market information systems. The group provides solutions for reporting and analysis of financial market data to approximately 250 banks, financial service providers and media companies in Europe and the US, both for their employees and end customers. The services include conception, design, development and operation of solutions over the Internet as well as intranets. Professional Consulting (based in Athens, Greece) is one of FactSet’s development partners for web based solutions.
We are looking for motivated web-developers for applications who will make financial data obvious.
Is web-development your passion? Are you keen on creating websites even in your spare time? Do you find advanced technology and new methods attractive? Can you deal with JavaScript, PHP and keep up with all the fast-paced improvements and innovations in modern Web Development? Does the continuous improvement of existing functions appeal to you? Then you are exactly what we are seeking!
Must-haves:
* JavaScript
* Vue.js (or prior experience with any other major frontend JS framework like Angular,React)
* PHP
* Symfony (or prior experience with any other major PHP MVC framework like Laravel)
* Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* MySQL
* HTML
* CSS
* Git
* English language skills
Nice-to-haves:
* Node.js
* Webpack
* Vuex
* REST
* Additional language skills in the following languages: Italian, German, Spanish, French

* Create and innovate by using State-of-the-Art technologies
* Start-up atmosphere combined with a secured job position
* Flexible working times
* Flexible work model
* Home office
* Trainings, workshops
* Flat hierarchies
* Excellent career prospects
* Young, dynamic and independent development team
Salary:

Competitive salary

description:
Company overview: 
We are a Europe-based AI and digital technology group with offices in Germany, Hungary and Greece. Our team is at the forefront of innovative solutions and we are looking for a dedicated and dynamic Project Manager to support our team remotely. You will work in a collaborative and innovative international team with opportunities for professional growth and development. 
Main tasks: 

Plan, manage and monitor projects to ensure they are delivered on time and meet customer expectations.
Collaborate with diverse teams to align project goals and effectively manage priorities.
Maintain clear and open communication with customers and stakeholders, ensuring their needs are met throughout the project lifecycle.
Anticipate, identify and manage challenges or risks that may arise during projects.
Create tasks, track project progress, and adjust plans and priorities as needed in a dynamic environment.
Facilitate effective meetings and provide clear action points to ensure smooth project delivery.
Document project milestones, decisions and deliverables to ensure transparency and future reference.
Create technical tasks for developers based on collected business requirements.
Test implemented features in the project (no code testing required). 

Requirements and Qualifications: 

Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to lead teams.
Fluent English and German skills (spoken and written) are essential. Proficiency in other languages ​​is highly valued.
A bachelor's or master's degree is not mandatory, but is considered a plus, especially in technical areas.
Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
Organizational and time management skills.
Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities and solve problems under pressure.
Experience in project management is a must? However, a technical background is not required but is an advantage.
Familiarity with project management tools (e.g. YouTrack, Float) is an advantage.
Experienced MS Office user (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 

Why should you join CBSI Systems? 

Work on exciting projects with an international customer base.
Become part of a collaborative and innovative team that values ​​your contributions.
Enjoy flexible working hours and remote work options.
Competitive salary and benefits tailored to your experience.
Opportunities for professional development and advancement.

title: Front-End Software Developer
description:
As we are expanding, we are looking to hire an ambitious and self-driven Front-End Software Developer to work on a large-scale project related to the Fintech Industry. In this role, you’ll make a significant contribution to translating our customer or internal needs and user expectations into interactive web apps. If you love combining the art of designing with the art of programming in order to implement visual elements that users see and interact within a web application, then FXGT is a perfect place to get ahead. 
 
Job Responsibilities

Compile and analyze data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement
Clearly understand and process requirements coming from the Product team
Build web applications with web development best practices
Build effective, optimized, high-quality reusable and well-documented code related to CRM functionality, financial transactions, blockchain (advantage), API integrations with payment gateways and other third-party systems as well as database structure
Regularly communicate and collaborate with other developers, quality assurance team, UX/UI designers, and system analysts to establish objectives and design more functional, cohesive codes to enhance the user experience
Bridge the gap between graphic design and technical implementation
Work with back-end developers to integrate UI components with APIs and databases
Debug errors, troubleshoot issues, and perform routine performance optimizations
Develop automated tests to ensure business needs are met and allow for regression testing
Test the quality of the code before submitting it for QA
Stay up to date with the latest tools and libraries to benefit user experience, performance, and developer experience

Job Requirements

Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or similar field
At least 3 years of development experience
Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git
Experience on RESTful APIs
Strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools
Implement automated testing platforms and unit tests
Knowledge of any frontend JavaScript/Typescript framework such as ReactJS, VueJS, Angular
Knowledge of PHP would be considered an advantage
Team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent written and verbal skills in English
Ability to quickly learn a new programming language or development framework
Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
Attention to detail and desire to probe further into data

 
Package

Attractive remuneration package
Corporate fund scheme
Discretionary bonus based on company's and personal performance
Discount benefit card
Referral Bonus
Friday Lunch and daily snacks and beverages at the office
Yearly Training Budget – Udemy membership per department
Training opportunities for growth and personal development
Up to 25 days holidays per year
Hybrid working model 

 
Please note that due to the high volumes of applications received, only shortlisted applicants will be responded to.

title: Junior IoT Developer @ Thessaloniki
description:
What Impact will you make?
Junior IoT Developer@ Deloitte Alexander Competence Center
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki, Greece that offers you a hybrid working model?
Are you ready to work on international projects for industry-leading clients around the world and elevate your tech consulting career to an international level?
If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Alexander Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
ABOUT YOUR TEAM
Our IoT practices support our customers in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions in industrial fields and more, identifying and implementing the integration architectures that best meet the requirements and business strategies.
Through our solution architects and developers, we help our customers to create safe and reliable innovations that guarantee a real competitive advantage in the market:

Our areas of expertise offer solutions in the Smart Manufacturing, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT and IoT) and Computer Vision.
Graphical interfaces that offer a high level of usability and scalability on different devices, adhering to well-defined graphical standards.
Integration Services solutions that aimed at radically transforming operational and digital processes, making them more efficient. Nowadays, a mandatory element for the unison functioning of complex enterprise ecosystems.
Technological Architectures that allow the most modern Cloud applications to be integrated and communicated with "plug & play" systems with enterprise systems.
Micro-services implementation that allows orchestration, reuse, and high availability in order to reduce time to market and improve the user experience.

 
OUR REQUIREMENTS:
Key Qualifications

Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution (already graduated or expected to graduate within spring/autumn of 2024) in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study
Be available to work full-time with a permanent contract at DACC office in Thessaloniki, Heraklion, Patra, Ioannina
Have a good understanding of the software lifecycle and problem-solving skills
Have Strong oral and written communication skills in Greek and English
Be Proactive and have genuine enthusiasm, curiosity and #teamwork attitude 
Have Programming knowledge:

Object Oriented Programming concepts
At least one of the following programming languages:
Java (preferred), Phyton, C#, C++
Relational databases (one of: SQLite, PostgreSQL, Ms SQL Server, etc.)
Knowledge of REST API, SOAP WS, MQTT, Integration Architectures principles
Good Linux knowledge (Ubuntu and/or SUSE)
Basic networking knowledge


Bonus Qualifications

Basic Angular or other frontend technology knowledge
CVS: Version Control/Git
Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab)
Experience with AWS tools (S3, Cloudwatch, Athena, Lambda functions, Stream Manager, Greengrass)
Basic knowledge of WebSockets
Basic testing and test report preparation experience
Knowledge of SOAP WS protocol
Knowledge of MES\MOM products (Siemens Opcenter Foundation, PTC Thingworks\Kepware)
Have your Military obligations fulfilled 
Enjoy traveling and working abroad
Italian language

 
WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Individuals who have a strong will to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in consultation with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.

title: WEB DEVELOPER
description:
Professional Consulting is a provider and operator of customized software solutions. We are specialized among others in financial market information systems for reporting and analysis of financial market data. Our clients are software companies, financial service providers and media companies in Europe and the US, both for their employees and end customers. Our services include conception, design, development and operation of solutions.
We are looking for motivated and experienced java-developers for high-end applications.
Is development your passion? Are you keen on creating Java applications even in your spare time? Do you find advanced technology and new methods attractive? Can you deal with Java, SOAP&REST API and keep up with all the fast-paced improvements and innovations in modern Development? Does the continuous improvement of existing functions appeal to you? Then you are exactly what we are seeking!
Must-haves:
* Java Development (Strong proficiency in Java, at least 2-3 years experience)
* SOAP & REST API (Designing and consuming APIs)
* Database Knowledge (SQL and NoSQL databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)
* Kafka (Experience with event streaming and message queues)
* JMS (Java Message Service) (Experience with message-oriented middleware)
* Syslog (Understanding and handling of system logging)
* CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
* Unit Testing & Integration Testing (JUnit, Mockito)
* English language skills
Nice-to-haves:
* Frontend Development with VAADIN (Experience building UIs with the Vaadin framework)
* Eclipse GLSP (Graphical Language Server Platform knowledge)
* SNMP Integration (Experience with Simple Network Management Protocol)
* CORBA (Common Object Request Broker Architecture) (Experience with distributed object systems)
* Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security)
* Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure experience)
* Microservices Architecture (Designing and deploying Java-based microservices)
We offer:
* Create and innovate by using State-of-the-Art technologies
* Start-up atmosphere combined with a secured job position
* Flexible working times
* Flexible work model
* Home office
* Trainings, workshops
* Flat hierarchies
* Excellent career prospects
* Young, dynamic and independent development team
Salary:
* Competitive salary

Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
 
#YourServiceLine
Technology & Transformation​
Our Technology & Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.​
 
#AboutYourTeam
Our IoT practices support our customers in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions in industrial fields and more, identifying and implementing the integration architectures that best meet the requirements and business strategies.
Through our solution architects and developers, we help our customers to create safe and reliable innovations that guarantee a real competitive advantage in the market:

Our areas of expertise offer solutions in the Smart Manufacturing, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT and IoT) and Computer Vision.
Graphical interfaces that offer a high level of usability and scalability on different devices, adhering to well-defined graphical standards.
Integration Services solutions that aimed at radically transforming operational and digital processes, making them more efficient. Nowadays, a mandatory element for the unison functioning of complex enterprise ecosystems.

Micro-services implementation that allows orchestration, reuse, and high availability in order to reduce time to market and improve the user experience.

Key Qualifications

Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution (already graduated or expected to graduate within spring/autumn of 2024) in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study

Have Strong oral and written communication skills in Greek and English
Be Proactive and have genuine enthusiasm, curiosity and #teamwork attitude 
Have Programming knowledge:

Object Oriented Programming concepts
At least one of the following programming languages:
Java (preferred), Phyton, C#, C++
Relational databases (one of: SQLite, PostgreSQL, Ms SQL Server, etc.)
Knowledge of REST API, SOAP WS, MQTT, Integration Architectures principles
Good Linux knowledge (Ubuntu and/or SUSE)
Basic networking knowledge

Basic Angular or other frontend technology knowledge
CVS: Version Control/Git
Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab)
Experience with AWS tools (S3, Cloudwatch, Athena, Lambda functions, Stream Manager, Greengrass)
Basic knowledge of WebSockets
Basic testing and test report preparation experience
Knowledge of SOAP WS protocol
Knowledge of MES\MOM products (Siemens Opcenter Foundation, PTC Thingworks\Kepware)
Have your Military obligations fulfilled 
Enjoy traveling and working abroad
Italian language

🏃 A buddy to support you with your onboarding
⚕️ Private medical health insurance plan
💳 Ticket restaurant card
 🛍️ Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
📱 Mobile phone
🍏 Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee everyday at our offices
 
Please note that all the well-being benefits mentioned above are subject to annual review

Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit & Assurance, Tax and Legal, Strategy-Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Italy and globally. In pursuing this we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.

It’s about being the first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.

At Deloitte we foster a collaborative culture where talented individuals can produce their best work. We value difference, with respect at the heart of our inclusive culture.

From day one at our firm, practitioners are part of a community. Our development and career progression framework will help them develop the skills and capabilities to succeed. The wellness of our people and the ability to offer agile working arrangements is at the center of our unique talent experience. We create a workplace that encourages collaboration, creativity, inclusiveness to ensure our staff are supported, encouraged and feel a sense of purpose and meaning in what they do each day.

title: Sr. Associate, Software Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Enterprise Platforms & Security (EP&S) team delivers the following capabilities for Pfizer. Business application platforms supporting Pfizer's enterprise application and critical business processes. Infrastructure allowing business traffic to travel where it needs to go, internally and externally, along with the appropriate access controls. EP&S secures Pfizer's most important information assets through world class controls and protections and enables Pfizer's business results by making security an enabler and not a roadblock to achieving business results.The Developer Products and Platforms (DPP) team within Business Operations and Cybersecurity Analytics (BOCA) group owns and operates common platforms that help EP&S and its customers build, deploy, and run leading-edge products on-premises and in the cloud. These platforms are the standard for the delivery of secure, integrated, scalable, and reliable products.As a DPP software engineer you will develop next-generation technology. You will be a technical member of a team using agile development methodologies and DevOps to provide continuous delivery of solutions. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the technology stack as we continue to push technology forward. You will be responsible for delivering high quality software solutions. This role requires strong collaboration skills, the ability to work independently with a focus on high quality and a strong sense of accountability. The role also requires a strong desire for continuous learning to stay current with the rapidly evolving global technology landscape and significant attention to detail and quality
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and develop in one or more technologies (Java, C#, C++, Python).
Develop, maintain, and improve new and existing software solutions with a strong sense of accountability and attention to quality.
Perform stringent testing of code written, including designing, and writing automated tests to allow for continuous delivery.
Help the team embrace agile core values, adopt, and apply those principles, and implementation practices.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in software development.
Experience in Java, C/C++, C#, Python, JavaScript, Go, .Net.
Demonstrated ability to effectively document software designs and communicate implementation details.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Cloud-specific experience with Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform.
Familiarity and/or previous experience with Agile (e.g., Scrum) is desired.
Experience in any of the following: Unix/Linux environments, cloud platforms, machine learning, networking, systems/security software development.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr. Associate, Software Engineer with id4919718.

title: Sr. Manager, Customer Journey & Automation Engineering
description:
Role Summary
The Customer & Commercial Creation Centre (C4) team creates technology solutions for our external customers. This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites.
Within C4, the Platform DevOps team are accountable for the platforms at Pfizer that allow the creation, configuration, launch, and support of all externally facing digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & device) products, services, and experiences, servicing all external customer types at Pfizer. This includes our Marketing Technology (Martech) platform.
Our mission over the next few years is to change how customer data is managed, from fragmented implementations to a coherent customer-data ecosystem of services dedicated to the collection and management of profiles, consents and organised data. We also aim to improve the marketer experience and to improve patient outcomes through tools that enable our marketing teams to create finely tuned, intelligent and relevant audiences, messages and journeys that can be activated across any or all of our channel options.
We seek an experienced full stack engineer versed in Adobe Fusion and/or Salesforce Automation Studio to join our team as an engineering lead working in our team building CRM data integration and automation services that supply data from CDP and other sources to our campaign journey orchestration & activation services. This team also maintains several web applications that support the management and operations of our data.You will be responsible for many aspects of solution architecture and technical design for the services you work on. This includes Adobe Fusion flows, AWS infrastructure, APIs and contracts, Laravel/Vue.js web applications, test strategy, performance, reliability, security and compliance. You will be supported by contract solution architects and other experienced engineers, but the expectation is that you become the engineering authority and source of truth and experience for your services.You will work with the PO and BA to design, refine and deliver solutions that meet business requirements but also our mission of building globally scalable, secure and supportable platforms. To achieve this, you will need to weigh short term business deliverables against longer term sustainability.
Responsibilities
Core responsibility: Product & service delivery
That the team produce fit-for-purpose solutions is the ultimate measure of your success, with you working closely with product owners to discuss and understand vision, strategy and help everyone deliver tactical next steps.This involves:

Understanding the overall roadmap, context and direction of the product and key partner teams by being part of the conversations and helping guide the roadmap.
Leading the estimation and working with the PO on prioritization of requirements
Working with platform architects and Enterprise Architecture to create an appropriate solution architecture and technical design that meets the business needs and our long-term objectives.
Refining stories as part of team refinement sessions, bringing expertise to bear in defining the right solution design, acceptance criteria and testing criteria
Coordinating execution within the team as well as writing code yourself. Key languages and tools include:

Front end applications: Laravel and Vue.js
Back end: Python
Platforms: Salesforce Automation Studio (plus elements of Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud) / Adobe Experience Manager (inc. Fusion, Workfront, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics)


Ensuring the team write documentation as required,including in-line code commentary, GitHub .MD documentation and confluence SDLC documentation that describes:

The purpose of the software
The CI environment and deployment processes
Development standards and processes
Architecture, API and Design
Architectural Decision Records
How to develop the application(s) locally as a new developer on the team
Processes and checks for deployment to the cloud environments



Qualifications & Education
Key Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years' experience with increasing responsibility developing digital solutions, products, and services.
Professional certifications in software engineering fields are a bonus
Proven experience in software engineering, with a focus on roles in complex global enterprise projects
Excellent experience with Laravel, Vue.js and Python, along with Typescript, SQL and other components common to full stack delivery.
Good experience of the Adobe and/or Salesforce marketing automation platforms including key technologies like Workfront, Fusion or Automation Studio
Excellent knowledge of AWS services
Excellent experience writing automated tests (Unit, Integration, etc)
Excellent experience with API-led development.
Excellent experience with Agile team processes, including Scrum, Scrumban.
Experience with the types of process problems that come when trying to build complex, new applications and comfortable when things are uncertain and require problem solving.
Good understanding of software development methodologies and best practices for implementing principles of privacy & security 'by design'.
Understanding of the DevSecOps best practices that should be in place, driving an "Everything as Code instead of paperwork" mentality.
Excellent experience estimating complex technical stories and breaking them down
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to establish relationships, influence outcomes, and deliver effective presentations to a variety of audiences.
Strong written and spoken English

 
Additional Notes
We are looking for people with sufficient experience to do most of the job and who are open to learning new things.This is a global role, in a team whose stakeholders and resources are largely based in North America. Travel therefore may be required from time to time. Attendance at meetings in the Eastern US time zone will be required.

Sr. Manager, Customer Journey & Automation Engineering Role Summary
The Customer & Commercial Creation Centre (C4) team creates technology solutions for our external customers. This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites.
Within C4, the Platform DevOps team are accountable for the platforms at Pfizer that allow the creation, configuration, launch, and support of all externally facing digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & device) products, services, and experiences, servicing all external customer types at Pfizer. This includes our Marketing Technology (Martech) platform.
Our mission over the next few years is to change how customer data is managed, from fragmented implementations to a coherent customer-data ecosystem of services dedicated to the collection and management of profiles, consents and organised data. We also aim to improve the marketer experience and to improve patient outcomes through tools that enable our marketing teams to create finely tuned, intelligent and relevant audiences, messages and journeys that can be activated across any or all of our channel options.
We seek an experienced full stack engineer versed in Adobe Fusion and/or Salesforce Automation Studio to join our team as an engineering lead working in our team building CRM data integration and automation services that supply data from CDP and other sources to our campaign journey orchestration & activation services. This team also maintains several web applications that support the management and operations of our data.You will be responsible for many aspects of solution architecture and technical design for the services you work on. This includes Adobe Fusion flows, AWS infrastructure, APIs and contracts, Laravel/Vue.js web applications, test strategy, performance, reliability, security and compliance. You will be supported by contract solution architects and other experienced engineers, but the expectation is that you become the engineering authority and source of truth and experience for your services.You will work with the PO and BA to design, refine and deliver solutions that meet business requirements but also our mission of building globally scalable, secure and supportable platforms. To achieve this, you will need to weigh short term business deliverables against longer term sustainability.
Responsibilities
Core responsibility: Product & service delivery
That the team produce fit-for-purpose solutions is the ultimate measure of your success, with you working closely with product owners to discuss and understand vision, strategy and help everyone deliver tactical next steps.This involves:

Understanding the overall roadmap, context and direction of the product and key partner teams by being part of the conversations and helping guide the roadmap.
Leading the estimation and working with the PO on prioritization of requirements
Working with platform architects and Enterprise Architecture to create an appropriate solution architecture and technical design that meets the business needs and our long-term objectives.
Refining stories as part of team refinement sessions, bringing expertise to bear in defining the right solution design, acceptance criteria and testing criteria
Coordinating execution within the team as well as writing code yourself. Key languages and tools include:

Front end applications: Laravel and Vue.js
Back end: Python
Platforms: Salesforce Automation Studio (plus elements of Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud) / Adobe Experience Manager (inc. Fusion, Workfront, Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics)


Ensuring the team write documentation as required,including in-line code commentary, GitHub .MD documentation and confluence SDLC documentation that describes:

The purpose of the software
The CI environment and deployment processes
Development standards and processes
Architecture, API and Design
Architectural Decision Records
How to develop the application(s) locally as a new developer on the team
Processes and checks for deployment to the cloud environments



Qualifications & Education
Key Qualifications

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years' experience with increasing responsibility developing digital solutions, products, and services.
Professional certifications in software engineering fields are a bonus
Proven experience in software engineering, with a focus on roles in complex global enterprise projects
Excellent experience with Laravel, Vue.js and Python, along with Typescript, SQL and other components common to full stack delivery.
Good experience of the Adobe and/or Salesforce marketing automation platforms including key technologies like Workfront, Fusion or Automation Studio
Excellent knowledge of AWS services
Excellent experience writing automated tests (Unit, Integration, etc)
Excellent experience with API-led development.
Excellent experience with Agile team processes, including Scrum, Scrumban.
Experience with the types of process problems that come when trying to build complex, new applications and comfortable when things are uncertain and require problem solving.
Good understanding of software development methodologies and best practices for implementing principles of privacy & security 'by design'.
Understanding of the DevSecOps best practices that should be in place, driving an "Everything as Code instead of paperwork" mentality.
Excellent experience estimating complex technical stories and breaking them down
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to establish relationships, influence outcomes, and deliver effective presentations to a variety of audiences.
Strong written and spoken English

 
Additional Notes
We are looking for people with sufficient experience to do most of the job and who are open to learning new things.This is a global role, in a team whose stakeholders and resources are largely based in North America. Travel therefore may be required from time to time. Attendance at meetings in the Eastern US time zone will be required.

Experienced Vue 3/TypeScript Front-End Developer

We are a rapidly growing company in the online assessment market, offering cutting-edge solutions for education. Our platform provides secure, scalable, and user-friendly online assessments, used by thousands globally. We’re seeking an experienced Vue 3 Developer with a strong background in TypeScript to join our team and enhance our front-end application.

Respect and Collaboration: We believe the best results come from an environment where everyone feels comfortable contributing.• Growth and Stability: We are looking for team members who want to grow with us over the long term and contribute to our success.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!
Please send us your CV at: hrgreece@burlingtonbooks.com

title: Software Developer & Engineering Experienced Consultant
description:
Finvent, since 2001, a successful regional provider of award-winning software and services for the investment management industry and the exclusive distributor and professional services partner of SS&C Advent Software.
Our clients span across 15+ countries and include asset managers, wealth managers, Pension Funds, hedge funds, family offices, fund managers, and fund administrators. Our solutions streamline their processes for portfolio management, trading and order management, risk management & compliance, portfolio accounting, fund distribution, remote client services, performance analytics, reporting and more.
 
Description 
We are seeking a talented and service-minded person to join our team as a Software Developer & Engineering Experienced Consultant, Investment & Risk Management Software Unit.
In this role, you will help our clients across Europe, Middle East and Africa by implementing and advising on technology solutions to streamline their processes, for increased efficiencies and reduced operational risk.
This is a unique opportunity to blend strong development expertise with financial industry knowledge & skills, in a vibrant, international work environment. You get to tap into the knowledge of leading financial institutions as well as our experienced team, to learn and develop skills that will ultimately help you progress your career and grow a solid network within the fintech industry.
Responsibilities

Design, develop, and test software along with the rest of the agile team while ensuring stakeholders remain satisfied with the results.
Ensure that the team remains laser focused on delivering value to the market and not just code.
You’re expected to be curious about new technology and driven to develop the best possible solution with the tools available.
Provide custom engineering services for clients across EMEA and APAC regions, covering modification and development of software specified by the services organization.
Create technical documentation for custom engineering items.
Manage project deliverables of custom solutions, for quality and on-time completion in implementation projects.

Qualifications & Skills
Ø Several years’ .NET experience and C# developing.
Ø Good SQL server skills (T-SQL, ADO .NET, database tools, etc.) with a drive to optimize and automate
Ø Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) is a plus.
Ø Relevant University Degree Education in computer science or other relevant technical degree
Ø Highly positive if knowledgeable with JavaScript/UI frameworks and full-stack development skills.
Ø Familiarity with agile development methodologies and familiar with test driven development.
Ø Very good communication skills in English and Greek is required. Communication skills in additional European languages skills are very desirable.
Ø A Holder of a European passport or EU Working Visa is required
Ø Knowledge of the financial industry and fintech is a plus but not required
 
Benefits
On top of challenging work and a competitive salary, hybrid model position, we are offering:
• Competitive salary and bonus payment plans
• Private health & medical insurance plan
• International product certification and continuous training programs
• International travel and global professional experience as well as working flexibility
• Become part of a mission-driven team which constantly learns and improves
• Be part of a socially responsible entity and with a group of like-minded people
Your race, age, ethnicity or disability, gender identity and expression make no difference to Finvent. We want to attract, develop, promote and retain the best people based only on their abilities and professional behavior.

Content creation

Fluency in English

Previous experience in ERP development
Experience in PHP and Laravel

Figma
.NET C#

Knowledge of SQL (SQL Server 2016) and T-SQL

Previous work experience in an Insurance Company

Master's degree in Information Technology or Business Administration
Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services and/or SQL Server Analysis Services
Using DevExpress tools
Relevant professional certifications in related technologies

We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and skills.
Complete set of group health insurance benefits.

title: Content Manager (CMS)
description: Who we areEtraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe. We hold consumer online travel agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate & Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights, TUI, etc.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 2400 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Canada, Greece, India, Poland.With the Greek office being one of the largest, hosting around 580 employees working from the center of Athens for the rest of the world.Join us and start as Content Manager (CMS) in the Customer Experience within Customer Services!Position SummaryWe are looking for a Content Manager to join our Localization & Content team and help us manage our brand-new CMS.In this position, you will directly report to Localization & Content Lead, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and be an expert in our Content Management (CMS), creating user guides, conducting trainings, as well as collaborating with developers and internal IT employees to ensure the system is set to match the organization's goals. You'll also keep everything up-to-date and accurate.If you are super organized, love content creation and new technologies (such as CHATGPT), and have a tracking notebook for everything, you are some steps closer to getting this position!The Localization & Content team is part of the Customer Experience department and owns customers’ Digital Communication channels and Branding. By streamlining the processes for our websites, app, and digital campaigns, we focus on incrementality through local and effective content experience for Etraveli Group’s millions of customers. The position will be based at our Athens office.Responsibilities: Manage our business CMS, working with developers and editors to ensure it meets your organization's demands Manage the content team members and run content audits to detect inconsistencies and redundancies in our sites Develop and implement content schedules for people to produce or update materials in the different channels we operate Create site maps, visualizations, or wireframes to help peers understand the structure and function of the site Organize the structure of the CMS such as folders, templates, images, etc Manage and edit web copy in different languages provided by our copywriters and translation agency Being the SPOC (single point of contact) for different stakeholders negotiating deliverables, deadlines, and policies Provide business requirements to the software development team in order to develop relevant automation Stakeholdership towards product and IT for development Requirements 3+ years of experience in a similar role using CMS and multi-channel communication in a marketing or communications field Familiarity with data-driven communication flows and digital mapping platforms SEO knowledge/keyword researchFluency in English. Any additional language will be considered an asset. Excellent communication skills & ability to build relationshipsOrganized, with the ability to work on multiple projects at once and strategic, prioritize things and able to oversee large projects and coordinate the work of othersGood writer and editor, with good spelling and grammar and the ability to adapt to our brandsUnderstanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Digital Asset Management (DAM) and other web technologies is a plus but not requiredNice to be Ready to talk to different people across the organization The person who always asks why things are the way they are and how about improving them Self-driven with strong organizational skills and the ability to take initiatives Analytical and detail-oriented skills using Excel, Google Analytics, and others BenefitsBenefitsWe are looking for people who would make the world smaller for travelers but want a bigger world of opportunities for themselves. With us you can enjoy:  Health Benefits - Through partners, we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need.  Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece.  Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility! #LI-Hybrid Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Ambelokipi Metro station.  Team activities - We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space!  Fun & Work - We have a relaxed work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast, beverages & fruits, playing ping pong or video games. *If interested, please send your CV in English*Diversity disclaimer: At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Senior Associate, Web & Social Channel Management
description:
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs: Within C4, the Patient and Marketplace Corp. Affairs team is accountable for delivering patient-facing digital companions and external marketplace solutions to increase customer value and simplify specialty pharma services to ensure patients can acquire Pfizer breakthroughs.​The U.S. Channels and Global Web Experience team directly owns and operates Pfizer.com, the operation of our primary U.S. corporate social channels. The team balances the needs of Pfizer's audiences with what Pfizer wishes to communicate, maximizing the effectiveness of both. The team works closely with the peer Content team to ensure the execution of their editorial strategies across all channels, as well with the various content owners throughout the company that contribute material to Pfizer.com.The Channel Management Sr. Associate will be working with fellow team members to ensure the smooth operation of Pfizer's corporate web and social channels.The Channel Management Sr. Associate reports to the head of the Corporate Channels team within the Digital function at Pfizer. Day-to-day, the senior associate takes direction from the Senior Manager, Channel Management to help prioritize and balance team tasks overall. They will also work closely with and receive guidance from the manager-level members of the channel management team who serve as the primary contacts for these channels.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage hundreds of change requests annually for Pfizer.com, arriving through multiple avenues. Requires the ability to evaluate requests and provide direction on standardized/modular design and UI/UX best practices. This role will include monitoring email requests, assisting customers in the entry of content in web-based content management systems, independently troubleshooting customer access difficulties and correction of difficult coding issues, logging of all requests into our Zendesk tracking system, updating and maintenance of other forms of work reporting and tracking.
Must be able to leverage front-end and back-end web knowledgeand experience to make recommendations that affect/enhance functional and user experience challenges on our corporate and global websites.
Actively seek out opportunities to standardize and modularize common Drupal components, leveraging their expert current front-end and back-end experience to make educated recommendations. This includes the ability to prototype recommendations when applicable.
Must be independently able to leverage strong use of image editing tools (i.e. Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator) to perform advanced image manipulation, color-correction, cropping and resizing while strictly adhering to best-in-class compression standards for Drupal/Pfizer.com.
Support colleagues in Corporate Affairs by executing time-sensitive organic posts to Pfizer's various social platforms and channels. These include X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. Responsibilities also include:

Utilization of the Sprinklr platform to manage/schedule posts and other related content
Assist the Data Analytics team, as an administrator, to ensure tags are correct for metrics and reporting purposes
Proofreading of manuscript and social copy to look for inaccuracies, punctuation errors prior to pushing live
Image manipulation to support all various social platform requirements
Troubleshoot/diagnose/resolve any errors/issues related to social platforms/channels (including Sprinklr and Newscred/Welcome).







BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
3+ years or relevant working experience.
Experience as an individual contributor/practitioner.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug and optimize simple/medium complexity applications.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, engaging, and user-friendly experiences.
Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management practices.
Expert front-end Drupal CMS (content management, structure, navigation) development and solid understanding of interdisciplinary skills in graphic design, information architecture, search engine optimization, accessibility and mobile responsiveness.
Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex ideas to colleagues and external audiences.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, XML and JavaScript as well as other core languages required in the context of Drupal development
Ability to troubleshoot problems and work well under tight timelines
Knowledge and experience with social media and digital communications
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-based environment and with multiple internal and external stakeholders; influence/negotiation skills and relationship management capabilities a must.
Strong communication planning, execution and process management skills
Strong interpersonal skills to quickly build rapport and credibility with Pfizer internal and external stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Strong use of Photoshop and Abode Illustrator with a focus on advanced compression techniques for web applications.
Any relevant degrees towards these qualifications is preferred, though aptitude in the skills is prioritized.

TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Candidate will be expected to travel globally to Pfizer locations as needed.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Web & Social Channel Management with id 4918591.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Join INTRALOT as a Senior Software Engineer 

Your Role: As a Senior Software Engineer at INTRALOT, you'll lead the charge in crafting exceptional digital experiences. You'll be at the heart of our development efforts, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver robust solutions.

Your Responsibilities:

 Spearhead the development life cycle, from concept to deployment, focusing on coding excellence and rigorous testing.
 Architect scalable solutions to accommodate fluctuating user demands and evolving business requirements.
 Mentor and collaborate with a talented team of developers, sharing your expertise and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
 Champion best practices in coding, testing, and deployment, driving innovation and efficiency.
 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with strategic objectives and technical standards.

Your Qualifications:

 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
 5+ years of hands-on experience in Software Development, with a strong emphasis on web applications.
 Expertise in Javascript (ES6+), React.JS, Redux, and Node.js, with a proven track record of delivering complex projects.
 Deep understanding of relational databases and proficiency in SQL.
 Strong grasp of RESTful APIs and modern web development principles.
 Proficiency in version control systems, particularly Git.
 Excellent communication skills, with fluency in both Greek and English.


About Us: INTRALOT, a publicly listed company established in 1992, is a leading gaming solutions supplier and operator active in 39 regulated jurisdictions worldwide. With a global workforce of approximately 1,700 employees, INTRALOT is committed to redefine innovation and quality of services in the lottery and gaming sector, while supporting operators in raising funds for good causes. In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.

INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.


Why Join Us:
 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family. 
 Modern facilities, parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus.
 An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment.
 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally. 

 Equal Opportunity Employer: We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other protected status. Our premises in Paiania, Attica, are accessible to individuals with disabilities.

teamsReview software architecture and design documentation to determine security threats, risks, and develop test-cases for manual security testing assessmentsParticipate and contribute to application security training activities and workshopsGive presentations on technical security topics towards internal development teams Support the implementation, configuration, and continuous tuning of Security domainAbility to understand workflows written in programming languages such as Java, C#, JavaScript and/or PythonExperience with OWASP Top 10 risks and CWE Top 25 vulnerabilities and compensation & benefits packageHealth and life insurance programMeal and commuting allowanceWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods title: IT SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR
description:
The British School at Athens (BSA) is seeking an energetic, personable and technically versatile IT Systems Administrator.  The ideal candidate is someone who values Greek cultural heritage and wants to play a key role in helping the BSA continue to investigate and celebrate it.
The IT System Administrator is the front-line support to the BSA’s academic and administrative staff.  These staff look to the IT System Administrator to ensure they have the tools to do their work.  In this role you will work with innovative researchers – archaeologists, historians, cultural heritage scientists, as they develop new web applications that support research, education and public outreach. The job includes some evening and weekend commitments in support of the BSA’s active schedule of seminars and lectures. 
In return for being a people-focused, flexible and adaptive IT professional, the BSA offers a competitive salary, excellent benefits, and a work environment focused on cooperation and mutual support.  For the right candidate, the BSA is willing to offer extensive on-the-job training in order to ensure the IT System Administrator succeeds in their post.
The annual gross salary will be up to €30,000, plus private health insurance.
Duties:

Help desk for desktop computing, including ticket management and escalation to offsite engineers.
Administration of Active Directory and Google Workspace user accounts
Support of staff computers (laptops, desktops in Windows OS)
Manage print services and offsite printer hardware maintenance
Support of computers attached to research instruments (Windows OS)
Support of library catalog terminals (Ubuntu desktops)
Support of School IT facilities for seminars and conferences
Design and maintenance of the BSA websites (WordPress, PHP)
Installation and integration of Digital Humanities tools in support of BSA research and information sharing activities. Website development (LAMP, CSS, SASS, Javascript, Python).
Provide GIS services and map making for BSA publications and websites
Accounting of software licensing and physical equipment

Required Skills:

Friendly, outgoing personality with great interpersonal skills.
Good working knowledge of Windows 10/11 desktop management.
Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V, WSUS, and Ubuntu.  
Experience and interest in development of web applications: PHP, JavaScript; CSS, SASS, HTML; configuration of web servers (LAMP).
Experience and interest in database administration, MySQL, Postgres/PostGIS.
Familiarity with Web CMS: WordPress.
Familiarity with Python coding to process BSA data for external and internal sharing.
Knowledge of and interest in GIS, GIS webmap servers.

The position (f/t) is available 21 October or a soon as possible thereafter. A probationary period will apply. Residence in Athens (Greece) is a requirement and a working knowledge of Modern Greek is desired.
Further details are available at: http://www.bsa.ac.uk. Informal enquiries about the post may be addressed to Dr Nathan Meyer  (itofficer@bsa.ac.uk).
Application:
Applications should be sent by email as a signed pdf attachment to the School Administrator, Mrs Tania Gerousi (school.administrator@bsa.ac.uk) by Monday 30 September 2024.
Applicants should supply the following:-

A covering letter (of no more than two pages), giving the applicant’s contact details, outlining the reasons for applying, giving details of supporting enclosures, and summarising the applicant’s principal qualifications for the job;
A curriculum vitae, giving details of past employment, academic and other qualifications, IT skills, academic research interests, and other relevant experience;
The names, addresses, telephone numbers and email addresses of two referees, whom the candidate has contacted in advance and who have agreed to supply letters of reference sent directly to administrator@bsa.ac.uk by 30 September 2024. 

Equality of opportunity is BSA policy.
The closing date for applications is Monday 30 September 2024. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed during the week of 7 October, either at the BSA in Athens, or by teleconferencing, depending on circumstances.

· ASP .NET CORE MVC

· Experience in DevExtreme and DevExpress components
· Proven knowledge of C#, LINQ, Javascript, JQuery, SQL

· Implementation of MVC architectural pattern
· Knowledge of conversion of SQL Server Queries to LINQ
· LINQ Query Optimization

title: Web Developer
description:
We are seeking a talented Web Developer to join our team and play a key role in creating and customizing web applications within the Pimcore CMS platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining our website, ensuring it is updated, optimized, and user-friendly on all devices and browsers. Familiarity with UX/UI design principles along with Responsive Design and the ability to produce user flows and mock-ups from wire-frame concept to completion, are highly desirable. Knowledge of creating web animations using Lottie or other JavaScript libraries is considered a plus.
Responsibilities:

Develop and customize web applications (creation of new web pages, input forms, integration with Hubspot etc.) within the Pimcore CMS platform.
Maintain web application in cooperation with the devops team, expand, scale, and update the website to ensure daily optimal performance and user experience. Implement technical SEO best practices according to business goals.
Support in content updates/uploads.
Collaborate with the design team to implement UX/UI designs effectively.
Implement web animations to enhance user engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in front-end development.

Skills Required:

4+ years proven experience.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
Familiarity with Symfony PHP framework and Twig templating engine used in Pimcore CMS or similar Content Management Systems.
Creating and/or integrating modules, plugins, input forms and APIs.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate and work in a team.

Nice to have:

Strong understanding of UX/UI design & Responsive Design principles for mobile friendly solutions.
Ability to create user flows and mock-ups from wire-frame concept to final implementation.
Usage of Adobe CC suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD etc.), or Figma.
Knowledge of web animation libraries like jQuery and Lottie.

Educational Requirement:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field.
Relevant certifications or additional training in front-end development are a plus.
English fluency, as we are an English-speaking company.

Join our dynamic marketing team and contribute to creating exceptional web experiences for our users! Apply now to be part of our innovative projects and collaborative work environment.

title: SERVICE NOW IMPLEMENTATION SPECIALIST (Fixed Term Contract)
description:
Key Accountabilities:

Project Management:

Effectively manage timelines and deliverables to ensure successful project completion
Communicate status, risks, and issues to stakeholders and senior management

Requirements Gathering and Analysis:

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable ServiceNow configurations as well identifying potential improvements and enhancements to existing processes and workflows

ServiceNow Implementation / Configuration / Development:

Design, develop, and implement business requirements using ServiceNow modules of IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and HR Service Delivery (HRSD)
Configure ServiceNow applications based to automate workflows and improve corporate processes efficiency based on business requirements, including workflows, forms, and scripts
Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise systems using APIs, web services, and other technologies
Create and maintain complex scripts, business rules, UI policies, and client scripts to tailor the ServiceNow platform to meet organizational needs

Testing / QA:

Perform unit testing of configured modules and customizations to ensure functionality and performance meets business requirements
Document test cases and assist stakeholders on UAT

Training and Documentation:

Execute training sessions to ensure effective use of the ServiceNow platform
Maintain proper documentation, including configuration guides, user manuals, and technical specifications

Support and Maintenance:

Provide ongoing support to internal application users of the ServiceNow platform including troubleshooting of issues as well as implementation of minor enhancements
Monitor system performance by conducting frequent health checks





Qualifications and Experience



Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other related field
Previous experience in ServiceNow implementation and administration is desirable
Deep knowledge of ServiceNow modules ITSM, SPM, HRSD is required
Strong knowledge of ITIL best practices is highly desirable
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is required; additional Implementation Specialist Certifications (e.g., ITSM, SPM, HRSD) are highly desirable
Experience with JavaScript, HTML or other scripting languages is considered a plus
Hands-on experience with web services, APIs, and integration methods is highly desirable
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills


About the benefits


Our Company provides a dynamic working environment, in which cooperation and continuous learning are encouraged and career development relates to performance.In addition, Elval offers its employees a competitive remuneration package and a wide range of benefits.
