title: React Developer
description:
ICAP Executive Search & Selection is one of the premium consultancies and part of ICAP People & Employment Solutions, the largest HR Services Provider in Greece and Cyprus. With more than 50 years of experience, we specialize in assessing and recruiting Senior to Middle Level Executives across all sectors.ICAP Executive Search & Selection on behalf of its client, a Leading Multinational IT Consulting Company, is seeking for a React Developer, to join their highly qualified software development team.
React Developer (5341/RDE/ESS/GR)
Location: AthensJob Overview:As a React Developer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining responsive, user-friendly web applications. Working closely with product owners, designers, and other developers, you will play a key role in the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment, in a hybrid work environment combining remote and in-office collaboration.Responsibilities:

Design and implement high-performance, responsive user interface components using React.js and related technologies.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, and deployment.
Ensure best practices in code quality, optimization, and reusability, including conducting code reviews and supporting continuous improvement.
Work closely with product owners and designers to finalize user experiences and user interfaces, ensuring seamless and intuitive designs.
Take ownership of product features, writing technical documentation, and guiding less experienced developers as needed.
Contribute to task estimation and sprint planning, while ensuring timely and high-quality feature delivery in an agile team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience in developing with React.js and building complex front-end applications.
Strong expertise in JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
Familiarity with single-page application (SPA) design patterns and best practices.
Solid knowledge of state management solutions like Redux or React’s Context API.
Experience with Git for version control and collaborative development.
Knowledge of RESTful APIs and experience in designing and integrating front-end applications with back-end services.
Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, or Jasmine is a plus.
Understanding of user interface design principles.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team and guide junior developers where necessary.
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with a passion for delivering high-quality products.

title: Associate, Solutions Delivery
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Digital Revenue Management (RM) Creation Center team manages technology strategy and delivery for the US Market Access (USMA) Operations Business within the Global Access & Value (GAV) organization. Pharmaceutical pricing is at the forefront of the U.S. national discussion for healthcare costs. The RM Creation team plays a critical role in ensuring patients have access to breakthrough medicines through efficient channels at affordable pricing.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Work as developer for developing and delivering reports that inform business decision making following Solutions Delivery Life Cycle or Agile.
Work as developer for developing and delivering system enhancements according to business requirements following Solutions Delivery Life Cycle or Agile.
Responsible for requirements documentation, business analysis and solution documentation.
Responsible for coordinating the deployment process with various Pfizer Digital teams.
Must be able to multi-task and perform a wide variety of tasks simultaneously such as organize presentations for upper management, perform system testing, and organize meetings.
Work with peers to manage project delivery through the system development lifecycle (SDLC) and through Agile Delivery.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a Computer Science or Computer Engineering field.
1-2 years of experience as developer.
Ambition to learn and utilize emerging technologies while working in a stimulating team environment.
Development skills in Oracle, PL/SQL, SQL, Snowflake, Informatica IICS, Business Objects, Tableau, AWS, Unix Scripting.
Willingness to take risks without fear of making mistakes.
Understanding of solutions delivery and delivery methodologies including Waterfall and Agile.
Strong organization and critical thinking skills.
Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Some knowledge of Javascript, Microsoft platform such as .NET, C#.
Knowledge of database, storage, hosting, cloud, application, analytics and services technologies.
Some knowledge in React.js/Node.js
Enthusiasm in building relationships with both business partners and Digital technical teams.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Associate, Solutions Delivery with id 4921885.

title: Experienced Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Job Title:
Experienced Quality Assurance Specialist
 
Company Overview:
We are a rapidly company operating in the online assessment market, providing innovative solutions for education, recruitment, and corporate training. Our platform delivers secure, scalable, and user-friendly online assessments used by thousands globally.
 
Job Description:
We’re looking for an experienced QA specialist to join our team. If you enjoy working on a modern web stack, collaborating with others, and want to stay with a company long-term, we’d love to talk to you.
 
What You’ll Be Working With:
You will work with and are expected to have experience in the following technologies and skills:• Basic understanding of software development processes, including the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).• Familiarity with testing methodologies: Manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, etc.• Experience with test management tools: Bug tracking and test case management systems.• Understanding of version control systems: Experience with tools like Git for managing code versions.• Basic knowledge of API requests and responses.• Knowledge of Chrome DevTools: Inspecting elements, monitoring network activity, debugging JavaScript, and analyzing front-end issues.
 
Who We’re Looking For:
We are looking for someone who meets the following requirements:• Strong English communication skills (both written and spoken) to communicate daily via Slack and Zoom

Attention to detail: Ability to detect subtle issues in software functionality or user interfaces.• Analytical mindset: Approaching issues logically and breaking down complex problems.• Critical thinking: Questioning how a feature should work and challenging assumptions.• Effective communication: Ability to clearly document bugs, test cases, and communicate findings with the development and product teams.• Team collaboration: Comfort working closely with developers, product managers, and other QA engineers.• Adaptability: Willingness to work in fast-paced environments, learning new tools and techniques as needed.• Time management: Self-organization, prioritizing tasks, and managing time effectively.

Experience:

At least 3 year of QA experience: Hands-on experience testing software in various environments.• Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies: Understanding of working in Agile environments, attending daily standups.• Experience writing test cases: Designing, writing, and executing test cases based on functional requirements and specifications.• Bug reporting: Experience identifying and logging bugs, providing clear steps to reproduce, and suggesting possible solutions or fixes.

 
What We Care About:

Respect and Collaboration: We believe the best results come from an environment where everyone feels comfortable contributing.• Growth and Stability: We are looking for team members who want to grow with us over the long term and contribute to our success.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!
Please send us your CV at: hrgreece@burlingtonbooks.com

title: Computer Science or Science Graduate - Python Developer with AI knowledge
description:
Project assignment to one (1) Graduate of Informatics or Positive Sciences with knowledge of Python programming and artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms, from the Hellenic Center for Marine Research (EL.KE.TH.E.), for the needs of the European research program "ObsSea4Clim »

The duties of the candidate for the position concern: a) the collection, processing and analysis of oceanographic data collected from the recording platforms in the European seas b) the further upgrading and development of the quality controls (QC) of the data for their use in the needs of the program , c) application of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and techniques to identify and quantify uncertainties in individual EOV/ECV (Essential Ocean Variables / Essential Climatic Variables).
Required formal qualifications:

University/TEI Informatics or University of Applied Sciences degree
At least one year of specialized experience in software development technologies with Python programming language
Good command of the English language.

Candidates who do not meet one of the required formal qualifications are excluded from the evaluation ranking.
Additional Desired Qualifications:

Master's degree in Informatics.
Experience in managing database systems (such as PostgreSQL).
Experience developing applications with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Experience developing web applications with Python Django or Drupal

The contract will have a duration of 6 months, with the possibility of extension until the end of the program.
Those interested can submit their application online no later than 18/10/2024.  Detailed description of the position as well as information on how to submit the nomination file and submit the application here.

- Creating visually appealing and responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, or JavaScript
- Collaborating with UX/UI designers to implement design concepts
- Ensuring cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness
- Optimizing website performance for speed and efficiency
- Debugging and troubleshooting web issues
- Keeping up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Ensuring website accessibility for all users
- Testing and validating web forms and interactive elements
- Collaborating with back-end developers to integrate front-end and back-end systems

- Proficiency in HTML, CSS, or JavaScript
- Knowledge of responsive web design principles
- Familiarity with front-end frameworks, like Vue.js
- Experience with version control systems, such as Git
- Understanding of web performance optimization techniques
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team
- Knowledge of web accessibility standards
- Excellent communication skills
- A continuous learning mindset to stay up-to-date with evolving web technologies
Interested parties are invited to submit their application to have the opportunity to work in a pleasant and supportive environment, in a steadily growing company in the hotel industry.
All submitted applications and information will be examined under conditions of absolute confidentiality and in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Higher Education Engineers (HEI/ATEI) Electricians, Mechanical Engineers, Chemists, Production & Management, Electronics, Automation Engineers and, 
Electricians & Practical Engineers, for the staffing of the Technical department and the Production departments.
Graduates of Informatics Schools for the staffing of the Group's IT department.

Position Description:
The main responsibilities concern the support of each team. These include the control and supervision of systems operation, solving basic problems and meeting needs.
Additionally for IT Graduates:

User support (Helpdesk support).
Solving hardware and software problems on workstations & servers.
Support and maintenance of internal applications and systems.
Develop and maintain code to automate tasks or improve processes.
Installation, configuration and maintenance of computer systems, applications and devices.

Necessary qualifications:

AEI-TEI degree (or foreign equivalent) in the relevant field
Planning and task organization skills
Ability to work effectively in a pressure environment

Additionally for IT Graduates:

Degree in Computer Science or related field.
Basic knowledge about servers, virtualization & networking.
Knowledge of at least one programming language (eg Python, Java).
Familiarity with Windows/Windows Server operating systems.
Excellent knowledge of Greek & English (written and spoken).

Desired qualifications:

Work experience in a similar position
Good knowledge of English and PC (MS Office)

Additionally for IT Graduates:

Previous experience in a similar position.
Experience in SAP ERP (or other ERP).
Active Directory & Microsoft 365 management experience.
IT certifications.

The company offers:

Excellent working climate
Salary package commensurate with qualifications
Continuous development of organizational structures
Special staff training - training - guidance program
Experience in a dynamically growing multinational company.

Attach your CV to the link: https://jobs.hellenicdairies.com/cvform/create

title: Machine Learning Specialist
description: On behalf of our client, ELPEDISON, we are looking to recruit a Machine Learning Specialist.This role offers a direct contractual association with Elpedison, ensuring that you become an integral part of our client's payroll and contribute your skills to their esteemed organization. Please be aware that our role is exclusively focused on overseeing the recruitment process.The companyElpedison is the first independent energy utility in Greece, and a leader in providing outstanding and innovative energy solutions. We operate with enthusiasm in what we do and we pride ourselves of offering our employees a place where they can excel, creating value. Now we are offering a set of exciting positions in our headquarters in Athens, to incite our new digital transformation program. If you are skilled in data management, data science, advanced analytics, technology project management, or related fields, this can be a big opportunity for YOUR career.Responsibilities Leverages machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies to develop data-driven solutions. Identifies potential use cases and collaborates with business stakeholders to mature the use of AI/ML within their respective organizations. Designs and develops machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence software to automate business tasks and provide predictive models. Builds and maintains an inventory of current and potential future AI/ML use cases to improve awareness and understanding of AI/ML potential value. Provides high-level AI/ML subject matter expertise to inform strategic decisions and project planning. Designs and develops ML algorithms and AI software to automate business tasks and provide predictive models, and integrates them into software systems. Transforms data science prototypes and applies appropriate ML algorithms and tools. Solves complex problems with multi-layered data sets, and optimizes existing machine learning libraries and frameworks. Monitors machine learning models in production to ensure they continue to perform effectively and generate accurate user recommendations. Performs statistical analysis and fine-tuning using test results to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of AI/ML models. Turns unstructured data into useful information by leveraging modern technologies and communicates effectively with technical and non-technical. stakeholders in order to interpret the results for further usage. Requirements BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or relevant field MSc will be considered a strong asset. Minimum 3-5 years of relevant working experience in Machine Learning, Data Science or relevant analytics role. Prior experience in the energy sector will be considered an asset.  Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python, or Java. Experience in developing and deploying ML models in a production environment. Proven experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions.  Familiarity with cloud concepts and platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including services like Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, and Azure Data Lake Storage. Strong understanding of statistical and mathematical concepts relevant to machine learning. Ability to work with large and complex datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Excellent command of the English language, both written and oral. Ability to work independently and in a team environment with a result driven mindset. Commitment to continuous learning and stay up to date with the latest trends in the field. Strong business acumen and ability to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.     Strong organizational and time-management skills. Benefits Competitive salary Performance-based variable pay Ticket restaurant card Private Health Insurance coverage Pension Scheme Home electricity discount Continuous learning & upskilling opportunities and access to our online training platform Flexible work from home options available #LI-Hybrid

 Experience in Python, C/C++.

in database administration.

An automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mindset
You have excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken

description: Company DescriptionWe are Netcompany-Intrasoft, a member of Netcompany Group A/S, and a leading European IT Solutions and Services company with strong international presence and expertise, dedicated to responsible digitalisation. We offer innovative and added-value solutions of the highest quality to a wide range of public and private organizations, while being a key-player in the EU Institutions for the past 30 years. We hold an outstanding record of 500+ organizations in 70+ countries, that have chosen our solutions and services, to fulfil their business needs. Our team of 3500+ professionals is our driving force and our most valuable asset.Job DescriptionEver wondered what it feels like to be a Data Scientist in Netcompany-Intrasoft?Joining us as a Data Scientist, you will be a skilled and motivated professional with strong experience in traditional machine learning techniques. The ideal candidate will also possess foundational knowledge of generative AI (GenAI) and be able to assess and decide when to apply traditional machine learning methods versus leveraging GenAI.As a Data Scientist you will:Develop, implement, and maintain predictive models (e.g., regression, classification), and unsupervised techniques (e.g., clustering).Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.Evaluate and select appropriate traditional ML algorithms and techniques for various projects.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions.Communicate insights and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through reports, visualizations, and presentations.Continuously monitor model performance and refine algorithms to improve accuracy and efficiency.Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in machine learning and GenAI.QualificationsWhat would make you a fit for the role:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.2+ years (mid) or 5+ years (senior) of experience in data science, with a focus on traditional Machine LearningStrong programming skills in Python and/or RProficiency with machine learning libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoostExperience with data preprocessing and manipulation using tools such as Pandas and NumPyFamiliarity with GenAI concepts and techniques, including embeddings.Ability to assess when to use traditional ML versus GenAI approaches.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.Additional InformationBeing a part of the Netcompany-Ιntrasoft team, you will be provided with: The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working modelA seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first stepsA competitive compensation & benefits packageHealth and life insurance programMeal and commuting allowanceWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)A personalized development plan for targeted career growthIf you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!Our cultureOur people are the most important element of our success. Our work life is well defined by our set of fundamental Values: https://netcompany.com/careers/greece/our-values/ #BePartOfSomethingGreat!Please submit your CV in English. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany-Intrasoft culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our our everyday working experience.

title: Security Engineer
description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals!
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We'll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams
Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world.The opportunityCyber Security is one of the most important risks for today's businesses. Our clients are overwhelmingly turning to EY for help and guidance on how to protect their assets, minimize business disruption and improve security as they continue to exploit technology and the Internet of things (IoT). As part of our cyber security engineering team, you will be providing advisory and technical execution support to help our clients improve their cyber security posture and respond to cyber threats. You will provide security domain expertise and utilize your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build and deploy security solutions and services.Your Key Responsibilities
Handles the architecture design and assessment of security solutions and services for complex projects to completion. This includes production support and documentation for client's On-Premises, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments including Multi-Cloud.
Undertakes implementation, configuration and operationalization activities of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.
Handles project management and operational needs.

To qualify for the role you must have:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Information Security experience in an engineering function.
Technical proficiency in at least one cloud service provider such as: Azure, Google and/or AWS Cloud services.
Experience in implementing and operating various security solutions (on-premise, cloud, hybrid).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to document processes, procedures, and security designs clearly and accurately for distribution to internal teams and customers.
Demonstrated experience in dealing with external vendors and suppliers.

Ideally, you will also have:
Involved in large-scale, global IT deployments implementing complex security solutions and services or application and data estate cloud migrations
Hands-on knowledge of security-related products and technologies (e.g. Network/Endpoint/Cloud Security, SASE, DLP, IAM, SIEM/SOAR etc.) 
Experience with Microsoft Azure security tools such as: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Firewall, Azure WAF, Azure Policies, Microsoft Entra ID, KQL and/or 
Experience with Microsoft 365 security tools such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender XDR (Defender for Endpoints, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps) and Microsoft Intune.
Microsoft Security certifications such as AZ-500, MS-500, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400 
Vendor-agnostic security Certification(s) such as from ISC2 (CISSP, CCSP, etc.), ISACA (CISM, CISA) or SANS/GIAC (GSEC, GCLD, GPCS, etc.) will be considered a plus.
In depth hands-on experience with a multitude of operating systems, databases and networking infrastructure.
Ability in writing custom scripting tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, etc.), interacting with API's.

What We Look For
Excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills and the ability to work within tight timeframes.
Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills.
Desire to investigate and try-out new tools and technologies as they are released.
Ability to work under tight timelines, in cases for multiple project deliveries.
Good interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within high-performing teams.
Confidence to convey technical advice and guidance to clients.
Evidence of self-motivation for continuous development.

What we offer you  
Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:

Developing your professional growth:

You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.




Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.

Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team's needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.
Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).




Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.#betterworkingworld

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Join INTRALOT as a Senior Database Administrator (DBA) 

Your Role: As a Senior Database Administrator (DBA), you will be leading the database management strategies, ensuring exceptional levels of performance and security. Your focus will be on providing technical direction and spearheading the development of advanced solutions.

Your Responsibilities:

Guiding the Way: Utilize your expertise to guide our team towards effective database management strategies that align with our company's goals and values.Managing Databases: Take charge of installing, configuring, and maintaining complex database systems in various environments, ensuring they run smoothly whether they're On-Premises, in the Cloud, or Hybrid.Boosting Performance: Lead efforts to optimize performance by fine-tuning operations, improving queries, and ensuring our database operations can scale effectively.Ensuring Security and Compliance:
Uphold strong security measures to protect our data and ensure compliance with regulatory standards like GDPR and the esteemed WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification.Supporting and Mentoring: Take on the role of mentor for the team members, offering guidance, sharing your technical knowledge, and nurturing an environment of ongoing learning and growth.Collaborating with Stakeholders: Work closely with teams across the organization, such as Software Development, Infrastructure, and Quality Assurance, to achieve impactful business outcomes through seamless collaboration.Your Qualifications:


 Extensive Experience: Bring at least six (6) years of hands-on experience in database administration, with a focus on enterprise-level deployments and mission-critical systems.
 Specialization: Mastery in MySQL or Oracle RDBMS, complemented by desirable proficiency in other databases including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MS SQL Server, and more
 Influence Opportunity: Demonstrate leadership prowess, spearheading technical projects, mentoring team members, and influencing strategic direction.
 Automation Mindset: Fluent in scripting and automation tools (e.g., Bash, Python, Ansible), committed to championing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
 Stellar Communication: Convey complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
 Lifelong Learning:
 Embrace a passion for continuous learning and growth, staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry best practices. 


About Us: INTRALOT, a publicly listed company established in 1992, is a leading gaming solutions supplier and operator active in 39 regulated jurisdictions worldwide. With a global workforce of approximately 1,700 employees, INTRALOT is committed to redefine innovation and quality of services in the lottery and gaming sector, while supporting operators in raising funds for good causes. In 2023, INTRALOT was distinguished as a top ten most attractive employer brands in Greece.
INTRALOT has been awarded the prestigious WLA Responsible Gaming Framework Certification by the World Lottery Association. We always act with integrity and enjoy what we do.

Why Join Us:
 A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits.
 Hybrid working model.
 Private Insurance for you and your family. 
 Modern facilities, parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus.
 An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment.
 Exceptional opportunities to learn and develop in a multinational environment.
 Prospects for professional growth both locally and globally. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: We champion diversity and inclusivity, fostering an environment where all individuals are celebrated and valued. Our premises are thoughtfully designed to ensure accessibility for all.
If you're a seasoned professional seeking a rewarding opportunity to leave your mark on the gaming industry's forefront, we invite you to join us at INTRALOT. Submit your resume today!

title: Cloud Engineer – Cyprus, Greece or Remote
description:
Cloud Engineer – Cyprus, Greece or Remote
 
The role: 
As a Cloud Engineer, you will be one of the main gears of the deployment engine within our team. Solutions, projects, deep troubleshooting along with investigations will be your focus areas. If you are an engineer looking to learn and grow within cloud services, processes and methodologies then we have a place for you in our team.
 
The key responsibilities of the role include:

Honour and practice Well Architected Framework accross all tasks and responsibilities
Research workloads for migrating it them to the cloud, with minimal interruption and impact
Participate in cloud migration projects
Assist in re-platform and re-factor of current cloud infrastructure
Assist IT departments and teams with their cloud infrastructure
Participate in evaluation of deployments and creating a risk register of cloud deployments and resources
Participate in definition of fair use policies and best practices for cloud services while complying to the company’s standards
Drive requests for new technologies, services or solutions required from internal customers
Deploy, document and orchestrate Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) and Solutions for internal customers in compliance with the company’s framework
Follow and provide training regarding new and current technologies and services used
Have an understanding of cloud costs

 
Main requirements:

University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a similar discipline
2 years of cloud services experience preferably on AWS cloud
Moderate knowledge in solution design and deployment projects
Understanding Well Architected Framework
Methodical troubleshooting of issues
Experience in AWS technologies, services and ecosystem
Organisation, Documentation and Time Management skills

 
The following will be considered an advantage:

Experience in Linux OS and Network
Exposure to scripting languages such as Python or Go
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts and tools, preferably HCL
Knowledge of Terraform and AWS CloudFormation
Experience with versioning tools such as git

 
Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package plus performance-based reward


Private health insurance
Corporate pension fund
Intellectually stimulating work environment


Continuous personal development and international training opportunities

Type of employment: Full time
Location: Cyprus, Greece or Remote
Please visit our website www.xm.com/careers to submit your online application for this position.
 
All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Senior Manager, Industrialized Assets Product Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARYDo you want to make an impact on patient health around the world? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that brings together scientific, clinical and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and analytics? Then join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Analytics organization (AIDA) where you can leverage cutting-edge technology to inform critical business decisions and improve customer experiences for our patients and physicians. Our collection of engineering, data science, and analytics professionals are at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization leveraging data science and advanced analytics to change patients' lives. The Industrialization team within Enterprise Data Science and Advanced Analytics leads the scaling of data and insights capabilities - critical drivers and enablers of Pfizer's digital transformation.As a Senior Manager, Industrialized Assets Product Lead, you will be a leader within the Data Science Industrialization team charged with setting a vision for and championing AI/analytic industrialized asset products that serve a broad base of users ranging from analysts, data scientists, and engineers to marketers, medical experts, and researchers. You will create, own the roadmaps for, and lead the development of an array of products that generalize point solutions into analytic and AI systems to simplify and fuel insight generation.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner with other leaders within the AI and Data Science Industrialization team to define team roadmap and drive impact by providing strategic and technical input including platform evolution, vendor scan, and new capability development Communicate value delivered through industrialized AI/ML assets to end user functions (e.g., Chief Marketing Office, PBG Commercial and Medical Affairs) and partner to ideate, design, and implement industrialized assets that can be scaled across markets, brands, and TAs
Partner with AIDA Data team to integrate industrialized assets into enterprise-level analytics data products where appropriate
Partner with AIDA Platforms team on continuous development and end to end capability integration between OOB platforms and internal engineered components (API registry, ML library / workflow management, enterprise connectors, GenAI reusable components); Performance and resource optimization of managed pipelines and models
Lead the advancement of at scale "industrialized" AI and data science capabilities and industrialized asset products
Own vision and maintain a holistic and consistent roadmap for industrialized asset products
Participate in the development of the product and service roadmaps for Generative AI products. Serve as product owner on Generative AI projects that deliver on the product roadmaps and mature the product and service offering across the enterprise.
Provide the voice of the user as the product owner on agile product development teams to maximize value and impact of industrialized asset products
Drive adoption of products through enterprise wide user community engagement (e.g., roadshows, training sessions, knowledge sharing etc.)
Develop and maintain business-facing assets documentation/communication for industrialized asset products (e.g., value proposition, catalog, and adoption metrics)
Define, monitor, and achieve product success and value metrics
Coordinate with other product and digital teams to ensure industrialized asset products fully enable and are integrated into the end to end data science, analytics and AI service delivery ecosystem





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in analytics related area (Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline)
7+ years of work experience in data science, analytics, engineering, or product management for a diverse range of projects
2-3 years of hands-on product management experience
2+ years of hands-on software development experience, preferably in a cloud environment such as AWS
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholder groups and effecting change
Clearly articulates expectations, capabilities, and action plans; actively listens with others' frame of reference in mind; appropriately shares information with team; favorably influences people without direct authority
Clearly articulates scope and deliverables of projects; breaks complex initiatives into detailed component parts and sequences actions appropriately; develops action plans and monitors progress independently; designs success criteria and uses them to track outcomes; drives implementation of recommendations when appropriate, engages with stakeholders throughout to ensure buy-in
Manages projects with and through others; shares responsibility and credit; develops self and others through teamwork; comfortable providing guidance and sharing expertise with others to help them develop their skills and perform at their best; helps others take appropriate risks; communicates frequently with team members earning respect and trust ofthe team
Strong business analysis, product design, and product management skills
Deep expertise with data science enabling technology, such as Dataiku Data Science Studio, AWS SageMaker, or other data science platforms
Strong hands-on skills in analytics engineering and data science (e.g., Python, R, SQL, industrialized ETL software)
Experience working with various types of data (structured / unstructured)
Deep understanding of MLOps principles and tech stack (e.g. MLFlow)
Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration
Ability to creatively take on new challenges and work outside comfort zone
Strong English communication skills (written & verbal)

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Manager, Industrialized Assets Product Lead id 4918553.

title: Actuarial Consultant
description:
About us
Grant Thornton Greece is part of a global network of independent audit, tax and advisory firms, made up of some 60,000 people in over 145 countries. We're a team of independent thinkers who put quality, inclusion and integrity first. All around the world we bring a different experience to our clients and to our people. A better experience. One that delivers the expertise they need in a way that goes beyond. Personal, proactive, and agile.
At Grant Thornton Greece we don’t predict the future, we ✨shape✨ it.
🏆 Some milestones of Grant Thornton Greece 🏆:

We have been Certified as a Great Place to Work for two consecutive years!
We are one of the Best Workplaces for Women 2023 for two consecutive years!
And we are proud member of Diversity Charter Greece and certified SHARE Equality Label

So, if you want to be part of this incredible journey here is an opportunity for you!
The key responsibilities of this role will include:

Participating in a broad range of insurance advisory-related projects covering every aspect of the insurance business, from regulatory requirements to key strategic implementations and business transformation ones
Implementing actuarial principles into business solutions, in alignment with the client’s needs and strategic priorities
Interacting on a frequent basis with stakeholders, to ensure the delivery of services of the highest standards
Working collaboratively with professionals from other divisions and areas, inside and outside the organization, in order to provide holistic services to clients and meet their needs
Maintain highest standards of business ethics
Depending the induction level of the candidate, the position’s responsibilities will include the project planning, management, fieldwork execution and review, the project completion procedures, as well as the preparation and delivery of relevant presentation to clients

The key requirements of this role are:

A passion for implementing actuarial and statistical concepts into real-world scenarios, discovering appropriate solutions to meet client needs and aiming at operational excellence
A proven life actuarial background, with minimum 2 years of experience in an insurance company and/or consulting firm
A strong set of analytical skills
Ability to lead and coordinate multiple tasks within multiple teams under the right kind of support
Fluency in English, both written and oral
Excellent skills in MS Office; Word, Excel, Power Point

Some qualifications that will be considered as great assets are:

Pursue the actuarial certification in Hellenic Actuarial Society or any other internationally recognized actuarial society. If you are already a qualified actuary, it will be an asset.
Experience in reserving under Solvency II and current accounting standards and/or pricing of insurance products and/or Asset-Liability Management will be evaluated positively
Knowledge of IFRS17 standards will be considered an asset
Experience in using actuarial modelling software (Prophet, Moses, ReMetrica, etc.) will be a plus
Skills in analyzing data, manipulating big datasets, developing descriptive, predictive & prescriptive models and visualizing data (using R, Python, SQL, PowerBI, etc.) will be also favorably evaluated
Taking initiatives to stay ahead of current trends and developments in insurance and financial sector
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical writing and client presentation
Ability to develop and deliver high quality services and solutions
A high work ethic
Motivation for career progression and development

 
What will we offer to you?

🏋️‍️Friendly and dynamic working environment
💰 Competitive remuneration
👩‍🏫 Formal training and Professional Qualifications fully funded (eg. ACCA/CIA/CFA/PMP etc.)
👨‍💼Coaching and counseling from Senior Professionals
🏃🏽‍♂️ Corporate Sports Teams (e.g. Running, Basketball, Volleyball)
🌈 Diverse and inclusive culture
👩‍🦽 Office designed to be accessible for wheelchair users
🏝Extra days off: August Freedays, Volunteering Days, Early days leave
🏠 Flexible way of working
👨‍👩‍👦 Parental Leave Extra day off
🧩 Corporate citizenship initiatives
🏢 Office amenities (subject to the office location)
🤝 Special employee offers and discounts.
💻 Company laptop
👩‍⚕ Insurance Program for all GT members
☎Employee Assistance Support 24/7

 
Just so you know…
If you have imagined a career that goes beyond business as usual, then you are in the right place. We go beyond to deliver a different experience to our people, our clients & our communities.
Joining the Grant Thornton Greece family is easy! Simply apply online by uploading an -up-to-date CV with your application and leave the rest to us!**
**All applications will be treated with confidentiality and only short-listed candidates will be contacted.
✨We are Grant Thornton. We go beyond business as usual, so you can too. #welcometomore #gobeyondwithus✨

Apply here and our recruiters will match your skills with the best open job role.
So, problem solved! 😉

Participating in a broad range of insurance advisory-related projects covering every aspect of the insurance business, from regulatory requirements to key strategic implementations and business transformation ones
Implementing actuarial principles into business solutions, in alignment with the client’s needs and strategic priorities
Interacting on a frequent basis with stakeholders, to ensure the delivery of services of the highest standards
Working collaboratively with professionals from other divisions and areas, inside and outside the organization, in order to provide holistic services to clients and meet their needs

Depending the induction level of the candidate, the position’s responsibilities will include the project planning, management, fieldwork execution and review, the project completion procedures, as well as the preparation and delivery of relevant presentation to clients

The key requirements of this role are:

A passion for implementing actuarial and statistical concepts into real-world scenarios, discovering appropriate solutions to meet client needs and aiming at operational excellence
A proven life actuarial background, with minimum 5 years of experience in an insurance company and/or consulting firm
A strong set of analytical skills
Ability to lead and coordinate multiple tasks within multiple teams under the right kind of support
Fluency in English, both written and oral
Excellent skills in MS Office; Word, Excel, Power Point

To be successful at this role you need the following:

Pursue the actuarial certification in Hellenic Actuarial Society or any other internationally recognized actuarial society. If you are already a qualified actuary, it will be an asset.
Experience in reserving under Solvency II and current accounting standards and/or pricing of insurance products and/or Asset-Liability Management will be evaluated positively
Knowledge of IFRS17 standards will be considered an asset
Experience in using actuarial modelling software (Prophet, Moses, ReMetrica, etc.) will be a plus
Skills in analyzing data, manipulating big datasets, developing descriptive, predictive & prescriptive models and visualizing data (using R, Python, SQL, PowerBI, etc.) will be also favorably evaluated
Taking initiatives to stay ahead of current trends and developments in insurance and financial sector
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical writing and client presentation

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: Technical Support Engineer 
 
Import
EVziiin© (member of Innvestio Group) is an innovative IoT platform focused on supporting electric mobility by facilitating the charging of electric vehicles through a large network of charging points across Europe. As part of our continuous development, we are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to staff the IT Department. This role includes providing technical support, troubleshooting and working with other teams to improve our products and services. 
 
Active position: Yes
 
Candidate Profile Basics

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related
Good knowledge of MS Windows & MS Office 365
Good knowledge of H/Y troubleshooting, peripheral hardware and software
Computer network experience
Good knowledge of the English language
Knowledge of SQL,  Python & PHP
Experience in Linux environments

 
Other candidate skills

Diagnostic and problem solving skills
Organizational and communication skills
Effective time management.
Consistency and sense of responsibility
Ability to communicate and work well with different departments and function within a team
Completed military service (for male applicants)

 
Basic responsibilities of the job

Diagnosis and resolution of technical PC problems
Management of corporate systems and applications
Configuration and installation of new equipment, both in and out of the field
Conduct systems audit to ensure smooth operation
Provide telephone and on-site support for installed customer equipment
Continuous monitoring and communication with the customer until normal operation is restored
Ability to travel

 
What does the company offer?

Group private life and health insurance plan.
Supplementary benefits at regular intervals.
Continuous training opportunities and prospects for continuous development.
Great flexibility of working conditions, with a combination of telecommuting and live professional employment.

 
We are confident that we can offer you the growth your ambitions seek. Do not hesitate to contact us if you meet the above requirements!

title: Senior Manager, Data Scientist
description:
ROLE SUMMARYPfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Analytics organization (AIDA) leverages data science and advanced analytics to change patient's lives. The R&D team under AIDA partners with business stakeholders to drive analytic capabilities, accelerating business insights and providing value for decision making. The R&D Data Science team under AIDA R&D accomplishes this through a focus on the use of data from inside and outside the organization, analyzed by a team of data scientists, in response to business partners to perform analyses that advance our portfolio.In the R&D team, the Senior Manager Data Scientist is a very important role in advancing AI and analytic methods, generating valuable insights using internal and external data sources. The Senior Manager Data Scientist will provide leadership in maximizing the value of Pfizer's investments in AI and analytics capabilities. She/he will work in a fast-paced multidisciplinary environment as the competitive landscape and advanced analytic strategies keep changing rapidly.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESThe Senior Manager Data Scientist will:

Locate and analyze different types of relevant data from inside and outside of Pfizer to answer research and development questions.
Provide leadership to and execute projects that help identify targets and enhance clinical trials in collaboration with R&D partners that have diverse scientific and informatics experiences.
Develop, implement, and optimize AI models to solve complex R&D problems using predictive analytics and natural language processing.
Produce actionable data presentations and visualizations that are intuitive, effective, and insightful for decision makers at senior levels throughout the organization.
Develop Proof-of-Concept (POC) utilities for use in answering business questions with innovation, value generation and competitive edge as key differentiators; provide thought leadership and architectural know-how to scale up these utilities for mainstream use by the broader R&D community.
Define and execute POCs using cutting edge and state of the art advanced analytic technologies.
Lead Business initiatives and support Pfizer Digital's Bold Moves

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

A minimum of a bachelors' degree with 7+ years of experience or a PhD 2+ years' experience in biological sciences or related area
Data analysis experience with heterogeneous data types and familiarity of big data, analytics and/or data mining environments in molecular sciences
5+ years of programming experience with one or more data analytics tools (Python, SAS, R or SQL)
3+ years with a data visualization tool (e.gs., R, DASH, Spotfire, Tableau)
Ability to build and manage models to predict outcomes using data that is often incomplete and/or imperfect and contained in disparate sources; Statistical analysis to understand and improve possible limitations in models.
Demonstrated capabilities in integrating and analyzing heterogeneous datasets; Ability to identify trends, identify outliers and find patterns.
Demonstrated experience in accessing and analyzing research, clinical and/or safety data
Strong verbal and written communication skills
The ideal candidate would have the ability to prioritize activities and work independently as well as in a team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Pharmaceutical industry experience preferred
Understanding of Pharmaceutical R&D data preferred
2+ years data science experience using molecular data sets in biology and/or chemistry
An understanding of one or more pharmaceutical domains including discovery, research, clinical, regulatory or safety would be a strong plus.
Experience with Jupyter Notebooks and/or Shiny applications is a plus
2+ years of data science experience in natural language processing and semantic technologies would be a plus.
Experience in computer vision would be a plus.
Knowledge of deep learning techniques would be a plus.
Experience with Electronic Medical Record and Claims data and/or public datasets a plus.
Experience working in a cloud environment and using cloud-based services is desirable.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
The Role:
You will join a team working with cutting-edge technologies and striving to utilize cloud services to the maximum. Your role will be to monitor critical applications and services to ensure their availability and minimize downtime. You will also ensure that the underlying infrastructure runs smoothly and systems/tools work as expected, help developers with troubleshooting and provide consultation in case of alerts.
The main responsibilities of the position include:

Monitor critical application metrics and create alerts
Build or use software to help DevOps, Devs and Support teams
Fix support escalation issues
Maintain documentation and runbooks
Conduct post-incident reviews

Main Requirements:

5+ years of experience in a SRE, DevOps or similar role
Experience in incident, problem and change management practices
Extensive working experience with CI/CD procedures and tools (e.g. Gitlab CI)
Strong experience using containers and Kubernetes
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Ability to work as part of a distributed team
Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic)

Familiarity with database concepts
Working experience with at least one cloud provider (preferably AWS)
Experience with Apache Kafka configuration and troubleshooting
Experience with ELK configuration and troubleshooting
Scripting skills (Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, etc.) 

Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package
Private health insurance
Corporate pension fund
Intellectually stimulating work environment
Continuous personal development and international training opportunities 

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Systems and Security Engineer
description:
Volton Hellenic Energy SA is a Greek company that is dynamically active and is increasing its capacity rapidly in the field of Electricity Supply and Trading, in the Gas Energy Sector and soon enough in the field of Telecommunications.
By offering reliable services that meet the ever-growing energy needs of businesses and households, Volton aims to build solid and trustful relationships with its customers. The company's ambition is to become one of the most important companies in the industry and remain at the forefront of developments as the first Multiservice provider combining Electricity, Natural gas and Telecommunications. As part of its development, Volton strengthens its human resources in Athens and seeks:
 
Systems and Security Engineer
 
The Systems and Security role is a part of the engineering team in an up-and-coming network operator and Telecommunications Service Provider (mobile and fixed), covering technologies such as: Virtualization, Automation, Infrastructure planning, Systems Monitoring and Security, etc. 
The role is an opportunity for a passionate Systems Engineer that wants to be part of an exciting project, an ISP/MSP in the making. 
 
Responsibilities:

Design and development of a supporting infrastructure (physical and virtual) for telecommunication services and applications 
Design and implementation of security policies/measures for systems and applications of mobile services 
Management of suppliers and subcontractors providing related products and services 
Participation and authoring in RFPs/RFQs 
Specification and documentation of engineering, operations and change management procedures for the systems and the security framework 
KPI definition and monitoring of systems performance 

 
Necessary Skills:

Excellent knowledge and experience in systems (physical, virtual, public cloud) management and in virtualization platforms / operating systems: 


Windows server 
Hyper-V 
VMWare 
Linux 


Very good knowledge and experience in the specification and implementation of security measures and operating procedures for the systems and their hosted applications 
Experience with security technologies/appliances, such as: next-generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, authentication/authorization systems etc. 
Knowledge and experience in managing virtual servers and other computing resources in public cloud environments (Azure & AWS) 
Knowledge in managing Virtual Machines in Hyper-V and VMWare environments 
Knowledge and understanding of systems networking requirements and basic networking principles  
Experience with main internet services (DNS, DHCP, NTP, etc.) 

 
Preferred Skills: 

Experience in managing large-scale technology projects 
Experience with resource management in public cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) 
Experience with system monitoring tools (e.g. TICK stack) 
Programming/scripting (Python, BASH, etc.) will be considered an asset 

 
Necessary Qualifications:

University Degree or relevant, in Engineering / Computer Science / Informatics 
At least 4 years of experience in the management of computer systems / servers 
Fluency in English 
Related Technology certifications will be considered an asset 

 
The Company Offers:

Competitive remuneration package
Hybrid working model
Mobile phone
Private insurance, corporate benefits and perks
Continuous training and professional development
Excellent professional environment
Modern and productive working facilities

 
Don’t miss the chance to join a Great Place to Work-Certified Company that promotes a positive work environment.
 
 
All applications will be treated with confidentiality.
If your CV meets the requirements of the job, we will contact you by phone to schedule an appointment.

title: Senior Linux AWS Administrator
description:
Job Description

AWS Infrastructure Management: Design, deploy, and manage AWS infrastructure using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and VPC, with a strong focus on Linux environments.
Linux System Administration: Manage and optimize Linux servers (Red Hat, Ubuntu, CentOS) in both cloud and on-premises environments.
Cloud Architecture: Develop and implement scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud architectures to support various applications and services.
Automation and Scripting: Automate cloud operations and deployments using tools like CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Perl.
Monitoring and Performance Tuning: Implement monitoring and alerting solutions (CloudWatch, Datadog) to ensure high availability and performance of cloud resources. Perform regular performance tuning and optimization of Linux systems.
Security and Compliance: Ensure the security and compliance of AWS and Linux environments by implementing best practices and conducting regular security assessments.
Disaster Recovery and Backup: Design and manage backup and disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity.
Cost Management: Monitor and optimize cloud costs, and implement cost-saving strategies.
Documentation and Training: Maintain detailed documentation of cloud architecture, Linux configurations, and processes. Provide training and support to team members on AWS and Linux best practices.
Collaboration: Collaborate with development, DevOps, and IT teams to support application deployments and troubleshoot issues.

 
Qualifications
 

5+ years of experience in cloud and Linux administration, with at least 3 years focused on AWS
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Excellent English speaking skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to convey technical information to non technical users successfully.
Extensive experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, etc.).
Proficiency in Linux system administration (Red Hat, Ubuntu, CentOS).
Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like CloudFormation and Terraform.
Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Perl).
Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
Experience with monitoring and logging tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk).
Solid understanding of networking, security, and system administration.

title: Manager, Cloud FinOps Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Digital Hosting Solutions (DHS) team represents the Digital Center of Excellence (CoE) for cloud infrastructure capabilities, providing foundational public and private cloud services to all business lines, globally across Pfizer. DHS is a high-performing team, focused on delivering secure, scalable, compliant, operationally viable, and cost-effective cloud solutions. Working within Digital Hosting Solutions involves working with the cutting edge of cloud technology within the context of the world's leading biopharmaceutical organization, at a time when adoption of these technologies is increasing rapidly.Pfizer seeks individuals that are highly self-motivated, eager to learn, and are effective when working in a team environment. A strong aptitude towards self-development and growth is highly desired.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESThe Cloud FinOps Engineer will work within the FinOps product domain within DHS. This role will collaborate closely with the FinOps product owner and other Pfizer engineering teams to support releases of Pfizer's foundational FinOps platform and associated automations that drive efficient use of cloud services. The ideal candidate will be able to work with programming languages such as Python, SQL and be able to manage and build ETL workflows and other automations.

Technical engineering lead in the design, development, and maintenance of Pfizer's custom FinOps platform for cost visibility and optimization across multiple platforms (AWS, Azure, and GCP).
Maintain and enhance existing automations to rightsize compute, eliminate unused resources and schedule compute instances
Drive the adoption of new technologies and methodologies to continuously improve the cost effectiveness of our cloud operations & workloads.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in software development and cloud infrastructure.
Proven hands-on technical leadership
Strong knowledge of public cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Knowledge of AWS services such as AWS Glue, S3, Athena, and Redshift
Demonstrated experience with Terraform and DevOps methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and strong business acumen.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner.
Commit to ongoing learning and professional development.
Demonstrated ability to work in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP, such as Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Cloud Engineer.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and processes, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
Knowledge of cost control and/or governance for cloud infrastructure and application development.
Working knowledge of Atlassian Confluence and Jira is desired.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Cloud FinOps Engineer id 4919818.

Hands-on data engineering and data science across multiple systems and data types.

Research, identify, and apply new algorithms and technologies to current business needs.

ROLE SUMMARYThe Digital Manufacturing Team is responsible for the delivery of Pfizer's Core Digital Manufacturing Operations Management (MoM) capabilities at every level of the PGS Plant Network (ISA 95 Levels 0-4). These solutions are critical to Manufacturing Execution, Manufacturing Process Intelligence and Production Optimization that aim to improve product quality, increase asset utilization/uptime, automate manual workflows, and streamline plant floor operations. The Digital Manufacturing Team provides common application platforms and solution capabilities for Digital Plant, Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Execution, Manufacturing Insights and Digital Quality solutions, while ensuring a unified User Centric Design. Key to the success of this transformative digital mindset is the secure, seamless flow of contextualized data from the device & control levels, all the way to the top of the Enterprise. Professional Cloud Architect AWS Certified Solutions Architect  Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) Terraform Associate Certification Competencies Technical knowledge & Problem-solving. In-depth understanding of IT systems, networks, and software applications, and the ability to manage incidents, problems, and requests. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues. Continuous Learning. Proactive attitude towards continuous learning and professional development to stay updated with the latest advancements in cloud technologies. Time Management and Organization.Effective prioritization, planning, and organization skills to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. Adaptability. Flexibility and openness to learn and adapt to new technologies, cloud services, and evolving industry trends. Collaboration and Communication. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams & stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions. Integrity, conscientiousness, responsibility, self-motivation. description:
The successful candidate shall be highly motivated with a passion for the analytics industry. The candidate must be results-driven, able to work independently, as well as actively participate with a collaborative team. As Data Scientist your role will include to take responsibilities in challenging engagements and generate high quality results and useful/ actionable insights.

Collecting, retrieving, and understanding datasets (combine data from different sources).
Developing and delivering analytics solutions for various Global clients.
Analyzing data and assessing their quality in terms of business sense.
Actively participating in project meetings/calls with local Circana teams.
Handling multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives/key deadlines.
Communicating results and recommendations to Local teams and technical consultants.
Collaborating with business specialists and commercial stakeholders across different teams, including technical consultants, to interpret requirements, understand business objectives and build and deliver advanced analytics initiatives.
Work cross-functionally to identify and answer business objectives using appropriate modeling techniques, utilizing sophisticated statistical analysis
MSc degree in Statistics, or similar quantitative field of study.
University degree (BSc) in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or any relevant field.
Minimum 2 years working experience in statistics or data analytics.
Very good knowledge of R or Python in advanced data handling with data table, manipulation, developing automated reporting.
Good level of SQL (e.g. data manipulation, reporting).
UNIX/ LINUX/ bash is a plus.
Knowledge of statistics, classification and time series analysis (random forests, logistic regression, decision trees) will be considered also a plus.
Good organizational skills and ability to multitask on small scale projects to meet tight deadlines.
Ability and willingness to work closely with the team and follow specific processes.
Fluency in verbal and written English is essential. Italian will be considered as a plus.
Eager to learn and grow and have a positive attitude.

title: Manager, Cash Management Solutions & Transformation
description:
Why Patients Need You
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.
What You Will Achieve
The Digital Finance Operations Manager in Cash Management Solutions & Transformation group will collaborate with various cross-functional Digital teams, business stakeholders, external vendor resources and other Digital Leads to help design, implement and support various digital solutions in support of Cash Management & Transformation projects in Digital Finance.The Manager will provide technology expertise in the areas of designing, developing and supporting Digital solutions to optimize processes, bring efficiencies in Cash Management & Transformation to enable the organization towards Pfizer's Bold Moves.The Manager will be a key Solution Delivery representative for this area, partnering with other Digital colleagues, client partners and business stakeholders to ensure clients meet their strategic goals.
How You Will Achieve It

Support the design, development, delivery and digitization of Cash Management and Transformation in Cloud Transformation, Infrastructure and Enterprise Solutions organization. This would include transactions and systems such as SAP Banking and Cash Management, HighRadius Cash Application Cloud, Process Mining solutions and homegrown custom and analytical solutions
Lead/manage a technology portfolio of multiple global systems to enhance existing solutions to ensure regulatory compliance
Lead and collaborate with application support service providers in identifying and eliminating barriers and gaps to improve systems, processes and services to maintain a strong business continuity for meeting critical target dates
Qualification of Digital solutions for audit compliance and ownership of audit deliverables, SOX surveys and validation in a timely manner
Manage solutions life cycle and develop long term solution strategies
Report and track progress relative to time, budget, scope and business objectives
Identify and initiate process improvements (continuous improvement)

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Business, Finance or an affiliated field required
Hands-on experience with programming languages, relational databases (SQL) and scripting languages (Python) is required. This job will require coding skills.
5+ years of progressively increasing responsibility in information technology
Demonstrated experience of various IT practices, including but not limited to, requirements analysis, software engineering, project management, large scale project implementations
Demonstrated ability to work across organizational regional and global boundaries, ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a cross-divisional and cross-functional matrix environment
Ability to work independently, effectively coordinating multiple priorities in a dynamic team-oriented and collaborative environment
Excellent interpersonal and timely decision-making skills

Nice-to-Have

Adept at understanding customer challenges, navigating from problem to resolution and communicating process and resolution effectively both verbally and in writing
Experience with Agile Software Delivery and/or Scrum Master Certification
Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

description:

At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally. This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.We seek a highly motivated Solution Engineer Lead to join Pfizer's Digital Technology team for Patient Support Services solution delivery for Pfizer's Specialty Access Solution CoE. You will help Pfizer build its information technology solutions. You will leverage your technical skills to design, develop and implement IT solutions which satisfy the short term or long terms needs of Pfizer. The ideal candidate must possess extensive expertise in data architecture, data profiling and quality tools, cloud databases, AI/ML tools, and building APIs. It is your hard work and dedication that will help in making Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients.
