Design, implement, and maintain efficient, scalable, and reliable data pipelines for ETL processes, collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and integration strategies, while ensuring the pipelines can handle large volumes of data.
Oversee the preprocessing of data within the PSSP system, ensuring high data quality across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and uniqueness.
Identify data quality gaps and issues and take necessary actions to address them.
Design and implement a standardized data structure, harmonize attribute values, and create a configurable framework with data quality and standardization rules.
Establish and enforce data governance practices, define and implement data quality and standardization rules, and collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain data models, schemas, and data dictionaries, ensuring compliance with regulations and standards.
Oversee the delivery team to ensure successful project execution and timely delivery of PSSP projects, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to team members

You will have the opportunity to:

Deliver data reliably, efficiently, and with best-in-class data governance, ensuring security and compliance.
Collaborate with analytics leads and business SMEs to understand data requirements and ensure the rules engine meets their needs.
Work with product owners to prioritize features for ongoing sprints and manages a list of technical requirements based on business needs, new technologies, known defects, and issues.
Coordinate across many stakeholders, creating a collaborative network with critical internal and external stakeholders. This can include outside contractors such as software vendors, data providers and specialty pharmacy customers.
Partner with the Digital Client Partners to align on priorities, processes and governance and ensure experimentation to activate innovation and pipeline value





Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
6+ years of relevant experience emphasizing application support, development, or systems engineering.
Proven experience and demonstrated skills with AWS technologies, Snowflake, Informatica Intelligence Cloud Services tools, Python, R and exposure to JS, Tableau and Data IKU
Demonstrated ability to take appropriate risks, share responsibilities and credit, celebrate/reward accomplishments, and instill in others a sense of urgency and ownership
Experience leading solution delivery teams supporting cloud applications and analytics
Experience managing vendors and contracted resources in a staff augmentation and outsourcing model.
Ambition to learn and utilize emerging technologies while working in a stimulating team environment

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree
Knowledge of systems within the Patient Services function.
Ability to adapt to changing working conditions and work assignments, to be open, and motivated to learn and adopt new ideas and concepts.
Strong interpersonal skills and experience working within a team environment across business functions to influence a desired outcome
Deep knowledge of Agile methodologies and SDLC processes

description:

Assist in the development and maintenance of reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
Analyze company performance data from various business functions (Supply Chain, Sales, Production) and create actionable insights.
Collaborate with departments to understand reporting needs and deliver impactful visualizations.

Data Integration & Pipeline Management:

Work with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and SQL to extract, transform, and load data for reporting purposes.
Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data is efficiently processed and integrated from multiple sources.

Utilize Python to automate data extraction, processing, and analysis tasks.
Develop and integrate REST APIs for accessing and sharing data across systems.

Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of data used in reports and dashboards.
Support efforts to improve data collection and validation processes to enhance reporting capabilities.

Basic knowledge of Python and REST APIs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Eagerness to learn and grow in a data-centric role.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Microsoft Power BI (Data visualization)
Microsoft Azure (Cloud infrastructure)
SQL (Database management and querying)
Microsoft Fabric (Data engineering and integration)
Python (Scripting for automation)
REST APIs (Data integration and exchange)

We offer

Competitive compensation
Flexible work models
A pleasant, fun, and achievement-oriented environment
Learning and growth opportunities in an international company setup

Interested?We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Metlen Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, leading the green energy transition with innovative solutions while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy. Our global presence covers two business Sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. With a consolidated yearly turnover of €6.3 billion and a workforce of over 5,500 dedicated individuals, we fuel success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.
We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, leaving a lasting impact. We foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.
 
We are currently looking for Data Engineer to join our M Energy Generation & Management Division in our Offices in Marousi
By joining this role, you will step into a crucial position where you will optimize data-driven processes for the energy management team and ensure seamless data flow across systems. You will develop and maintain ETL processes to facilitate and automate the team’s data extraction needs and implement processes to create business-level analyses.
 
Your role will encompass:


Creating and maintaining procedures to extract data from diverse origins and consolidating it within our centralized databases.


Ensuring that data meets rigorous validation criteria and is stored in an organized manner.


Carrying out exploratory data analysis (EDA) and executing the process of feature engineering.


Adopting state-of-the-art methods for choosing Machine Learning models and fine-tuning models’ parameters.


Deploying models into production environments.


Creating, developing, and maintaining Power BI reports.


Participating in the development of analytic tools to assist the daily operations of the department.


Monitoring the status, the performance, and the health of data pipelines and ensuring they do not fail.


Creating detailed documentation to facilitate team members’ comprehension of the completed tasks and pipelines.


 
What You Bring to the Role:


Bachelor’s in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.


2+ years of experience in Data Engineering


Hands-on with Azure, including Azure Data Factory and Databricks.


Proficient in SQL for ETL.


Experience with Python, PySpark, and/or R.


Knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning.


Strong Power BI skills.


Proficient in written and spoken English.


Strong data analysis and modeling skills.


Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Eager to learn new skills and technologies.


Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.


Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently.


 
Your Benefits:


Competitive remuneration package


Ticket Restaurant Card


Group Health Insurance program


Protergia discount on electricity and natural gas bill


Pension Plan


Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news
 
We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential.  
At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.

Share technical expertise with the rest of the QA team

Experience with testing framework development

Experience in the Finance/Forex domain

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
Division: IT
Department: Data Science Lab
Location:  Athens International Airport, B57, Spata
Type of Employment: Full-time
Deadline: 13/10/2024
 
About us
AEGEAN Airlines, based in Athens, Greece, is a member of the Star Alliance Group since 2010 and a proud winner of 14 SKYTRAX World Airline awards for ‘Best Regional Airline in Europe’. Our employees have been instrumental in our success, through seeking to channel their energy and motivation into the challenging industry of aviation, providing services of high standards across all travel stages and contributing to the continuous improvement of our products. We are looking for enthusiastic, talented and dedicated individuals who can drive our organization forward.
 
If you wish to explore the exciting world of aviation, join our team!
 
About the role
There is currently a job opening for ‘’Data Engineer’’ in the Data Science Lab. As a Data Engineer in our Data Science Lab, you will be responsible for leveraging company’s large amounts of data to drive business insights and improve technical operations.
If you're passionate about leveraging the latest technologies in data engineering to optimize aviation maintenance processes, thrive in a collaborative environment, and have a positive, problem-solving attitude, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of our innovative team.
What you will do:

Develop and maintain robust, efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and distribute large volumes of operational and maintenance data across both on-premises and cloud environments
Design and implement relational and non-relational database systems, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and availability
Utilize Python and data analysis libraries to analyze maintenance data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights, as well as develop and automate reporting mechanisms
Collaborate with maintenance, operations, and IT teams to ensure data-driven decision-making and process optimization
Implement data governance policies and practices, ensuring data security and compliance with industry regulations
Continuously monitor and improve data processes, staying updated with the latest trends and technologies in data engineering and aviation maintenance to implement innovative solutions

You fit, if you cover the following requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field
3+ years working experience as a Data Engineer, preferably in the aviation industry or a related field
Excellent knowledge in Python & SQL
Experience with PySpark and Databricks will be highly appreciated
Prior experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) will be considered an asset
Fluency in oral and written Greek and English

And you have competence in:

Communicating effectively in a structured manner, with all stakeholders
Demonstrating positive attitude with a collaborative approach
Working under pressure, managing changing priorities and meeting deadlines
Problem solving and managing projects in an efficient manner
Striving for the best results for the company's business needs

 
If you pursue your career journey with AEGEAN, on top of a challenging job, we offer:

 A working environment where you feel valued and appreciated
 Excellent career and development opportunities within the organization
 Flight tickets
 Private health insurance scheme

 
If this looks like an interesting opportunity for you,
send us your application now!
Your application shall contain your CV in English language and is to be submitted until October 13, 2024.  All applications will be treated as strictly confidential. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Keep on following us to find a job opening that matches your profile.

description:
We look forward to meeting you at the kariera.gr career days on 12 & 13 October at stand 343!
Our CTO will be there to discuss career potentials with you!
 
PRISMA ELECTRONICS SA provides high technology-based solutions for businesses and organizations. Through its R&D and technical divisions, Prisma Electronics, is currently looking for an AI Engineer in order to join the R&D engineering team that designs, develops and manufactures a wide array of IT, smart grid, IoT and wireless-based systems.
 
AI ENGINEER- (Job code: AIE-2402)
 
The AI Engineer is responsible to Manage and direct processes and R&D to meet the needs of our AI strategy. Part of her/his daily activities is to understand client challenges and how integrating AI capabilities can help lead to solutions as well as  analyze and explain AI and machine learning (ML) solutions while setting and maintaining high ethical standards.
 
Responsibilities:
 

Advise C-suite executives and business leaders on a broad range of technology, strategy, and policy issues associated with AI
Work on functional design, process design (including scenario design, and flow mapping), prototyping, testing, training, and defining support procedures, in collaboration with an advanced engineering team and executive leadership
Articulate and document the solutions architecture and lessons learned for each exploration and accelerated incubation
Serve as liaison between stakeholders and project teams, delivering feedback and enabling team members to make necessary changes in product performance or presentation

 
Requirements:

Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science or a related field
Two or more years of experience in applying AI to practical and comprehensive technology solutions
Experience with ML, deep learning, TensorFlow, Python
Experience in program leadership, governance, and change enablement
Knowledge of basic algorithms, object-oriented and functional design principles, and best-practice patterns
Experience in REST API development, NoSQL database design, and RDBMS design and optimizations

Additional Requirements:

Experience with innovation accelerators
Experience with cloud environment

What we offer:

Competitive remuneration package
High standard working environment
Cooperation with International Companies & Executives
Ongoing training
Opportunities for career development

 
Please send your CV to address mail: ibd@prismael.com by referring the relevant Ref Code (ex. AIE-2402).

title: Senior Associate, Digital Quantitative Sciences
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Senior Associate, Digital Quantitative Sciences applies technical, software development and analytical expertise to support the research, development, and deployment of novel digital biomarkers into clinical trials. The successful candidate will inform the selection of sensors and wearable devices, write code to ingest data from these devices, implement the analytics pipelines for combining data from multiple sources, and develop novel digital biomarkers by using advanced signal processing and AI/machine learning techniques. They will also provide subject matter expertise to help advance the research and development of novel digital endpoints and manage the data processing efforts for analytical and clinical validations in collaboration with internal as well as external partners.This role sits in Pfizer's AI/ML, Quantitative & Digital Sciences (AQDS) team within Global Biometrics and Data Management, Pfizer Research & Development, leveraging multi-modal data, digital measures, and the power of quantitative science to inform trial designs, support clinical and regulatory strategy and build patient-centric health solutions. The successful candidate will partner closely with Translational Clinical Sciences, Biomeasures, Endpoints & Study Technology team to develop novel measures that advance drug development.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Use structured and unstructured data to develop digital biomarkers by implementing novel signal processing and machine learning workflows
Participate in study design to ensure data meets modeling needs
Prepare, clean, and filter sensor and clinical data for processing
Design and build digital endpoint pipelines, implement new algorithms, as well as enhance existing algorithms
Evaluate algorithm performance and lead verification and validation testing
Supports algorithm specification documents as well regulatory submissions
Collaborate with partners in Pfizer Digital to translate algorithm code and insights into product assets
Develop software tools and scripts at scale to support data analysis and interpretation pipelines
Integrate and summarize large-scale data and information across multiple scientific, translational, and clinical domains
Communicate effectively with team members, external experts, and regulatory authorities

QUALIFICATIONSBasic Qualifications

M.S. in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Biostatistics, or equivalent degree
Minimum of 1+ year/s of work experience, preferably in a laboratory science, biotech or clinical trial environment
Technical knowledge through coursework and/or demonstrated application in signal processing, statistics and machine learning
Superior computational skills: SAS, R, Python, or equivalent, with a knowledge of a variety of commercial packages such as scikit-learn, pandas, pytorch
Expertise in feature engineering and AI/machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in analyzing physiological sensor signals from sensors and wearable devices, time and frequency domain signal processing, e.g., accelerometer, gyroscope, ECG, CGM, voice
Knowledge of time series analysis methodologies such as Fourier or wavelet transforms
Familiarity with cloud technologies (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
Familiarity in setting up and using agile software development, and source control tools, e.g., git
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
Experience with Python package development
Experience working in medical technology or pharmaceutical industries is a plus
Strong publication record is a plus

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

description:
Antyxsoft is looking for a highly motivated and skilled Mid-Level Cloud Engineer to join its dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for server provisioning, infrastructure mo­nitoring, and providing support to our clients. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the growth and success of our company.
Responsibilities

Server provisioning: Deploy and configure servers, both physical and virtual, based on client requirements. Collaborate with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth and efficient server setup.
Infrastructure monitoring: Monitor the performance, availability, and security of the infrastructure systems. Proactively identify and resolve any issues or bottlenecks to maintain optimal system performance.
Management of Office 365: Assist clients with basic Office 365 setup, configuration, and troubleshooting. Provide guidance and support on Office 365 applications, such as Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.
Networking tasks: Possess a fundamental understanding of networking concepts and protocols. Assist in troubleshooting network-related issues and collaborate with network engineers for more complex problems.
Customer support: Provide timely and effective technical support to clients via phone, email, or ticketing system. Troubleshoot and resolve system-related problems, guiding clients through proper solutions.
Documentation and reporting: Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps. Generate reports on system performance, issues, and resolutions as required.
Night Shift Schedule and remote work: Participate in a rotating night shift schedule, allowing coverage during non-business hours. Additionally, have the ability to work from home during scheduled shifts, ensuring seamless support and system management.
Continuous Learning: Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends. Engage in self-learning and professional development to enhance skills and knowledge.

Requirements and skills

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or CompTIA Network will be considered a plus.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in cloud engineering or related role. Familiarity with server provisioning, infrastructure monitoring tools, and basic Office 365 administration is preferred.
Technical Skills:

Strong understanding of server hardware, operating systems, and virtualization technologies.
Proficient in scripting languages (e.g. PowerShell, Python, bash) for automation and system management tasks.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Knowledge of basic networking concepts, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS), and troubleshooting.
Demonstrated success in leading complex cloud projects.
Proven track record of mentoring and guiding junior team members.




Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to analyse complex technical issues, troubleshoot problems, and propose effective solutions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure.
Communication and Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Minimum age: 28 years old & fulfilled military obligations

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, have a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, and possess the technical skills outlined above join our team and contribute to the success of our clients and the advancement of our company's cloud solutions. This position offers a night shift schedule with the flexibility to work remotely from home during the assigned shifts, ensuring work-life balance and accessibility for our valued employees.
We offer a competitive remuneration (with full benefits) package, based on qualifications and experience, including:

Competitive full-time salary.
A great opportunity to grow and work with innovative and exciting specialists in the industry.
Being part of an environment that offers challenging goals, autonomy and mentoring and creates development opportunities, both for you and the company.

Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.

Your expertise in DevOps will ensure the scalability, reliability, and ongoing operations of AI solutions. You will help Pfizer build its information technology solutions. Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure and tools for software development and deployment using IaC tools.
Automate processes for continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD pipeline) to ensure smooth software delivery.
Collaborate closely with developers, testers, and operations teams to facilitate seamless software delivery.
Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues.

Implement logging and monitoring tools to gain insights into system behavior.
Train and guide junior developers on DevOps principles, fostering their professional growth.
Foster a collaborative learning environment within the team, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their needs, aligning DevOps practices and reusable components with their goals.
Continuously improve and optimize DevOps processes and workflows, leveraging feedback and lessons learned.
Stay up to date with the latest trends in DevOps, AI, and data science, and share knowledge across the organization.
Provide strategic input to the AI ecosystem, contributing to platform evolution and new capability development.

Partner with the AIDA Platforms team to enforce best practices for reusable component architecture and engineering principles.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field (Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline).

Strong scripting skills in languages like Python or Bash.

Self-directed learner with a strong desire to continuously improve coding skills.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
The Role:
You will join a team working with cutting-edge technologies and striving to utilize cloud services to the maximum. Your role will be to monitor critical applications and services to ensure their availability and minimize downtime. You will also ensure that the underlying infrastructure runs smoothly and systems/tools work as expected, help developers with troubleshooting and provide consultation in case of alerts.
The main responsibilities of the position include:

Monitor critical application metrics and create alerts
Build or use software to help DevOps, Devs and Support teams
Fix support escalation issues
Maintain documentation and runbooks
Conduct post-incident reviews

Main Requirements:

2+ years of experience in a SRE, DevOps or similar role
Experience in incident, problem and change management practices
Extensive working experience with CI/CD procedures and tools (e.g. Gitlab CI)
Strong experience using containers and Kubernetes
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Ability to work as part of a distributed team
Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic) 

The following will be considered an advantage:

Familiarity with database concepts
Working experience with at least one cloud provider (preferably AWS)
Experience with Apache Kafka configuration and troubleshooting
Experience with ELK configuration and troubleshooting
Scripting skills (Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, etc.) 

Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package
Intellectually stimulating work environment
Continuous personal development and international training opportunities 

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Global Information Security (GIS) organization delivers proactive cyber defense for the global Pfizer enterprise. Our mission is to secure all of Pfizer's information assets ranging from the manufacturing floor to the core data centers and out to the patient facing solutions. We achieve this mission through a team of world-class talent, utilizing top-tier technologies, advanced analytics and the promotion of a cybersecurity ownership culture across the company. This role requires the individual to embrace an agile work environment and demonstrate a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive approach to problem solving.In this role, we are looking for emerging talent to develop analytics and automations that enable seamless execution and monitoring of operations, while being compliant to standard processes for Global Cybersecurity Engineering services. The Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer is a hands-on role which will develop analytics, and automations and work towards Infrastructure as Code and Policy as a Code to ensure end to end reliability, continuity and consistency of our services to protect Pfizer.For Pfizer, we look for candidates that are motivated, self-learning, and team-oriented individuals. From a technical perspective, an ideal candidate would have the skills shown below, but candidates that possess a strong subset and an attitude towards self-development & growth will be considered.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESThis role will have the following primary responsibilities, but will often act under the support and direction of the Sr. Manager, Cybersecurity Engineering Automations Lead:

Design and implement Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning and management of infrastructure.
Automate Policies as Code and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
Develop automations to eliminate manual repetitive tasks and allow time for more meaningful work.
Develop and optimize automation scripts for configuring and managing cloud infrastructure, while ensuring efficient and error free deployment process.
Create analytics from transactional logs from Global Cybersecurity Engineering solutions to provide visibility to support operational monitoring and policy analysis.
Develop analytics/analyze data to improve situational awareness and make informed decisions.
Manage small to medium security enhancement and remediation projects.
Demonstrate commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrate effective oral, written, and interpersonal communications skills as well as organizational and planning abilities.
Create and document processes, templates, and workflows for service execution across the Global Cybersecurity Engineering services.
Create and maintain compliance and audit related records relevant to the automation processes.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BS in Computer Sciences, Information Security, Information Systems, Engineering, Sciences, or related field.
3+ years of experience.
Experience with Python and SQL.
Experience developing automated workflows using a graphical user interface solution.
Experience developing python scripts for data collection and automation use cases.
Experience performing raw data analysis using a log repository or SIEM.
Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to prioritize and execute with minimal direction or oversight.
Concise, accurate communication skills (both verbal and written).
Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Demonstrated commitment to training, self-study and maintaining proficiency in the technical cyber security domain.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Policy as Code, Security.
Experience with Terraform, PowerShell, and cloud infrastructure monitoring tools.
Experience developing alerts and reports based on data logs.
Experience with agile ways of work, Scrum framework and Scrum Master role.
Experience with compliance frameworks, code quality assurance and audit processes.
Experience creating workflows and templates in Confluence/JIRA.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
 
To apply pleae visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Sr. Associate, Cybersecurity Automation Developer with id 4915504.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Pro4ia Inc. a US based entity, providing solutions and expertise as a trusted technology partner, welcomes creative and motivated individuals to join our team.
We are looking for a Network Engineer for shift 2 (5 PM to 1 AM local), that demonstrates strong customer service and troubleshooting skills to resolve all technical issues for our clients.
The Network Engineer acts as the primary interface to clients to provide level 1 or 2 technical support in time to meet Pro4ia's client SLA obligations.
 
Pro4ia offers the following:
A 5 Working Day Schedule (US holidays apply)
Competitive compensation package
Private Health Insurance and Pension Plan
Friendly environment comprising of young, enthusiastic, and multi-national staff
High tech environment with many learning and development opportunities
 
The ideal candidate should have EXCELLENT British or American English accent and will be responsible for the following work.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
Responsible for solving computer network issues from clients and completing requests received from the Technical Services Coordinator.
Perform analysis of environments and provide level 1 and level 2 technical support through the help desk ticketing system.
Use network technology expertise to install network equipment and perform repairs for network related issues.
Confer with users or conduct computer diagnostics to investigate and resolve problems or to provide technical assistance and support.
Participate effectively in multiple support efforts and provide technical expertise.
Set up network equipment for employee use, performing or ensuring proper installation.
Work closely with clients and the Project Management Team.
Make recommendations based on knowledge of network equipment and systems, in order to improve user experience.
Create and maintain client-related documentation.
Actively participate as a strategic member of the technology team, including participating in team meeting and providing technical support for managed service clients.
Support Sales Engineering in reviewing recommended solutions for clients.
Participate in Pro4ia internal projects as required.
 
ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Provide input to strategic Information Technology planning and implementation.
Provide daily communication to clients on outstanding ticket status.
Job requirements
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
Three or more years Help Desk experience working in a related role
Bachelor’s degree in information technology and/or other industry recognized designation
CCNP certification preferred or equivalent experience
Competency in diagnosing, troubleshooting and repairing networking issues on PCs and related equipment
Strong knowledge of switching, routing, VPN, Cisco, Meraki and Fortinet products
Experience with network management systems, e.g., Auvik, Solarwinds, ManageEngine, PRTG
Experience with designing and implementing cloud infrastructures in AWS and MS Azure
Basic knowledge of network engineering programming languages, ex. (PERL, PYTHON)
Expert technical and management skills with in-depth application on the Information Technology and Informatics professional environment
Ability to provide high level support in installing, optimizing, maintaining and securing of networks
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to multitask
Detail oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills
Desire and demonstrated ability to continuously learn new technologies
Flexible with the ability to adapt and change schedule to meet deadlines
Strong customer service attitude and prior experience in a client service role
Works well independently and as part of a team
MUST be able to perform duties independently or with minimum assistance

description:

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that integrates scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team is a key driver of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As a Manager, AI and Data Science Solution Engineer, you will join the Data Science Industrialization team. Your responsibilities will include architecting and implementing AI solutions and reusable AI components. You will iteratively develop and continuously improve data science workflows, AI use cases, and reusable components to accelerate use case delivery.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop scalable and reliable AI solutions and reusable software components.
Implement robust technical strategies, including API integration, to connect reusable AI components with broader systems and deliver scalable AI solutions.
Proactively identify and resolve potential system issues.
Deliver scalable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from various sources, providing high-quality data products for data science and AI applications.
Build scalable ML pipelines based on available infrastructure.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and quality checks.
Create and maintain robust technical documentation for AI accelerators to ensure knowledge retention and sharing.
Collaborate with AI use case development teams to integrate reusable components into production AI solutions.
Partner with the AIDA Platforms team to integrate capabilities between enterprise platforms and internally developed reusable component accelerators (e.g., API registry, ML library/workflow management, enterprise connectors).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in AI, data science, or a related field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or solution engineering, with a proven track record of building and deploying complex software systems.
Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and data science development lifecycle (CRISP).
Experience working in a cloud-based analytics ecosystem (e.g., AWS, Snowflake).
Highly self-motivated, capable of delivering both independently and through strong team collaboration.
Ability to creatively tackle new challenges and step outside your comfort zone.
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline.
Experience in solution architecture & design.
Experience in software/product engineering.
Strong hands-on skills in ML engineering and data science (e.g., Python, R, SQL, industrialized ETL software).
Experience with data science enabling technology, such as Dataiku Data Science Studio, AWS SageMaker or other data science platforms.
Experience in CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub, GitHub Actions or Jenkins).
Deep understanding of MLOps principles and tech stack (e.g. MLFlow).
Experience with Dataiku Data Science Studio.
Hands on experience working in Agile teams, processes, and practices.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Data Science Solution Engineer id 4922199.

title: Intraday  Shift Trader
description:
Optimus Energy, a company of the IRON ENERGY S.A. group, manages the largest portfolio of renewable energy sources in Greece (>3,500 MW) in the short-term energy markets, enabling the successful integration of wind and solar energy into the market. In addition, it manages over 200 MW of flexible loads and aims to optimize the largest portfolio of Battery Energy Storage Systems in the country.
The Intraday Trading team is looking for an Intraday Shift Trader for our office in Athens. We are looking for a team-oriented and motivated individual who can work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. We offer you the opportunity to become part of a team of experienced and talented traders who will help you achieve top performance and develop your knowledge and expertise in the markets.
The role:
As an Intraday Shift Trader, you will manage one of the largest renewable energy portfolios in Greece, in a complex and rapidly changing energy environment. As an Intraday Trader, you will be directly involved in trading as we believe hands-on experience is the best way to learn. The role also involves attending shifts and maintaining good communication and collaboration with other departments.
Main Responsibilities:

Execution of trades in the short-term energy market (Day-Ahead, Intraday and Balancing Market) within the company's risk and regulatory compliance limits.
Development of analytical tools to facilitate departmental operations.
Develop and implement strategies that maximize profit.
Continuous monitoring of weather conditions, cargo, market prices and cross-border transactions to identify potential risks to the company's portfolio and take necessary measures to reduce these risks.
Maintain good communication with the meteorology and analysis team.
Participating in shifts that include mornings, evenings, holidays and weekends.

Requirements:

University degree with excellent performance (ideally in engineering, natural sciences or economics).
Solid background in mathematics, statistics and time series analysis.
Hands-on programming experience (Python, Matlab) and MS Office.
Excellent knowledge of the English language.
Ability to make decisions under time pressure in a demanding environment.

title: Manager, Solution Engineering
description:
ROLE SUMMARYThe Digital Manufacturing Team is responsible for the delivery of Pfizer's Core Digital Manufacturing Operations Management (MoM) capabilities at every level of the PGS Plant Network (ISA 95 Levels 0-4). These solutions are critical to Manufacturing Execution, Manufacturing Process Intelligence and Production Optimization that aim to improve product quality, increase asset utilization/uptime, automate manual workflows, and streamline plant floor operations.The Digital Manufacturing Team provides common application platforms and solution capabilities for Digital Plant, Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Execution, Manufacturing Insights and Digital Quality solutions, while ensuring a unified User Centric Design. Key to the success of this transformative digital mindset is the secure, seamless flow of contextualized data from the device & control levels, all the way to the top of the Enterprise. These solutions are deployed across more than fifty manufacturing & center locations across the PGS Globally. Major Core Solutions and team capabilities for the Manufacturing Operations Solutions Team include:

This group supports the design, development, delivery and digitization of PGS Manufacturing and Engineering processes. Process Areas (Systems) include Industrial Internet of Things, Enterprise Data Historians, Cybersecurity, Manufacturing Operations Solutions (Manufacturing Intelligence, EAMS Maintenance Mgmt & Calibration, Capital Mgmt, Permit to Work, OEE/RTE, Engineering systems), Manufacturing Execution Systems and Manufacturing Innovative Technologies including AI/ML and Generative model based digital solutions.
The AI Solution Engineer, Manager plays a key role in delivering the future of Advanced Manufacturing Capabilities within the Digital Manufacturing Organization. This colleague will take comprehensive role that intersects technology, strategy, development, and customer support. Their expertise in manufacturing domain, strong programming skills and advanced analytics in cloud infrastructure will be crucial in ensuring the successful development, deployment, and management of our business solutions. The ideal candidate requires not just a technical aptitude, but an understanding of business processes and excellent communication skills to interact directly with clients.





ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and build the sustainable problem-solving solutions that meets the business needs and goals.
Assist product team in creating practical demonstrations of proposed solutions and demonstrating them to business and others.
Understands the Pfizer's technology portfolio; and, by being in direct conversation with Product and Business teams, can identify how their existing solutions and products can solve the current business challenges.
Establish a framework for necessary contributions from various teams and facilitate their collaboration.
Implement best practices for version control, model reproducibility, and model deployment.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, and data quality issues.
Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and tools to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of machine learning operations.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field.
5 years of managing projects.
5+ years of work experience in medium to Python and cloud technologies, including designing, building, and deploying production solutions.
Strong programming and coding skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases and database design.
Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, analysis, and model development.
Strong knowledge of Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration of machine learning applications.
Passion for learning and staying updated with the latest advancements in coding and cloud technologies.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Solution Engineering id 4915418.

To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.

Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.

title: Associate, Full stack Engineer
description:
Do you want to make a global impact on patient health? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that integrates scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team is a key driver of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As an Associate, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer, you will join the Data Science Industrialization team. Your responsibilities will include implementing AI solutions at scale for Pfizer business. You will iteratively develop and continuously improve data science workflows, AI based software solutions and AI components.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Contribute to the end-to-end build and deployment of data science and analytics products and AI modules.
Develop server-side logic using back-end technologies such as Python.
Contribute to the implementation of data ETL pipelines using Python and SQL.
Build web applications with JavaScript frameworks.
Build data visualizations and data applications to enable data exploration and insights generation.
Maintain infrastructure and tools for software development and deploying using IaC tools.
Automate processes for continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD pipeline) to ensure smooth software delivery.
Implement logging and monitoring tools to gain insights into system behavior.
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and colleagues from across Pfizer to integrate AI and data science models into production solutions.
Build data visualizations and data applications to enable data exploration and insights generation (e.g, Tableau, Power BI, Dash, Shiny, Streamlit, etc.).
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and trends in your field.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience in programming languages such as Python or R.
Familiarity with back-end technologies, databases (SQL and NoSQL), and RESTful APIs.
Familiarity with data manipulation and preprocessing techniques, including data cleaning, data wrangling and feature engineering.
Highly self-motivated, capable of delivering both independently and through strong team collaboration.
Ability to creatively tackle new challenges and step outside your comfort zone.
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.
1-2 years of experience in software engineering, data science, or related technical fields.
Experience in CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub, GitHub Actions) and containers (e.g. docker).
Understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
Experience with data science enabling technology, such as Dataiku Data Science Studio, AWS SageMaker or other data science platforms.
Knowledge about BI backend concept like Star Schema and Snowflake.
Familiarity in building low code dashboard solution tools like Tableau, Power BI, Dash and Streamlit.
Experience developing dynamic and interactive web applications; familiar with React, AngularJS, Vue.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Cloudformation.
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Snowflake).
Hands on experience working in Agile teams, processes, and practices.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Associate, Full stack Engineer with id 4923011.

Role Summary
Do you want to make a global impact on patient health? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that integrates scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team is a key driver of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As a Senior Associate, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer, you will join the Data Science Industrialization team. Your responsibilities will include implementing AI solutions at scale for Pfizer business. You will iteratively develop and continuously improve data science workflows, AI based software solutions and AI components.
Role Responsibilities

Contribute to the end-to-end build and deployment of data science and analytics products and AI modules
Develop server-side logic using back-end technologies such as Python
Contribute to the implementation of data ETL pipelines using Python and SQL
Build web applications with JavaScript frameworks
Build data visualizations and data applications to enable data exploration and insights generation
Maintain infrastructure and tools for software development and deploying using IaC tools
Automate processes for continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD pipeline) to ensure smooth software delivery
Implement logging and monitoring tools to gain insights into system behavior
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and colleagues from across Pfizer to integrate AI and data science models into production solutions
Build data visualizations and data applications to enable data exploration and insights generation (e.g, Tableau, Power BI, Dash, Shiny, Streamlit, etc.)
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and trends in your field

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, or related technical fields
Experience in programming languages such as Python or R
Familiarity with back-end technologies, databases (SQL and NoSQL), and RESTful APIs
Familiarity with data manipulation and preprocessing techniques, including data cleaning, data wrangling and feature engineering
Highly self-motivated, capable of delivering both independently and through strong team collaboration
Ability to creatively tackle new challenges and step outside your comfort zone
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

Nice-to-Have

Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline
Experience in CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub, GitHub Actions) and containers (e.g. docker)
Understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
Experience with data science enabling technology, such as Dataiku Data Science Studio, AWS SageMaker or other data science platforms
Knowledge about BI backend concept like Star Schema and Snowflake
Familiarity in building low code dashboard solution tools like Tableau, Power BI, Dash and Streamlit
Experience developing dynamic and interactive web applications; familiar with React, AngularJS, Vue
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Cloudformation
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Snowflake)
Hands on experience working in Agile teams, processes, and practices

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer with id 4923226.

title: Manager, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Summary
Do you want to make a global impact on patient health? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment that integrates scientific, clinical, and commercial domains through engineering, data science, and AI? Join Pfizer Digital's Artificial Intelligence, Data, and Advanced Analytics organization (AIDA) to leverage cutting-edge technology for critical business decisions and enhance customer experiences for colleagues, patients, and physicians. Our team of engineering, data science, and AI professionals is at the forefront of Pfizer's transformation into a digitally driven organization, using data science and AI to change patients' lives. The Data Science Industrialization team is a key driver of Pfizer's digital transformation, leading process and engineering innovations to advance AI and data science applications from prototypes and MVPs to full production.As a Manager, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer, you will join the Data Science Industrialization team. Your responsibilities will include architecting and implementing AI solutions at scale for Pfizer. You will iteratively develop and continuously improve data science workflows, AI based software solutions, and AI components.
Role Responsibilities

Develop end-to-end data engineering, data science and analytics products and AI modules.
Develop server-side logic using back-end technologies such as Python.
Develop data ETL pipelines using python and SQL.
Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
Build dynamic and interactive web applications with JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or AngularJS)
Build data visualizations and data applications to enable data exploration and insights generation (e.g, Tableau, Power BI, Dash, Shiny, Streamlit, etc.).
Implement and maintain infrastructure and tools for software development and deployment using IaC tools
Automate processes for continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD pipeline) to ensure smooth software delivery
Implement logging and monitoring tools to gain insights into system behavior.
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and colleagues from across Pfizer to integrate AI and data science models into production solutions
Demonstrate a proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential system issues.
Contribute to the best practices of the team and help colleagues grow
Communicate complex technical concepts and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and trends in your field.

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in software engineering, data science, or related technical fields.
Proven experience as a Full Stack Engineer or similar role, with a strong portfolio of successful projects.
Solid experience in programming languages such as Python or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Good understanding of back-end technologies, databases (SQL and NoSQL), and RESTful APIs.
Knowledge of BI backend concept like Star Schema and Snowflake
Experience in building low code dashboard solution tools like Tableau, Power BI, Dash and Streamlit
Highly self-motivated, capable of delivering both independently and through strong team collaboration.
Ability to creatively tackle new challenges and step outside your comfort zone.
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

Nice-to-Have

Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline
Experience in CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub, GitHub Actions) and containers (e.g. docker)
Experience developing dynamic and interactive web applications; familiar with React, AngularJS, Vue.
Experience in creating responsive user interfaces; familiar with technologies such as HTML, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material, Vuetify
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Chef
Proficiency in Git for version control of infrastructure code and application code
Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack
Knowledge of serverless computing and experience with serverless platforms like AWS Lambda.
Good understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
Experience with data science enabling technology, such as Dataiku Data Science Studio, AWS SageMaker or other data science platforms
Familiarity with cloud-based analytics ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Snowflake).

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, AI and Data Science Full Stack Engineer id 4923224.

title: Manager, Front-End Developer - Interactive Experiences Specialist
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.Pfizer Digital is the organization charged with winning the digital race in the pharmaceutical industry. We apply our expertise in technology, innovation and our business to support Pfizer in this mission.The Biopharma, Patient & CDI (C4) team builds and maintains the platforms and capabilities that enable Pfizer Business Units to connect digitally with our external customers and effectively engage and collaborate across teams internally.  This includes all digital (web, mobile, omni-channel, & devices) products, platforms, services, and experiences in service of patients, HCPs, payors, pharmacists, or clinical sites. We build advanced cloud-based technology solutions at a global scale that positively impact Pfizer business performance.OmniChannel Solution & Service (OSS): Within C4, the OSS team is accountable for strategizing, implementing, maintaining, tracking, and evolving next-level digital capabilities for external customer engagement.The Content Experience, Innovation and AI (CXI&AI) team is part of the Omnichannel Services and Solutions (OSS) and responsible for cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of digital experiences within Pfizer. We craft exceptional experiences that captivate users and drive digital initiatives to success.The Front-End Developer - Interactive Experiences Specialist is a technical role leading/guiding the design and development of interactive user interfaces using front-end technologies, optimizing performance, and ensuring seamless integration between our systems. It requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, working together with other front-end developers, UX/UI designers, and product managers to turn ideas into polished, high-performance applications.The role is crucial in driving innovation and implementing cutting-edge solutions that enhance Pfizer's digital marketing capabilities and customer engagement strategies and requires a passion for immersive and interactive content technologies.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
Subject Matter Expertise - General

Define and oversee technical solution patterns and projects across immersive, interactive and AI technology initiatives.
Develop and maintain interactive applications and interfaces using a foundation of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and React plus other JavaScript libraries and APIs.
Have a deep knowledge and experience of React.js
Experiment with emerging technologies to support the creation of innovative and engaging experiences.
Integrate and manipulate 3D models within web and application interfaces to enhance interactive content.
Understand the role of Unity and Unreal Engine in developing interactive experiences and how they can enhance application capabilities.
Keep up-to-date on the latest trends in immersive technologies and contribute ideas to drive continuous improvement.
Tackle complex challenges with innovative solutions and a forward-thinking approach.

Strategic Leadership & Delivery

Take risk-based approach to advance new concepts and methodologies that are moderately complex in the evaluation and recommendation of appropriate technologies, platforms, and frameworks, considering factors such as scalability, performance, security, and integration with existing systems.

Resource and Financial Management

Manages and leads people, technological and financial resources within a department

Cross- Team Collaboration

Collaborate with the Delivery Lead, Service Owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather and analyze business requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including the Technical Services Leads and Platform teams, to ensure seamless integration and support for solutions with Pfizer's digital platforms and technologies.

Coaching and Mentorship

Actively share knowledge with others within department through existing knowledge sharing processes/systems on technical design reviews and solution evaluations to ensure alignment with business requirements, technological constraints, and industry best practices.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BSc degree with at least 5 years of experience OR Masters with at least 3 year of experience, OR a PhD with 0+ years of experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience in solution architecture, technical design, and implementation of complex software systems, with a focus on React.js
Minimum of two years experience with React.js and JavaScript. Experience working with RESTful APIs and integrating them into web applications.
A solid understanding of HTML, CSS, Node.js, and CLI tools.
Understanding of front-end development technologies, platforms, and frameworks, along with their strengths, limitations, and integration capabilities.
Strong proficiency in programming languages, development tools, and software engineering practices relevant to front-end technologies.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Familiarity with agile development methodologies, project management practices, and software development life cycles.
Passion for exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation in the field of immersive and interactive technologies.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, robust, and scalable technical solutions.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Manager, Front-End Developer - Interactive Experiences Specialist id 4924089.

title: Application Team Leader
description:
What you will need to do:

Lead and manage a team of application developers, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality outputs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project management, product owners, and other stakeholders, to align technology solutions with business objectives
Oversee the development, deployment, and maintenance of business applications
Establish coding standards, processes, and best practices within the team
Ensure that all projects are completed on time, within scope and budget
Perform regular performance evaluations and identify areas for skill development within the team
Handle resource planning, allocation, and capacity management
Stay updated on the latest industry trends and integrate new technologies when appropriate
Occasional traveling to project sites, if needed

What you will need to have:

BSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Five (5) years of experience in software development using frameworks and technologies such as PHP, MS SQL, TypeScript, jQuery, Laravel, and React
Proven experience in leading and mentoring a team of developers
Strong understanding of application architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), and project management
Fluency in English

You are someone who:

Is confident of your abilities and you like to present new problem-solving ideas
Can work with minimum supervision and you are eager to develop and get exposed to new things every day!
Can prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
Is a true team member
Enjoys challenge, working with different cultures and travelling!
Is resourceful and ownership taker
Pays extreme attention to detail

What's in it for you: 
Competitive salary and benefits are part of the offering, yet the real joy comes from being a member of smart and passionate teams, within an international leading EPC Group on a mission that matters. We create mega construction projects - literally around the globe - with meaningful impact on the local communities for the years to come. At Archirodon, you will find a proud, productive and human-centric culture, caring for and building on our people and their development!
Please note that you will be contacted only in case you are shortlisted for an interview. In the meantime, do not hesitate to stay in touch and keep monitoring our open vacancies and our LinkedIn page!  Rest assured that your application will be treated with strict confidentiality and under all applicable data privacy regulations

title: Guest Relations Manager
description:
Ιn a nutshell:
The Guest Relations Manager and team at Daios Cove is considered as a critical role for our guests’ experience, as they are the main point of contact for guests, turning their everyday moments into exceptional memories. Together with their team, a Guest Relations Manager ensure and provide flawless, professional, and high-class guest services throughout their stay, and provide direction to continuously improve guests and team experience.
Some of the responsibilities you will be entrusted with:

Ensure all guests, receive personalized services and oversee and coordinate all arrivals and departures.
Provide upscale guest service experiences starting from welcoming upon arrival throughout their stay.
Coordinate and manage communication between guests and our teams and follow up to ensure we resolve any guest concerns.

Proactively plan and react promptly to guests’ requirements and inquires

Our people and culture

Interviewing and onboard potential or new hires following People & Culture department guidelines.

Experience working with diverse backgrounds, respecting cultural differences, beliefs and practices

This role generally requires a relevant degree in Hotel/Tourism or equivalent experience in hospitality environment
Proficiency in English; knowledge of other languages will be considered a plus.
Leadership skills along with the ability to motivate a team into high performance
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to quickly work around different solutions, are critical success factors for this role
Requires the ability to be flexible and adapt to change

Some of the benefits you will be enjoying:

a pleasant and long session (around 7,5 months) 
ongoing training opportunities - both external and internal
accommodation in the vicinity of Daios Cove
meals within premises
use of Daios Cove Facilities according to the relevant policy…and a number of other perks, prepared as you read this job ad!

title: Electrical Technician / One&Only Kéa Island
description:
At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn.   
Shimmering in the depths of the azure Aegean Sea, a story-filled island of myths and marvels, One&Only Kéa Island emerges to honour untold beauty with authentic flavours of Greece. The warm Mediterranean hospitality is one of our most unique and valued assets. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect family day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
About the role
Responsible for maintenance and proper functionality of electrical systems and devices. Daily on-site inspections, interventions and reporting. Ensuring that safety measures are followed.
Key Duties and Responsibilities

Daily on site inspecting of electrical systems, filling of check lists and acting per instructions of direct superiors.
Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components to locate the cause of a breakdown and perform reparation/replacement on faulty elements, utilizing hand and power tools.
To follow preventive maintenance calendar and to ensure that all activities are performed accordingly.
Closely cooperate with team leader about given tasks and activities.
To be familiar with safety standards and legal requirements and to followed them in daily activities.
To respond promptly and accurately on maintenance request and work orders.
Timely and accurately reporting to superiors and relevant parties about completed and uncompleted tasks.
Record of all activities has to be properly filled-in in the maintenance software.
Lights checking and bulbs replacement.
Responsible for inventory and proper condition of personal tools, and large tools which are provided to the electricians on as-needed base. To report immediately about any failures or breakages.
Responsible for cleanliness and organization of electrical rooms and workshop.
Monitoring of electricity consumption and report immediately if any deviation is noted.
Searching for potential improvements in order to reduce consumption and improve work quality.
To follow up room maintenance as per Perfect Room Program
To attend department meetings.
To follow up spare parts stock and to inform superior timely when refilling is needed.
To liaise, actively support and assist to the other technicians on any issue.
To be familiar with the buildings BoH and public areas, all pieces of equipment and installation (electrical cabinets, cable routing, control panels, BMS, room management system, Lutron, Access control, CCTV, FLS systems, electricity meters and other electrical devices…).
To be familiar with main shut ’offs (water, electricity, heating and cooling, LPG) and to react quickly in a case of emergency.
To be familiar with FLS systems and procedures.
To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Skills, Experience & Educational Requirements

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.
Proven success working in a team.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals.
Excellent problem-solving ability.
Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.

title: Guest Relations Agent
description:
In your department: 

Ensure all guests, receive personalized services from arrivals to departures and everything in between.
Conduct a flawless check -in and check out process.
Provide information about amenities, area and venues and promote services.
Effectively resolve any guest concern and ensure timely follow up.
Proactively plan and react promptly to guests’ requirements and inquires.
Escort guests to their rooms, informing them about our resort's events and services.
Promote our resort's events and special/theme nights.

Our People & Culture: 

Encourage and build mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

Flexible and willing to take the extra step and support the team.
Open to receiving feedback and maintaining a continuous-learning attitude.

This role generally requires a relevant degree in Hotel/Tourism.
Previous similar experience in a luxury hospitality environment is essential.
Proficiency in English; knowledge of other languages will be considered a plus.
Excellent problem-resolution skills and ability to quickly work around different solutions, are critical success factors for this role.
Requires the ability to be flexible and adapt to change.

What we offer:

A very pleasant and long season (approximately 7 months)
Accommodation in single or double room according to the level (in case the selected candidate is from a different area)
Transportation from/to accommodation to/from the hotel
Car parking - in case you have your own car.
Free meals - even on your days off
Training - both online as well as classroom - for a variety of topics
A working environment which supports your professional growth
Use of Hotel premises (as per relevant policy)
Opportunities to work abroad during the winter, in one of the hotels we exchange talent with.
