title: Electrical Technician / One&Only Kéa Island
description:
At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn.   
Shimmering in the depths of the azure Aegean Sea, a story-filled island of myths and marvels, One&Only Kéa Island emerges to honour untold beauty with authentic flavours of Greece. The warm Mediterranean hospitality is one of our most unique and valued assets. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect family day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
About the role
Responsible for maintenance and proper functionality of electrical systems and devices. Daily on-site inspections, interventions and reporting. Ensuring that safety measures are followed.
Key Duties and Responsibilities

Daily on site inspecting of electrical systems, filling of check lists and acting per instructions of direct superiors.
Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components to locate the cause of a breakdown and perform reparation/replacement on faulty elements, utilizing hand and power tools.
To follow preventive maintenance calendar and to ensure that all activities are performed accordingly.
Closely cooperate with team leader about given tasks and activities.
To be familiar with safety standards and legal requirements and to followed them in daily activities.
To respond promptly and accurately on maintenance request and work orders.
Timely and accurately reporting to superiors and relevant parties about completed and uncompleted tasks.
Record of all activities has to be properly filled-in in the maintenance software.
Lights checking and bulbs replacement.
Responsible for inventory and proper condition of personal tools, and large tools which are provided to the electricians on as-needed base. To report immediately about any failures or breakages.
Responsible for cleanliness and organization of electrical rooms and workshop.
Monitoring of electricity consumption and report immediately if any deviation is noted.
Searching for potential improvements in order to reduce consumption and improve work quality.
To follow up room maintenance as per Perfect Room Program
To attend department meetings.
To follow up spare parts stock and to inform superior timely when refilling is needed.
To liaise, actively support and assist to the other technicians on any issue.
To be familiar with the buildings BoH and public areas, all pieces of equipment and installation (electrical cabinets, cable routing, control panels, BMS, room management system, Lutron, Access control, CCTV, FLS systems, electricity meters and other electrical devices…).
To be familiar with main shut ’offs (water, electricity, heating and cooling, LPG) and to react quickly in a case of emergency.
To be familiar with FLS systems and procedures.
To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Skills, Experience & Educational Requirements

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.
Proven success working in a team.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals.
Excellent problem-solving ability.
Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.

title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER / SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
description:
We look forward to meeting you at the kariera.gr career days on 12 & 13 October at stand 343!
Our CTO will be there to discuss career potentials with you!
 
PRISMA ELECTRONICS SA is an innovative, high technology company that was established in 1991 in Alexandroupolis, Greece. Throughout a consistent and continuous effort, the company engaged in a wide range of activities in the field of Electronics, Information Technology, Telecommunications and Energy. Today it is known for its popular products: LAROS (www.laros.gr) and XENAGOS (www.e-xenagos.gr), as well as the close co- operation with major research institutes such as CERN, ESA and NCSR Demokritos etc.
 
The R&D Department of Prisma Electronics, located in Athens - Greece, is looking for talented and motivated individuals that will join to our software team and work as computer Software Engineer / Software Developer on the design, development and debug of various software components and be actively involved in further progress of our solutions. Candidates must have the following skills:
 
SOFTWARE ENGINEER / SOFTWARE DEVELOPER- (Job code: SED-2403)
 
Responsibilities:
The Software Support Engineer is responsible for the implementation and support of software development used inside the company and Web. The role develops and prepares (in-house) software coding whenever there is a corresponding business need within a specified timeframe. The ideal candidate is expected to have a thorough understanding of technical concepts required for software engineering and deployment and should be able to navigate and quickly understand complex code and systems. The position demands excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and applicants must be able to communicate clearly and effectively. She/he should be a person with great technical passion, terrific problem-solving skills, drive for results and ability to work independently.
 
Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent in related technical field(s)
Experience in C# / .NET, Microsoft Visual Studio
Solid understanding of object-oriented methodologies
Ability to be self-motivated and team-motivated
Ability to work well in a team environment with developers
Strong communication, problem solving, and analytical skills.
Strong troubleshooting.
Fluent in English

 
Additional Requirements:

Experience with Mobile Platforms
Experience web development technologies
Experience with multiple projects
Experience with IT Troubleshooting

 
What we offer:

Competitive remuneration package
High standard working environment
Cooperation with International Companies & Executives
Ongoing training
Opportunities for career development

 
Please send your CV to address mail: ibd@prismael.com by referring the relevant Ref Code (ex. SED-2403).

Training and supporting users in the use of Entersoft Business Suite.
Anticipate and troubleshoot problems.
Collection and analysis of ERP user requirements, with the aim of finding facilitation proposals.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills 
Good knowledge of the English language

Satisfactory salary package, adjusted to qualifications and experience
Career development and growth opportunities in a dynamic and growing company
Modern and comfortable working environment
Continuous training and skills development

description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.
Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.
Responsibilities

Develop and maintain applications using IBM System i (RPG LE) and .NET technologies.
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to gather and define software requirements.
Design, code, test, and debug application software throughout the development process.
Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to industry standards and best practices.
Keep abreast of new technologies and determine their potential value in improving our systems.

 
Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Experience 3-5 years in corporate environment
Proven experience in IBM System i (RPG LE) application development and .NET framework.
Strong understanding of database systems and SQL.
Experience with software design patterns and architecture.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and collaborate effectively with others.
Strong communication skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Why Ayvens?  
With over 3.3 million vehicles managed across more than 44 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. title: Senior Associate, Solution Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARYTechnology impacts everything we do. Pfizer's digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives.The Digital Revenue Management (RM) Creation Center team manages technology strategy and delivery for the US Market Access (USMA) Operations Business within the Global Access & Value (GAV) organization. Pharmaceutical pricing is at the forefront of the U.S. national discussion for healthcare costs. The RM Creation team plays a critical role in ensuring patients have access to breakthrough medicines through efficient channels at affordable pricing.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Work as developer for developing and delivering reports that inform business decision making.
Work as developer for developing and delivering system enhancements according to business requirements.
Responsible for requirements documentation, business analysis and process optimization.
Responsible for coordinating the deployment process with various Pfizer Digital teams.
Responsible for work efforts across functional areas within RM.
Must be able to multi-task and perform a wide variety of tasks simultaneously such as organize presentations for upper management, perform system testing, and organize meetings.
Work with peers in Pfizer Digital to project financial estimates for small projects.
Manage business request prioritization with peers in Pfizer Digital.
Organize project deliverables for the Digital RM team.
Help promote the Purpose Blueprint for all projects.
Work with peers to manage project delivery through the system development lifecycle (SDLC) and through Agile Delivery.





BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a Computer Science or Business Management field.
3+ years of experience in a large corporate setting with an emphasis on solutions and application development.
Ambition to learn and utilize emerging technologies while working in a stimulating team environment.
Development skills in Oracle, PL/SQL, SQL, Snowflake, Informatica IICS, Business Objects, Tableau, AWS, Unix Scripting.
Willingness to take risks without fear of making mistakes.
Understanding of solutions delivery and delivery methodologies including Waterfall and Agile.
Strong organization and critical thinking skills.
Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technology solutions delivery in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment.
Competency in understanding organizational behaviors in a large corporate environment.
Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle management including requirements definition, design, testing and implementation.
Experience with external Contract Management vendor solutions such as the ModelN FLEX application.
Some knowledge of Java or a Microsoft platform such as .NET.
Knowledge of database, storage, hosting, cloud, application, analytics and services technologies.
Experience building relationships with both business partners and Digital technical teams.

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job Senior Associate, Solution Engineer with id 4918518.

title: Application Developers (Junior & Mid-Level)
description:
Who We Are: a leading business software and services provider in South East Europe and the Middle East. We offer an integrated business software suite with ERP, CRM, Retail, WMS, Mobile, HCM, e-Commerce and e-Invoicing as well as a range of software for Verticals such as Pharma Distribution and Pharmacies, Retail, Real Estate and other. With more than 20 years of experience, thousands of clients, a highly skilled Channel Partner network and more than 600 employees, we continuously invest in advanced technologies and professional development of our people.
We are expanding our Software Development team in Athens and are looking for Application Developers at both junior and mid-level. If you are passionate about building cutting-edge Web SaaS applications and want to grow in a dynamic, innovative environment, we encourage you to apply.
As an Application Developer, you will play a pivotal role in the design and implementation of our next-generation Web SaaS applications. Whether you’re just starting your career or have a few years of experience, we offer the opportunity to develop your skills and make an impact.
Key Responsibilities:

Deliver high-quality web and SaaS solutions as a member of an autonomous Agile team.
Evaluate software solutions and functionality according to business requirements.
Implement application functionality using Entersoft Web studio, a suite of tools to design rich web apps.
Participate in code-reviews to maintain code quality and share best practices.

Desired Skills & Experience:
We are seeking candidates with a range of experience. Whether you are early in your career (junior) or have more experience (mid-level), we’d love to hear from you!

1+ years of proven working experience in delivering software solutions
Bachelor or master’s degree in Computer Science or any other related field
Knowledge of SQL (SQL Server, Postgres, MySQL etc)
Clear understanding of UI/UX Design & Principles
Experience with C# .Net Framework
Team player with strong communication skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English
Ability to collaborate, perform and meet strict deadlines

Nice to have:

Familiarity with reporting tools (Crystal Reports, DevExpress Reports, Fast Reports) will be considered a plus
Knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript will be considered a plus
Knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) will be considered a plus

What we offer:
For the right talent that want to be part of our innovation-driven environment and high-performance culture, our offering includes:

Competitive remuneration package
Private health insurance plan
Training and development opportunities
A positive and supportive working environment
Free use of company bus

title: Network Engineer
description:
The Network Engineer’s role is to ensure the stability and integrity of network infrastructure. In addition, the Network Engineer will participate with the design, installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion.

Strategy & Planning  

Collaborate with department heads to assess near- and long-term network capacity needs.  
Create and maintain documentation as it relates to network configuration, network mapping,  processes, and service records.  
Develop, implement and maintain policies, procedures, and associated training plans for network  administration, usage, and disaster recovery.
Management of virtual/physical assets (ASNs, IP addresses, equipment inventory etc.)
Testing of new equipment for introduction into the network

Excellent knowledge of Ethernet & IP technologies and more specifically

IPv4/IPv6
Interconnection, IP traffic routing & switching and aggregation technologies
Routing: ISIS, BGP, MPLS
Security: L3VPN, IPSec/SSL VPN
Layer2: VLAN, STP, LAG, mcLAG
Service provisioning: PPPoE, IPoE, BRAS/BNG

Necessary qualifications:

University Degree or equivalent, in Engineering, Computer Science or similar
At least 3 years of experience in Ethernet & IP technologies, ideally in a Telecommunication Service Provider environment or related technology Vendor/Integrato
Fluency in English
Related certifications will be considered an asset, especially from Cisco, Huawei, Mikrotik
Soft skills: problem-solving abilities, effective communication and teamwork are all considered as a must

The MARM team plays a critical role in ensuring patients have access to breakthrough medicines through efficient channels at affordable pricing. The Manager Solutions Engineer will work alongside with US Digital Leads and the solutions delivery development team located in Greece supporting Revenue Management and Market Access of US market as a contributor on multiple projects based on client demands. The candidate will be involved with the business areas including Contract Strategy and Operations, Contract Insights, Customer Service and Trade Operations. The candidate will collaborate with various digital groups of Pfizer and external vendors. This role provides the opportunity to work with exciting breakthrough technologies, integrate with key enterprise systems and be part of Pfizer Digital.
Role Responsibilities

Responsible for managing, developing and delivering solutions through requirements documentation, business analysis, technical development, and process optimization.
Responsible for estimating work efforts for the assigned solutions/projects.
Manage business request prioritization with peers in Pfizer Digital.
Responsible for acting as onboarding resource and mentor to newer colleagues
Must be able to multi-task and perform a wide variety of tasks simultaneously such as organize presentations for upper management, perform system testing, and organize meetings.
Work with peers in Pfizer Digital to project financial estimates for small projects.
Work with peers to manage project delivery through system development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile Methodologies
Work with peers to manage external system implementation vendors to deliver on projects according to project timelines.
Act as a thought leader on emerging digital technologies.
Use technical acumen and knowledge of technologies to provide detailed advice regarding applications and executes specialized tasks.
Analyze trends, identify and lead implementation of process improvements.





Required skills and qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a large corporate setting with an emphasis on solutions and application development.
Strong development skills in ETL Snowflake, Informatica, Oracle, PL/SQL, SQL, Business Objects, Tableau, AWS, Unix Scripting.
Experience with cloud hosted solutions including AWS.
Ambition to learn and utilize emerging Artificial intelligence technologies.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills especially with customers.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Understanding of solutions delivery and delivery methodologies including Waterfall and Agile.
Can-do and positive attitude.

Preferred skills and qualifications

M.Sc. in a relative field.
Technology solutions delivery in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment.
Competency in understanding organizational behaviors in a large corporate environment.
Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle management including requirements definition, design, testing and implementation.
Experience with external Contract Management vendor solutions such as the ModelN FLEX application.
Knowledge of database, storage, hosting, cloud, application, analytics and services technologies.
Experience building relationships with both business partners and Digital technical teams.
Understanding of system auditing principles and guidelines.
Experience with external Contract Management vendor solutions such as the ModelN FLEX application.
Knowledge of database, storage, hosting, cloud, application, analytics and services technologies.
Experience building relationships with both business partners and Digital technical teams.

·        Participate in software implementation process according to requirements

·        Experience with SQL Databases

·        Knowledge of business processes with priority in Finance and Accounting

·        Strong interpersonal skills in Greek & English  
·        Eager to learn
·        Time management
·        Problem solving
·        Teamwork

For the right talent that want to be part of our innovation-driven environment and high-performance culture, our offering includes:
·        Competitive remuneration package
·        Private health insurance plan
·        Benefits such as gift cards, meal tickets, personal travelling expenses etc.
·        Continuous training opportunities and certifications
·        A positive and supportive working environment
·        Corporate laptop and equipment

title: Digital Analytics Specialist
description:
Digital Analytics Specialist
Amplifyd is a growing team of curious and data-led thinkers, who are genuinely passionate about Digital Marketing channels, specializing in performance and analytics.
We work with businesses spending more than $1M a year on advertising, becoming an extension of their team and prioritizing their long-term success, over our short-term profit margins.
Our approach? A blend of data-led planning, best-practice ad buying, tech & automation, and relentless experimentation.
Amplifyd has the expertise of a global agency, the personalisation of an in-house team and the agility of a specialist agency. 
A hybrid team across EMEA with a central hub in Athens, and we are proud to have a team that has worked with some of the world’s largest advertisers and scale-ups helping them make the right strategic marketing decision., and growing their businesses.
Recent finalists of the European Search Awards & Google Premier Partner awards, One of the few agencies who are Premium Google partners, Google Marketing Platform certified for Analytics and Facebook Business partners in the UK – we are looking for candidates to help us and our clients grow.
We believe in a global community, transparent relationships and changing work ethics.
Sounds like something you want to be part of?
 
You will be:

Analyzing and interpreting complex data to help driving strategic marketing decisions for our clients.
Implementing and managing web analytics tracking using Google Tag Manager (standard & ecommerce).
Implementing and managing tracking for marketing platforms (e.g. Google Ads Conversion Tracking, Enhanced Conversions, Meta Pixel, Conversions API)
Configuring data integrations across various marketing and analytics platforms using tools similar to AppsFlyer, Zapier, Hubspot
Creating and maintaining insightful and actionable reports using Looker Studio.
Conducting tests, troubleshooting and resolving tracking issues & data discrepancies between Google Analytics, advertising platforms and internal data.
Conducting Analytics and Tracking audits to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
Presenting analytical findings to clients and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.
Staying updated with the latest trends and advancements in digital analytics and marketing technologies.

Requirements
The hard skills we would like you to have:

1-2 years of experience with Google Analytics for data analysis and discrepancy troubleshooting.
GA4 Certification to demonstrate proficiency in Google Analytics 4.
1-2 years of experience with Google Tag Manager for tracking implementation and tag setup.
Proficiency in Looker Studio for creating visually appealing and actionable reports.
Good understanding of data collection, processing, and visualization techniques.
Excellent verbal and written communication in English

Extra points if you have:

Experience with server-side tagging and advanced tracking implementations.
Knowledge of SQL or other query languages for data extraction and analysis.

How a typical day in Amplifyd will look like:
Your day at Amplifyd some coffee and daily checks. According to the weekly plan set with your line manager, you'll dive into developing data tracking systems (using Google Tag Manager) and fixing bugs on existing setups.
During the day, you might have to deal with some more urgent issues like broken reports or the identification of data discrepancies and help explaining data discrepancies between platforms and/or reports. So, you'll also frequently be performing Google Analytics or tracking audits for new and existing clients and even present to clients, where you get to showcase your findings and recommendations.
Collaborations with the performance teams will be frequent, ensuring that your work directly contributes to client success stories. Expect a blend of focused project work, learning sessions to sharpen your skills, and meaningful interactions with a team that values innovation and results.
 
Benefits

Competitive remuneration package
Private Health Insurance
Flexible and hybrid working schedule
2 extra days of holiday per year
Young, dynamic and growing team disrupting the classic agency model
Rigorous training from Analytics, Technical and PPC experts to grow skills & expand expertise

Interview Process

Intro call where we get to know each other .
Technical interview stage where you are asked to solve a small exercise.
A call with the CEO

title: Senior CRM Strategist
description:
The organization
Why Join Us? It's More Than a Job in Retail, It's Your Story.
At Public Group, we believe in the power of our people in a sustainable way. That's why we're not just focused on what you do, but who you become. We're committed to fueling your growth, because when you win, we all win. Imagine a place where you feel supported, valued, and empowered to make a real difference.  A place where you can build a career you love, to leave your mark in our story!
Public Group strategically invests to create an ecosystem of innovative scaleups around its core Omnichannel Retail business, with the objective to provide exciting customer experiences powered by operational excellence. We bring together technology, talent & entrepreneurship to create value in the Greek market & society.
Our Omnichannel retail, in Greece and Cyprus, is the love brand Public, a Leading Omnichannel Home Living, Tech & Entertainment Retailer with long lasting heritage. Innovation is part of our DNA. Through our ecosystem of startups and organizations, - iRepair, Klarna, Douleutaras.gr, SVUUM, Bookvoice, BOX NOW, Instacar, our tech PublicNEXT, Endeavour, Big PI, Metavallon, & Venture Friends - we offer pioneer services to our consumers. We operate 60 stores, 3 eShops and an ecosystem of digital properties such as: public ticketing, public business and bookfriends.gr.
We are looking for a talented Senior CRM Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive CRM strategy that drives customer lifetime value across our diverse customer segments, both consumer and business. You will lead the orchestration of CRM campaigns, utilizing data-driven insights to optimize customer engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
 
Responsibilities: 

Leads the development and execution of Public’s CRM strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs. 


Enhances and manages our portfolio of customer segments, microsegments, and personas to ensure tailored and effective communication strategies. 


Oversees the preparation, execution, and optimization of targeted CRM campaigns across all channels. Ensure campaigns are relevant, timely, and aligned with customer journeys to maximize conversion and ROI. 


Manages and optimizes Public’s marketing automation platforms, driving the execution of an omnichannel automation strategy triggered by customer attributes, transactional data, and behavioral events. 


Implements strategies to grow and maintain Public’s contactable customer base, focusing on both acquisition and retention. 


Develops and refines a robust contact strategy that maximizes customer engagement while avoiding fatigue, ensuring a balance between frequency and relevance. 


Works closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Data Analytics, IT, and Sales to ensure seamless campaign execution and integration with other customer touchpoints. 


Establishes KPIs and regularly analyzes CRM performance, providing actionable insights to optimize strategies and reporting outcomes to senior management. 

 
Requirements: 

At least 5 years of experience in CRM, with a strong background in campaign management, customer segmentation, and data-driven marketing. Experience in industries such as retail, telecommunications, or eCommerce is highly desirable. 


Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or relevant certifications in CRM, Digital Marketing, or Analytics is a strong plus. 


Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), marketing automation tools, SQL, Microsoft BI, and Google Analytics. Strong command of Excel and PowerPoint is essential. 


Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and derive actionable insights. Creativity in developing innovative CRM strategies and campaigns. 


Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to craft compelling messages and present complex ideas to various stakeholders. 


Copywriting abilities, aesthetic and commercial perception, negotiation, and teamwork skills. A strong sense of self-motivation, enthusiasm, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences. 

 
What we offer:

Competitive compensation & benefits package
Bonus scheme
Life & Health insurance
Behavioral health programs
Dynamic work environment
Exciting opportunity to grow with the role

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and derive actionable insights. Creativity in developing innovative CRM strategies and campaigns.

title: Associate, User Success Engineer​
description:
ROLE SUMMARYPfizer's Chief Digital Office (CDO) leads the transformation of Pfizer into a digital powerhouse that will generate patient superior experiences which results in better health outcomes. The Analytics Experience team, which is part of the Artificial Intelligence, Data and Advanced Analytics (AIDA) organization, is responsible for the creating a seamless experience for analytics experts to harness the potential of big data, machine learning, and interactive analytics through a unified platform across the enterprise in all Pfizer geographies.  Part of the Analytics Experience team are a group of User Success Engineers who are responsible for onboarding, enabling, and supporting self-sufficient analytical users across the Pfizer business, to ensure seamless user experience in the enterprise analytics platform. This platform will be the digital engine that brings together investments we have made into a unified experience for colleagues that take us to the next level of value creation.  It powers next generation insights by developing enterprise-grade data foundations, allowing data to flow horizontally, enabling a versatile analytics environment, and embedding insights into day-to-day work to create a digital, data-driven culture. In this role, you will be the responsible for understanding end users' needs, providing technical guidance, and ensuring their success with enterprise analytics platform. You will work closely with platform engineers, and external vendors to address customer issues, gather feedback, and drive platform adoption through improvements. Smooth onboarding, ongoing support and robust change-management is critical to success in this role. As this role require both technical expertise and customer services skills, you will have the ability to develop technical proficiency and get exposure to Pfizer stakeholders.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIESWith supervision, you will:

Collaborate with cross functional teams and provide tailored solutions to meet stakeholders' needs.
Facilitate the onboarding and training activities to ensure successful adoption of the enterprise platform.
Partner with end-users to provide support and guidance.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve user experience and drive customer satisfaction.
Contribute and manage our knowledge base, community forums and community of practice.
Monitor and analyze customer usage data to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.
Up-skill to and maintain 'expert' status in one of our core analytical platforms.
Employ 'creative disruption' techniques to ensure continuous improvement and evolution within our methods and practices.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

BS in computer science, data science, or a related field.
0-2+ years of work experience.
Familiarity with database systems such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Experience in frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript.
Experience with developing, testing and maintaining high-quality code using Python.
Hands-on skills in data engineering, machine learning and/or data visualization.
Experience with analytical problem solving.
Strong communication skills (written & verbal).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

1+ years of experience in the field of data and analytics.
Strong hands-on skills for data and machine learning pipeline orchestration via Dataiku, Palantir or similar platform.
Strong hands-on skills in Data Visualization platforms (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire).
Containerization and underlying infrastructure knowledge to support performance and resource optimization.
Knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum).





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job ​​Associate, User Success Engineer​ with id 4916754.

description:
Angular Developers – Cyprus, Greece or Remote 
 
The Role: 
As an Angular Developer you will join a fast-growing team of highly skilled professionals. Your focus will be to deliver high quality code in existing and new Angular client-facing applications. In addition, you will have the opportunity to share your knowledge amongst other IT professionals and evolve in your career by pushing Angular to its limits.
The main responsibilities of the position include:

Build advanced front-end applications with the Angular Framework
Follow test-driven development, continuous integration and agile methodologies
Review code from other developers
Continuously monitor and improve application reliability and optimise performance
Run unit testing and automation testing
Contribute to system design and architecture

 
Main requirements:

Degree in computer science, engineering, or any other related degree
At least 1 year of work experience in Angular 2+ and TypeScript
At least 5 years of work experience in JavaScript development
Proven experience with REST APIs
Experience with CSS/SCSS
Experience with unit tests using Jasmine and Karma
Experience with Git
Excellent understanding of algorithmic complexity, data structures, OOP Principles
Solid understanding of the full development life cycle
Very good communication and interpersonal skills
Self-motivated with a passion for professional development
Fluency in English

 
The following will be considered an advantage:

Knowledge of NestJS
Familiarity with AWS Services
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts
Work portfolio of open-source projects and technical blogs, working knowledge of Node.js

Benefit from:

Attractive remuneration package plus performance related reward  
Intellectually stimulating work environment
Food allowance
Continuous personal development and international training opportunities
Attractive relocation package and support for a smooth relocation for you and your family

Type of employment: Full-time
Location: Cyprus, Greece or Remote
Please visit our website www.xm.com/careers to submit your online application for this position.
 
All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Scope of tasks

design and provide programming software and parts of the software,
creating new and changing existing elements of the software such as its functionality and performance,
based on the analysis of mathematical models and programming algorithms, development of software in accordance with the tasks set.
selection of the programming language for describing algorithms and data structures,
determination of the information to be processed by computer equipment, its volume, structure, layouts and schemes of input, processing, storage and output, methods of its control,
unification and typification of computing processes,
checking the functionality and compliance of the software with its functional purpose,
formation of the content of control examples for software testing,
development of automatic software verification systems,
preparation and debugging of the software,
adjustment of the developed software based on the analysis of the output data of testing and debugging,
start of operation of debugged programs and entering the source data determined by the conditions of the tasks set,
software administration, maintenance and modernization,
development and execution of user, technical and operational documentation,
preparation of a reports for managers on the work done and tasks completed (including a monthly list of creative works performed, i.e. works or parts thereof),
performance of other instructions and tasks of the manager within the scope of the Contract.

 
Requirements:

5+ years of commercial experience in Java programming with expertise in the Spring framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
Strong understanding of Web Services (SOAP/REST) and integration techniques.
Solid knowledge of SQL and practical experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), including ORM technologies (Hibernate) and query languages (HQL).
Strong expertise in React and TypeScript
Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure as code (IaC).
Good knowledge of AWS services and best practices for cloud architecture, with hands-on experience in Kubernetes (k8s) for container orchestration.
Ability to produce clean, high-quality code, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
Experience in designing and improving software architectures for performance, reliability, and maintainability in large-scale distributed systems.
Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Ability to work UK business hours and participate in on-call rotation.


English skills sufficient to read technical documentation (min. B2)

 
Nice to have:

Proficiency in Python for data processing, scripting, and integration tasks.
Experience working with NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
Familiarity with WebSockets for real-time communication.
Familiarity with AngularJS, Redux Toolkit, Vite
Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and integration of AI functionalities into production systems.
Exposure to monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack for effective system observability.

title: Senior Software Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are
Kariera Group is a leading key player for recruiting in the global job market. We empower employment through every product, service or initiative we produce and support, across Europe and Asia. We have one clear mission: to match the perfect candidate with the right job!
 
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Frontend Engineer to join our growing, fully remote team. In this role, you’ll lead the development of high-performance, scalable user interfaces for our products, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional user experiences.
As a senior engineer, you’ll take ownership of frontend architecture, drive best practices, and mentor junior developers - all while working with cutting-edge technologies like React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
If you’re excited by the challenge of building world-class interfaces and want to have a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!
 
Key Responsibilities


UI/UX Development:


Design, build, and maintain responsive, dynamic frontend applications using modern frameworks.


Collaborate with designers to bring intuitive, accessible, and engaging interfaces to life.




Collaboration:


Work closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to turn concepts into reality.




State Management & APIs:


Architect solutions that integrate seamlessly with backend services via RESTful APIs.


Use tools like Redux or Context API for state management.




Performance Optimization:


Ensure applications are fast, efficient, and scalable across all devices and browsers.




Technical Leadership:


Mentor junior developers and foster a culture of learning.


Lead code reviews and promote coding standards and best practices.




Testing & Quality Assurance:


Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using frameworks like Jest or Cypress.




Continuous Improvement:


Contribute to CI/CD pipelines.


Help evolve our frontend development processes to keep us at the cutting edge.




 
What We’re Looking For


Experience: 5+ years in frontend development, with at least 2 years in a senior role.


Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Next.js.


Tools & Processes: Familiarity with build tools (Webpack, Babel) and version control systems (Git).


Architecture Knowledge: Solid understanding of component-driven design, responsive layouts, and performance optimization techniques.


Testing Experience: Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks.


Bonus Points:


Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).


Familiarity with Docker, mobile-first design, and accessibility standards.




 
What We Offer


Competitive Compensation: Salary and bonus aligned with the role’s impact.


Private Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for your peace of mind.


Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere, with the option to visit our Athens office whenever you like.


Award-Winning Office Space: Our Omikron Building features an in-house gym and an onsite restaurant.


Growth & Learning: Access to ongoing training, challenging projects, and career development opportunities.


Team Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovative work environment where your ideas matter.


 
If you’re ready to shape the future of our frontend technology stack and make a tangible impact, we’d love to have you on board!

title: Experienced Java Developer @ Thessaloniki
description:
What Impact will you make?
Experienced Java Developer @ Deloitte Competence Center
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki that offers you a hybrid working model?
Are you ready to work on international projects for industry-leading clients around the world and elevate your tech consulting career to an international level?
If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
 
#YourOpportunity
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
 
#YourServiceLine
Technology & Transformation​
Our Technology & Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.​
 
#AboutYourTeam
Our Application Modernization practices support our customers, in various projects, in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions.
You will be part of a project delivery team, with colleagues in Greece but as well as members of other international offices, including Italy. Delivering front and / or back-end development tasks, as part of an Agile Scrum team. The projects will focus on the delivery of Cloud based and or related solutions and/or on cutting edge integration tools.
You will be responsible to:

Proactively interpret customer needs, identifying coherent methodologies and approaches; 
Develop initiatives and solutions independently, collecting and structuring data and carrying out analysis to support business decisions;
Enhance the contribution of the most junior colleagues and contribute to their growth. 

 
 
#OurRequirements
Key Qualifications

Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study
Integration at a consultancy firm or software house
Experience on modern enterprise tools and platforms, such as Java, Python, Typescript, Angular, Spring Boot, Spark, Mongo DB, Kafka
Knowledge of Relational Databases
Competence of the main web communication protocols such as REST, SOAP, XML, JSON
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability and willingness to work in a team, but also autonomously if necessary
High motivation for consulting field
Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English

Bonus Qualifications

Knowledge of design and architectural pattern
Exposure to any major public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

 
#WhoWeAreLookingFor

title: SW QA Engineer
description:
In Thessaloniki, GWF has established a modern Development Center whose mission is to create fresh smart-metering and IoT solutions that reshape traditional utilities toward smart city paradigms. We want to contribute to the local tech ecosystem and at the same time drive the company’s international growth. The team offers a vibrant environment, passionate bright colleagues, and a clear goal to transform IoT data into modern applications.
 
Key Responsibilities

Participate in the verification and validation testing of digital products. Understand product requirements and specifications, and identify problems in them, especially from the testing/testability viewpoint. Contribute to test plans with well-designed test cases for specific parts of the products. Execute automated and manual testing to verify and validate functionality.
Assist in harmonizing processes, tools, and methodologies for the functional workstream. Follow best practices and team recommendations and identify challenges in them.
Collaborate with development, testing and project and product management teams and document your work. Participate in relevant peer and code reviews. Actively participate in and contribute to team processes including planning, dailies, standups, retros, etc. Create and maintain synoptical and detailed documentation.
Contribute to a healthy local company culture. Embrace company vision, values, and mission.
Contribute towards program goals, ensuring schedules are met and deliverables are signed off in time, scope, and budget.
Assist in the evaluation of new and existing technologies to propose how they could be applied in new ways to solve problems (incl. pre-development/pre-studies).
Focus on growing as an engineer, learning existing tools, resources and processes.

 
Essential skills

Linux (also in the embedded systems context)
Python
CI/CD & DevOps (azure pipelines and similar, Jenkins and similar)
Test mentality (experience, mentality, diligence, completeness, coming up with Test cases, redacting test plans)
Digital Product Testing (Playwright, Appium, Espresso, Selenium)

 
Important skills

Networking (layers, protocols, TCP/IP)
Version control systems (git, branching models)
Full stack fundamentals: Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React - Remix, Next.js), Backend (Django, FastAPI), Databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Redis)
Cloud Services (Azure: API management, Logic apps, Function apps, Event Hubs, Service Bus, Webapps)
Test automation (relevant frameworks, triggering strategies, nightly/weekly tests, test setups on-prem & cloud)

 
2+ years of experience in testing, relevant certifications (e.g. ISTQB, CSTE, or relevant) and a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or similar rounds up your profile.
 
We offer

A pleasant, fun and achievement-oriented environment
Learning and growth opportunities in an international company setup
Full support for relevant training & lifelong learning initiatives
Medical Coverage Package
Modern, bright office with parking space, located close to the airport
Company Sponsored events

  Interested? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.

As a key member of our Legal Services Department, you will collaborate closely with the Business Analyst team to design, develop, and implement scalable applications that align with business needs.Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain robust front-end and back-end applications. Develop new user-facing features using Angular and React. Build reusable components and front-end libraries for future use. Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high-quality, responsive code. Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability. Collaborate with UI/UX designers and back-end developers to improve usability and performance. Develop and maintain back-end services using Python. Implement and manage RESTful APIs for seamless integration. Write complex SQL queries while ensuring performance optimization and avoiding deadlocks. Ensure code quality through comprehensive testing and debugging. Maintain high graphic standards and ensure brand consistency across all applications. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies, frameworks, and best practices to drive continuous improvement. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Hands-on experience with React, Angular, and Angular Material. Proficiency in back-end development using Python. Expertise in writing optimized SQL queries and working with relational databases. Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Token (JWT). Experience with front-end development tools such as Babel, Webpack, and NPM. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Familiarity with version control systems, primarily Git. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a collaborative environment. Benefits Competitive remuneration and benefits package. Bonus upon success. Private medical insurance. A team who is eager to provide the best possible solutions for our clients. Formal training and development of your skills. A place where your professional and personal success is our commitment.

applications.Strong command of TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3/SASS.Experience with component architecture, state management patterns (e.g., NgRx, Akita), and lazy loading for title: Angular Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Αt Relational FS we know that companies with a strong positive culture perform so much better. That is why every day we strive to create a collaborative and inclusive working environment where our people can feel empowered to succeed.
 
Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.
 
Responsibilities

Work closely with a business analysts’ team and stakeholders to design and implement the best solutions.
Follow industry’s best practices and standards.
Test and deliver high-quality software.

 
Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.
Experience in building SPAs with Angular.
Experience in Typescript.
Experience in building rich responsive/adaptive web UIs with HTML5 and CSS3.
Extensive experience in consuming REST APIs and in REST principles.

 
Desired Qualifications

Experience with state management tools (e.g. NGRX, NGXS, Akita, Redux).
Familiarity with version control software tools (preferably Git).
Familiarity with CSS preprocessors (e.g. Sass, LESS).
Familiarity with CSS frameworks (e.g. primeng, tailwind).

 
 
What Does our tech stack look like?
At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor

 
Why work with us?
 
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Through matrix organizational structure we achieve cross-functional collaboration which helps to increase efficiency, innovation, and responsiveness to changing markets. Along with that we introduced a software coaching/mentoring scheme which provides guidance, feedback, and support to software engineers or learners who want to improve their skills, knowledge, and performance.
 
You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Our company is people - centric and offers personalized benefits to each employee:

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

Relational Financial Solutions adheres to the General Data Protection Regulation principles by applying its Privacy Policy as published in https://www.relationalfs.com/legal-information/pri.... By submitting an application to this position and by sharing your personal data with Relational Financial Solutions you acknowledge and accept its Policy and authorise Relational Financial Solutions to process your personal data for the purposes of the company's recruitment opportunities, in line to the Policy.

description:
What Impact will you make?
Experienced Java Developer @ Deloitte Competence Center
Are you looking for an opportunity in Thessaloniki that offers you a hybrid working model?
Are you ready to work on international projects for industry-leading clients around the world and elevate your tech consulting career to an international level?
If so, check below for more info about this career opportunity!
You bring passion, we bring opportunities!
 
#YourOpportunity
Deloitte is a worldwide leader in Professional Services with a presence in more than 150 countries and territories. Since 2018, Deloitte has been operating its Competence Center in Thessaloniki with satellites in the cities of Patras, Heraklion, and Ioannina - which are model hubs of expertise, training, and innovation, specializing in cutting-edge exponential technologies, in which graduates and young professionals undergo immersive experiences, continuous learning, gaining practical insights and hands-on training that empower them to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape.
Deloitte is an ideal working environment for both young and senior professionals who want to take the next step in their careers, offering them a supportive and international working environment that leverages their expertise and potential. Its corporate culture is based on trust and collaboration and ensures diversity and inclusion so that everyone feels part of a great team.
 
#YourServiceLine
Technology & Transformation​
Our Technology & Transformation teams empower organizations to navigate the future through technology-driven business transformation. Combining deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge technology, we deliver tailored solutions that drive innovation, enhance efficiency, promote cybersecurity, and foster sustainable growth.​
 
#AboutYourTeam
Our Application Modernization practices support our customers, in various projects, in understanding and adopting the most advanced technological solutions.
You will be part of a project delivery team, with colleagues in Greece but as well as members of other international offices, including Italy. Delivering front and / or back-end development tasks, as part of an Agile Scrum team. The projects will focus on the delivery of Cloud based and or related solutions and/or on cutting edge integration tools.
You will be responsible to:

Proactively interpret customer needs, identifying coherent methodologies and approaches; 
Develop initiatives and solutions independently, collecting and structuring data and carrying out analysis to support business decisions;
Enhance the contribution of the most junior colleagues and contribute to their growth. 

 
 
#OurRequirements
Key Qualifications

Own a degree from a University or Technological Educational Institution in Informatics, Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar technical course of study
Integration at a consultancy firm or software house
Experience on modern enterprise tools and platforms, such as Java, Python, Typescript, Angular, Spring Boot, Spark, Mongo DB, Kafka
Knowledge of Relational Databases
Competence of the main web communication protocols such as REST, SOAP, XML, JSON
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability and willingness to work in a team, but also autonomously if necessary
High motivation for consulting field
Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English

Bonus Qualifications

Knowledge of design and architectural pattern
Exposure to any major public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

 
#WhoWeAreLookingFor
Individuals who have a strong will to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. We approach our work with a collaborative mindset, teaming across businesses, geographies, and skill sets to deliver tangible, measurable, attributable impact. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.
 
#WhatWeOffer
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits:

Modern hybrid workplace, characterized by flexibility and Smart Working
Empowered well-being: We provide multiple program offerings to support your well-being needs (flexible working arrangements, extra days of leave, parental allowances)
Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.
Constant opportunities for learning with unlimited access to internal and external learning platforms and sponsored certificates aligned with business needs and technology trends
Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work 
Team Building and Corporate Social Responsibility Activities
A buddy to support you with your onboarding
Private medical health insurance plan
Ticket restaurant card
Exclusive Discounts to several retail providers, restaurants and others
Mobile phone
Fresh fruits and unlimited coffee every day at our offices  

Please note that all the well-being benefits mentioned above are subject to annual review 
 





#AboutDeloitte
#OurServices
Deloitte offers integrated services that include Audit & Assurance, Tax and Legal, Strategy-Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with global business and industry expertise to help our clients excel anywhere in the world. We deliver outstanding impact on the reputation and success of our clients, in Italy and globally. In pursuing this we contribute to a sustainable and prosperous society, and are firm believers in the positive impact business can and should have on the world it operates within.
#OurPurpose
We are led by a purpose, to make an impact that matters with clients, people and society. This purpose defines who we are and what we stand for. It's not about being the biggest. It’s about being the first choice for the largest and most influential clients, and the first choice for the best talent.
#OurValues
At Deloitte we foster a collaborative culture where talented individuals can produce their best work. We value innovative thinking, diverse insights and a genuinely distinctive level of customer service through our expertise and professionalism. We value difference, with respect at the heart of our inclusive culture.
#OurTalentExperience
From day one at our firm, practitioners are part of a community. Our development and career progression framework will help them develop the skills and capabilities to succeed. The wellness of our people and the ability to offer agile working arrangements is at the center of our unique talent experience. We create a workplace that encourages collaboration, creativity, inclusiveness to ensure our staff are supported, encouraged and feel a sense of purpose and meaning in what they do each day.
 
Sounds like the sort of role for you? Apply now.
Location: Thessaloniki

description: Company DescriptionAre you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe? We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Are you ready to shape the future through technology? Your journey starts here. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/ Our fully inhouse Testing team consists of 240+ professionals and is Gold ISTQB partner. This is a team led by Test Managers, that serves the entire Netcompany SEE & EUI organization, bringing value and benefit in all the technologies we use and offer. Our Testing team is engaged with a vast portfolio of services, technologies, solutions and methodologies.Job DescriptionWhat does it feel like to be a Software Engineer in Test in Netcompany?As a Software Engineer in Test you will:Understand the business logic for the system under testFamiliarize with the architecture of the system under testAnalyze the tests to be automated and identify the most appropriate test automation methodology/technologyImplement and maintain test automation scripts/frameworksParticipate in PoC for evaluation of various tools, frameworks, methodologiesParticipate in the building of a CI pipelineAutomate tests for any of the following test types (functional, performance, usability, compatibility, cross-browser, component)Analysis of test results for troubleshooting, qualitative and quantitative analysisQualificationsWhat would make you a fit for the role:Degree in Information Technology or another relevant fieldExperience in Software Testing including expertise in writing Test scripts for Functional, Regression and Performance testsExperience in various tools/frameworks such as Selenium, SoapUI, JMeterWork experience in the creation of Test Cases, Test Scripts, Test Reports and participation in Test CyclesComplete understanding of the Agile Software Development methodologiesExcellent command of the English language (written & oral)It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:Knowledge in WebServices (SOAP & RESTful), Cucumber, Serenity, TestNG, JUnit, Mockito, REST Assured API and Jira, Jira XRay, Javascript, Typescript, Microservice Architectures, Kafka, Arquillian and Spring Boot are considered a plusWork experience in Java, .Net, Groovy, SQL, XML Additional InformationBeing a part of the Netcompany-Ιntrasoft team, you will be provided with: The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working modelA seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first stepsA competitive compensation & benefits packageHealth and life insurance programMeal and commuting allowanceWell-being activities (on premises)Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)A personalized development plan for targeted career growthIf you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!By joining Netcompany in Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2,300+ tech professionals. When at the office, you'll have the flexibility to work from our three modern, sustainable, and state-of-the-art offices!Please upload your CV in English via the Apply button. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our everyday working experience.In the following link you may find our CV Submission privacy notice: https://netcompany.com/cv-submission-privacy-notice/

title: Angular Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Αt Relational FS we know that companies with a strong positive culture perform so much better. That is why every day we strive to create a collaborative and inclusive working environment where our people can feel empowered to succeed.
 
Relational FS has an opportunity available, to work on complex and challenging new products, to drive transformative change for our top-tier Financial Services clients. Be part of both Product and Discipline teams through our Product-Chapter Matrix and develop state-of-the-art software products in the former, and an ever-evolving engineering culture in the latter.
 
Responsibilities

Work closely with a business analysts’ team and stakeholders to design and implement the best solutions.
Follow industry’s best practices and standards.
Test and deliver high-quality software.

 
Essential Qualifications

Excellent English communication (both verbal and written).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other relevant field.
Experience in building SPAs with Angular.
Experience in Typescript.
Experience in building rich responsive/adaptive web UIs with HTML5 and CSS3.
Extensive experience in consuming REST APIs and in REST principles.

 
Desired Qualifications

Experience with state management tools (e.g. NGRX, NGXS, Akita, Redux).
Familiarity with version control software tools (preferably Git).
Familiarity with CSS preprocessors (e.g. Sass, LESS).
Familiarity with CSS frameworks (e.g. primeng, tailwind).

 
 
What Does our tech stack look like?
At Relational FS, we pride ourselves on adaptability and keeping up with the latest technologies. Our current tech stack looks like this

Angular,Typescript, PrimeNG, TailWind
Figma
.NET C#
Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git
Kubernetes, Docker, Harbor

 
Why work with us?
 
Relational FS is one of Greece's leading technology software companies, with a mission to provide our clients with innovative, scalable, and secure software solutions that enhance their business performance and customer satisfaction. Through matrix organizational structure we achieve cross-functional collaboration which helps to increase efficiency, innovation, and responsiveness to changing markets. Along with that we introduced a software coaching/mentoring scheme which provides guidance, feedback, and support to software engineers or learners who want to improve their skills, knowledge, and performance.
 
You will collaborate with experienced and talented people, who will inspire you, mentor you, and help you grow. You will also have access to numerous resources, tools, and facilities that will enable you to do your best work.
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Our company is people - centric and offers personalized benefits to each employee:

We want you to be well compensated for what you bring in, so we offer an attractive salary package
Your health matters to us, so all colleagues have a private health insurance plan from day one
Developer’s fuel is coffee, and the supply source is in our kitchen!
We are excited for challenges, so you are invited to take part in exciting projects
We love the Relational vibes so we gather on smaller and bigger occasions to celebrate good times together!

Relational Financial Solutions adheres to the General Data Protection Regulation principles by applying its Privacy Policy as published in https://www.relationalfs.com/legal-information/pri.... By submitting an application to this position and by sharing your personal data with Relational Financial Solutions you acknowledge and accept its Policy and authorise Relational Financial Solutions to process your personal data for the purposes of the company's recruitment opportunities, in line to the Policy.
